chapters/prophecies/introduction.text: This is a list of all the missions in Prophecies, taking you through the storyline, as well as some quests connecting the missions. Characters from non-Prophecies campaigns who travel to Tyria will join the storyline at Lion's Arch, with the quest Report to the White Mantle.

references.title: List of Prophecies missions and primary quests

chapters/factions/introduction.text: This is a list of all the missions and primary quests in Guild Wars Factions, taking you through the storyline, as well as the challenge Missions and Competitive Missions. Characters from non-Factions campaigns who travel to Cantha will join the storyline at Bejunkan Pier with the quest Welcome to Cantha.

references.title: List of Factions missions and primary quests

chapters/nightfall/introduction.text: This is a list of all the missions and primary quests in Guild Wars Nightfall, taking you through the storyline, as well as the challenge missions. Characters from non-Nightfall campaigns who travel to Elona will join the storyline at Kamadan, Jewel of Istan with the quest Battle Preparations.

quests/quest:gww:295349/sections/objecti.text: Relive the events of the Canthan plague.

quests/quest:gww:295349/sections/notes-1.text: Once you have completed Cleansing Morostav Trail, you can take this quest to restore default spawns in Cantha, except in an area affected by any other Winds of Change quest.
This allows you to continue the Winds of Change storyline without abandoning Memories of Purity.
In areas with an active Winds of Change quest, you are likely to see the original spawns, in addition to those foes that spawn due to the quest.
The quest doesn't stop Winds of Change related dialogues between NPCs from happening.
To return to the Winds of Change spawns, abandon the quest from your log.

quests/quest:gww:295349/sections/instruc.text: [Flashback Quest]: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.

"Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out."
"Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task."
Once you have completed Cleansing Morostav Trail, you can take this quest to restore default spawns in Cantha, except in an area affected by any other Winds of Change quest.
This allows you to continue the Winds of Change storyline without abandoning Memories of Purity.
In areas with an active Winds of Change quest, you are likely to see the original spawns, in addition to those foes that spawn due to the quest.
The quest doesn't stop Winds of Change related dialogues between NPCs from happening.
To return to the Winds of Change spawns, abandon the quest from your log.

quests/quest:gww:2742/sections/requireme.text: To get to the Underworld, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). The party must be in one of the locations below and have a player either use a Passage Scroll to the Underworld or pay 1000 gold to the Voice of Grenth at a Statue of Grenth.
Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)

quests/quest:gww:2742/sections/objective.text: Your party has completed [0...10] of 10 quests.
Grenth has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the Hall of Judgement to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:2742/sections/notes-1/b.text: If your party wipes, you will be kicked out of the area. This will also happen if certain allies die.
Heroes can enter, but henchmen are not allowed.

Successfully completing all of the quests in a single session once will unlock the quest The Nightman Cometh from King Frozenwind. After taking this quest players can go inside the Hall of Judgement. When every player is inside the Hall of Judgement, Dhuum, who resides there, will become aggressive and players can defeat him. Defeating Dhuum will unlock a statue in the Hall of Monuments and allow each party member to open the Underworld Chest once.
In Hard mode, foes have a constant seven pips of health regeneration.
The Underworld is home to the Black Widow, which can only be found there and only after completing certain quests.
This area is popular for farming Globs of Ectoplasm.

Approximately 50 Skeletons of Dhuum, which can be farmed throughout the year for Every Bit Helps if you stockpiled Everlasting Mobstoppers, spawn in the Underworld without quests. From quests, there are additional spawns:
Unwanted Guests spawns nine Skeletons.
Terrorweb Queen spawns six Skeletons.
Servants of Grenth spawns nine Skeletons.Best guess per walkthrough of quest which is ambiguous
Imprisoned Spirits spawns three Skeletons.
The Four Horsemen spawns four Skeletons. Off of memory, being either one or two skeletons per horseman
If Gwen is a member of your party, you will see a conversation between her and her mother, Sarah. Yet another dialogue will be triggered if both Gwen and Keiran Thackeray are present.

Dhuum will not become active until all players are present and can enter the hall together: be sure to bring skills or items to resurrect any dead party members and ensure that none of the others walk away from the computer too soon.
The following Zaishen Quests take place here:
Vengeful Aatxe (Zaishen quest)
Charged Blackness (Zaishen quest)
The Four Horsemen (Zaishen quest)

When planning to complete this area in hard mode, it can be a good idea to first obtain the quest Miniature Companion: The Underworld from Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach. This quest rewards 2025 experience, 2006 gold and the Miniature Mad King's Guard.

Allies created by summoning stones are not teleported with the party when talking to a Reaper. This can cause wipes on certain quests. One example is getting the Reaper of the Labyrinth killed during The Unwanted Guests. If your party begins the fight with Dhuum before King Frozenwind walks past the gate, he will be stuck outside. About a minute after your party defeats Dhuum, King Frozenwind and the Ice Elementals will spawn inside the Hall of Judgment. Sometimes King Frozenwind will not appear once Dhuum dies and the chest will not appear as a result.

quests/quest:gww:2742/sections/elite-que.text: Important note: This quest is a legendary death trap for players new to the Underworld. It is important to advise these players not to take the quest before entering to avoid any problems caused by the groups of Grasping Darknesses spawned by this quest. Clearing the area of all Bladed Aatxes before taking this quest is beneficial. However, aggroing a number of Aatxes and Grasping Darknesses at the same time may serve as a stress test for the party, and show whether it is up to the challenges of The Underworld.

When a player accepts this quest three groups of Grasping Darknesses spawn nearby. Two of the groups spawn on the upper level of the beginning area and begin patrolling there. The third group spawns further away and will patrol from that point to the upper level of the beginning area and back. If the players stay on the lower area they will remain out of aggro range. The groups consist of three or four Darknesses each and aren't difficult to defeat for a prepared party.

After eliminating all three groups the doors out of the beginning area will open, revealing the paths to the rest of the Underworld. There are two paths which take you to the next target of the quest, the Terrorweb Dryders. The north-western path is shorter, but leads the party to a tight passage which leads to the destination chamber filled with enemy groups. When approaching from this direction it is hard to pull enemies one group at a time. The north-eastern route is a bit longer and has some small enemy groups in it, but pulling of the groups in the chamber is a lot easier from this side.

Be sure to kill all other enemy groups before attacking the Terrorwebs, because after you kill them a Reaper of the Labyrinth will spawn near the statue of Grenth in the chamber. If there are any enemies left at this point they might attack the Reaper and kill it, causing the party to be taken back to to the outpost from which they left to the Underworld. Speak to the Reaper to receive the quest reward. You might also want to save the quest reward for later on so that you can remove Death Penalty with it.

Important note: Advise all players to not take any further quests from the Reaper. Each of the quests offered spawn additional enemies, which might be hard to fight without extra preparations such as clearing certain areas of their regular enemy groups. Also, the quests Escort of Souls and Unwanted Guests are almost impossible to complete at the same time, because in Escort of Souls you need to protect a group of New Souls following your party and in the other you will face the nearly invincible Vengeful Aatxes.

The safest way to do this quest is to clear all the way to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale before taking any quests from the Reaper of the Labyrinth. There should be one or two pairs of Bladed Aatxes and four groups of Grasping Darknesses along the way. There is also a group of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights that patrols near the statue of Grenth in Forgotten Vale.

Take the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments from the Reaper of the Labyrinth which will spawn three Terrorweb Dryders at the monument of Forgotten Vale. Destroy the Terrorwebs and speak to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale which appears after this. Have him teleport you back to the Reaper of the Labyrinth and take the Escort of Souls. After accepting this quest a group of six New Souls will spawn and start to walk to the vale. At the same time, four groups of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn, one in the starting point of the Underworld,didnt have this happen just now, talk comment from 2015 asks the same, rng or hm only group? one in the wide hallway that connects the Labyrinth to the Vale, at the gate between that hall and the vale, and finally one group of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn between Mayor Alegheri and the bridge to the Labyrinth.

Do not teleport back to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale, which leaves the New Souls to walk to the first group of Mindblade Spectres. Instead, have one group member start the quest while the rest of the group stands at first spawning point and kills the group before the New Souls arrive. Try to stay ahead of the group of New Souls or have a good watchful monk.
Note: New Souls will walk towards Vale and will die before you can finish backtracking.

Note: Before taking this quest you should clear the entire Labyrinth and free the Reapers of Forgotten Vale and Ice Wastes so that you can use the teleport function to attack the Keeper of Souls from behind. The quest Escort of Souls should not be taken at the same time.

Once you accept the quest, six clusters of foes spawn throughout the Labyrinth. Each cluster consists of one Keeper of Souls, two groups of three Terrorweb Dryders, three groupless Skeletons of Dhuum and two groups of three Vengeful Aatxes. The Vengeful Aatxes are invulnerable, but they do less damage than Bladed Aatxes. In each cluster, the Aatxes and Dryders die immediately when the Keeper of Souls of the same cluster is killed. To complete the quest you need to kill all six Keepers of Souls.

In some cases when you approach a cluster from behind you can kill all Terrorweb Dryders without aggroing the Aatxes or the Keeper. After killing them you will sometimes have a clear path to the Keeper of Souls and sometimes you will be required to aggro the Vengeful Aatxes on the way. The Keeper of Souls is easy to kill, but if you have to aggro the Aatxes you might have a tough time depending on your party. If possible someone should tank the Aatxes while the rest of the party kills the Keeper or the Dryders. You can also utilize traps which will knock down and cripple the otherwise invulnerable Aatxes.
After clearing all of the groups you can return to the Reaper of the Labyrinth to get your reward.

Completing this quest will require you to travel the whole Underworld, killing groups of three Terrorweb Dryders at the six other monuments of Grenth. Upon accepting the quest one group of Terrorwebs will spawn next to each of the monuments. When your party kills one of the groups the corresponding Reaper is spawned next to the monument.

Pay extra caution at the monuments of Forgotten Vale, Twin Serpent Mountains and Spawning Pools. Kill the surrounding monsters before the Terrorweb Dryders, because otherwise they might attack the Reaper and cause your party to be taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld.

As the quest suggests, once a Reaper is freed, you will be able to speak to him and he can teleport you to any other Reaper that you have freed. The Reapers also have quests to offer, but be aware that taking any quests without consulting the party is unwise as they tend to spawn dangerous groups and might cause a party wipe if the party isn't prepared.

Note: Although it is very tempting to take the quest immediately after completing the preceding quest or soon after clearing one or two nearby areas due to the offered teleportation possibility, it might be wise to clear the furthermost problematic monuments before accepting the quest to avoid having to fight against the Terrorwebs and the other enemies surrounding the monuments at the same time.

It is highly advisable to have only one player take the quest while the rest of the party waits near the Bone Pit, where a group of four Tortured Spirits will spawn one by one as soon as the quest is taken. If any of these spirits are killed, you will be forced to go back to the outpost, so make sure that your team protects them. These spirits will attack foes, and actively run to enemies if they come within aggro range.

Almost immediately upon taking the quest, three Skeletons of Dhuum will spawn, one at each spawn point. Shortly after, a group of Terrorweb Dryders (both standard and silver) will spawn to the south (near the bridge), followed by another smaller group spawning to the northeast (by the small hooked pathway). It is important to position your party more or less on the spawns, so that the dryders do not more forward and aggro the Spirits. A third group of three Terrorweb Dryders will spawn near the bridge, further south than the first, about a minute after the quest begins. If your group is fast enough with DPS, both other groups will be dead by the time they spawn. If the Tortured Spirits hadn't taken any aggro, they will have already begun moving towards the Reaper.
Once you've killed the dryders and skeletons the spirits will walk to the Reaper and the quest will be completed.

After accepting this quest, the four horsemen begin their approach toward the Reaper from the middle section of the Chaos Planes. The horsemen, accompanied by several Terrorweb Dryders, split into two groups approaching from separate sides. The groups will attempt to eliminate the Reaper, returning the party to the outpost from which they entered the Underworld.
This quest is arguably the most difficult in the underworld, requiring a good strategy to survive.
Strategy 1: Defend the Reaper
Spread out around the Reaper and make your stand there. Keep your distance to each other and to the Reaper to mitigate the Dryders' AoE spells - flag your heroes if you brought any.

Your healers' priority should be to keep the Reaper alive. Everyone else must focus on dispatching or disabling the incoming foes. With a sufficiently strong party, you will outlast the waves, completing the quest.
This works well in normal mode and can be done with a 7-hero-team. In hard mode, more elaborate strategies are needed.
Strategy 2: Use the Choke Points
Use one or two party members to delay one side while everyone else kills the other.

This strategy needs a dedicated tank to draw aggro and block the foes on one side. A tank with permanent spell targeting prevention should be able to do it alone, otherwise help from a healer may be needed. The tank will last longer with knockdown prevention, Mantra of Flame and anything that boosts armor. The healer must be very careful not to draw aggro, keeping out of range, only approaching the tank when needed.

When the tank is ready, the other party members can accept the quest and intercept all spawns from the other side. Running as far as possible towards the spawns results in earlier kills, reducing the time your tank needs to hold out. On the other hand, staying closer to the reaper allows you to take measures should the tank fall.

You should clear the closest patrolling groups of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights before taking the quest. When you take the quest, five groups of three hostile Tortured Spirits spawn nearby. Four of the groups spawn in the village in the midst of the allied Tortured Spirits and start attacking them. The last group will spawn on the nearby hill and can be ignored until the other groups have been handled.

Killing the hostile Tortured Spirits isn't as simple as killing a regular level 15 enemy. They use Illusionary Weaponry with a high level of Illusion Magic, inflicting 40 points of armor ignoring damage per hit. A full group of three spirits will therefore cause a very high amount of damage if they gang up on a single target.

In addition to having to cope with the enemy, you need to protect the allied spirits. If all of them die your quest will fail. In addition, the hostile spirits will attack Mayor Alegheri and the Reaper after killing all other spirits. If the mayor or reaper die your party will be returned to the outpost from which you left to the Underworld. The allied spirits far away will most likely die before you can reach them, so make sure to protect atleast one of the nearest allied spirits. Even one survivor is enough. If possible a monk should concentrate on healing one of the spirits, but you can also use traps, AoE and interruption.
After defeating the hostile spirits in the village you can take out the last group on the hill. Then talk to the Reaper to receive your reward.

Completing the quest will spawn an unlocked chest and a Black Widow next to the monument of Grenth, allowing a party member to charm it. If charming the pet, remember to ask the others not to attack it when it turns hostile. The chest will drop a random purple or gold item to one random member of the party.

Tip: There is a trick to avoid the possibility of failing the quest. The friendly spirits you need to protect will spawn to the area after you kill the Grasping Darknesses near Mayor Alegheri. If you leave the first Darkness group alive, some of the spirits will not spawn making it so you cannot fail the quest. Just remember to avoid aggroing the darknesses when fighting the Wrathful Spirits. After you have cleared the area of most of the Wrathful Spirits you can kill the Grasping Darknesses.

Once this quest is activated, groups of enemies will start spawning northeast. Each wave consists of separate groups of two yellow Terrorweb Dryders, one or two silver Terrorweb Dryders, and one Skeleton of Dhuum. One group will head towards King Frozenwind, while the other heads toward the Reaper of the Ice Wastes (see the map). A total of three waves will spawn within a short span of time. King Frozenwind has four level 28 Ice Elementals to assist him, but they will fall quickly to the fire spells of the dryders. You must protect both King Frozenwind and the Reaper. If either of them dies, your party is taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld. You can either split your team into two groups which take one group of foes at a time or you can take all foes as a whole group if you aggro them at their spawn-point. Note that the following waves spawn quickly, so you will need to take them down quickly.

King Frozenwind and his allies can take down a group of 4 Terrorweb Dryders, thanks to his Ward Against Harm. This can lighten the load on your team if you position yourselves to primarily defend the Reaper, who is practically defenseless.

The Terrorweb Queen spawns in a small passageway accompanied by four Obsidian Guardians. Four Obsidian Guardians, three Skeletons of Dhuum, and four Terrorweb Dryders also spawn on each side of her room, so make sure to take caution when attacking these enemies. The Obsidian Guardians' regular attacks can sometimes knock down foes and they will use wards to defend themselves and the Terrorweb Queen. It is possible to first kill the enemies on one side, then to teleport to a Reaper on the other side of by talking to the Reaper so that it would be easier to defeat the queen when all of her guardians are dead.

It is also possible to simply pull the queen away from the guardians and to complete the quest from one side. She can attack from a long distance so the puller may need to back up further than usual to get her out of the defensive wards.

As soon as you take the quest the Slayer will spawn at the bottom of the hill and will move slowly towards the Reaper whom you need to defend. As there is enough room to maneuvre, make sure to do all fighting away from the Reaper. The Slayer itself should pose no threat, however after it will spawn four Keepers of Souls, four yellow Terrorweb Dryders and four silver Terrorweb Dryders. These groups will slowly advance to the Reaper simultaneously. It is possible to pull the Keepers of Souls forward to buy some time, but due to the close proximity of the groups this may instead cause all 12 dryders to follow.

In order to survive it is essential to spread the party out and negate the danger from AoE damage. The key to victory lies in the clustering of the dryders, where they easy to keep in check with AoE damage and skills like Panic. Due to the sheer number of dryders perfect clusters are hard to force, so deal with the situation as it develops and focus on dryders that are near each other.

It is possible to accept the quest reward after the death of the Slayer, but make sure you take out the groups of Keepers of Souls and Terrorweb Dryders before leaving. Otherwise, they will destroy the Reaper, causing your removal from the Underworld.
The Arena

While facing Dhuum, if you die or your death penalty hits 60%, you will be moved next to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale and turned into Spirit Form. Players must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; heroes are returned automatically. Consumables that remove death penalty or grant a Morale Boost can prevent this.

Death in Spirit Form is supposed to be permanent, since the Curse of Dhuum prevents the use of resurrection skills during this battle. But resurrection scrolls and "By Ural's Hammer!" still work, as does pre-casting delayed resurrection skills like Unyielding Aura before entering the room.
The Fight

There are two goals in this battle. One is to fill the Dhuum's Rest bar, which is achieved gradually with the skill Dhuum's Rest used by the Reapers and by players in Spirit Form. The other is to damage Dhuum directly, bringing him below 25% health. When both goals are met, the fight is over and you can collect the reward from King Frozenwind.

Throughout the battle, make sure to kill all of the Minions of Dhuum and Champions of Dhuum that Dhuum periodically summons; if you don't kill them, they'll swarm your team. Because of the amount of skeletons and the easiness of killing them, Edge of Extinction is a good tool for keeping their numbers down. Avoid using the spirit form skill Encase Skeletal, since it prevents the target from taking damage; as more and more come it gets harder to keep them all in check and easier for them to swarm.

quests/quest:gww:15060/sections/objectiv.text: Go to North Kryta Province and follow the road to the fort in the D'Alessio Seaboard. Once there, report your presence to Mantle Knight Karriya.

quests/quest:gww:15060/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head west to D'Alessio Seaboard. Enter the outpost and talk with Mantle Knight Karriya to complete the quest. It's a short trip; however, a few Fire Imps may cause trouble for low level characters. Bring sufficient healing.

quests/quest:gww:15061/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to First Spear Dehvad to gain entrance to the Training Area.
Report to Castellan Puuba in the Sunspear Great Hall for further orders.

quests/quest:gww:15061/sections/notes-1/.text: Koss, Dunkoro, Melonni, and Tahlkora are unlocked after talking to Kormir. They will all be level 15, rather than the level they have during the quest.

At the same time you will be given an extra copy of the weapons these heroes come with. These weapons are more powerful than the ones they're currently equipped with, and more adapted to their (higher) level.

When Nightfall was released, the 4 heroes were recruited at the same level that they were recruited in the Nightfall campaign (Koss at level 2, Dunkoro at level 6, Melonni at level 8 and Tahlkora at level 12). This was changed later, probably due to the fact that foreign characters were very soon faced with the Consulate Docks mission where all foes are level 20 (thus, rendering the heroes quite useless). At that time, Securing Champion's Dawn and A Land of Heroes didn't exist.
Characters who obtained heroes under level 15 are stuck with them, even if they have not yet completed this quest:
Abandoning the quest and retaking it will not fix their levels. (the levels were set when the heroes were first unlocked)
It is not possible to delete the heroes via support request.

quests/quest:gww:15061/sections/instruct.text: You must be the foreign recruits Kormir told me to expect. It's good to see so many heroes from beyond these shores coming to our aid. Spearmarshal Kormir is awaiting for you in the Plains of Jarin. You should hurry and catch up to her; she seems even more driven than normal these days and probably won't wait around long.

quests/quest:gww:283486/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283486/sections/environ.text: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Morostav Trail, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. The Ritualist's Construct also disappears after completion of this quest, which makes Soul Twisting much more time-consuming to capture without Memories of Purity active.

quests/quest:gww:283486/sections/walkthr.text: Leave from Durheim Archives and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. Try to only engage one group at a time.

quests/quest:gww:283486/sections/notes-1.text: With the exception of Initiate Zei Ri, all ministry allies do not resurrect if they are killed.

quests/quest:gww:320696/sections/objecti.text: Meet up with your profession trainer outside the city gate. Complete their test.
Meet up with Devona and complete her task.
Choose a secondary profession. Visit trainers to try out different skills from each profession. Once decided, return to Armin Saberlin.
Speak with Sir Tydus when you are ready to proceed.
Speak with any Town Crier to receive your reward.

quests/quest:gww:320696/sections/walkthr.text: Step out of the gates of Ascalon City into the idyllic meadows of Lakeside County. Your first task is to master the fundamentals of your chosen Primary Profession. Depending on your chosen profession, the available quest will vary:

Accept your respective quest and complete it. Once you have proven your basic competence, travel southwest along the road to the village of Ashford to meet with Devona. She will task you with investigating some Unsettling Rumors.

After you finish that quest, you must expand your horizons by selecting a secondary profession. Caution: Your choice of a secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game; therefore, it is advised not to lock in your choice until you are done with adventuring in this area.
The following quests unlock a secondary profession:

After you have firmly locked in your secondary profession, return to Ascalon City and speak to Armin Saberlin. Accept the quest A Second Profession from him (if you haven't already done so) and accept the reward from that quest to proceed. Then speak to a Town Crier for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:320696/sections/notes-1.text: This quest was added as part of the May 27th, 2026 update.
If you accept this quest after completing A Second Profession, the objective to speak with a Town Crier will not appear and you will be unable to obtain the reward.

quests/quest:gww:63264/sections/objectiv.text: Help the Dwarves locate and flee through the Asuran Gate.

quests/quest:gww:63264/sections/walkthro.text: A timer will appear showing "Time remaining to escape", giving you 3 minutes. The easiest way to complete this quest is to click on Burol Ironfist or Kodan on the way in to the meeting. After the meeting is over (or you and your party members click the "skip" button), just press the space bar to follow them. Your character will follow them, trying to catch up as they run their way to the Asura Gate, possibly catching up to them once or twice on the run. If this happens, just hit the space bar again. A lot of Destroyers will spawn behind your party and chase after. They can be ignored, and it is best to do so as fighting them will eat up time. As you approach the gate, be prepared for your character to stop moving when the NPC you were following enters the gate. Using this strategy, you reach the gate with roughly 1 minute left — provided you didn't stop to fight.

quests/quest:gww:63264/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest is automatically added to the Quest Log upon completion of the Encounter in the Depths cinematic of any one of the preceding quests. This quest is also automatically completed and removed upon entering the Asura Gate, and the follow-up quest, Against the Destroyers is automatically added.
The Quest Log says the quest is given in the Tunnels Below Cantha regardless of which continent you came from.
Trying to fight the Destroyers is a bad idea: the chance of winning is slim and it takes a great part of your time. Also, you can easily go to the gate without a speed boost and without any combat.
If you do decide to fight the destroyers, some things to consider are:
All destroyers during this mission are warriors, making them vulnerable to Blindness, Weakness and skills that can disable the attacks of multiple enemies, such as Clumsiness.
The fact that they are all melee-fighters opens up for the possibility of clumping them up and knocking them down with area knockdowns like Meteor, Earth Shaker and Grasping Was Kuurong.
Due to the time limitation, it is unlikely that you will have time to defeat all destroyers if fought individually; Consider running to the end of the mission and fight them all there.
Also see the Destroyer-page for general weaknesses of destroyers.
During the quest, the Guild Wars Eye of the North overture (from the login screen and character selection screen) plays.
Going through the portal will send you to the Into the North cinematic.
When "Time remaining to escape" runs out, your party automatically dies and a "QUEST FAILED: Your group did not escape from the dungeon in time." message appears.

quests/quest:gww:25445/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.
Travel with Brother Mhenlo to find his old teacher, Master Togo.
See Guardsman Chow for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25445/sections/walkthro.text: After leaving Kaineng Center, speak with Mhenlo right outside. Then follow the marker to Emi and Chiyo in a large courtyard area. After Mhenlo and the twins talk for a moment, the quest will update and you, Mhenlo, and his gang will travel to the Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) entrance, where Guardsman Chow will let you enter Vizunah Square.

quests/quest:gww:25445/sections/notes-1/.text: If you keep this quest active, all the quest NPCs will travel and fight with you in Bukdek Byway.
The Quest Log displays "Dockhand Quangnai (Kaineng Docks)" even though Bejunkan Pier is where Dockhand Quangnai is located and the quest is acquired.

quests/quest:gww:63397/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the Eye of the North.
Seek assistance from the Asura. (The Knowledgeable Asura)
Gain the Norn as allies. (Northern Allies)
Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands. (The Missing Vanguard)
Look into the scrying pool at the Eye of the North.
Seek out Jalis Ironhammer and help summon the power of the Great Dwarf. (Heart of the Shiverpeaks)
Eliminate the Destroyers. (A Time for Heroes)

quests/quest:gww:63397/sections/walkthro.text: Leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside. Follow the quest marker north and into the Eye of the North. Once there, you will be directed into the Hall of Monuments. Speak with Gwen and look into the Scrying Pool. Choose to keep your eyes open to receive The First Vision and three primary quests:
These three quests can be done in any order. When all three are completed, look into the Scrying Pool once more. Select "Look Deep into the Pool" to activate The Final Vision.
Your next task is to travel to Jalis Ironhammer, receiving the quest Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
Upon completion, Jalis will give you the quest Destruction's Depths. While this is not part of the quest objectives, it is needed to reach the Central Transfer Chamber where the final task awaits.

Once inside the Central Transfer Chamber, talk to High Priest Alkar to receive the final quest, A Time for Heroes. Finishing it marks the end of Eye of the North's storyline and sends you to the Epilogue, where you can receive the quest reward and a Droknar's Key from Droknar.

quests/quest:gww:63397/sections/notes-1/.text: Even if the quest objectives, markers and exclamation marks update properly at the scrying pool, the First Vision will not be available until you talk to Jora in Ice Cliff Chasms.
This quest is automatically added to the quest log upon completion of the preceding quest. Unlike most quests, it cannot be abandoned. This is due to not being able to reacquire it.

Once you leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside, you can either walk back or map travel back to the station, leave again, and collect the Norn Bounty at the resurrection shrine. If you continue on directly to the Eye of the North, you cannot get it until further along the path.

quests/quest:gww:7679/sections/objective.text: Travel to the Sunspear watch post.

quests/quest:gww:7679/sections/walkthrou.text: Start the Tutorial by speaking to Kormir. She will explain how to walk and how to interact with other characters. Go to the chest behind you, open it, and pick up the weapon. then go into your Inventory and equip it (either by double-clicking it, or dragging it to your weapon slot). Speak to Kormir once again to continue. She will then explain Quests and how to use the Compass. Follow her toward the gate, where she explains how Loot Drops work.

Now you have to kill 3 Corsair Spies; just attack them and they will die quickly. Afterward, proceed towards the resurrection shrine…where you will die quickly (as Kormir explains Death and the Death Penalty). There you will also learn your first 3 skills and she will explain how to use them.

Proceed to the next two groups of corsairs and kill them. While running, listen as Kormir explains the Aggro Range Circle on your compass. Speak to Kormir again to get your reward. She will explain what Attribute Points and Skill Points are. Speak to her again to get your next primary quest.

quests/quest:gww:7679/sections/notes-1/b.text: Dying during the tutorial explanation of the resurrection shrine does not increase the number of deaths you have taken (see /deaths).
Kneeling at the resurrection shrine will summon the Avatar of Dwayna, but she will not talk to you nor offer any blessings.

Before talking to Kormir and beginning the tutorial, obtain your weapon from the Weapons Chest and scrape the entire area, which will add 0.5% toward the Elonian Cartographer title (as well as some experience and treasure from killing the Corsairs in the water -- you might have to engage in tactical retreats from the Corsair Healer, who is the same level as you, but who apparently cannot heal). After talking to Kormir and completing the tutorial, you should have a total of 0.8% toward the Elonian Cartographer title.
This quest will stay in your Quest Log when leaving the zone (such as when entering the Guild Hall or resigning), but will be automatically removed upon re-entry to the Island of Shehkah instance.

quests/quest:gww:7682/sections/objective.text: See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:7682/sections/walkthrou.text: Walk to First Spear Jahdugar and speak with him. Choose to enter. That's it.

quests/quest:gww:7682/sections/notes-1/b.text: Resigning after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't talked to First Spear Jahdugar.

quests/quest:gww:12189/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Instructor Ng at the gate.
See Instructor Ng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:12189/sections/walkthro.text: Follow Instructor Ng and speak to him each time he requests. Kill all the mantids on the way. After you are resurrected at the resurrection shrine, you receive two skills.

quests/quest:gww:12189/sections/notes-1/.text: Despite Instructor Ng implying he has given Kisai and Mai two skills each, they actually both possess their full starting henchman skill bars, and use them against the two hatchlings before the resurrection shrine as well.
Mai also uses Viper's Defense despite usually only gaining that skill at level 10.
If you resign while in the area the Krytan loading screen will be seen briefly, then quickly change to the Shing Jea loading screen.

quests/quest:gww:2170/sections/objective.text: Go to the town square in Ascalon City. Talk to Sir Tydus.

quests/quest:gww:2170/sections/walkthrou.text: Head north from the Town Crier, crossing the stone bridge. You will find Sir Tydus on a podium just in front of the gate to the Ascalon Academy. Speak to him to claim your reward and learn of his news.

quests/quest:gww:2170/sections/notes-1/b.text: While it acts as an introduction to the questing system, this quest is entirely optional. You can proceed directly to Sir Tydus to begin War Preparations. The only thing you will miss is a small amount of gold and experience.

quests/quest:gww:63663/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Vekk in the Hall of Monuments.
Journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations.
Assemble a krewe for project G.O.L.E.M.
Recruit Gadd to help with the project. (Finding the Bloodstone)
Enlist Oola to help with the project. (The Elusive Golemancer)
Acquire Renk's help with the project.
Protect the golem foundry from the Destroyers. (Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation)

quests/quest:gww:63663/sections/walkthro.text: If starting from Olafstead, journey south-west through Varajar Fells to Verdant Cascades. Continue traveling west to Umbral Grotto.
For new characters starting from the Eye of the North, you can travel west into Battledepths then follow the northern route to reach Varajar Fells. The mini map will display where the exit is.
From Umbral Grotto, travel through the dungeon Vloxen Excavations to the south western exit on level 1. Be wary of rolling boulders, they will instantly kill anything in their path.
After the cinematic, adventurers will find themselves in Vlox's Falls. From here on, the story branches into three separate quest chains.
Take the quest Finding Gadd from Livia. Upon completion, you are offered the quest Finding the Bloodstone. Finish it to recruit Gadd.

Take the quest Lab Space from Lork. It will lead you to Rata Sum. On your way there, consider making a little detour to advance Renk's quest chain (see below) or to unlock Tarnished Haven. Either way, completing Lab Space will directly lead to The Elusive Golemancer, gaining the support from Oola.

Take the quest A Little Help from Plaxx. As mentioned above, the first objective can be completed on your way to Rata Sum. The remaining objectives can only be completed after recruiting the other two Asura, making Renk the final addition to your krewe.
When turning in the last quest at Mamp, pick the follow-up quest, Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, and complete it.
Talk to Mamp again to finish the asuran storyline and claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63663/sections/notes-1/.text: Upon completion of the quest, you are automatically under the effect of Call of the Eye.

Despite the third objective asking the player to journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations, the objective is considered complete and the cinematic will begin if the player is able to enter Vlox's Falls from Arbor Bay.

quests/quest:gww:66317/sections/objectiv.text: Head southeast to the Shards of Orr. Use the Asura Gate inside the entrance to gain access to Gadd's Encampment. Rendezvous there with Bartholos.
Join Livia and Gadd in Sparkfly Swamp.
Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.
Return to the entrance of the Bloodstone Caves.
Activate the inscription and gain entrance to the Bloodstone Caves.

quests/quest:gww:66317/sections/walkthro.text: This is a fairly long quest and you should have around fifty minutes devoted to do it. To get to the Shards of Orr dungeon, start at Vlox's Falls and head southeast. The Krait along the way should be relatively easy.

Once inside the dungeon, it is very helpful to take your time with the skeletons and zombies. Two groups at once will be very dangerous to the party. Holy damage is effective, while physical attackers will have trouble due to the many blinding skills. One method is to bring seven heroes with "Charge!"/"Incoming!" and/or "Fall Back!" and stagger their uses in order to run right past the enemies. If the party racks up too much Death Penalty, the zombie groups can be impossible to kill. It's sometimes possible to get past them by creative flagging of henchmen/heroes. Flag your healers off to the sides and a strong tank in front of the first group. Flag the rest of your henchmen on the second group, off to the side so they don't get tangled up in the first group. An alternate way is to take the north side when you reach the breach halfway through the map, because there are only two groups up there and no healers (however there are more warriors to do heavy damage). After half a dozen tries you should be able to pass them and activate the next Resurrection Shrine. Once you activate the second shrine, you can follow the path on the quest map to avoid the remaining mobs all together.

Once Gadd's Encampment is reached, talk to Bartholos. Head outside and to the right towards the Bloodstone Caves to meet Gadd and Livia at point L on the quest map. At first you cannot enter the Bloodstone Caves, but Gadd will be able to lift the seal by deciphering inscriptions that are tattooed on nearby Inscribed Ettins. Follow the quest markers to each of the three Ettins marked 1-3 on the quest map to the right. After killing them, make sure Livia gets close enough to extract the inscriptions. There are many roaming Raptor groups in this area, you may want to take care of them before engaging the Ettins. Return to the cave entrance at point L to let Gadd decipher the inscriptions and collect your reward from the Inscription Stone.

quests/quest:gww:66317/sections/notes-1/.text: You may wish to avoid bringing minion masters on this quest since there are many wandering groups around the Ettins that the minions will aggro. As a result, you will find yourself defending against more groups than you intended to fight.
If you have not recruited Hayda, with Frogstomp active, you can meet her and either do that quest first, or just let her help you with the Sparkfly Swamp phase of the Gadd/Bloodstone quest.
Leaving the area of Sparkfly Swamp at any part of the quest will reset it and make you repeat, including when you enter the Bloodstone Caves before Gadd completed deciphering the inscriptions.

Gadd and Livia do not attack or use any skills that exploit corpses (Well of Blood) or target foes, but they do bodyblock allies and foes. They can only be harmed by area of effect skills because foes cannot directly target them.
If you have the Lost Souls quest, abandon it or the portal will be blocked by an angry mob.

quests/quest:gww:25374/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
Seek out Headmaster Zhan in the monastery.

quests/quest:gww:25374/sections/walkthro.text: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills once you load into the Monastery.

You will also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Sword after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Zhan, who is nearby, for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25374/sections/notes-1/.text: If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.

quests/quest:gww:2766/sections/objective.text: Make your way to Chahbek Village.
See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:2766/sections/walkthrou.text: Escort Kormir, Koss and 3 Sunspear Recruits to First Spear Jahdugar just outside Chahbek Village. Along the way, 2 Corsairs will popup, however they are easily defeated.

quests/quest:gww:2766/sections/notes-1/b.text: Accepting the quest unlocks three skills for the character to use.
Resurrection Signet, and 2 profession skills as follows:
Re-entering the Island of Shehkah zone by any means after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't completed any of the objectives.

quests/quest:gww:3286/sections/requireme.text: Primary profession test (elementalist, mesmer, monk, necromancer, ranger, or warrior) not completed.

quests/quest:gww:3286/sections/objective.text: Go out the gate to Lakeside County and talk to .

quests/quest:gww:3286/sections/walkthrou.text: Go through the Lakeside County gate to the northwest and leave Ascalon City. Your profession trainer will be standing directly outside. Speak to them to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:3286/sections/notes-1/b.text: Though this is a primary quest, it can actually be skipped. You can proceed directly to the profession trainer outside the city in Lakeside County. The only thing you will miss is the experience reward. This quest will then be unavailable upon completion of the Test quest.
This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to leave pre-Searing.

quests/quest:gww:4569/sections/requireme.text: To start the mission, Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Into Chahbek Village or Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial). However, they can be ferried into the mission by another character, and will receive full credit for mission completion.
Characters from other campaigns should talk to Historian Laharo, in the southeast corner of Churrhir Fields.
Koss must be present in the party.

quests/quest:gww:4569/sections/objective.text: Destroy the corsairs occupying the village.
Sink the corsair ship on the north side of the village.
Sink the corsair ship on the south side of the village.
*BONUS* Keep as many Sunspear Recruits alive as possible.

quests/quest:gww:4569/sections/rewards-1.text: The reward for this mission depends on how many Sunspear Recruits are still alive at the end. This tutorial's normal mode rewards are substantially less than that of other missions. Nightfall Surviving recruits Sunspear 0 - 1 2 3 0 - 1 2 3 250 750 1,000 1,000 2,000 3,000 20 30 50 200 300 500 5 5 5 50 50 50

quests/quest:gww:4569/sections/walkthrou.text: Eliminate all of the corsairs attacking the village, including those on the boats on the right and left sides of the map. You are aided in your efforts by the presence of a level 20 Kormir and a handful of Sunspear recruits.

After killing the corsairs near the village's entrance, you have a choice: follow Kormir's advice and sink the two vessels using Istani Fire Oil fired from the catapults or kill the ship-based corsairs using ranged attacks. If you choose the first method, make your way to the fire oil and carry it to one of the catapults: click once to load the weapon and click again to fire it. Each ship you sink will provide a morale boost. Kill the boss next and then clear out the remainder of the corsairs.
You can speed things up by flagging koss and any henchmen to kill corsairs while you sink the ships.
The recruits sometimes are slow to engage mobs. If this happens, step closer to the enemy so that foes are within aggro range of the sunspears.
Keep as many of the Sunspear recruits alive as possible. If you confront one group at a time, there is almost no risk to losing any to the corsairs, especially if you sink the ships early.

In hard mode, there are only two risky spots: attacking the boss (who can manage to kill one of the recruits) and confronting the 3-4 mobs of corsairs in the upper right. However, you can easily succeed with any balanced group that can deal some damage and heal the recruits as well as party members. When engaging groups, take out the Corsair Healers first and any of their spellcasters next. Take advantage of the morale boosts you get for sinking the ships and go after the boss before tackling the overlapping groups.
Bring condition removal skills, since nearly all foes inflict some condition.
In normal mode, non-boss foes do not use any skills. In hard mode, all foes only use one skill, so you can easily disable them. This makes Wastrel's Demise and Worry effective in both modes.
None of the foes carry hex spells or hex removal skills.

quests/quest:gww:4569/sections/notes-1/b.text: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.

The boss (Midshipman Bennis) has Natural Resistance, unlike most in Elona. Consider bringing along Wastrel's Worry for damage as often as you can afford to cast it, or Lightning Surge, for an almost-instant knockdown.

It is possible for a new paragon to acquire Harrier's Toss from the boss (instead of waiting to reach the skill trainer that has the skill for unlocking) if they visit their guild hall first and buy a Signet of Capture.
After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Churrhir Fields.
Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #11 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.

quests/quest:gww:66322/sections/objectiv.text: Locate the laboratory of Oola, the Asuran master golemancer.
Find Oola's former assistant, Blimm, in Rata Sum.
Travel with Blimm to the secret entrance to Oola's Lab in Magus Stones.
Defeat the timberland guardian and pick a vine seed from its remains to open the bridge to Oola's Lab.
Speak to Blimm about the secret entrance to Oola's Lab.

quests/quest:gww:66322/sections/walkthro.text: Start off by talking to Blimm in Rata Sum to update the quest. Meet him in Magus Stones (right outside Rata Sum) with the party you will need for The Elusive Golemancer (follows on). Fight your way through Magus Stones taking care about patrols of Wind Riders. Wind Riders move quickly and aggroing several mobs at once can easily result in healers being overwhelmed. The actual Timberland Guardian is very weak since it's on its own.

quests/quest:gww:66322/sections/rewards-.text: Oola didn't fire me. I quit. She moved my desk into the cellar and stopped paying me. After a couple of months, I left. I think she took my staff, too...that's why I left. I loved that staff. Someday I'm going to burn her lab down if I don't get it back. Oh yes! Well anyway, you'll find Oola's lab below all the traps. Good luck disarming them. If I had my staff I'd help you. When you're ready to enter, speak to me and I'll use this vine seed to open the path to Oola's Lab.

quests/quest:gww:66322/sections/notes-1/.text: If someone in your party has the quest The Elusive Golemancer, he can teleport you across Magus Stones leading directly to Timberland Guardian by talking to Blimm a short distance west from the entrance of Rata Sum.

quests/quest:gww:25378/sections/objectiv.text: Search Sunqua Vale for Talon Silverwing.

quests/quest:gww:25378/sections/walkthro.text: Talon is in the northwest of the vale.

quests/quest:gww:11772/sections/objectiv.text: Go southwest along the road to find the skale. Clear the river of skale.
Return to Van the Warrior for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11772/sections/walkthro.text: Follow your compass marker and kill the three skale in the area. Then return back to Van the Warrior.

quests/quest:gww:66490/sections/objectiv.text: Seek Renk in Riven Earth and recruit him for the project.
Meet Renk at his laboratory in Alcazia Tangle once you've recruited Gadd and Oola.
Talk to Mamp in Rata Sum regarding the G.O.L.E.M. project.

quests/quest:gww:66490/sections/walkthro.text: This is a 3 part quest that begins with finding Renk, recruiting both Gadd and Oola (each requiring two more quests), and meeting up again with Renk.

Part 1: The quest begins after speaking with Plaxx in Vlox's Falls. Map travel to Rata Sum and either follow the quest marker east (map 1) or taking the alternative route with fewer foes (map 1a). You will find Renk by the base of the great waterfalls.
Part 2: Next, you recruit both Gadd and Oola (in any order): Gadd requires completion of Finding Gadd and Finding the Bloodstone; Oola's recruitment requires Lab Space and The Elusive Golemancer.

Part 3: Return to Rata Sum and exit into Magus Stones, follow quest map 2. Along the way, you will encounter 24 spiders (rangers, paragons, and monks); there are five groups, two of which are popups. You can directly zone into Alcazia Tangle or considering first killing the nearby group of Krait to obtain an additional Asura rank bonus.

From the portal in Alcazia Tangle, cross the bridge and head south to southeast. This area is populated with Dinosaurs, the first of which you'll meet is 3 dervish Ferothrax on a patrol. The second patrol group you'll encounter is a Raptor group with the assassin boss, Pywatt the Swift.

From here, take the lower southern path. Hug the right stone wall and be wary of patrolling Raptors. After a short distance, turn right into a passage littered with Asuran corpses. Renk is here with a group of 4 Destroyers. Although your foes will also target Renk, you can safely ignore him because he will self-resurrect.
Alternatively, you can map to Tarnished Haven and follow the alternative route (map 2a) to Renk.
Speak with Renk one last time, then travel to Rata Sum and speak to Mamp for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:66490/sections/notes-1/.text: You can actually complete Finding the Bloodstone and The Elusive Golemancer before initiating A Little Help. However, the story is written with the intent that A Little Help is initiated first.

quests/quest:gww:11029/sections/objectiv.text: Find the river skale queen and slay her.
Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11029/sections/walkthro.text: Head south towards the river. The River Skale Queen should be on the other side of it. You can use the Control key (Ctrl) to see the name of any foes within the range of the radar. They will appear in red on your screen.

quests/quest:gww:25389/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Talon again when you are ready to begin the duel.
See Talon Silverwing for your reward.
Talon teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:

quests/quest:gww:25389/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting this quest talk to Talon Silverwing once again to start the duel, he will attack you as soon as you talk to him again so be prepared.
Right as he is about to die he turns friendly and you can turn in the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25389/sections/notes-1/.text: Talon Silverwing is very weak against earth damage, use this to your advantage if you need help.
Talon will not use any skills.

quests/quest:gww:66649/sections/requirem.text: All party members must have received the reward for Finding Gadd.
It is possible to enter the mission with just one person meeting the requirement, but anyone else will not receive any credit for mission completion.

quests/quest:gww:66649/sections/objectiv.text: Invoke the inscription stone in Sparkfly Swamp to unlock the path to the Bloodstone.
Help Gadd and Livia reach the Bloodstone in the depths below.
Defeat Inscribed Sentries and decipher their inscriptions to open passageways.
Destroy the Inscribed Guardian protecting the Bloodstone.

quests/quest:gww:66649/sections/walkthro.text: During the quest, all creatures will be under the effect of the Aura of the Bloodstone: all nearby creatures (including spirits) will be healed each time any other creature dies (by 20 on the first level and 20 more on each successive level). Proceed slowly; there are numerous popups along the way. Most enemies throughout the mission are in relatively small groups and thus are not very dangerous. However, there is a major exception to this in the form of the several, large pop-up groups of Incubi throughout Levels 1 and 2 which can easily remove protective Enchantments while the many Stormcloud Incubus will use their Mind Shock to Knockdown and spike down players and heroes to death.

Level 1: Walk down into the bigger area first. Gadd will then comment about an inscribed creature to the south-east. Walk to the east first, then, when he says so, to the south. Finish off the Inscribed Sentry and wait for the quest log to update (indicating that Livia has extracted its essence). Then, head north to the portal; wait for Gadd to open it.

There are several pop-up groups along the suggested path: on the way east from the starting point there are 3 small pop-up groups of 3 Arachnids each, and on the later, southern path there are 2 large pop-up groups of Incubi, the first at the bottom of the first stairs and then a second one at the bottom of the stairs just to the west/right of the first stairs.
The Incubi pop-up groups on this level are composed entirely of the dangerous Mind Shock-using Stormclouds, making heavy protection and anti-spell shutdown essential for surviving.
The second pop-up of Incubi can be avoided by keeping to the left, though this will often force a fight with a smaller, non-pop-up group of Incubi that patrols in the area.

Level 2: Walk to the south-east. Eventually you will come to a huge chamber guarded by Skeletal Hounds. When you enter the room, the nearby Skeletons will start off friendly. Pull the patroling sentry away from them and kill him; once he dies, all the skeletons (except the neutral ones right next to the walls) will disappear. Should you get too close, they will become hostile, but you should still be able to pull the sentry away. Again, wait for Livia to extract the essence, then proceed to the portal and wait for Gadd to open it.

There are 3 mixed pop-up groups of Incubi throughout the level. The first one is after the initial groups of Skelk, near the bottom of an incline after a stone portal. The second one is on the path to the left of the central stone pillar, which can be avoided by keeping to the right and fighting the 2 Skelk there. The third one is just after the Resurrection Shrine at the top of the second incline, before the large group of Skeletal Hounds.

Level 3: Go west, eventually reaching a cavern, at the center of which is the Inscribed Guardian guarded by several Enchanted weapons. There will also be four Enchanted Scythes farther from the center; although these are initially friendly, they will turn hostile after you aggro the Guardian. Once it dies, the quest is completed (so you need not bother with the other foes, if you can kill it fast enough).
The only real danger here is that the Enchanted Scythes will attack groups that don't pull the Guardian from a distance in the back.

The many Enchanted Shields surrounding the Guardian will make it difficult to attack it initially due to Protector's Defense and by Body blocking the path to it. However, it is fairly easy to get them to drop the skill by walking around the boss to make them move.
Due to the heavy Enchantment Removal from the Incubi's Soulrending Shriek throughout most of the areas it is generally good to use something else for protection, such as Binding Rituals.
The Necromancer Skelks will quickly spread Disease throughout groups, making party-wide Condition Removal, such as Extinguish, potentially useful.

The ability to either provide Blocking towards all party members or Blind to several enemies is useful for neutralizing the massive group of Skeletal Hounds on Level 2, which can otherwise be a danger.

quests/quest:gww:66649/sections/notes-1/.text: If you gained Death penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much DP while in this mission, you can simply resign to eliminate your death penalty before talking to the inscription stone again to restart the mission.

This mission takes place in a zone with an identical layout as the Bloodstone Caves in the Depths of Tyria; however, this area is considered to be Asura territory (Tarnished Coast), so Edification will grant its bonus.

After defeating the Inscribed Sentries, wait for Livia to extract the inscriptions before proceeding; Gadd cannot open the gates until she has done so. You can check that she has managed this by ensuring that the quest log has updated. However, the dialogue will continue whether Livia has succeeded or not.
At the beginning of the 2nd level, Livia or Gadd can get stuck at the bottom of the stairs in the corner. As with any NPC allies, watch that they stay with the party to avoid backtracking later.

When repeating this quest, you can travel directly to the Inscription Stone outside Bloodstone Caves. (You could also visit the Scrying Pool first to obtain the quest, but this is not necessary.) Once you approach the site, the gate may open and if you zone in without clicking the Inscription Stone, Gadd and Livia will not join your party as you will be starting the dungeon instead.
When repeating this quest, if you have already unlocked Livia, you will still receive the notification that you've unlocked her.
Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
Similar to Curse of the Nornbear with Jora, if a Livia hero is in your party, you will have two Livias in your party instead of the Livia hero being renamed "Shining Blade Necromancer".

quests/quest:gww:25506/sections/objectiv.text: Go southwest up the road until you find skale. Cross the river and find the missing girl Gwen.
Lead Gwen back to Ciglo the Monk. Gwen will not move as long as the skale are in the way.

quests/quest:gww:25506/sections/walkthro.text: Cross the river to the south of Ciglo the Monk and find Gwen. Once you find her, kill the three River Skale Tads that are in the river near her. Once you kill the skale, lead her back towards Ciglo and talk to him to receive your reward.

quests/quest:gww:8947/sections/objective.text: Travel to the Sunspear encampment near Chahbek Village.
Speak to at least one expert .
See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:8947/sections/walkthrou.text: Speak to at least one expert of your character's profession. They will teach you some skills. Return to First Spear Dehvad. He will teach you all the other skills the experts offer for your profession, so you do not have to speak to all of them.

quests/quest:gww:8947/sections/notes-1/b.text: Accepting the reward as a Ranger teaches Pin Down, even though none of the expert rangers offer the skill.

quests/quest:gww:25383/sections/objectiv.text: Look for Weng Gha in Panjiang Peninsula.

quests/quest:gww:25383/sections/walkthro.text: Travel southwest until you reach Tsumei Village. Enter, and exit to the south. Weng Gha is close by, westwards.

quests/quest:gww:7683/sections/objective.text: Speak to Second Spear Binah to enter Kamadan.
Hone your skills by reaching level 5.
See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:7683/sections/walkthrou.text: Complete quests or defeat enemies until you reach level 5. Talk to First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:7683/sections/notes-1/b.text: If you map travel to Kamadan or if you received the quest from First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan, your compass will have a starburst to talk to Binah in Kamadan, to go into Churrhir Fields and then talk to Binah again to go back into Kamadan. Your world map will also say to go back into Churrhir Fields.

quests/quest:gww:11068/sections/objectiv.text: Go south to the river. Slay a skale so that Verata can make use of its corpse.
Return to Verata the Necromancer for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11068/sections/walkthro.text: After you obtain the quest, Verata will start following you. Follow the road and kill one of the River Skale Tads. Wait for Verata to animate a Bone Horror and collect the reward.

quests/quest:gww:11068/sections/notes-1/.text: Killing anything that can provide an exploitable corpse, not just a skale, will fulfil the quest requirements.

quests/quest:gww:25394/sections/objectiv.text: Prevent the thieves from stealing crops from the field.
See Weng Gha for your reward.
Weng Gha teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:

quests/quest:gww:25394/sections/walkthro.text: After you accept this quest, follow the path leading to Tsumei Village. When you near the marked spot on the mini-map 3 Crop Thieves dressed like the Crimson Skull appear. Kill them and then return to Weng Gha.

quests/quest:gww:25394/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest will sometimes register as completed before all the thieves have been defeated.

quests/quest:gww:66521/sections/requirem.text: All party members must have received the reward for Lab Space.
It is possible to enter the mission with just one person meeting the requirement, but anyone else will not receive any credit for mission completion.

quests/quest:gww:66521/sections/objectiv.text: Find Oola's workshop in the depths below and convince her to help with Mamp's project.
Find a golem to circumvent the security system.
Discover a way to access the next laboratory level.
Search the room for a passage leading further into the laboratory.

quests/quest:gww:66521/sections/walkthro.text: Level 1

You begin this mission in a room filled with worker Sentry Golems. None of them are hostile at this point. There are two Worker Golems at the entrance followed by a line of 3 more workers. Click on the one to the far left of the first line and tell it to, "Go pull that lever." It will slowly walk to the other end of the cavern to flip the switch. At the same time, the sentries will become hostile and will attack both the party and the Worker Golem; if the worker dies, go back and select another and repeat. However, simply taking the sentries one or two at a time should be sufficient even in Hard mode.

Occasionally, Worker Golem will fail to pull the lever; it will say "Invalid Command" when spoken to. (This seems to happen if you talk to it after activation but before it reaches the lever.) Should this happen, restart by typing the /resign emote; this returns you to Blimm (outside the dungeon) and allows you to start over without having to travel from Rata Sum.

When you enter the second room, a mysterious voice warns against "pulling the lever" (at the far corner of the room). There is no choice, however, since the lever unlocks the exit to Level 2. It also activates the Sentry Golems. Make your way to the new exit, dispatching Sentry Golems as you go. (Again, only aggro as many as you can handle.)
Level 2

There are two mystical keyholders: one near you when you enter and the other around the corner. Use the first device to receive a Crystalline Key. The sentries are hostile and active when you hold this bundle; dropping it deactivates them. These golems respawn indefinitely until the bundle is placed in the second mystical keyholder, at which point they deactivate completely.

One way of dealing with this is to flag all heroes and henchmen to the far keyholder and having a well-armored character carry the key. If things get hairy, drop the key, get healed, and repeat. This method avoids letting the sentries body block party members when they deactivate; if they are blocked, the only way to free them is to reach the next level.

When working with heroes and henchmen, the player can be surrounded by Golems and be unable to move or fight after picking up the crystal. If this happens, try to have your heroes kill the golem or golems trapping you, and then escape quickly because new golems will respawn. If this strategy fails, the only solution is to restart the quest. Another strategy is to use the key while flagging your heroes farther North towards the other keystone and lead all the golems together to body block you in a line so you can run around them after you drop the stone. Then move your heroes to body block the golems while you pick up the key and run it to the other keystone. No deaths or well armored units required. Just ensure your body block of the golems doesn't put them in the archway or you will have to pick it up and pull them back and may die from the attempt. (Again, typing /resign will result in being taken to Blimm in Magus Stones, giving you the chance to start again.)

The next challenge is a room filled with Fire Darts, Sentry Golems, and another Worker Golem. Some of the Sentry Golems are already hostile, and others will become hostile as you approach them. The mysterious voice will taunt you again. The sole Worker Golem has a fire protection aura that will protect your party against the Fire Darts. The Worker Golem will slowly walk back and forth from your end of the room to the other. The intent is that your entire party stay in its shielded area, which protects against damage and burning. This becomes difficult to do as you encounter Sentry Golems in your path. Body blocking can halt the worker's progression temporarily, giving you time to fight.

The golem stops a few steps short of safety so your party will have to run a few steps under dart attacks. It is not possible to disable the Fire Dart machines. If part of your party is left behind, the Worker Golem will be back.

The Worker Golem can sometimes get stuck and stop moving. When this happens, the Golem Fire Shield will lose sync with the Worker Golem and continue to progress forward. If this happens, follow the shield, not the Golem, and advance like normal. Sometimes the Golem continues and the shield stops; stay with the shield, not the Golem.

Up some stairs will be a large room with many golem bodies, Sentry Golems, and three Worker Golems. Some are hostile, some will become hostile when you approach them. The mysterious voice will, again, encourage you to give up. The objective here is to activate the Worker Golems ("follow mode engaged") and lead them to three touchplates near the door to the next room. They should "engage stationary mode" once on top of the touchplates. If not, activating the golem again should do so. One Worker Golem is already placed for you.

In the last room of level 2 will be an Indestructible Golem, a bundle item (Flux Matrix) and an interactive Unstable Magical Energy Storage. The golem will not take damage from any normal means; but spells that cause life stealing and some forms of health degeneration work. This is not advised as the golem has a large amount of health.

Run past the Indestructible Golem (it's usually best to circle around to the left) and pick up the Flux Matrix. Click on the Unstable Magical Energy Source to charge the bundle item. Drop it beside the Indestructible Golem to cause 1337 damage. Repeat the procedure and refill the bundle item at the Unstable Magical Energy Source after each drop. It will take 2 drops to destroy the golem.
Level 3

The final level is filled with Sentry Golems and Golem Sentries. Only the Golem Sentries can become hostile. Oola is at the end of the room. As you approach her, a cinematic will trigger. You do not actually need to fight anything in this room as running to Oola will end the quest.
Skill recommendations

Though there are no Hexes inside of the mission itself, there are quite a few Wind Riders on the path there and those carry quite a few. The prevention of most healing through Shame and shutdown of Adrenaline-reliant builds through Soothing Images are of especially heavy concern.
Most of the damage comes from the melee golems, so sources of Block is very useful.
Conditions are relatively unimportant outside and inside of the mission, with really only the Blind from the Elementalist Golems being important if the team is reliant on a martial attacker.
Most of the Conditions can be prevented via blocking or Blinding.

quests/quest:gww:66521/sections/notes-1/.text: If your party gained Death Penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much Death Penalty while in this mission, you can simply resign in the mission dungeon, which causes your party to spawn next to Blimm and eliminate the Death Penalty. Talk to Blimm again to restart the mission.

None of the foes in this quest are fleshy, so skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
None of the foes in this quest use hex spells, so hex removal skills are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
In Level 3, the Golems that you need to fight are named Golem Sentry; the stationary ones are named Sentry Golems.

A Shadow Form or Vow of Silence runner can run most of the mission for a significant time saving, most notably all the way through Magus Stones. The few occasions when fighting is unavoidable can be easily handled by the rest of the party.
The endlessly respawning golems on level two do not give experience (which prevents them from being used as an AFK farm).
This quest (and all primary repeatable Eye of the North quests) may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments after completing it once.
The Asuran Skill Pain Inverter also works against the Indestructible Golem.
This is not the TPS Regulator Golem quest. For that quest (Little Workshop of Horrors) talk with Blimm in Rata Sum, not in Magus Stones.
Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
The Edification energy boost is granted in this area, unlike most zones in the Depths of Tyria below Asuran territory.
The Hero's Handbook lists this mission as Oola's Laboratory.

quests/quest:gww:161909/sections/objecti.text: Seek out Master Togo in Linnok Courtyard.

quests/quest:gww:161909/sections/walkthr.text: Open your world map (default: "M"), and click on Shing Jea Monastery. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it.

quests/quest:gww:161909/sections/notes-1.text: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player, once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the followup quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.

quests/quest:gww:25505/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road southwest until you find skale. Clear the road of skale.
Return to Sebedoh the Mesmer for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25505/sections/environm.text: Haversdan appears in front of the gate to Ascalon City, while Sebedoh leaves and can no longer be found pre-Searing.

The 4 River Skale Tads will no longer spawn on the road. Instead, creatures around the river will begin spawning as normal, with different low-level skale as well as devourers appearing in the eastern section of Lakeside County.

quests/quest:gww:25505/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the road southwest until you come upon the 4 skale. Killing either of the two closest to the city triggers the rest of the pack to start fleeing toward the river, completing the quest condition. Killing either of the other two has no effect on the quest and does not trigger any reaction from the remaining skale, but is a quick source of a little extra XP.

quests/quest:gww:7684/sections/objective.text: Travel to the Sunspear encampment near Chahbek Village.
Speak to at least one non-[primary profession] expert.
See First Spear Devhad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:7684/sections/instructi.text: Good to see you again, . Today must be my lucky day! I won 200 gold on a bet with First Spear Jahdugar and then you show up just when I need to talk to you. Looks like it's time for you to begin learning about secondary professions. Why don't you head back to the encampment near Chahbek Village and speak to a few of the experts there. They can tell you all about life in the professions.

quests/quest:gww:160140/sections/require.text: Having M.O.X. in the party. (Doesn't have to be in the party during the three quests.)

quests/quest:gww:160140/sections/walkthr.text: Zinn's Secret Underground Lair can be found in the explorable area The Falls. It is at the westernmost end, where the waterfall displayed on the last page of the golem manual is located. A person with M.O.X in their party must interact with "The Falls" in order to achieve entrance to the secret lair. The closest town to start from is Ventari's Refuge and you must pass through two other areas with a maximum party size of six members to reach it.

quests/quest:gww:160140/sections/notes-1.text: MOX must be in your party in order to reach Zinn's lair; only the player bringing the golem hero can speak with Zinn to continue the quest.
Parties who haven't completed the quest will be returned to Ventari's Refuge, after Zinn's dialogue.
Be careful in the area right before the secret lair, as it is easy to aggro the nearby Wind Riders (and their elementalist boss).

While in Zinn's Secret Lair, the map displays as if the party is beneath Oola's Lab; however, the Lair is northwest of that location. Page 5 of the manual says, "bring M.O.X. with you, as he will be able to bypass the security protocols;" however, the quest log fails to make this requirement clear.

quests/quest:gww:7689/sections/objective.text: See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:7689/sections/notes-1/b.text: Accepting the reward as a secondary ranger teaches Pin Down, which is not taught by any of the expert rangers during the previous quest, instead of Power Shot, which is offered by Rakanja. You can abandon this quest after choosing your secondary and before accepting the quest reward and will get a new choice to choose your secondary. However, this will have no effect — your secondary profession has already been locked.

quests/quest:gww:7689/sections/instructi.text: Now that you have learned more about the other professions, it's time to make a choice. Think carefully, now. Once you decide, you won't be able to change your mind for some time.
