Once all the attackers from the north are dead (you can ignore any stray monks or spirits for now) grab the canister and use it to help finish off the groups to the south.

At spot 8, position your group just on the north side of the outcropping. Be very careful to stay around this area and not extend too far out into the open - pull enemies back as needed. Once the first group is dead another two groups will spawn, one near you and one south. The nearest group you can ignore as they will engage your team, but the far group you will need to pull before they reach the turtles. One player will need to position themselves out on the sea as you finish the last enemies and be very careful to aggro the second spawn, pulling them back to the corner. Once the second wave are finished another two mobs will spawn, so do the same again. For these pulls a long range bow gives you the best chance. Be careful not to stray to the east - if you get near the turtles the group of enemies in the quarry will be spawned and attack them.
At spot 9 you can just drop your canister on the approaching enemy monk and party. When they are dead move it just inside the quarry gate and wait for the cinematic.

quests/quest:gww:17278/sections/notes-1/.text: If Argo dies, the turtle procession will continue, except without Argo's dialogue. The turtles will still wait as if his dialogue is going however.

When placing the smoke canister at the final gates to fight the afflicted, the Siege Turtles will sometimes continue to fight all through the end cinematic, causing the screen and characters to shake noticeably on impact.
Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
At the end of this mission, your party appears in Leviathan Pits.
You can increase your Luxon Faction cap limit by 7,000 by completing this mission along with Boreas Seabed and Unwaking Waters. This increase can only be applied once per account.

There are 2 NPCs named Petras in the final battle. Any Young Turtles that die appear to be resurrected after the cinematic; however, they still count as "dead" for the master's reward. Some of the groups at point 6 might fail to spawn when doing the mission via the back way. To prevent this, stay with the turtles and avoid letting them stray too far. The Young Turtles at the end of the mission sometimes wander off past the Afflicted.
de:Gyala-Brutstätte (Mission) fr:Couvoir de Gyala (Mission en mode coopératif)

quests/quest:gww:17419/sections/objectiv.text: Escort Master Togo to the edge of the Unwaking Waters.
Speak with Attis to gain access to the Unwaking Waters.
See Elder Oxis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17419/sections/walkthro.text: Travel through Silent Surf from Leviathan Pits to Unwaking Waters. All you need to do is make sure Master Togo survives (else the quest fails and must be restarted). Be alert to the movements of various mobs, including those in the distance, as most have wide patrol routes and can easily join aggro while you're busy dispatching another mob.

quests/quest:gww:11847/sections/requirem.text: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Taking Back the Palace (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Raisu Pavilion will be closed.
Taking Back the Palace grants access, but any characters that have not completed Unwaking Waters will be left behind in Raisu Pavilion.

quests/quest:gww:11847/sections/objectiv.text: Get to the emperor before Shiro kills him!
, you must choose two allies from among these heroes to accompany the party.

quests/quest:gww:11847/sections/rewards-.text: Factions Completion time > 25 minutes 20 - 25 minutes 28 minutes 26 - 28 minutes < 26 minutes

quests/quest:gww:11847/sections/walkthro.text: Preparation

At the beginning of this mission, be sure to acquire a Celestial skill from Kuunavang. These skills are very powerful, and will recharge each time you defeat one of the many bosses in this mission. Take note that only player characters and henchmen can get Celestial skills; heroes cannot. As such, it is worth considering whether or not your hero build really is more effective than the warrior and elementalist henchmen as they get Storm of Swords and Celestial Storm respectively.

After that, the party leader has to choose two NPCs to join as allies. These NPCs will fight with you, but cannot be resurrected if they die, and will leave your party at a prescribed point during the mission (if they are still alive) to let your party skip a small section of the mission:
Argo - Lets the party skip the first groups of Shiro'ken; thereby allowing the party to head straight to the Warrior boss.
Cynn - Lets the party skip the group of Shiro'ken; this occurs before the bridges after the Elementalist boss.
Danika - Closes a gate in a large room full of Shiro'ken; thereby providing the party with a faster alternate route to the Ritualist boss.
Nika - Lets the party skip the Ranger boss.
Panaku - Disables the Acid Traps in the corridor that leads to the Ritualist boss.
Talon Silverwing - Closes the gates on the portal rooms after the Warrior boss; thereby containing the Shiro'ken in those rooms.

Choosing Danika, in addition to Talon, is recommended as being the most "time-efficient". If you chose Talon, you can skip the most combat-intensive segment of the mission that has the largest number of Shiro'ken. After the elementalist boss, if you chose Danika, the party can run past where Cynn's shortcut would be and activate Danika's; effectively giving you the benefits of both. Argo only skips an insignificant group of six or seven Shiro'ken. Panaku only disables the traps (that only deal 10-20 damage each and can be easily avoided); Panaku can also get body blocked by enemies during the cinematic and end up not disabling the traps.

The timer for the mission does not actually start until after the party leader has selected two allies, and walked through the gate that opens after the allies have been selected. In addition to the two allies selected, Master Togo and Mhenlo will also be accompanying the party.
Getting to the emperor
Room one, unless you chose Argo, you must go left or right around the outside of the room to reach the Warrior boss. It is advised to pull the boss as to not aggro the group behind him.

Boss two, if you chose Talon, the doors to the spawn portals close and you can approach and kill the Necromancer boss with ease. If you did not choose Talon, your party should run through the middle into the Necromancer group and be careful not to aggro the growing group of Shiro'ken forming in the middle of the room.

Boss three, if you chose Nika, you will skip the Ranger boss. Otherwise, you must defeat the Ranger boss atop the ramp. After killing the boss, turn left or right and begin pulling the small patrolling groups of enemies carefully in order to eliminate them before engaging the Elementalist boss. If you try and take Nika's route without having Nika with you, the Ranger boss runs around and onto the high point and engages you anyway.

Boss four, after pulling the groups near the Elementalist boss, engage and kill the boss group. Be mindful that Ritualists and Monks tend to hide on the stairs behind the boss and can resurrect or heal without pressure. If you chose Danika, be prepared to run.

Boss five, if you chose Danika, you must make a dash across the bridge behind this room, ignoring enemies from the spawn portals until the cinematic engages. You may be followed by a group from behind which you will have to defeat. This can be hard to do if your party has not discussed the run. After the cinematic, you must turn left and follow the outside wall until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.

Boss five, if you chose Cynn, the spawn portals are closed and you can fight your way across the bridge in the middle of the room. Once across, you must follow the multiple groups of enemies until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.
Boss five, if you chose Panaku, and he is still alive, the Acid Traps will be disabled making it possible for the party to stand where you like.

Boss six/seven/eight, the bosses in this mission are all just health and energy tank versions of their Shiro’ken offspring. Use the same kill order as before, making the Monk a priority, followed by the Assassin and Mesmer.
Skill recommendations
Consider area damage over time skills, such as Ray of Judgment, to deal with the spirits created by Shiro'ken Ritualist.
Minion masters should consider Blood of the Master to keep their minions alive from the Elementalist health degeneration.
Because Shiro'ken Monks use Spell Breaker and Spell Shield, consider non-spell skills like "You Move Like A Dwarf!", "Finish Him!", or Brawling Headbutt to spike the Monks.
Bring enchantment removal skills to deal with the Shiro'ken Elementalist's Sliver Armor and Shiro'ken Monk's Spell Breaker and Spell Shield.

The foes in this mission have hex removal skills (Shiro'ken Monks have Reverse Hex and Shiro'ken Mesmers have Shatter Hex), but lack condition removal, so consider bringing skills that inflict conditions instead of hex spells. Consider bringing hex spells with an end effect that triggers when removed by a hex removal skill, such as Phantom Pain.
Consider bringing skills that can affect multiple allies, since they will also affect the four non-party member allies.
Consider bringing skills that prevent and remove burning as Shiro'ken Elementalists use Star Burst and Burning Speed.

quests/quest:gww:11847/sections/notes-1/.text: If you speak to Kuunavang you get a temporary Celestial skill which recharges when a boss is killed. If you replace Charm Animal, Comfort Animal, or Heal as One with a Celestial skill, your pet will still remain.
The Gate Guard spawns immediately before the ending cinematic, as such, it cannot be killed.

Make sure that the two ally henchmen you choose survive until the part that you want them to help you skip. If they die before they get there, they are unable to perform the action that will allow you to skip the room/boss.

If you choose Danika, once you get past the elementalist boss run until you cross the bridge and a cinematic will start where you will see her lock the next room and reveal an alternate route that is far more pleasant. Be aware that you will be attacked from behind by a group of Shiro'ken once the alternate route is revealed.
You must defeat all of the Shiro'ken bosses, including the final three, in order to complete the mission. This prevents the mission from being easily run by a single person.
Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 of the Shiro's Return storybook.

If one of the allies you choose at the beginning of the mission dies near an enemy's Restoration spirit, that ally will be revived when the spirit dies. Since you need to kill all the Shiro'ken bosses, this can make it impossible to finish the mission should you pick a character such as Cynn.

quests/quest:gww:13702/sections/requirem.text: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Raisu Palace.

quests/quest:gww:13702/sections/rewards-.text: Factions Completion time > 5 minutes 2.5 - 5 minutes 6 minutes 3 - 6 minutes < 3 minutes

quests/quest:gww:13702/sections/walkthro.text: Imperial Sanctum/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
Upon completion of this mission, the players will end up in the Divine Path.

If this is the first time your character has completed this mission, remember to talk to Suun in Divine Path. There will not be any quest nor reward indicator over his head. Suun will give you the Amulet of the Mists. You can then go to one of the nearby adepts and trade the amulet for a unique item. You can only receive this amulet once per character. If for some reason you forget to talk to Suun and leave the Divine Path, you can perform the mission again and talk to Suun to receive the amulet.

quests/quest:gww:13702/sections/notes-1/.text: Banished Paragons or Dervishes are replaced by Bound Warriors.
You gain a morale boost each time a bound foe is killed.
The mission will succeed even if Mhenlo dies.
Some elementalists run this mission for money, echo chaining Celestial Storm to quickly solo Shiro and getting Master's reward.
The area to which Shiro banishes players contributes approximately 0.2% towards the Canthan Grandmaster Cartographer title.
You need to team up with at least one other player to uncover this area, as Shiro doesn't banish you if you're the only player.

The Spirits of the Mists in that area do not respawn after being killed, so spirit-killing skills such as Gaze of Fury help considerably if more than one banishment is planned for zone scraping at leisure.
Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of the Shiro's Return storybook.

Sometimes there is a malfunction with Shiro's skill: Meditation of the Reaper. He will be able to take damage while in meditation, but the skill won't register any damage taken. It will therefore last the maximum of 30sec.
Sometimes there is a malfunction with Shiro's skill: Echoing Banishment. Heroes sometimes get taken with you when Shiro uses Echoing Banishment.

quests/quest:gww:319946/sections/objecti.text: Carve a path through the Northlands and retake Piken Square.
Hold off the Charr forces to secure Piken Square.

quests/quest:gww:319946/sections/environ.text: Upon accepting the reward, portals appear in the Northlands leading to the Piken Square outpost and the Forsaken Tunnels dungeon.
If all party members have completed the quest, two gates in the Northlands will open, allowing passage into the northern section of the map.

quests/quest:gww:319946/sections/walkthr.text: Pull the lever above the gate and enter the Northlands, where Devona, Vell and Bock await you. (If they are not present, ensure no party members have Across the Wall active in the quest log and rezone.) While Vell and Bock are expendable, Devona's survival is mandatory; if she is killed at any point during the quest, you will need to restart.

Proceed north toward Piken Square. Six groups of two or three Charr each are scattered along the path, replacing most of the Grawl and Oakheart spawns in the area. It is not necessary to kill these patrols, and several of them can be easily bypassed. Inside Piken Square itself, there are four more Charr groups which must be eliminated. Pull them carefully to make sure your allies (especially Devona) do not get overwhelmed.

Once the square is clear, Devona, Vell, and Bock will stop following you and gather at the bottom of the stairs. At this point, you only have a few seconds to prepare for a counterattack. Two Charr Hunters and the warrior boss Scarl the Slicer will move into the square through the same gate you did and engage your allies. Be wary of heavy projectile damage from the hunters, which can easily kill Devona if she is allowed to aggro the group.
After Scarl's warband is defeated, you can return to Ascalon City and talk to Prince Rurik to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:319946/sections/notes-1.text: Completing this quest unlocks access to the Piken Square (pre-Searing) outpost.
Players who have completed this quest can also ferry players to the outpost.

You do not need to turn in Across the Wall to get this quest. After leading Ben Wolfson to the exit, simply zone into Lakeside County, wait for Ben to finish his two dialogs, and then accept the quest. Once the new quest is taken, you are free to go back to an outpost and abandon Across the Wall.
Other players in the party can also take the quest from Ben Wolfson regardless of their advancement of Across the Wall.
If any player has Across the Wall active in their quest log, the quest NPCs for A Bastion In the North will not appear in the Northlands.

If a party enters the Northlands from Piken Square with this quest active, at least one party member must reach Devona at the gate to Lakeside County before the four Charr groups in the square will spawn.
Devona will speak her line "There's the square!" almost immediately after she is reached.

Reforged mode is only necessary to start the quest. If you opt out of reforged mode using the Shrine to Godly Accoutrements, the quest will still be in your quest log, the quest NPCs will still spawn and the quest can be progressed normally.
"In" in the quest title is in upper case, which is inconsistent with other quests (e.g. Fire in the Sky, Fire in the Hole)

quests/quest:gww:25344/sections/objectiv.text: Find out what has become of Tirzah's beloved Chebar in the Salt Flats.
Take the silver ring to Tirzah.

quests/quest:gww:25344/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from Seeker's Passage, go southeast until you go through a narrow channel, then round the wall to your left and up another narrow channel with wooden plank steps and platforms. You will reach Chebar, the objective of this quest, at the top of the channel beside the teleporter.

Alternatively, you can travel around the north side of the wall, through some narrow channels and around to the south, reaching Chebar by using the teleporter from the other side. Both routes are approximately the same length, but you may need to move more carefully to avoid wandering hydra on the northern path.

If you are fighting enemies along the way, take it slowly. You will encounter Rockshot Devourers, Jade Scarabs and a pretty large number of Storm Kin. The Storm Kin patrol in small groups but can move very quickly along their patrol routes, so it is easy to aggro more than you would like.

It is also possible to simply run to Chebar, even without a running skill, going headlong through the groups of enemies. Hire a full party of henchmen and let them serve as distractions. Assuming you don't trigger any traps, the most dangerous thing you'll face is constant Health degeneration from Conjure Phantasm and Parasitic Bond, but this is unlikely to be fatal as the run is not a very long distance. If you choose to bring a self-healing skill, be aware that the Rockshot Devourers use Distracting Shot.

quests/quest:gww:25344/sections/notes-1/.text: The quests Ancient Secrets and The Ranger's Path lead to nearby places in the Salt Flats, on the far side of the teleporter from where Chebar is found, so doing these quests together can save time.

quests/quest:gww:13063/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Herder Tsiyingju about getting treated hides.
Destroy the group of Crimson Skull plaguing Kaitan Village.
See Neing the Tanner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13063/sections/walkthro.text: If you don't have Tsumei Village on your map, exit Shing Jea Monastery into Sunqua Vale, and follow the westward leading road. If you already have Tsumei Village on your map you can simply map-travel to it.

From Tsumei Village exit into Panjiang Peninsula. Follow the quest marker to Herder Tsiyingju and talk to her. She will then send you off to fight and kill a group of 4 Crimson Skull. Follow the quest marker again to the nearby Crimson Skull. Killing the Ritualist and the Mender before the other foes will make the fight significantly easier. Return to Herder Tsiyingju to collect the Treated Hides (they will appear in your inventory). Map-travel back to Shing Jea Monastery to collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13063/sections/notes-1/.text: If you have the quest The Siege at Tsumei Village active, you cannot complete this quest.

quests/quest:gww:14214/sections/objectiv.text: Verify if the Tomb of Saevio Proelium is intact.
The tomb has been breached! The Order of Whispers must know right away!
See Whispers Acolyte for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14214/sections/walkthro.text: Verify the Tomb of Saevio Proelium has been breached at the Monument to the Defeat of Palawa Joko in Jahai Bluffs, just outside the Command Post entrance to the zone. Report to Whispers Acolyte at the Chantry of Secrets for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23275/sections/objectiv.text: Find Yera Swiftsight in the Sunward Marches and ask him about the corrupted plants.
Examine 10...0 more suspicious shrubs for signs of corruption.
Report your findings to Mirza Veldrunner in Turai's Procession.

quests/quest:gww:23275/sections/walkthro.text: Start from Venta Cemetery and speak to Yera Swiftsight just outside. Yera will direct you to investigate 10 Suspicious Shrubs in the Sunward Marches, simply follow your quest pointer to each one. To examine the shrubs, click on them as if you are trying to pick it up.
At any suspicious shrubs which display the "dark aura" dialogue (see below), a pack of Vicious Seedlings will popup and attack the party.
After examining 10 bushes, return to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289664/sections/objecti.text: Attend the Ministry of Purity's rally.
Prevent the Ministry of Purity from killing Miku.
Escape from the Ministry of Purity.

quests/quest:gww:289664/sections/notes-1.text: Reiko's speech is reduced considerably in the hard mode version.

quests/quest:gww:289664/sections/shared-.text: Talking to the Herald of Purity again will move your party to the Winds of Change explorable Kaineng Center.

Listen to Reiko's pretentious speech, dispose of her posse, and then flee the scene. In the event you fail, you'll be spared most of the initial dialogue if you try again without abandoning the quest.

The initial group of Ministry use a lot of AoE skills which can easily wipe the entire party if you aren't careful. Remember to protect Miku; Shield of Absorption can usually handle everything but the Ministry's special monster skills. Spread out to make the fight easier.

After defeating the initial group of Ministry, follow Miku and avoid fighting. When she says, "There's an exit to the east of here," split off from her and head toward the portal to Bukdek Byway. Xan Hei and Initiate Zei Ri are waiting just in front of the portal, and will attack after more dialogue. You must kill Xan Hei twice to gain credit for the quest; this can be done even if you lost most of your team along the way (unless the ministry troops followed you to the portal).
To claim the reward, talk to Miku in Shenzun Tunnels just outside Tahnnakai Temple.
This quest is the most common farming place for Ministerial Commendations.
Sometimes the Spirit of Life summoned by Ministry Purgers appears as an allied target.

quests/quest:gww:25225/sections/objectiv.text: Return to Vassar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25225/sections/walkthro.text: Go north after exiting the Sanitarium. Nente is standing next to the Statue of Balthazar, where the portal into Green Hills County used to be.

quests/quest:gww:25685/sections/objectiv.text: Keep an eye on the monument while Vadben gets his tools.

quests/quest:gww:25685/sections/walkthro.text: This quest can be hard for low level players in a small group (four or less). Since it is not a primary quest but optional, wait until you are stronger or have other outposts available such as Beknur Harbor. Doing this quest from Beknur Harbor is advantageous as you can bring a party of eight from there, and the henchmen are level 12 rendering the challenge safer and simple.
Make sure to pick up the Skale Hunt bounty from outside either Beknur Harbor or Champion's Dawn for the additional sunspear reputation points.

The quest tells you to "protect" a monument but there is no "health" bar that degenerates per skale attack nor a countdown timer that tells you when Vadben will be back. Instead, the quest is about remaining alive after several waves of skales spawn near the monument, starting from a group of level 4 skales up to a group of level 13 and 14 skales. The frequency of each new group of skales is fast, so be sure to finish the waves off quickly before a new one arrives to prevent becoming outnumbered.

quests/quest:gww:25685/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest Queen of the Quarry provides some additional Sunspear guards that can double the party size and make the defense much easier. M.O.X. and/or Mercenary Heroes could also assist as level 20 allies.
It is possible to talk to Vadben to accept your reward before all of the enemies in the area are entirely defeated.

quests/quest:gww:25668/sections/objectiv.text: Save Farmer Foneng from the corsairs.
Get a sack of grain from Farmer Foneng for Scholar Chago.
See Scholar Chago for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25668/sections/walkthro.text: Map to Kodlonu Hamlet. Travel into Issnur Isles and head west towards the small gathering of people. As you approach Farmer Foneng, a small group of corsairs will spawn. Take out the group of corsairs, and speak with Farmer Foneng afterward to receive the sack of grain.
Travel back to the Astralarium to receive your reward from Scholar Chago.

quests/quest:gww:23889/sections/objectiv.text: Defeat the Lady of the Dead and free the soul of Sinni's father.

quests/quest:gww:23889/sections/walkthro.text: Venture south of Sinni's village to find the Ancient Remains. Activate the altar to summon the Lady of the Dead, and defeat her to complete the quest. Low-level parties should spread out when fighting, as the Lady is a dervish and can deal a lot of AoE damage with her attacks.

quests/quest:gww:289143/sections/objecti.text: Locate the Jade Brotherhood at Mount Qinkai.
See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289143/sections/shared-.text: Start from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon). Listen to Meijun, Vengeful Eye and then head north to the yeti cave (refer to the map). The cave has two entrances: the southwest and the east. As you approach, a dialogue between Yuun, Kisai, and Mai will trigger. Soon after that, the trio will be attacked by waves of yeti. Your task is to protect them; the quest is failed if any of them dies.

The yetis will attack from both entrances in groups of three: all but two groups will come from the east. As Meijun ends his dialogue (and you approach the cave), two groups will spawn close to cave entrance; there is plenty of time to kill them and return inside before the main assault begins. You can also use a spirit wall to delay the approach of the next group.

That small cliff overlooking the east entrance is a good place to make your stand. Keep an eye on the NPC health bars, especially Mai's, since she has a tendency to shadow step right into the fray. Although the yeti are light damage dealers, they are capable of wearing down your party due to their large numbers, especially in hard mode. After you've killed all the Yetis, Yuun will thank you and you will finish the quest.

If you have trouble keeping Mai alive, you can buy yourself some extra time by avoiding triggering the quest dialogues until after you have cleared out a path to the cave entrance. If you follow the colored dots on the legend in order, you should be fine!

Starting from Aspenwood Gate, clear your way north through the Rot Wallows and the Island Guardian. Take a left along the path and defeat the hidden Oni before continuing north (beware the wandering group of Rot Wallows). Then flag your heroes just south of the western cave entrance. Now make your way back to the outpost along the clear path, and go near enough to Meijun, Vengeful Eye to begin the dialogue. (You can alternatively trigger his dialogue from the ledge to his northeast where the Oni were hidden). Once Meijun begins talking, head back along the clear route to the cave and when the dialogue stops the yeti will spawn - due to your direction of approach, the vulnerable NPCs will not immediately be added to the party list.

Now sweep your way through the cave past the now invulnerable NPCs to kill the various incoming Yeti groups. Once you have killed the waves of yeti immediately moving into the cave, you can head east to kill the stationary foes - just bear in mind that moving far enough north will trigger the NPCs to become vulnerable. If more dialogue begins, run back to the cave to protect the NPCs.
See talk page for further elaboration of this method.
Spirit spammers and/or minion masters, to help distract the yeti.
Blood is Power to replenish energy.
Well spells, such as Well of Silence and Well of Suffering.

The quest log fails to mention the gold and experience rewards. If you run to the three students before the initial dialogue is complete, the quest will not trigger properly. You must run about halfway back to him and re-approach the cave.

quests/quest:gww:25693/sections/objectiv.text: Free the other Orrian spirits from the Leech Tunnels. You have rescued [0...3] of 3 spirits.
Lead Orrian Spirit Gildran to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
Lead Orrian Spirit Minos to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
Lead Orrian Spirit Kandril to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
See Wandering Soul for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25693/sections/walkthro.text: Following on from the previous quest, head to each of the three markers to find different groups of stationary awaiting torment creatures. Orrian Spirit Minos also has some awaiting titans. The Orrian spirits cannot be attacked and so you don't need to worry about them.
After saving all three spirits, head to where you picked up the previous quest - the resurrection shrine at the entrance to the Leech Tunnels.

quests/quest:gww:25693/sections/notes-1/.text: As the spirits are capable of body blocking characters, there may be a little trouble moving through the narrow Leech Tunnels.

quests/quest:gww:21380/sections/objectiv.text: Defeat the demons blocking the path to the Titan. 4...0 groups remain.
Seek council with the Titan, Ignis Cruor.
See Scorch Emberspire for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21380/sections/walkthro.text: After exiting the Gate of Secrets to the Domain of Secrets, follow the quest marker west and clear the groups as marked on the map. If you have the quest Escape from the Torment, you might run into the Margonite ambush from that quest along the way.

After defeating the demon groups, you will be able to approach the titan boss, Ignis Cruor. He will remain green until you walk past him, then suddenly turn hostile. He is a high level elementalist who hits very hard, so be ready with interrupts. Two Titan Abominations behind him will come to his aid. If you came from the other side you will be able to finish them off first.

quests/quest:gww:21380/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with Escape from the Torment.

Despite the quest instructions, it is not necessary to kill the four groups of demons. If you avoid them by taking alternate paths, the quest will still update when you reach Ignis Cruor, and will be marked as completed as soon as the titan dies.

quests/quest:gww:23978/sections/objectiv.text: Visit Ruthless Sevad to collect Koss's winnings.
Find Jerob No-Spine on the Barbarous Shore and inquire about his debt to Ruthless Sevad.
Seek Ruthless Sevad's loot keeper and slay it to free the treasure.
Give Ruthless Sevad 5 Tarnished Platinum Coins.

quests/quest:gww:23978/sections/notes-1/.text: This is a fairly interesting quest, since the point at which players receive it, they are unlikely to have ventured very far east, so following this quest can provide a great opportunity for exploration.
Potentially there are two routes to take from the Command Post:
both of which then lead into Dejarin Estate -> Camp Hojanu -> Barbarous Shore. Alternatively, hold the quest until the primary storyline takes you to one of Pogahn Passage or Kodonur Crossroads.
This quest fits right in with The Foolhardy Father since both have you talk with Ruthless Sevad.

If a player with at least 51 platinum talking to Ruthless Sevad selects the "Thief! Here's your five platinum..." option but hasn't clicked the following "Here's the money..." option, the player can drop all of their gold on the ground, click the "Here's the money..." option, and pick their gold back up to skip to the reward objective without actually paying the 51 platinum.
Although Koss says he won the debt collection ticket from Megundeh, you can accept the quest before getting him as a rune trader for the command post.

quests/quest:gww:23978/sections/instruct.text: "Great news! I bested Megundeh, the rune trader, in a game of cards and won this debt collection ticket from him. He says it's worth five platinum!
We must go to the Barbarous Shore and find Ruthless Sevad. He's the corsair with the debt. I can't wait... This sure is my lucky day!"
"A debt collection ticket? Interesting. Let's just open it up and see what's inside, shall we?

It says here you've agreed to pay off Megundeh's debt to me. Did he mention how much he owes? It's a sizable sum. The man doesn't know when to quit when he's behind, and he never, ever, manages to get ahead....

You've clearly bitten off more than you can chew. I'm feeling extremely generous today, so I'll give you a choice. You can pay the five platinum he owes me or you can work it off. The task is simple, but not one I care to perform personally. I want you to collect another debt. Wring the cash out of Jerob No-Spine and I'll consider Megundeh's debt paid in full. What's it to be?"
Option 1: "Thief! Here's your five platinum... and not a gold piece more."
"Well, five platinum is quite a bit of money. Maybe I should think this through."
Yes"Here's the money...five platinum." (If you have 5 platinum.)
Yes"On second thought, I just can't afford it."
Option 2: "You want five platinum? Outrageous! I'll collect the other debt."

"Sevad sent you? Is he here? ... Look, I told him. I need more time. I'll get the money. I swear. It's just a matter of... please don't hurt me! I know the location of a rich, old corsair's loot. But it's protected by a beast he's tamed. My mum's been sick and I've got to tend her every need, bless her heart, so I haven't had time to... don't draw that weapon! I'm thinking, since you're not going to hurt me, right...right? I'm thinking you could collect that loot for me. Here, I'll mark the spot on your map. Then you can take care of it for us both."
"Megundeh's debt is paid. Looks like things worked themselves out. For me at least..."

quests/quest:gww:25654/sections/requirem.text: Never Fight Alone neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:25654/sections/objectiv.text: Add a henchman to your party and meet Kina in the Plains of Jarin.

quests/quest:gww:25654/sections/instruct.text: You think you're ready to go save the world? It's dangerous out there, and even a Sunspear can't do it alone. Luckily, you don't have to. You see these fine people stand next to me? They're called henchmen. They want to adventure with people, and they are looking for someone to take them along so they can fight the dangers of the world. You may need to call on their services often, so you should introduce yourself. Go ahead and add one to your party, then meet me out on the Plains of Jarin.

quests/quest:gww:207015/sections/objecti.text: Destroy the Asura Gate in the temple near Raven's Point.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:207015/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:207015/sections/walkthr.text: As per A Gate Too Far.

quests/quest:gww:25651/sections/objectiv.text: Hunt down Wianuyo to bring peace to the ghost of Sehwanu

quests/quest:gww:25651/sections/walkthro.text:
The Ghost of Sehwanu spawns randomly — empirically at a rate of roughly 5% (i.e. about one time in twenty). When she does spawn, she will be staring out to sea on the beach behind Bloodback Morrob and his cultists.
She is guaranteed to spawn for any member of the party due to receive the reward after killing Wianuyo - this can remove the random element of her spawning for picking up the quest.
Wianuyo himself is on the south-eastern edge of Lahtenda Bog, near a lagoon.

Enter Lahtenda Bog through Blacktide Den, making your way through the lagoon to the quest marker. The enemies encountered are the local insects and the two quest related corsair groups around Wianuyo. Consider luring some Corsairs away from the other group of Corsairs to make them easier to pick off.

Your party may wish to consider bringing condition removal since the area is rife with poison, disease and the other conditions. Also consider bringing weakness since a lot of the foes encountered are either melee or attacking with bows and spears.
Wianuyo himself is a renamed Corsair Seer and will be no challenge for a coordinated group.
Map back to Kodlonu Hamlet and travel to Sehwanu again for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:45428/sections/requirem.text: Charr at the Gate not active
Prince Rurik and Captain Osric have finished conversing

quests/quest:gww:45428/sections/objectiv.text: Find the perfect gift for Lady Althea. It must be something beautiful.
Give the Beautiful Feather to Captain Osric.
Give the Beautiful Pearl to Captain Osric.
Give the Beautiful Pendant to Captain Osric.
Return to Captain Osric for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:45428/sections/environm.text: Upon accepting the quest, Prince Rurik will no longer spawn next to the city walls with Captain Osric.

quests/quest:gww:45428/sections/walkthro.text: To trigger the quest, first listen to a conversation between Prince Rurik and Captain Osric that takes place just west of the Ascalon City portal, on the path toward the Actors' Stage. When they finish, talk to Osric to accept the quest. You can collect all of the three beautiful items at any time.
All three items are located in Lakeside County:
The Beautiful Feather can be found on a fenced-in hill in the center of Ashford.
The Beautiful Pearl is hidden inside a Beautiful Shell near the watermill.
The Beautiful Pendant is in a chest in a mountain pass, northeast of the bandit camp above Ashford Abbey.
There are two ways to complete the quest, neither of which alters the storyline:

Collect all three items:: Obtain all three items and return to Captain Osric. No matter the order you present them, he will fuss over and reject the first two before finally accepting the third, granting your reward. Regardless of the order you present them, he will reject the first two and select the third as the gift, allowing you to conclude the quest and obtain the reward. Or...
Speak with Althea: Collect any one of the items, then speak to Lady Althea in front of the Actors' Stage. She will accept the single beautiful item, concluding the quest and granting you the reward.

quests/quest:gww:45428/sections/notes-1/.text: If you are carrying more than one of the items, Lady Althea will take all of them when completing the quest.

Having Charr at the Gate active means the Beautiful Feather, the chest holding the Beautiful Pendant, and the Beautiful Shell do not spawn. Otherwise, even without A Gift for Althea active, all 3 will spawn.

Similarly, having Charr at the Gate active makes it impossible to initiate this quest, since Osric and Rurik will not initiate their conversation about Althea. You can begin the quest once you re-zone and talk to Osric.
Captain Osric's appearance and weapon during his conversation with Prince Rurik differ from those he has when he accepts the quest items.

quests/quest:gww:25339/sections/objectiv.text: Escort all three Forest Griffons safely to the Tower of Courage.
See Rastigan the Eternal for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25339/sections/walkthro.text: Upon accepting the quests, go near the griffons to get them to follow your team and then head back to where Rastigan the Eternal was (the Tower of Courage). There will be groups that appeared upon accepting the quest along the way, as seen in the map to the right. Be wary that the Forest Griffons can be killed easily and if just one dies the quest fails and the team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. Also, the griffons will follow moving party members in radar range.

An alternative method which takes a little bit more time but ensures not failing the quest is to head back to Rastigan and kill all the popup groups along the way before going near the Forest Griffons. Once the enemies are killed, have a party member go near the Griffons to lead them back to Rastigan.

quests/quest:gww:25339/sections/notes-1/.text: If any Forest Griffon dies after the quest is completed, your party still will be defeated (even if you have done all other quests). If you turn in the quest while not all three griffons are near Rastigan the Eternal you will get the reward, but the quest log won't be updated, stopping you from progressing (the remaining griffons who were out of range will remain in your party).

quests/quest:gww:25307/sections/objectiv.text: Find Greplak Froststaff and obtain the Heart of Ice from him.
Deliver the Heart of Ice to Howland the Elementalist.
Return to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25307/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the path on the map posted above to find Greplak. He can control Ice Golems, so when you get close to him he will try and summon more to defend himself with. All you have to do to finish this quest is talk to Greplak. He'll get scared and give you the Heart of Ice.

quests/quest:gww:25642/sections/objectiv.text: Follow Elonbel as he patrols the western riverbank.
Now that Elonbel's true allegiance has been revealed, deal with him and his cohorts accordingly.

quests/quest:gww:25642/sections/walkthro.text: Exit the Sunspear Great Hall and travel west to the river to find Elonbel. Once the player get close, he'll begin his patrol up the river. Along the way, he'll walk by a Level 10 Irontooth Drake surrounded by a swarm of Level 2 Juvenile Bladed Termites. Depending on the levels of the party members, players may want to avoid catching the Irontooth Drake's attention.
Elonbel will walk to camp just outside the Astralarium where the player finds him meeting with the corsairs. However, they discover Elonbel's been followed, and become hostile.

The corsairs are a minimal threat due to their low levels. However, Elonbel is Level 15 and can deal some moderate damage with his attacks. Low leveled players may want to consider bringing a full party with a Monk. Additionally, keeping the quests Quality Steel, Hog Hunt, and Proof of Courage active will provide players with additional allies to help as well.

If the player stays out of range, the corsairs and Elonbel will fight each other. Players can use this to their advantage by leaving the corsairs alive to whittle away at Elonbel's health, then finishing them off afterwards.
After defeating Elonbel and the corsairs, return to Shaurom in the Sunspear Great Hall to receive your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25642/sections/notes-1/.text: If the player arrives at the meeting point ahead of Elonbel, the Corsair Commandant may become hostile before the dialogue begins. Defeating him and Elonbel early will stop the Corsair Spotters from spawning. This will prevent the quest from being completed, and the player will have to start again.

quests/quest:gww:20304/sections/objectiv.text: Free the bound souls of the Imperial guards from Shiro's constructs. You have freed 0...3 of 3 souls.
Speak to Imperial Guard Hao Li.
See Imperial Captain Shi Wang for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:20304/sections/walkthro.text: Leave the Gate of Fear and head south into the swampy area of the Domain of Fear, where you will find the first 2 bound constructs to free. Each construct is accompanied by a mob of Margonites, and there are also patrols of Terrorweb Dryders and hidden creatures to defeat. The final construct is found north on the plain just outside the Gate of Secrets. Particular care should be take here due to the number of patrolling mobs present on the plain.

quests/quest:gww:20304/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with The Last Patrol for some much needed extra allies.

quests/quest:gww:63651/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Jaga Moraine and track down the polar bear.
Use the bear to drive the hunters away. You have driven away [0-5] of 5 hunters.
See Hogni Truthseeker for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63651/sections/walkthro.text: Travel to Jaga Moraine from Sifhalla and head for the Branch with Honey (location 1 on the map) near one of the resurrection shrines. Carry the branch to the hunter group (location 2 on the map). The hunters will run away when the bear approaches. Return to Hogni for your reward.

The bear can be killed by foes in the area and if it dies, you have to rezone and start over. To avoid this, drop the honey branch in a safe area (e.g. near Egil's Perch) and clear a path to the hunters. The bear will wait for your return; pick up the branch again so that it follows you to the hunters.
The bear can get trapped in corners; be careful not to lead it into one.
Quest is fully runable from Olafstead, using a build that includes running skills and an anti-cripple and/or KD skill.

quests/quest:gww:63651/sections/notes-1/.text: The Polar Bear involved in quest is not tameable.
You can save time by combining this quest with Krak's Cavalry, Prenuptial Disagreement, and Anything You Can Do.
Thackeray's scavenger hunt requires a set of Votive Candles, which can be acquired for the three honeycombs rewarded by this quest.

Any player in the party may complete the objectives for quest-holders by bringing the branch, for example, with a specialized running build. This may be useful for saving time when combining multiple quests at once.

quests/quest:gww:25648/sections/requirem.text: Having Isle of the Dead active or completed

quests/quest:gww:25648/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Sahreh's father, Dalz, just outside Beknur Harbor. Tell him about Sahreh's behavior and request he meet with the two lovers.
Meet Dalz on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
Bring Dalz to Behron and Sahreh.
Witness the duel. You can choose to aid Behron or simply let the duel resolve.
See Dalz Jelon for your reward.
Quest Failed. Travel to a nearby outpost or area, return and try again.
Quest Failed. Travel to a nearby outpost or area, return and try again.

quests/quest:gww:25648/sections/environm.text: Once this quest is completed, Behron will no longer spawn in Cliffs of Dohjok.

quests/quest:gww:25648/sections/walkthro.text: Behron and Sahreh are standing above the south-west tip of the quarry. At first this is a straight objective to either run to or map travel to Beknur Harbor. Dalz isn't 50 feet from the exit. The argument can seem drawn-out, but it is recommended to stand well-away from the 3 until all have turned hostile. Behron and Sahreh will turn hostile first, so if there are spirits or minions in the area, they will take after those two first. Also of note: Sahreh is a Monk, and if you send minions out of her range, she will chase them to heal them. If you have them, or have a hero who does, send them away before approaching Sahreh.
Use precision to pick off your villain of choice and avoid AoE's to spare nearby Sahreh.
If you accidentally kill someone you didn't want to, traveling to any town and re-entering the area will reset the quest to the point of meeting Dalz on the Cliffs.
If Sahreh dies, and neither Behron or Dalz have turned friendly yet, both Behron and Dalz remain hostile, forcing you to restart the quest to finish it.
If both Behron and Dalz have been killed near simultaneously, the quest will count as failed and you must restart from the meeting.

quests/quest:gww:11995/sections/walkthro.text: After receiving the quest, map travel to Zos Shivros Channel and head out the northern exit into the Boreas Seabed. The Halcyon is the large ship just to the north.

Several large groups of Outcasts patrol the area immediately around the Halcyon. However if you're careful you should only have to fight one group located at the left rear of the ship. The other groups will move away giving you access to the inside of the ship. Arani is inside the ship on the scaffolding (effectively the "2nd floor"), to get to her go up the ramps.

quests/quest:gww:22920/sections/objectiv.text: Take Koss to Arkjok Ward and talk to Herbalist Umjabwe. Find out what's upsetting the villagers.
Create a diversion to help the villagers escape.

quests/quest:gww:22920/sections/walkthro.text: Seek out Herbalist Umjabwe in the north-east section of Arkjok Ward. After talking to him, go to the location of the conscripted villagers. When the Kournan military escort turns hostile, kill them.

quests/quest:gww:22920/sections/notes-1/.text: Some Heroes and Henchmen do not attack when Koss's Elixir is done in the same run, but Jagged Horrors are able to inflict damage and Bleeding Condition when they replace Shambling Horrors. Occasionally, a nearby group of plants will patrol by the Kournan soldiers. If the Kournan soldiers do not become hostile (if you stay out of range of that quest trigger) the Kournans will peacefully stand by while the plants kill them. The quest can be completed in this fashion with little combat. The Plants will not attack the Kournan Captain.

quests/quest:gww:25663/sections/requirem.text: A Peaceful Solution not active or completed

quests/quest:gww:25663/sections/objectiv.text: Travel with Shaudok to the merchant's camp.
Teach the merchant and his bodyguards the error of their ways.

quests/quest:gww:25663/sections/walkthro.text: After taking the quest from Kohanu you have to speak to Shaudok. He will now come along with you to wherever you are going. Upon arriving at the merchant Dashon a dialogue will take place after which you get attacked. The bodyguards Merkod and Nadara are both warriors. With a 4 man team (human or hero/henchman) they should be no problem to beat. You will not have to kill them only bring down their health to about 20% and then they will turn friendly. You can do that one at the time. A second dialogue will now take place and after that you can return to Kohanu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25663/sections/notes-1/.text: Mutually exclusive with A Peaceful Solution.

Shaudok is shown holding a sword and shield rather than the spear Kohanu refers to. The pre-quest offer dialogue will always get initiated for non-Nightfall characters despite the fact that non-Nightfall characters will not be offered this quest.

quests/quest:gww:9471/sections/objective.text: Kill the rogue bull that is threatening Althea's theatre.
Return to Lady Althea for your reward.
Lady Althea will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:9471/sections/environme.text: Upon completing the quest, even before accepting the reward, the Rogue Bull will no longer spawn at the watering hole. Instead, Old Mac will appear near the gate and offer The Rogue's Replacement after having a word with Althea.
This change requires that all members of the party have completed the quest.

quests/quest:gww:9471/sections/walkthrou.text: Head roughly southwest from Lady Althea towards the pool of water to find the Rogue Bull. As a level 5 beast, the bull boasts a high armor rating that blunts standard physical attacks and can deal a significant amount of damage.

Begin the encounter by casting Imagined Burden to severely cripple the bull's movement speed. Follow up with Conjure Phantasm to apply steady health degeneration, bypassing its armor. Also be wary of its Bull's Charge, with which it can quickly close the gap and inflict a knock down, particularly if you are attempting to flee. Once the bull is dead, return to Lady Althea for your reward.
Skills which ignore armor, such as Bane Signet, Banish or Empathy
Health degeneration skills, such as Conjure Phantasm or Sever Artery
Healing skills, such as Orison of Healing or Troll Unguent

quests/quest:gww:25621/sections/requirem.text: Must have talked to Ruthless Sevad before bringing the supplies to Elder Jonah.

quests/quest:gww:25621/sections/objectiv.text: Bring Janeera the message from Ruthless Sevad.
See Ruthless Sevad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25621/sections/walkthro.text: Nice and easy. Map to the Sunspear Sanctuary and walk out into the Marga Coast, where Janeera is waiting in Ronjok village just outside. After speaking to Janeera, map to Camp Hojanu and return to Ruthless Sevad in the Barbarous Shore.

quests/quest:gww:25621/sections/notes-1/.text: Since this quest is picked up during one of the steps of A Question of Morality, Janeera can be very easily spoken to when you come to complete the latter quest.

quests/quest:gww:25637/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Kamadan and speak with Clerk Arlon.
Acquire official papers to grant Jatoro diplomatic status.
Relieve the clerk of some of his duties so he can draft Jatoro's diplomatic papers.
Bring Jatoro the official papers proving he has ambassador status

quests/quest:gww:25637/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, travel to Kamadan and speak with Clerk Arlon; he stands near the exit to Consulate Docks. He gives you the quest One Good Turn Deserves Another. Complete that quest and then speak again with Clerk Arlon. Now you have the diplomatic papers for Jatoro. All you now need to do is get your reward from Jatoro Musagi at Kodlonu Hamlet.

quests/quest:gww:25637/sections/notes-1/.text: Unlike other quests, the quest item Official Papers will only be taken once you accept the reward.

quests/quest:gww:17681/sections/objectiv.text: Find Gate Guard Hollis at the eastern gate in Old Ascalon]. Give him Zain's strongbox.
Return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17681/sections/walkthro.text: Walk northwest from Ambassador Zain. Keep going west along the Wall until you reach the portal leading out into The Breach. Gate Guard Hollis is standing in front of the sign. Speak with him and return to Zain for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17681/sections/notes-1/.text: The rewarded Jeweled Chalice has what would normally be the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chakram. Conversely, the quest Frontier Gate Fugitives rewards a Jeweled Chakram with the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chalice.

quests/quest:gww:17982/sections/objectiv.text: Go with Paulus and use your healing prayers to make sure he survives.
Return to Brother Mhenlo for your reward.
Brother Mhenlo will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:17982/sections/walkthro.text: Upon receiving the quest from Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey, head through the portal into the Catacombs. Paulus will be waiting just outside the entrance. When you approach him, he will start walking. Simply follow him, staying close by at all times so he doesn't stop walking.

Although your primary duty is to keep Paulus breathing, he is surprisingly self-sufficient. His Bane Signet is enough to nearly one-shot a Raging Cadaver or Restless Corpse when they ambush you along the path. Combined with a couple attacks of your own, you can easily dispatch most of them before they lay a rotting finger on him. If you want to make sure of that, stay slightly ahead of Paulus to draw the initial aggression.

Eventually, Paulus leads you into the Swamp Water section. While inside, it inflicts continuous health degeneration on both of you. Unless Paulus was damaged earlier or either of you gets bogged down by an enemy, he can actually survive the trip without needing to be healed even once. In fact, you might want to keep a closer look on your own health. For peace of mind (and to practice your new skill), tossing one or two Orisons of Healing his way while in the water will guarantee a safe retrieval.

You shouldn't encounter any enemies on the way back, as you've already cleared the path of undead. Follow Paulus until you both reach the entrance to Ashford Abbey. Wait for the quest to update then walk through the portal and collect your reward from Mhenlo.

quests/quest:gww:22258/sections/objectiv.text: You must defeat 10 more Am Fah
See Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward

quests/quest:gww:22258/sections/walkthro.text: This quest does not have a green quest marker to follow until completed. Instead, simply killing the required number of Am Fah is tallied while the quest is active.

quests/quest:gww:22258/sections/notes-1/.text: You can complete this quest, The Xunlai Agent, Eliminate the Am Fah or many other quests simultaneously.
When starting Vizunah Square from the Local Quarter, this quest will be completed without a fight, as Mhenlo and his party will kill enough Am Fah while making their way to your location.

quests/quest:gww:25670/sections/objectiv.text: Find the location of the farm referred to in Yomindhe's note.
Travel to the Plains of Jarin.
See Scholar Chago for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25670/sections/walkthro.text: Leave from Jokanur Diggings out into Zehlon Reach. Head for the compass point in the northwest corner of Zehlon Reach. Talk to Farmer Muenda there and then open the Warped Chest.

Map travel to Kamadan and head out into the Plains of Jarin. Follow the compass point to a Mound of Dirt. Rummage through it to find Yomindhe's message and journal, then return to Scholar Chago to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25670/sections/notes-1/.text: If the player accesses the Warped Chest before talking to Farmer Muenudo, it is possible that the map marker will not appear properly when you travel to the Plains of Jarin despite your quest journal updating. The Mound of Dirt can be found just north of the Sentient Root Collector.

quests/quest:gww:19050/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford Abbey to find Wizard's Folly. Continue following the road until you reach the tower, and speak to Elementalist Aziure.

quests/quest:gww:19050/sections/walkthro.text: Although the journey from Lakeside County to Elementalist Aziure is long, the path is not hard to find. Simply go south and continue past Ashford Abbey. Follow the signs to Wizard's Folly. Once there, follow the road that leads into the mountains. For those who have not explored the area yet, it is a good idea to visit Foible's Fair, as this outpost is just along the path.

Farther along the road you will see a very large tower. Elementalist Aziure can be found at the foot of the central tower. Speaking to her and accepting the quest immediately starts the action. While you're presented with new skills, ice elementals rush to your location in waves. Three waves of three ice elementals will rush in and attack.

Despite the strength and number of ice elementals, take a moment to accept at least two of the skills offered by Aziure for immediate use on your skill bar: Glyph of Lesser Energy and Firestorm. These two skills can be used to handle most of the the elementals while any other offensive skills you may have will deal with the rest.

quests/quest:gww:19050/sections/notes-1/.text: In the mountain you will encounter many Ice Elementals, so be sure to bring fire related skills to make defeating the creatures easier.

Next to the resurrection shrine outside of Foibles Fair you will encounter a collector named Savich. He will exchange 3 Icy Lodestones for a pair of Elementalist's Gloves, so be sure to save any stones you may acquire from fighting elementals in the mountains.

quests/quest:gww:9266/sections/objective.text: Meet Merchant Orek and the Caravan in Drazach Thicket.
Escort Merchant Orek and the Caravan to Saint Anjeka's Shrine.
See Merchant Orek for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9266/sections/walkthrou.text: You'll find Merchant Orek waiting just outside the north exit of Brauer Academy, with his caravan of 3 other Merchants. Once you talk to Orek, the quest will update and point towards Saint Anjeka's Shrine to which you must lead Orek and his merchants, defeating any creatures you encounter along the way and taking care of the 4 allies as well.

The merchants are quite weak, so you should beware of warden popups as you travel through Drazach Thicket, they can cause trouble by focusing their attacks on the merchants. Once you are within sight of the shrine outpost, there will also be two groups of wardens and three groups of dragon mosses to defeat.
At the end, walk up to, but do not enter Saint Anjeka's Shrine, and wait for the quest to update, then speak to Orek to collect your reward.

Alternatively, if you have unlocked Saint Anjeka's Shrine, you can do the quest backwards: starting from the shrine, head towards the academy to clear the way and pick up the merchants, then return the way you came.

quests/quest:gww:9266/sections/notes-1/b.text: Only Orek must survive to complete the quest; the unnamed merchants are expendable.
The caravan follows the party leader; you can send others in the party (including heroes and henchman) ahead to clear the way.
If you keep the quest active, the three groups of Dragon Moss can be farmed for Plant Fibers, Spiritwood Planks, and Dragon Roots.
Although the unnamed merchants are listed as Monks, they do not use any healing skills on themselves or the party. However, they will attack using their wands.

quests/quest:gww:25465/sections/objectiv.text: Help Curator Ruras unearth a fossil for his "Tyrian Investors."
Bring the fossilized shellfish to Curator Ruras.
Escort Curator Ruras back to the Lair of the Forgotten.
See Curator Ruras for your reward

quests/quest:gww:25465/sections/walkthro.text: Find a Pile of Rocks that contains the fossil that Curator Ruras needs. After that, escort Ruras back to the Lair of the Forgotten. He does not join as an ally so there is no need to worry about him getting attacked.

quests/quest:gww:25465/sections/notes-1/.text: Fondalz the Spiteful hovers near Curator Ruras' starting position with the Signet of Suffering elite skill.

quests/quest:gww:25494/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road northwest from town. Talk to Lady Althea at the Actor's Stage.

quests/quest:gww:25494/sections/walkthro.text: Upon receiving the quest, follow the road to the northwest and head up the hill. The Actor's Stage is on just up this hill next to the city walls, and Lady Althea can be found standing in front of it. Simply talk to her and obtain your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25496/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road southwest toward Ashford. Continue on to Ashford Abbey. Talk to Brother Mhenlo.

quests/quest:gww:25496/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the road southwest along the river and up a hill until a cliff edge overlooking the village of Ashford to the south. Follow the road as it turns west towards a fenced off building. Enter the portal at the end of the road to arrive at Ashford Abbey.

quests/quest:gww:25495/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road southwest from town. Proceed past Ashford Abbey to the Catacombs. Talk to Necromancer Munne.

quests/quest:gww:25495/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the road southwest along the river and up a hill until a cliff edge overlooking the village of Ashford to the south. Follow the road as it turns west towards a fenced off building. Enter the portal at the end of the road to arrive at Ashford Abbey.

Inside Ashford Abbey, exit via the western portal to enter the primary entrance area of the Catacombs. Inside, head directly right. Necromancer Munne can be seen standing within an old building immediately to the north. Talk to her to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25495/sections/notes-1/.text: Wilton Payce can be found traveling this route to and from Ascalon City.

quests/quest:gww:25498/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road southwest from town. Turn south on the bridge near the village and enter Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.

quests/quest:gww:25498/sections/walkthro.text: It will take a while to reach Master Ranger Nente's location, but the path is not hard to follow or travel. From Haversdan, follow the road southwest along the river. Before the bridge to Ashford Village, turn south and follow the signs into Regent Valley (which is another explorable area). Continue south along the road past non-hostile Devourers to find Master Ranger Nente on a small rise.

quests/quest:gww:25497/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road northwest from town. Follow the signs to Green Hills County. Talk to Warmaster Grast.

quests/quest:gww:25497/sections/walkthro.text: Head northwest along the road from Haversdan and follow the road to Green Hills County. Warmaster Grast is standing near where you entered, before the large statue of Balthazar.

quests/quest:gww:25667/sections/requirem.text: A Loose Cannon not active or completed

quests/quest:gww:25667/sections/objectiv.text: Travel with Shaudok to the merchant's camp.

quests/quest:gww:25667/sections/walkthro.text: After taking the quest from Kohanu you have to speak to Shaudok. He will now come along with you to wherever you are going. Upon arriving at the merchant Dashon a dialogue will take place after which you get attacked. The bodyguards Merkod and Nadara are both warriors. With a 4 man team (human or hero/henchman) they should be no problem to beat. You will not have to kill them only bring down their health to about 20% and then they will turn friendly. You can do that one at the time. A second dialogue will now take place and after that you can return to Kohanu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25667/sections/notes-1/.text: Mutually exclusive with A Loose Cannon.
Shaudok is more a dead weight than a loose cannon. He simply won't join any fight.

Shaudok is shown holding a sword and shield rather than the spear Kohanu refers to. The pre-quest offer dialogue will always get initiated for non-Nightfall characters despite the fact that non-Nightfall characters will not be offered this quest.

quests/quest:gww:25671/sections/objectiv.text: Search Fahranur for clues as to the nature of the Scarab Plague.
See Scholar Chago for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25671/sections/walkthro.text: From Jokanur Diggings, enter Fahranur, The First City and move forward a little to get the quest objective to update. The rest of the quest is accomplished by simply following the quest marker to find five different interactive objects. In order, your character needs to examine two sets of Weathered Bones, an Old Chest, a Rusty Chest, and a Loose Rock. At each location, several hostile insects will spawn, but they are easily dispatched.

quests/quest:gww:25671/sections/notes-1/.text: Several additional chests may spawn near the location of the respective interactive objects.

quests/quest:gww:18798/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to a Xunlai Agent and open a storage account.
See Xunlai Agent Jueh for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18798/sections/walkthro.text: With the money you earned from completing quests in Chahbek Village (plus completing the first mission), you should have more than enough money to give your new character access to your storage and add access to the crafting material storage. It will cost 100 gold to accomplish this feat. Simply walk up the stairs to the north and turn right and speak with the other Xunlai Agents.
Note: You only need to open the account in order to complete the quest, but it's easier to kill two birds with one stone by adding the crafting material storage.

quests/quest:gww:23983/sections/objectiv.text: Protect the fields. Do not let them be overrun.
See Elder Isma for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23983/sections/walkthro.text: When you reach Elder Isma in Arkjok Ward north farmers village, the preamble dialog starts. The quest is only available from Isma after she finishes her speech.

Once you accept the quest, a timer starts counting down from 5 minutes. If the timer reaches 0:00 with any foes still alive, the quest fails, and you will have to leave the zone and return to try again.

The invading insects come as 3 waves of 2 groups each. All the groups spawn and approach from the portal to Jahai Bluffs nearby, so the party can easily intercept and destroy them by standing in front of the portal - just make sure you don't accidentally run through after a creature. Flagging heroes/henchmen near the first field below the portal is a good way to catch the first insect invaders as you return from accepting the quest. Correct placement also helps ensure all the attackers clear the portal but don't scatter over the fields.
When all the insects are killed, speak to Elder Isma to get the reward.

quests/quest:gww:23983/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be used to farm Insect Carapaces.

quests/quest:gww:14240/sections/objectiv.text: Locate the caravan in Arkjok Ward.
Steal the supplies from Herbalist Umjabwe.
Take the herbal remedies to Ruthless Sevad in Barbarous Shore or Elder Jonah in Ronjok.
Take the herbal remedies to Elder Jonah in Ronjok. (added if the party goes to Ruthless Sevad first)

quests/quest:gww:14240/sections/walkthro.text: This can be started from either the Command Post, Yohlon Haven or Pogahn Passage. The party will need to make their way to Umjabwe, who can be found in the north-east side of Arkjok Ward overlooking the farmland areas. Umjabwe will be surrounded by a group of Kournans, which the party will have to defeat to continue the quest.
Once the Kourans are dispatched, speak to Umjabwe to get his supplies, and then decide who is more deserving of them: the corsair blackmailer Ruthless Sevad, or the needy village of Ronjok.

To get to Ronjok, it's quickest to map back to the Sunspear Sanctuary and walk out into the Marga Coast where you will find Elder Jonah. Ruthless Sevad as always will be found in the Barbarous Shore, south of Camp Hojanu. Should you choose to speak with Ruthless Sevad first, an additional quest can be picked up before he directs you to take the medicines to Elder Jonah anyway.

quests/quest:gww:14240/sections/notes-1/.text: To get the followup quest, you must return to see Ruthless Sevad, before taking the herbal remedies to Elder Jonah.

quests/quest:gww:25485/sections/objectiv.text: Inform Palawa Joko about the Great Margonite Temple in The Sulfurous Wastes.
Report to Officer Lohru in the Remains of Sahlahja.
Report to Officer Lohru in The Sulfurous Wastes. She will release minions to you.
Destroy the Great Margonite Temple with the rune!
See Palawa Joko for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25485/sections/environm.text: Once this quest has been completed, allied Mummies will spawn in The Sulfurous Wastes and Graven Monoliths will no longer spawn in The Sulfurous Wastes.

quests/quest:gww:25485/sections/walkthro.text: Firstly, you need to travel to the Bone Palace and talk to Palawa Joko.
Next, you will need to travel back to the Remains of Sahlahja and talk to Officer Lohru (the quest giver). She will also give you a Rune of DOOM.

Then you must travel outside to The Sulfurous Wastes and optionally talk to Officer Lohru out there. There is no reason not to, though you are able to complete the quest without taking this step. She will give you four Minions of Joko to fight for you. They will not really help that much, just doing a little damage and taking some damage for you. Before you leave, consider bringing a lockpick or key, because in the temple there is one Ancient Elonian Chest and one Treasure Chest (the latter of which does not need a key).

Next you must travel from there to the Great Margonite Temple (structure at the bottom left of the map) using the wurms. You will have to defeat all of the enemies in the temple, then destroy it. There will be a ton of Graven Monoliths, but with your wurms, it should be no problem. There will also be Abaddon Shrines lining the outside of the temple. You will need to use each shrine, with the Rune of DOOM that you got earlier in your inventory. When you use each shrine, five Graven Monoliths will always spawn. With them will be either zero, two or four Margonites as well, except in the first shrine on the right-hand side when you first enter the temple. On the left-hand side, the first four Shrines will have only Monoliths, the last two will have two margonites. On the right-hand side, the first shrine will have three Margonite bosses, the next three will have four margonites and the last two will have two margonites.

After you use all of the shrines, your quest log will be updated, telling you to travel back to the Bone Palace and see Palawa Joko for your reward. You do not have to defeat all of the spawns to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25485/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be used in conjunction with Requiem for a Brain to farm Sunspear and Lightbringer points (see Guide to farming Lightbringer promotion points).

Some players avoid claiming the quest reward, since it provides an easy opportunity to farm Graven Monoliths for Inscribed Shards (needed for Sticks and Stones) or Elemental Swords. Remember to map out while one shrine remains (or abandon and retake the quest).
Although this quest is marked as "Master" difficulty, it can be easily completed using Junundu.

As with other triggered spawns, one or more of the shrine-based monoliths will sometimes appear without being able to aggro or respond to attacks. Likewise, heroes will not attack them until the player initiates combat. While in this inactive state, they appear in their fully assembled form.

quests/quest:gww:10448/sections/objectiv.text: Visit some of Ahmtur's old friends and acquaintances. Find suitable reinforcements.
Visit Ordash in the Kodash Bazaar.
See Archivist Mijir in the Halls of Chokhin.
Consult with retired General Poruk in Vehtendi Valley.
Speak to Hervahn the Vexing in Resplendent Makuun.
See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10448/sections/walkthro.text: Ordash is easily found by mapping to the Kodash Bazaar and speaking to him near the fountain.
Archivist Mijir is in the library north of Mihanu Township.
General Poruk is by a shrine, just to the east side of the Kodash Bazaar, head out of the south-east corner of the town.
Hervahn the Vexing is just to the south-east of Honur Hill in Prince Bokka's palace.

It's worth noting that all these npcs can be reached and spoken to without the need to fight any creatures - getting to Mijir may need some fancy footwork to avoid aggroing the groups along the way, but it is possible.

quests/quest:gww:25675/sections/objectiv.text: Eliminate the corsairs camping out in Lahtenda Bog. 0..5 of 5 camps still remain.
See Guard Kovu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25675/sections/walkthro.text: Head out into Lahtenda Bog and follow the green compass point to find the 5 corsair camps. There is a group of 6 level 15-17 Corsair Seamen at each camp. Expect pop-ups along the way.

quests/quest:gww:25672/sections/objectiv.text: Catch the three children and retrieve the stolen spores.
See Scholar Chago for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25672/sections/walkthro.text: Enter Zehlon Reach by way of the Astralarium. As you approach the group of three children, they'll begin to discuss the spores they stole from Scholar Chago. They'll notice you and start running - Nehduvad in one direction, and Adina and Paldinam in the opposite direction.

It's easy to get close to the children while they are standing and talking; simply get inside their little circle, and then talk to them very quickly once Nehduvad shouts to run away. It is possible to catch all 3 of them before they get past the first group of insects.

If that fails, then it's best to use a speed boosting skill to try and catch the children before they wander off. If the children slip away from you, don't worry. They meet up near the exit to the Cliffs of Dohjok to the south. The children will run through mobs of insects, corsairs, skale, and plants. Travel southwest and take out the groups one by one, grabbing bounties along the way.

If you reach the exit to the Cliffs of Dohjok before the children do, simply wait for them to show up. Use your speed boosting skill of choice to run up to them and get the spore. Once you've spoken with all three children, return to the Astralarium and see Scholar Chago to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25463/sections/objectiv.text: Meet up with Charen in the Ruptured Heart.
Journey with Charen to find Rebirther Jirath, the Margonite soul eater.
Wait in hiding until you hear the signal. The code word is: cat.
Kill the soul eating Margonite before he devours Charen.

quests/quest:gww:25463/sections/walkthro.text: Once you meet Charen in the North Eastern portion of The Ruptured Heart go south to the shrine where Jirath is waiting. Initially he will be an ally and you will not be able to attack him. Wait for Charen to talk to Jirath without going in Jirath's aggro range or Jirath will flee before he becomes an enemy. If you wait patiently the dialogue will follow and Jirath will start attacking Charen. You must kill him before he kills Charen to successfully complete the quest.
To make things easier you can clear the area of monsters first, optionally using the Junundu. There is a Wurm Spoor close-by.

If, during your current visit, you have passed near the resurrection shrine where Jirath is, Charen will head directly there (instead of staying with you) and will often get stuck on the way, preventing completion of the quest. If rezoning does not work, you can try abandoning the quest: afterward, return to the Ruptured Heart to pick up the quest again and this time, avoid the shrine until after you speak to Charen.

quests/quest:gww:19046/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the ridge east until you find a plague worm. Kill all the Plague Worms in the time allotted.
Return to Ivor Trueshot for your reward.
Ivor Trueshot will give you a Starter bow and the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:19046/sections/walkthro.text: This is a simple quest. Just go to the pointed location and kill all the worms in under 1 minute and 30 seconds. Using the skills provided with the quest will make it much easier for Bow wielding characters.

quests/quest:gww:19046/sections/notes-1/.text: The worms do not need to be killed with a bow to complete this quest.
The skills will not be removed if the quest is abandoned or the timer runs out. This is useful if a careful experience management strategy is needed.
Once the quest is completed, the worms will not spawn anymore

quests/quest:gww:25620/sections/objectiv.text: Assault the Kournan column marching north to Jahai.
Fall back to escape the incoming Kournan army.
Run toward Pogahn to escape the Kournan reinforcements.

quests/quest:gww:25620/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Pogahn Passage and head west. Clearing the path between the portal and Nerashi’s location, (including the two Kournan guards near Gandara's side gate) will make this quest easier.
Once you reach Nerashi, there are two possible strategies. The first option is the quicker, more direct approach. The second strategy takes longer, but can be easier & safer.
Accepting the quest from Nerashi will cause three waves of Kournan soldiers to advance toward your location. Each wave must be completely defeated before the next will begin their approach.

The first wave is made up of Kournan Guards, Phalanxes and Bowmen. 
 The second wave is a combination of Kournan Priests, Seers and Scribes. 
 The third wave is a mix of Kournan Zealots and Oppressors.

Once the first three waves are defeated, the quest marker will update and Nerashi will tell the party to fall back. You can choose to stay and fight the extra groups, but be forewarned that all three waves will attack as one mob, and can easily overwhelm an unprepared party.

Whether you choose to fight or run, another Kournan ambush waits to the east, at the quest marker. Pulling the mobs toward the small bridge can help prevent over-aggro (and/or getting hit by Kournan siege fire from Gandara.) After the second set of Kournan mobs are killed, Nerashi will again advise the party to retreat. As before, you can choose to fight the incoming soldiers, or just run to the next quest marker right outside of Pogahn Passage.
