Do not enter the portal. Wait for the quest to update, and then collect your reward from Nerashi.
Instead of taking the quest from Nerashi, the easier approach is to completely ignore her until your party is finished clearing all the Kournans from the area.

The soldiers are clumped together into three large groups in the western plain just past Nerashi. (These mobs are the first three waves and both extra groups that chase the party.) They can be easily pulled and defeated, one at a time. Sometimes, one group will break off and gather around Nerashi, but will not attack her. Clear the remaining Kournans, and then pick off that mob as normal.
Consider activating the nearby resurrection shrine, so the party can easily pick up where they left off in case of disaster.

Once all three groups have been eliminated, continue back east and defeat the soldiers that spawn near the fortress. Scout the path back to Pogahn Passage, clearing any stray Kournans, then return to Nerashi to take the quest.
Follow her through the now-empty quest markers, but do not run into Pogahn Passage. Wait until the quest updates, then accept the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25620/sections/notes-1/.text: It is recommended that you complete this quest prior to vanquishing the area, as it spawns several mobs of Kournan Soldiers.

quests/quest:gww:214511/sections/objecti.text: *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:214511/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:214511/sections/walkthr.text: As per A Time for Heroes quest.

quests/quest:gww:289241/sections/objecti.text: Find and speak with Ryun Grayfeather in Jaya Bluffs.
Defend Tsumei Village from the attacking Sensali Tengu.
Defeat the Ministry of Purity's Forces.
See Soar Honorclaw for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289241/sections/shared-.text: Ryun Grayfeather waits for you in Jaya Bluffs just outside Seitung Harbor. Talk to him to be sent into an explorable area version of Tsumei Village, which you must defend from attacking forces.

The Sensali attack first; midway into the battle, Ryun Grayfeather will arrive to reinforce your position with the Angchu Tengu. After you defeat the Sensali, the Ministry of Purity's forces will arrive, entering the village. After a brief dialogue, the Ministry forces become hostile. Defeat these enemies to complete the quest.

All attacks come from the east; if you are farther than earshot range outside the gate, you will be teleported back to the village. The gate is a natural choke point: use this to ball up the Sensali so you can maximize your area of effect skills. Alternatively you can fight at the high ground in the center of town.
Bring corpse exploitation skills to counter the enemy's use of Aura of the Lich.
Alternatively, bring your own minion master, Verata's Aura, or other minion counters.

If you flag heroes near the first Ministry group, while they are non-hostile, they will attempt to heal any minions. Shortly after combat begins, the minions will expire and explode (if you bring Death Nova and other minion bomber skills).

Trappers are very effective since you can funnel all incoming enemies through the village gate. They have plenty of time to set traps for the final battle, since the next-to-last dialogue is long-winded.
If players stray too far outside the portals in the village, players are teleported back inside the village walls and the message "You must not abandon the village!" displays.

quests/quest:gww:25669/sections/objectiv.text: Kill insects and gather 10 Scarab Spores for Scholar Chago. 0...10 of 10 spores gathered.
See Scholar Chago for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25669/sections/walkthro.text: You can farm insects in Fahranur, The First City. Start from Blacktide Den if you want a party of eight.

quests/quest:gww:25669/sections/notes-1/.text: It's a good idea to do the quest Defender's Choice at the same time, since the insects reached from the Jokanur Diggings entrance is near the targets for Defender's Choice.

quests/quest:gww:269280/sections/walkthr.text: Follow the path along Majesty's Rest towards the Sage Lands. There are fewer foes if you go around the north of The Mausoleum and Rotscale.
As in other Hearts of the North mini-missions:
Use Keiran's Sniper Shot against targets called out by Miku, which causes over 900 points of damage if it hits (unless Miku's Promise of Death is removed).
If Miku dies, she will self-resurrect once no enemies are in earshot.

quests/quest:gww:269280/sections/notes-1.text: This quest is automatically obtained upon entering Majesty's Rest (via the Scrying Pool), and will be removed should one leave.
The foes that spawn near Danthor (friendly until approached) can be individually pulled.
Danthor can be separated from his group and killed quickly, ending the mission. Attack him, step back and wait for Miku to call him as a target, then use Keiran's Sniper Shot to finish the job.
Even if you die, this quest can still be completed if Danthor dies (either via Miku or degen).

If your inventory is full after Danthor is defeated, any reward items will be dropped on the ground; they will be in the Unclaimed Items box the next time you enter an outpost, if you do not get a chance to pick them up sooner.

While you must equip Keiran's Bow to access this mission, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has weapon upgrades appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
Rotscale can be killed during this mission, making this an easy way to get Rotwing Recurve Bow. However, his death during this mission will not count for his Zaishen Bounty.

quests/quest:gww:211562/sections/objecti.text: *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

*BONUS* Guide the spirit of Leah Stone to her rest.

quests/quest:gww:25499/sections/objectiv.text: Find your way north of the Wall. Search the road to Piken Square for Ben Wolfson.
Lead Ben Wolfson back to the gate.
Return to Gate Guard Torin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25499/sections/environm.text: Reforged Mode: After completing this quest, even before accepting the reward, Ben Wolfson will spawn in Lakeside County next to Gate Guard Torin, offering A Bastion In the North.

quests/quest:gww:25499/sections/walkthro.text: To enter the Northlands, you must open the gate behind Torin by pulling the lever above it. While Torin insists you need a partner, you can pull the lever, enter the opened gate and proceed with the rest of the quest entirely on your own since the June 6, 2018 update.

In the Northlands, head north, ignoring the path east leading to large ruins and packs of Charr. You should come to a fork in the road, with one path descending to the right (north-east) toward areas of water and one to the left (west) leading to a cliff and a few Oakhearts.

Follow the left path. At its end, you will find a group of Grawl at the bottom of the cliff to the right, a group of four Charr near one of their gods' effigy to the left, with Ben in the back in between. Avoid aggroing any of the two hostile groups. While the Grawl should not pose much of a threat, the Charr will easily kill you in a matter of seconds if you are not prepared for them. Wait until they group up before carefully sneaking past them, hugging the cliff to the right.

Alternatively, instead of taking the left path at the fork, you can opt for the right one instead, crossing the lake. This makes it easier to avoid the Charr, but you will have to confront the group of Grawl directly, as they are in the way.

As you get close to Ben, the quest will update and the Grawl will start moving toward Ben's location in an attempt to ambush you. You can either dispose of them with Ben's help, or simply back up to the cliff, wait and sneak around them. Note that you need to get closer to Ben than just aggro range, as he will not follow you otherwise (despite him telling you "I'm right behind you"). Occasionaly, the Grawl may even aggro the Charr, usually leading to their death.
To complete the quest, simply escort Ben back to the gate. Go through the gate yourself and talk to Torin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25499/sections/notes-1/.text: Having Across the Wall active in the quest log will override NPC spawns for A Bastion In the North and will prevent access to the Piken Square outpost (except by map travel) and the Forsaken Tunnels, so it must be abandoned or completed (though not necessarily handed in for rewards) whenever the subsequent quests are attempted.
During this quest, all three gates leading to the northern section of the Northlands will be open, instead of just the Piken Square gate.

quests/quest:gww:209242/sections/objecti.text: Kill Admiral Kantoh in the Fortress of Jahai.
*BONUS* Kill Admiral Kantoh in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:209242/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:209242/sections/walkthr.text: Leave from the Sunspear Sanctuary, through the Command Post into Jahai Bluffs. From there keep going east until you reach the Fortress of Jahai. There are a large number of foes within the fort so it is advised to bring a longbow for pulling. Also area of effect skills are of great use. Skills like Panic, Spiteful Spirit, and Searing Flames can greatly help turn the odds. A minion master is also valuable in taking advantage of the number of corpses, but be careful as they can overaggro. The boss is at the very top of the fort and should not be too much of a problem if your party makes it to him without much difficulty. Speed tip: It is not necessary to fight all the Kournan foe and go to the top of the hill, if you aggro the Admiral from outside the fort - before crossing the bridge. Killing him is possible with skills that will ignore walls. This can avoid 6 or 7 mobs of Kournan.

quests/quest:gww:25410/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Weng Gha again to begin your test.
Use defensive skills to survive attacks for 2 minutes, or defeat Jinzo and Weng Gha.
See Instructor Ng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25410/sections/walkthro.text:
If you can, just defeat them. Otherwise, use the skills you gained when accepting the quest to stay alive for as long as you can.
 Also, since Weng Gha will be using Drunken Blow, bring a condition removal skill.

quests/quest:gww:25410/sections/notes-1/.text: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are Weh no Su. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.

quests/quest:gww:14784/sections/objectiv.text: Return to Ascalon City. Form a party with another player.

quests/quest:gww:14784/sections/walkthro.text: This is a very simple and short quest. All that is needed is a fellow party member. If you don't have a friend online, there are generally plenty of players in Ascalon City wanting to do this quest as well, so if you need someone, just send a message in the chat window. If you find a player who is willing to join you, and they haven't invited you already, you will need to invite them to join you. Once you have a full party and both of you are ready, exit Ascalon City towards Lakeside County and the quest is complete. Speak to Lina the Healer for the reward.

It is worth doing this quest in order to get the Resurrection Signet, even if you intend to solo during the entirety of your time in pre-Searing Ascalon, since you'll have to pay in order to get it following the Searing. You may wish to skip this quest if you take Monk as your primary or secondary profession, as reusable resurrection skills are available later on; however, none are available immediately after reaching post-Searing Ascalon.

quests/quest:gww:14784/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be completed without a partner by adding the hero Devona to your party.

It may be difficult to complete this quest if you are using a free trial account, as you can't use chat or invite another player to your party. It would require being invited to a party, or obtaining Devona.

quests/quest:gww:203388/sections/objecti.text: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203388/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203388/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Against the Charr mission.

See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281916/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281916/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Alcazia Tangle on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281916/sections/target-.text: Leave via any of the exits in the Tarnished Haven. If that outpost has not been reached, then start from Rata Sum and pass through either Magus Stones or Riven Earth.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:

When engaging dinosaurs in Hard mode (excluding Raptors), forgetting to spread out in their area of effect damage will easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen. Ceratadons particularly must be avoided at melee range due to their deadly spells.
Shing Jea Sherman can be used as an additional ally for foes to target, which can relieve some pressure off your party.
When looking for your final foes, remember there is a group of Simians right up against the portal to Arbor Bay.
This area can be completely explored without enemies during the quest Insidious Remnants for Master of the North.
The southern edge of the map does not line up with the character perspectives along the coast. For this reason, some of the explorable footage in those areas does not clear when explored.

quests/quest:gww:25731/sections/walkthro.text: Talk to Olias to have him join your party as an ally, then follow the map, fighting each group of enemies along the way. You will first encounter two groups of two Thorn Stalkers, then three groups of two Jungle Trolls, and finally two groups of White Mantle. The first White Mantle group consists of two Zealots and a Seeker, and the second group consists of a Zealot, a Seeker, and an Abbot. When you arrive at the Bloodstone, you will meet the necromancer boss Erulai the Inimical. Wait for Erulai and Olias to finish talking, then fight Erulai until he is low on health. After more dialogue, two Blades of Corruption and one Arm of Insanity will spawn and be hostile to both Erulai and your party. Kill them, then return to Kamadan and speak to Clerk Arlon to collect your reward.
