quests/quest:gww:25237/sections/objectiv.text: Find the temple where Althea was killed and use the Barradin Family Urn to gather her ashes.
Bring Althea's Ashes to Duke Barradin.

quests/quest:gww:25237/sections/walkthro.text: First, make sure you have the Barradin Family Urn.

Head to Diessa Lowlands in order to reach the Flame Temple Corridor where the ashes are located. It is easier to start from the Grendich Courthouse, but if player hasn't been there yet, it's possible to start from Piken Square and get to Diessa Lowlands from The Breach. The entrance to the Flame Temple Corridor is in the north-east corner of the Diessa Lowlands across the large tar pit.

Once at the Flame Temple Corridor, fight several groups of Charr and get to the altar where Althea's ashes are. There will be four Ascalon Strikers allies, but they aren't very strong. It's advisable to clear a single path towards the altar. The altar is guarded by a large group of Charr, so players should try to avoid aggroing too many groups at once. After the Charr have been cleared, interact with the Altar and the Barradin Family Urn will turn into the Urn of Althea's Ashes.
An alternative to killing the large groups of Charr at the altar would be to just run up and click on the altar, instead of fighting the Charr. Consider using henchmen as a decoy.

quests/quest:gww:25237/sections/notes-1/.text: Having The Titan Source active will make this quest much more difficult.
To collect the ashes one must have the Barradin Family Urn in your inventory.
If player does not have the urn in their inventory, talking to Duke Barradin will give another.
It is possible to get multiple urns by placing them into the Storage and talking to Duke Barradin.
Having multiple urns into the inventory, it is possible to interact with the altar multiple times to get multiple ashes from one single visit.
It is possible to complete the quest by buying the ashes from another player.
It is not possible to collect ashes from the altar if the quest is not active or is completed.

quests/quest:gww:12683/sections/objectiv.text: Collect as much amber as possible before the timer runs out. Kill a boss to gain a time bonus.

quests/quest:gww:12683/sections/rewards-.text: Scoring in this mission rewards Kurzick faction, experience, and gold based on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.

quests/quest:gww:12683/sections/walkthro.text: This mission has a 10 minute time limit, however, killing a boss adds 60 seconds to the timer. 30 seconds after the mission timer starts, Azukhan Stonewrath spawns in the north-west. After 1 minute, Froth Stonereap spawns in the north-east. After 1 minute 30 seconds, Ennsa Stoneweaver spawns in the southwest. After 2 minutes, Dorn Stonebreaker spawns in the southeast. Each boss respawns 5 minutes after being killed.

There are two types of amber to collect, both of which add 1 point to the total score when picked up. Raw Amber Chunks are dropped when an enemy is killed (bosses drop 4). Refined Amber Chunks randomly spawn on the ground.
Consider bringing speed stances or shouts to quickly move around. Also consider bringing AoE ( Area of Effect) and DoT (Damage over Time) characters to assist with the multiple enemies

quests/quest:gww:12683/sections/notes-1/.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
Obtaining a score of 100 or above will increase your Kurzick faction cap once by 1000.

quests/quest:gww:8568/sections/objective.text: Save as many Kurzick refugees as possible before time elapses.

quests/quest:gww:8568/sections/rewards-1.text: Scoring in this mission rewards Kurzick faction, experience, and gold based on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.

quests/quest:gww:8568/sections/walkthrou.text: This mission has a 10 minute time limit; however, additional time can be earned after rescuing a set number of refugees (+60 seconds every 25 people saved). Kurzick refugees come in groups of 1 - 4 from three different paths and head towards the portal. Approximately every 30 seconds, the next group spawns and makes its way toward the portal. Between the refugee spawn points and the portal is where several groups of Wardens spawn. As time progresses, more groups will spawn. Guard Karsten and Guard Uwe are standing next to the portal and will help fight any Wardens that get within range. They are not required to survive, but their presence is helpful.
The general strategy for this mission is to keep the Wardens distracted while the Kurzick refugees run to the portal.
Doing this mission in hard mode provides a few benefits:
While the Wardens are only 2-6 levels higher, the refugees become level 20, therefore last longer.
If you bring it, Churning Earth's knock down effect will always trigger on non-snared Wardens.
Consider using Shelter or Displacement to help the level 10 refugees survive.
Hex spells are not used by any of the foes in this area.
Although Ash Blast is a hex spell, the hex is only applied to Burning foes. None of the foes in this area can apply Burning, so you would have to apply it to yourself.
Wells and Wards are helpful, since you're going to be in the same general area the entire time.
Have one player tank one direction the wardens approach from to distract them while the rest of the team focus on saving the refugees from another side only.
AoE skills are effective due to the eventual high number of foes.

quests/quest:gww:8568/sections/notes-1/b.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
Obtaining a score of 100 or above will increase your Kurzick faction cap once by 1000.

quests/quest:gww:10140/sections/objectiv.text: Find Tukan on the rooftops and end his suffering

quests/quest:gww:10140/sections/walkthro.text: Head out from Senji's Corner into Xaquang Skyway and head left, you will come across Tukan after a while. He is alone and his skills are identical to normal Afflicted Warriors, so fighting him shouldn't be a problem.
After Tukan has been killed, return to Qian and claim the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25433/sections/objectiv.text: Restore Zunraa's presence by cleansing the valley of miasma. Should he fall, you may revive Zunraa by ringing the ceremonial bell at any of his shrines.

quests/quest:gww:25433/sections/environm.text: Foes will not spawn in Zen Daijun if you enter from Seitung Harbor. Water Buffalos will appear.
The Afflicted will no longer appear in Haiju Lagoon; they are replaced with equal numbers of Crimson Skull.
Afflicted will remain in Minister Cho's Estate.

quests/quest:gww:25433/sections/walkthro.text: Zunraa can be found to the right of the entrance to the Zen Daijun explorable area in Seitung Harbor, at the Shrine of Zunraa on the hill. If Zunraa isn't present, interact with the shrine to summon Zunraa. After accepting the quest, talk to Guard Lae Fao to enter Zen Daijun. Remember to bring skills that give health regeneration to counter the effects of the miasma.

In the explorable area, follow the quest markers to the spots where miasma needs to be cleared. To achieve that, you have to run through them so that Zunraa will follow and clear them. Consider flagging your henchmen away from the miasma before leading Zunraa through it, to minimize the health degeneration. If Zunraa dies, you can re-summon him at any of the bells that are found in several spots in the area.

Instead of running through the miasma and tagging Zunraa along, you can run in circles (whenever possible) around the miasma. The advantage being that you won't be affected, while Zunraa will try to follow you, remain in the miasma and clear it.
Once the miasma have all been cleared, the quest will update and point you towards the Daijun Library. Clear the miasma there and take down the Corrupted Zunraa to complete the quest.

One tactic is to clear the final miasma area before clearing the other areas (the Corrupted Zunraa doesn't appear until all other miasma have been cleared), that way when you battle the Corrupted Zunraa you won't also have to combat party wide health degeneration while fighting him.

quests/quest:gww:25433/sections/notes-1/.text: Corrupted Zunraa does not appear sometimes.

This is the second of the two attribute point quests available for Factions PvE characters. Completion of these quests is necessary to gain the full 200 attribute points for your character. The first quest is Lost Treasure.
Though the quest marker at the end directs you back to Seitung Harbor, you can also get the reward from the Zunraa in your party.
The Zunraa in Seitung Harbor is occasionally called Kirin.

quests/quest:gww:25625/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out and purify the corrupted sprouts in Turai's Procession. Defeat any vile incarnations you encounter. You have 3..0 sprouts left to purify.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25625/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the arrows on your minimap to the corrupted sprout, you must have the Sacred Roots with you to succeed. Repeat 2 more times and return to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25625/sections/notes-1/.text: Plants have reduced armor to fire damage so it's handy to bring Fire Magic elementalists or to use weapons with the accordant prefix.
It's advised to focus on the monk sprouts at first since Corrupted Healing can heal allies for 300 health.
Corrupted Healing can be easily interrupted, so bring suitable skills to stop it being cast.

quests/quest:gww:13892/sections/objectiv.text: Find Sennat Sen in Salt Flats.

quests/quest:gww:13892/sections/walkthro.text: Sennat Sen is in the northeast corner of the Salt Flats. The outpost closest to his location is Seeker's Passage, which is reachable through a long walk from the Amnoon Oasis or Augury Rock. You may need to use teleporters to reach Sennat Sen, depending on the path you take.

quests/quest:gww:13892/sections/notes-1/.text: Sennat Sen is an artisan. It is not necessary to complete this quest before making use of his services.
Consider picking up the quest A Belated Betrothal at Seeker's Passage before completing this quest, since its destination lies close to the same route.

quests/quest:gww:25644/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Zehlon Reach and talk to Tahon.

quests/quest:gww:25644/sections/walkthro.text: [Incomplete source section] Walk northwest until you come to the same spot where the Stone Face Cult always stand. Before talking to Tahon, it is advised that low level characters have some enchantments active since he is a level 12 monk. After killing him, travel to The Astralarium and talk to Kihawa to receive your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281557/sections/objecti.text: Clear Anvil Rock in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281557/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281557/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Anvil Rock in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281557/sections/target-.text: Head west from Yak's Bend through Iron Horse Mine if you have not completed Borlis Pass.
Head north through Deldrimor Bowl if coming from Lion's Arch.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:

There is a small Dwarven village in the southern area of the map. On a random chance per map instance, about 5 waves of Frostfire Dryders will attack (totaling to about 30 Dryders). The allied Dwarven Soldiers there will fight with you. Depending on where you entered the map, those Dwarven allies may already have been killed by the time you reach their location. The Dryders can also get stuck on the way to the village from Deldrimor Bowl so if you are looking for a missed wave check along that path.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.

There is an area in the mountain range just northeast of Ice Tooth Cave where you can explore a fair distance farther north than on the field. The ridge is large enough that several Snow Wolves may spawn along it.

The Centaur boss Jolo Lighthaunch's healing may prove difficult to overcome if you party lacks firepower or interrupts, especially if two Shiverpeak Protectors spawned in its group. Consider defeating this boss right at the start. The group is large, and strays far from its origin point. Pulling them so they are bodyblocked by the nearest cliff corner and having your team hold them for AoE damage is suggested.
In the Southeast of the area, there is a small road leading to the Frost Gate outpost. There are Dwarven and Minotaur groups that patrol that path, and they may be easily missed during vanquishing.

Some minotaur groups patrol in very large circles at a fast pace, both clockwise and counter-clockwise around the center. If you're looking for the last mob and can't find it, try circling the center of the map one way, then the other. Also check the north-south path in the far eastern part of the map.
Centaurs and minotaurs are hostile to each other.
A few groups of Centaurs have been reported to be hostile to each other.

quests/quest:gww:63450/sections/objectiv.text: Prove your worth to Sif. Bring down Whiteout in Jaga Moraine.
Test your mettle. Defeat Avarr the Fallen in Jaga Moraine
Cement your legacy. Beat the Fragment of Antiquities in the Sepulchre of Dragrimmar.
See Sif Shadowhunter for your Reward

quests/quest:gww:63450/sections/walkthro.text: Whiteout is on a circular cliff towards the north of Jaga Moraine. As you approach, a massive ice boulder rolls down the path. It kills anyone in its way, but there is room to step aside if you act quickly. Note that you do not get a death penalty from the ice boulder.
Avarr the Fallen is on the north-west corner of Jaga Moraine.

Fragment of Antiquities is in the very North-West corner of the first level in the map Sepulchre of Dragrimmar. The Sepulchre of Dragrimmar is in north-west corner of Drakkar Lake, not far from Shrine of the Wolf Spirit. In order to be able to reach the Fragment of Antiquities, you need to get the quest The Anvil of Dragrimmar from Outrunner Remlok just outside the entrance to the dungeon, or you won't be able to get past the first room. Do NOT mistake Fragment of Antiquities for Remnant of Antiquities (who is the dungeon's boss). They have similar names, but killing the Remnant will not count towards this quest.

quests/quest:gww:63450/sections/notes-1/.text: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Krak's Cavalry, and Prenuptial Disagreement.
Defeating Remnant of Antiquities may, but does not always, count as defeating Fragment of Antiquities.

quests/quest:gww:25435/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Sister Choi Ju in Tsumei Village to learn more about Zen Nai Falls.
Go to Zen Nai Falls and find the Naga that have invaded the area.
Scare off the Naga from the area.
See Captain Zinghu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25435/sections/walkthro.text: This quest can be quite tricky, especially at a low level, due to the Naga Witches using Spirit Rift which can cause significant damage if not avoided. It would be a good idea to leave this quest until you are a higher level which makes it a lot easier; but if not just take Taya [Healer Henchman] and Aeson [Spirit Henchman] for maximum healing to survive the high damage per second.

Starting from Tsumei Village will give you more powerful followers, and the road will be shorter. From there just follow the pointer to Lake Puang, killing Nagas as you encounter them. By the time you reach the falls, you're done.

quests/quest:gww:212999/sections/objecti.text: Kill Arachni in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:212999/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:67794/sections/rewards-.text: Warrior 24 (24) Dwarven Ghost can be found in the rectangular chamber with the poison arrow traps.
Dwarven Ghost can be found near the Spider Matriarch, on the ledges above the eggs. Go behind the left hand eggs to find it
No profession 1 (20) Secret Switch near the south corner of Lok The Mischievous's room, which opens the door to a secret area that contains multiple Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost.
3 Hidden Treasures can be found near Dagnor Grubeater.
3 Hidden Treasures can be found near the dungeon key.

There is a secret passage way that opens at the Area Map if you use Light of Deldrimor at the nearest intersection to the Area Map and then activate the switch. This passageway will lead you straight to the Flame Guardian. The passage also contains two Hidden Treasures, side by side.
A Hidden Treasure is located under the Flame Guardian.
Two Hidden Treasures are in a beetle-filled side room southwest of the entrance. One is in a water pool which conceals the light effect.
There is a Hidden Treasure in that candlelit corridor south of the waterlogged room before the second Beacon of Droknar.
There are two Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost in the waterlogged room, which conceals the glowing effect.

The Treasures are placed towards the back, approximately three Zhed-Lengths into the water. One is approximately central to the (overgrown) exit, while the other is approximately central to the large ramp. The Dwarven Ghost is roughly in the middle of the room. A little trial and error may be in order.
There is a Hidden Treasure in a dead-end southward corridor at the second Beacon of Droknar. It can be pinged on the compass while standing at the Beacon.
A Hidden Treasure can be found near the entrance to the poison-filled spider room after the second Beacon of Droknar.

quests/quest:gww:67794/sections/notes-1/.text: Without the required quest, you cannot pass the spiderwebs of the first room, near the Torn Cloth.
You earn 1,500 Asuran reputation points the first time you complete this dungeon in normal mode (2,250 in hard mode); subsequent visits reward half that (750 and 1,125 points respectively).
Though you can walk past them easily, burning the spider eggs is the only way to spawn Spider Matriarchs, and thus get the Dungeon Key.
Lok The Mischievous's fiery boulders will kill you instantly if you are struck by them, although they do not cause any Death Penalty.
To disable the fire traps on Level 2, kill the Flame Guardian in the southeastern corner.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #14 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
In first person mode, you can see behind the walls if you stand next to them at certain points:
On Level 1: an extra normal gate and several hidden rooms.
On Level 2: an extra Asura Gate behind one of the walls.

On Level 2, there is an Albino Rat that occasionally spawns behind the walls. You can shadow step or teleport to it (e.g. using Consume Corpse), which will leave you stuck behind the wall (unless you can jump back, e.g. via Recall).

The spawns including Arachni and the final Spider Matriarch may be significantly delayed after burning the eggs. If the party continues burning eggs during this delay, it can lead to Arachni spawning before the matriarch, though both must still be killed to spawn the chest.

quests/quest:gww:67794/sections/shared-q.text: Beware of the Ooze! They multiply and can wipe an unprepared party with PBAoE damage spam.
Level 1

On the first level, you need to take out a number of groups of Needling Lavastriders and Lifeweavers. If you kill the Lifeweaver first, the rest of each group is much easier. The Oozes should be pulled carefully or avoided if possible since they tend to swarm the party quickly with high amounts of AoE damage. There are plenty of pop ups throughout the dungeon, so try to aggro mobs one by one.

To the south of the start point there is a dungeon map guarded by spiders. Following the map, you will find an Asura Flame Staff bundle among the dead asura, which must be used to light up the nearby spider web blocking the path. (You do not need to keep the first staff, but keeping hold of the second one you obtain later will save time.) Continue until you reach the next Beacon of Droknar - where a ranger boss will appear.

There are a lot of spiders and poison traps in the next room, so pick a wall and keep close to it to avoid spawning too many spiders. Head for the northwest gate, pickup the staff and burn the web. (Keep this staff.) Keep close to the right hand wall and you can avoid many of the Elementals and Forge Masters in this room, but be wary of the Fire Bombs that Lok sends down the passage. Exit the room by the next web, and kill the plant popups in the next room. Pass the narrow passage with more Painweavers and poison jets.

Clear the spiders out from around the Spider Eggs. It is useful to the party if you light the eggs one at a time to prevent the party being overwhelmed by the popups. Also on the fourth group of eggs, the spawn of spiders is delayed. After lighting all the eggs, a Spider Matriarch will appear.
Repeat this process on the eastern bunch of Spider Eggs. Once complete, the Dungeon Key will appear on the ground in front of the last Spider Web gate.

If a party misses the first matriarch by running straight past the eggs, then the key will not drop at the matriarch near the entrance to the next level. The party must run back to the first matriarch and kill it. This will cause the key to spawn in the location of the matriarch near the entrance to level 2, this had been mistaken for a bug but can be avoided by simply killing the first matriarch as you pass the eggs.
Level 2

Head east as soon as you enter the level to retrieve the asura flame staff, then back-track to the start and head southwest. Ignore the tunnel with the Spider Web gate in front of it and head up the stairs past the Fire Darts. If the Fire Darts are difficult to deal with, they can be disabled by killing a Flame Guardian off the direct path to the south of the entrance; a safer route to the Guardian can be opened at the Area Map using a Secret Switch that can be revealed using Light of Deldrimor within compass range of the entrance.

Head west across the waterlogged next room and to the Beacon of Droknar. Ignore the skelk-infested passage and head northwest to the large room with the Spider Web gate in front of it. From here there is only one route to the end of the dungeon, with large numbers of spiders and a few popups of plants.

In the final room there are many spiders, from Level 14 Spiders to Lifeweavers of Level 24, and it is recommended to kill all of the spiders before starting to burn the eggs because of the pop ups. There are ten clutches of eggs to burn, in two groups of five on either side of the chamber. Burning all five clutches on one side causes a large group of spiders including a Spider Matriarch to spawn, and after you've burned the last clutch of eggs, Arachni spawns with another large group. You have to kill the matriarch and Arachni to complete the quest and reveal Arachni's Spoils; it doesn't matter which one you kill first.
Killing Arachni

Blinding skills, or skills such as Price of Failure and Spiteful Spirit make the final boss battle much easier. The damage from Arachni comes from Barrage and Whirling Defense. If you use Diversion to stop Barrage then Arachni will simply stop attacking.
Whirling Defense can be turned to your advantage with Pain Inverter.
Skill recommendations

Minion Masters are extremely useful, as they are very efficient in killing the many weaker mobs. There are enough corpses to easily support two Minion Masters. Ebon Battle Standard of Honor can boost the damage output considerably.
AoE damage is extremely useful against the large groups of low level spiders.

Because of the large number of Ranger and Paragon enemies in this dungeon, consider taking a skill like "Shields Up!" or Winds to reduce the damage you and your party takes. The henchman Talon Silverwing uses "Shields Up!".

When trying to do this dungeon, remember that your NPC allies are warriors as primary, and they'll rush to attack anything crossing their aggro bubble. This can be extremely dangerous when trying to pull the oozes on level 1, because the NPCs following you will attack your target and aggro all the others. For this reason, it's highly recommended to bring along with you at least one running skill to break NPCs' aggro on foes.

quests/quest:gww:282211/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Arbor Bay on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282211/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282211/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Arbor Bay on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282211/sections/target-.text: Discounting quest influences, it has been reported to range from 375 to 563.
O Brave New World will increase the amount of enemies by about 50, although you can vanquish the area prior to triggering the quest spawns to reduce the kill count.
The Cipher of Kormir will cause an additional boss, Facet of Spirit, to spawn.
Aggressive Hippopotami (around Ventari's sanctuary) and Elder Crocodiles (in the southeast) spawn only in hard mode.
Several groups of Wind Riders (some large, some small) patrol quickly around Ventari's sanctuary in a counter-clockwise direction. They are also found moving quickly in the forests to the southwest.
A cave just outside Vlox's Falls and one halfway to the Shards of Orr have hidden Venomweavers.
The enclosed area surrounding the ruins has many groups of hidden Incubi, some will spawn right next to Simian groups.

quests/quest:gww:206294/sections/objecti.text: Kill Arbor Earthcall in the Morostav Trail.
*BONUS* Kill Arbor Earthcall in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:206294/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:206294/sections/walkthr.text: Leave from Durheim Archives, Vasburg Armory or Unwaking Waters (Kurzick). Even though he appears to be alone, six Wardens of Seasons will popup when you get close to his initial location. However, as he has a larger-than-usual aggro bubble, you can pull him towards you without spawning those Wardens of Seasons.

quests/quest:gww:205337/sections/objecti.text: Retrieve the Urn of Saint Viktor from the cathedral in Arborstone.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 30 minutes.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:205337/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:205337/sections/notes-1.text: This quest was first offered on June 1st, 2009.

quests/quest:gww:281604/sections/objecti.text: Clear Arborstone in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281604/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281604/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Arborstone in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281604/sections/target-.text: The Count's Daughter primary quest will lead a party through here for the first time, although that part of this explorable area is actually in an isolated small section. To explore the rest of this explorable area will entail reaching the Altrumm Ruins first. From there, secondary quests like Song and Stone and Wardens On the March will bring parties here. From Arborstone, talk to Gatekeeper Becker. This will allow you to enter the northern part of the explorable area (with Lift Operator Shulz).
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
Song and Stone
The Count's Daughter
Wardens On the March

Your character can bypass the lift by having more unspent faction of the allegiance not controlling Tanglewood Copse and not activating the resurrection shrine outside of Tanglewood Copse (by bribing the priest or killing the resurrection shrine NPCs). When your party wipes, your party will be resurrected at a shrine closer to Altrumm Ruins and/or the Arborstone outpost.
There are places here that allow a view of the eastern edge of the map. However, instead of the Qinkaishi Mountains, the player will see water.

Each of the stone guardian bosses appear to be alone. However, they are guarded by spawns hidden in nearby pillars (typically 2 each of Stone Crushers, Reapers, and Rains). Be prepared to take on 6 pillars plus the boss.

These extra guardians are not automatically released from the pillars: the Warrior Boss' guards are triggered when a human player walks over the top of the southwest ramp in the main room (from Altrumm Ruins); the caster bosses' guards are triggered by the northeast ramp.
Bosses can be pulled away from the pillars without triggering opening of the pillars. Alternatively, you can sometimes break the guardians out of the pillars without aggroing the nearby boss.
Cartographer candidates should scrape the edges of this small area (uncovering approximately 0.5% additional area).
Vanquishing: 245–372 foes.
You will be warned, "You must enter the Arborstone explorable area from Altrumm Ruins in order to vanquish it."
Some enemies in the Cathedral zu Heltzer may spawn out of sight in an area that has already been visited. While the exact spawn triggers are unknown, reported methods to trigger them include:
killing or approaching the bosses on one side of the cathedral
crossing the opposite ramp near the Cathedral portal
approaching the pillars where the stone enemies spawn.
In some cases, it may be necessary to revisit the cathedral multiple times to find all enemies.

Kneeling at the statue of Balthazar resurrection shrine at the exit into Altrumm Ruins will sometimes not cause the Champion of Balthazar to appear. If you reconnect after disconnect, any dead elemental will respawn. They will have to be killed again to count for a vanquish.

quests/quest:gww:282018/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Archipelagos in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282018/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282018/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Archipelagos in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282018/sections/target-.text: Many quests acquired from Cavalon will lead players into and through this explorable area, including the primary quests of Fort Aspenwood, the Jade Quarry, and Stolen Eggs.
This area lies between Cavalon, Breaker Hollow, and Jade Flats (Luxon).
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
Anti-melee skills are effective due to a large number of warriors and assassins in this area.
Snapjaw Windshell is in a group with several Rockhide Dragons and Saltspray Dragons, making that group very deadly to unprepared groups that are bunched up.

There are five hidden Oni spawn points - one on a clearing east of Snapjaw Windshell, two at the Jade Sea path connecting Breaker Hollow and Cavalon, On the hill north of the Luxon arena, and there is one behind Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna.
Exploring this area will contribute approximately 2.6% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
There is a bridge near the Jade Flats, where the coral below can strike allies crossing over.

quests/quest:gww:283854/sections/objecti.text: See Xan Hei for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283854/sections/shared-.text: Enter Nahpui Quarter from Senji's Corner. Follow the walkthrough map.

There is a very large battle at the first map marker on your mission map. While going up the last ramp, be prepared for a battle. Also, midway between the first and second marker there are an extremely large number of Am Fah. It is recommended to pull them in small groups back through the door.

When you get to Jeijou, he appears to be alone, but soon spawns a large number of Am Fah before engaging in combat. Once you have killed him, return to Xan Hei. Because you only have to kill Jeijou, you can map out once he's dead even if the rest of the final groups are not.

quests/quest:gww:281722/sections/objecti.text: Clear Arkjok Ward in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281722/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281722/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Arkjok Ward in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281722/sections/target-.text: The Great Escape is the primary quest that will first lead characters into this area.
Secondary quests that take place in this area include A Little Recon and Drake in a Cage.
The A Prescription for Conscription quest in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.
Several hidden groups of Mandragors are located in the southeast area from the Yohlon Haven exit.

It is possible to acquire all of the Sunspear bounties before killing any related foe, resulting in about 1,300 Sunspear points for clearing the area. Start from the Jahai Bluffs exit in the north and work through the shrines in a counterclockwise direction until arriving the Mandragor Hunt shrine at the exit into Marga Coast. Turn southeast and head towards the Monster Hunt shrine before turning back to the Yohlon Haven exit for the Insect Hunt bounty.
The exit into Sunspear Sanctuary is blocked until the completion of Hunted!

quests/quest:gww:18805/sections/objectiv.text: Meet with Dengo on the Plains of Jarin.
Protect Dengo from corsair attacks as you travel to the Sunspear Great Hall.

quests/quest:gww:18805/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Kamadan through the gate leading to the Plains of Jarin. Dengo will be standing around in the open, waiting for you. Speak to him and he'll take off in the direction of the Sunspear Great Hall, taking regular stops to catch his breath (you can also use this emote yourself: type "/catchbreath"). At the middle of the journey, he'll yell and you'll have to deal with a wave of four, low-level Corsairs. Keep following him as he proceeds towards his destination. Remember to wait for the quest to update before leaving this area or you will have to restart from Kamadan.

quests/quest:gww:18805/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with Quality Steel and Map-Travel Inventor.
If you travel north-northwest from where the corsairs attack you, you may find another group or two apparently hanging around, maybe as backup for the first wave.

Sometimes the corsairs that run at you while on the plains will run away as soon as they reach your aggro radius, making you run after them until they stop. Then you can kill them. (Example) After killing the corsairs, Dengo sometimes will not move, forcing you to restart the quest.

quests/quest:gww:18223/sections/objectiv.text: Find Old Mac's body out in the Breach.
Escort Old Mac back to Piken Square.
Return to Armsman Pitney for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18223/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Piken Square and travel West towards some old ruins and climb the slope, killing the Charr along the way. Watch out for patrols (composed of a Charr mesmer and two rangers). Head towards the Charr Elementalists and take out the various patrols in this area one at a time. Afterwards move south and look for an entry into the rock wall to the west, usually blocked by a Charr Overseer, Martyr, and Axe Warrior (visible on the radar). Kill them. Move onward and you will soon see Old Mac, usually close to a Charr Overseer and a Martyr.
Quickly make your way to Mac and kill the nearby Charr — if he dies, you have to restart the quest. Backtrack your way to Piken. Wait for the quest to update before passing through the portal.

quests/quest:gww:18223/sections/notes-1/.text: Ironically, the quest cannot be completed if Old Mac is killed by the Charr before you reach him, despite the quest log saying that you have to find Old Mac's dead body.
Joe has a few pips of constant health regeneration.
Old Mac might repeat his dialogue as you approach the portal.

quests/quest:gww:25337/sections/requirem.text: You must clear the camp on the western edge of the Great Battle Field for Kromril the Eternal to spawn.

quests/quest:gww:25337/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the unholy text to Kromril the Eternal

quests/quest:gww:25337/sections/walkthro.text: The Priest of Menzies is in a camp across the battlefield to the east. There are several patrols of Skeleton Army units with scattered popups of Skeletal Impalers between you and the camp. It is wise to dispose of the Skeletal patrols near the camp, because it's quite possible to aggro them when going for the Priest.

The camp is accessable by two ramps on opposite sides of the camp. Each ramp is guarded by a powerful Dragon Lich. Despite being necromancers, they are strong melee attackers that can take out a caster with as few as two hits. Pull one of the dragons and the accompanying Skeletal Ether Breaker away from the camp to dispose of them.

With one of the entrances clear, you can proceed to the Shadow Army group in the camp. It is possible to pull the group out and away from the Priest and his healing. There will also be a Skeletal Impaler popup in the camp. Keep a wary eye on the compass when attacking the camp though; it's possible for the second Dragon Lich to come after you.

When the Priest of Menzies has been killed, he will drop an Unholy Text. This is a bundle item you will need to pick up and carry back to Kromril. Before handing the text over to Kromril, make sure your teammates all have the quest first. If someone doesn't have the quest before turning in the text, they will be unable to complete it afterward.

quests/quest:gww:25337/sections/notes-1/.text: The Priest of Menzies is the only boss in the Fissure of Woe and as such the only opportunity for the party to gain a morale boost, if they do not carry certain consumables such as a Powerstone of Courage.
There is an invisible wall on the west ramp that can be used to obstruct the Shadow Rangers' line of sight, resulting in less damage taken.

quests/quest:gww:10933/sections/objectiv.text: Kill the Sly Dredge who stole Jun's art supplies

quests/quest:gww:10933/sections/walkthro.text: The Sly Dredge is found in Melandru's Hope. Head northeast from Lutgardis Conservatory or, if it is unlocked, west from Jade Flats (Kurzick) and follow the quest pointer to the Sly Dredge. The Sly Dredge will usually be accompanied by a group of 5-6 other Dredge.
The quest is completed once you return Jun's Art Supplies to Jun in House zu Heltzer.

quests/quest:gww:281769/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Ascalon Foothills of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281769/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281769/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Ascalon Foothills of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281769/sections/target-.text: Leave from Yak's Bend southeast through Traveler's Vale or from Nolani Academy or Grendich Courthouse and travel north/west (respectively) through Diessa Lowlands.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
If starting from Yak's Bend or Borlis Pass, you can come to this area with a party size of 6. Consider continuing onwards into Diessa Lowlands with the larger group.

quests/quest:gww:11964/sections/objectiv.text: Complete the Advanced Defense Techniques course.
See Headmaster Lee for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11964/sections/walkthro.text: This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.

quests/quest:gww:11993/sections/objectiv.text: Find Ratsu and stop him before he kills Saito.

quests/quest:gww:11993/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from Nahpui Quarter, head down the bridge and over to the area with Qian and Paomu. When you approach them, Ratsu will appear. Slay him to finish the quest.

quests/quest:gww:11993/sections/notes-1/.text: Having Seek out Brother Tosai active in your quest log will not prevent you from completing this quest as Ratsu will still be hostile.

quests/quest:gww:25632/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Elder Jurdu when all members of your party are ready to defend Beknur Harbor
Defend Beknur Harbor from the attacking amphibian army. 6...0 waves of attackers remain.
See Elder Jurdu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25632/sections/walkthro.text: You will begin in an explorable version of Beknur Harbor and a countdown timer will start. Once the timer ends, the gates to the harbor will open and the first wave of Skale will rush in. A good tactic would be to bottleneck them in the opening of the gate with your melee fighters and hit them with AoE damage. This will kill off the lower level foes quickly and allow you to target the higher level ones. You need to be careful not to let them mob your casters and monks because with so many foes it is difficult for your casters to run away. Once the first wave starts, there will be constant waves of Skale until the quest ends, so be sure to have proper energy management and healing to endure the assault. The Skale Blighter can be particularly nasty because they carry Rotting Flesh and will spread disease quickly throughout your party. Consider bringing sufficient Condition removal to combat this. The last group to spawn will have Glug Klugg in it, finishing him and his small group will end the quest and you will be automatically returned to the Harbor.

quests/quest:gww:25632/sections/notes-1/.text: This is one of the more challenging quests in the game, depending upon your character and build, since there are large waves of enemies which never seem to stop coming. Having a minion master and an AoE Elementalist (or two) helps quite a lot.

If you're having trouble taking on all groups at once, then once the gates open, head out to the far left and take out the groups that spawn there first. Then pull the group inside the gate to the far right and repeat. Finally, take out the groups that spawn in the middle.

If you let one of the first few waves inside, the quest will not progress, although the monsters will still come. After you go back and defeat the wave inside, groups of 4 or so creature waves follow for the remainder of the quest.

quests/quest:gww:202174/sections/objecti.text: Assault the Stronghold and free the Ebon Vanguard captives from Hierophant Burntsoul.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:202174/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:202174/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Assault on the Stronghold quest.

quests/quest:gww:10065/sections/objectiv.text: Locate Waeng in the sewers and eliminate him.
See Guardsman Tang for your reward

quests/quest:gww:10065/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is very straightforward. Starting from the entrance to The Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar, head right and follow the arrow on your radar. The Am Fah patrols between you and Waeng are small, around 4-6 members per group, and are easily dispatched. Eliminating Waeng himself is the only thing required by the quest.

quests/quest:gww:10065/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can easily be completed at the same time as Capturing the Orrian Tome and It Ends Here, as they're all in the same general area of The Undercity.
Waeng is an Assassin boss who gives players an early opportunity to capture Flashing Blades

quests/quest:gww:269351/sections/objecti.text: Complete the "Zinn's Task" or "The Knowledgeable Asura" quest
Speak with the Asura Chark in the Tarnished Coast.
Report to Salma in Talmark Wilderness on the outcome of the Asuran Trial.
Speak with the Lion's Arch Keep gate guard to gain access to Lion's Arch Keep where Salma will have your congratulatory message.

quests/quest:gww:269351/sections/walkthr.text: After completing either Zinn's Task or the Knowledgeable Asura quests, map travel to Vlox's Falls and exit into Arbor Bay. Talk to Chark who is immediately outside the portal you just came through. Simply entering Zinn's Trial and stepping into the witness area will complete the objective for witnessing the trial, it is not necessary to watch the entire scene.
After that, return to the Shining Blade camp to witness Livia Recruits Zinn. Once the dialogue is complete, then head to the Lion's Arch Keep and talk to Salma to finish the quest.

quests/quest:gww:269351/sections/notes-1.text: This quest was added on November 18, 2010.
Before the November 19, 2010 update, this quest was automatically placed in your quest log after witnessing Search for Allies if The War in Kryta was active.
After reporting, Livia, Zinn and Blimm will walk towards the future site of the Secret River Passage, which will appear the next time the player enters this map.

quests/quest:gww:64059/sections/objectiv.text: Tell Orozar that you are ready to defend King Jalis and his camp.
Ask Orozar when Ural will arrive.
Defend King Jalis's camp from the attacking Stone Summit forces.
See Orozar Highstone for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:64059/sections/walkthro.text: Speak with Orozar, and Ural Highstone will come down warning of the impending attack. Shortly after, four waves of Stone Summit will attack from the north, east, and south (for a total of 12 waves). In the last waves, you will encounter the Taskmasters Nard, Beld, and Larn. The final attack is led by Marln Steelfist. The Deldrimor dwarves will assist you in this fight, and they have some ability to resurrect each other, but they will likely take heavy losses from attrition.

Like the allies you get in dungeons, Ural Highstone, Orozar Highstone, Telzar Ironjaw and Jalis Ironhammer all self-resurrect once there are no enemies within their aggro radius, but High Priest Alkar self-resurrects even if there is an enemy near him which makes the necromancer enemies get more minions. This means that they can effectively delay enemy waves for a very long time. Therefore, it's best to focus on the waves coming from one particular direction until they have all been killed, then move to another direction.

Note that only Marln Steelfist's group needs to be killed for the quest to be completed. Once his group is dead, you will be returned to the Battledepths map after a brief countdown, even if there are still other Stone Summit dwarves still alive and attacking the camp.
Another good trick to use is to have someone in your party bring Verata's Aura. The Stone Summit Gnashers generally summon 20~30 minions.

quests/quest:gww:64059/sections/notes-1/.text: No NPCs need to be protected. Jalis Ironhammer can be killed. If he comes close to dying, he regains a significant amount of health but he can die after a while. Ural Highstone can be attacked and killed, but this has no effect on his death by Marln Steelfist in a scripted event at the end of the quest. Orozar Highstone seems to have extremely high health, armor and regeneration, and the quest will not fail if he is killed. All other dwarves can be killed by the Stone Summit.

Marln Steelfist will spawn when the last southern wave (containing Taskmaster Nard) has been defeated. It is recommended that you clear all northern waves before that, otherwise Marln's group will gang together with the group of Taskmastern Larn (also from the north). The resulting mob is quite large and can easily kill the party.

quests/quest:gww:15811/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the forces marching on Gyala Hatchery. You have [9...0] groups remaining.
See Captain Juno for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15811/sections/walkthro.text: Despite its name, this quest is really about defending the portal into Gyala Hatchery. All of the Kurzick attackers are heading toward the portal.

The first quest objective is to find Khim who is in the Maishang Hills, just outside of the Gyala Hatchery portal. He is so close to the portal that it might not be immediately obvious that you are not being directed back into the outpost. Provided you have access to it, Gyala Hatchery is the best starting location. Otherwise, Eredon Terrace is the next closest location.

Advancing the quest further requires speaking to Khim. Besides answering you, Khim runs off to the west. Your quest destination star is set at Khim's new location. Joining him there will start the waves of Kurzick attackers; however, do not remain at this spot. Move half the distance back toward the resurrection shrine. This will place you outside of immediate aggro range of incoming waves of attackers from either direction.

Each wave, alternately attacking from the west and northeast, usually consists of at least four foes with a monk or ritualist. Having defeated one group, run to the next group and kill them off. Keep doing this until you have defeated all nine groups of foes. One of the western groups will include two Kurzick Juggernauts and the final wave will have foes attacking from both sides along with General Kaimer Vasburg.
After all the Kurzicks are defeated return to Cavalon to obtain your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15811/sections/notes-1/.text: Despite the arrows pointing away, it is best to stay by the shrine as Kurzicks will come from both sides.

You may wish to accept this quest but not complete it so that it is active in your quest log while you perform the quest Stolen Eggs. This will prevent the final boss Stsou Swiftscale from spawning making the run to your destination a bit easier.
Even if you already completed this quest, when you re-enter Maishang Hills without accepting the reward, the quest log resets and you will have to complete it again.

quests/quest:gww:211893/sections/objecti.text: Defeat your Doppelganger at Augury Rock.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 10 minutes (2 minutes in Hard Mode).
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:211893/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:211893/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Augury Rock mission.

quests/quest:gww:211893/sections/notes-1.text: The mission doesn't need to be a success. Defeating the Doppelganger is enough to complete the quest; however, the first bonus is not satisfied if you die before the Doppelganger.

quests/quest:gww:203642/sections/objecti.text: Attune to and use the Henge Portal in the Aurora Glade before the White Mantle can do the same.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203642/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203642/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Aurora Glade mission.

quests/quest:gww:269269/sections/objecti.text: Rescue Miku from the White Mantle.

quests/quest:gww:269269/sections/walkthr.text: After finding the embedded arrowhead consult the scrying pool In the Hall of Monuments. Get Keiran's Bow from Gwen, equip the bow, and consult the scrying pool, select "Show me the story of the arrowhead". You will be transported to Watchtower Coast and will be under the effect of Keiran Thackeray (disguise) for the duration of this quest.
Follow the path towards Divinity Coast to find Danthor the Adamant.
As in other Hearts of the North mini-missions:
Use Keiran's Sniper Shot against targets called out by Miku, which causes a fatal amount of damage if it hits (unless Miku's Promise of Death is removed).
Until she does so, it is more efficient to concentrate on far-away targets; Miku targets the nearest ones, which you will be able to instantly kill with the sniper shot.
Miku's aggro range is smaller than Keiran's, so pull targets and retreat slightly so that she will engage foes more quickly.
If Miku dies, she will self-resurrect after a short period of time.
Several of the foe groups can be avoided by leaving the patrolled path and taking a detour over the hills.

quests/quest:gww:269269/sections/notes-1.text: This quest is automatically obtained upon entering Watchtower Coast (via the Scrying Pool), and is removed should one leave.
Rewards are placed automatically into inventory. If your inventory is full, it will be dropped on the ground. With the short time until next mission, make sure you have an inventory slot available.

While you must equip Keiran's Bow to access this mission, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long- or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has weapon upgrades appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
You cannot zone into Divinity Coast during this quest.

Some consider this quest a good farming option for Ebon Vanguard reputation points, War Supplies, or sweet points. When using a personal speedboost consumable (such as a cupcake or rock candy), it is possible to run past all of the groups except the first and last in Auspicious Beginnings. This can be repeated in approximately 4-5 minutes, i.e. in an hour, approximately 60,000 experience, 60 supplies/sweet points, and 15,000 EV points.
A tutorial to complete quest in 5 minutes can be found here.
Sometimes Gwen endlessly repeats the last dialogue in the Hall of Monuments.
If you fail the mission by swapping out Keiran's Bow too soon, the game incorrectly states you must equip Togo's Staff to play the mission.
Spirits and pets do not turn hostile in the final battle, even those summoned after enemies turn hostile.

quests/quest:gww:24524/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out the Fortune Teller in the Domain of Fear and defeat her.
See Imperial Captain Shi Wang for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:24524/sections/walkthro.text: Enter the Domain of Fear and follow the quest pointer to find the fortune-teller in the north-west corner of the area. The Fortune Teller is protected by a group of Margonites, and on her death, will re-spawn as the Demonic Fortune Teller, as well as causing a number of torment creatures to spawn.

Alternatively, the player could start at the Gate of Secrets, if that outpost has already been reached. This significantly shortens the distance and decreases the number of enemies that must be killed to reach the Fortune Teller.

quests/quest:gww:24524/sections/notes-1/.text: Although the Gate of Secrets is probably the closest starting point, this quest combines well with the Last Patrol to provide some much needed allies, in which case, it would have to be started from the Gate of Fear.

quests/quest:gww:281819/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Bahdok Caverns in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281819/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281819/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Bahdok Caverns in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281819/sections/target-.text: Your character must have completed the Moddok Crevice mission to be able to enter this area. If entering from the Moddok Crevice mission outpost, talk to Gatekeeper Kahno to gain entry.
No quests take place here; entering this explorable area is completely optional.
This area does not contribute to the Elonian Cartographer title track because it is considered underground (i.e. not uncovered on the world map).

There are several hidden groups of mandragors in the northeastern portion of the area. It is advised to start from Wehhan Terraces and work your way through the foes counter-clockwise to avoid popups.

The mandragor boss, Joknang Earthturner, appears to be alone, however upon approaching him several mandragors will spawn. If you approach slowly, there is a chance that only half the mandragors will spawn.

The sole Skale group in the area is led by Armind the Balancer. Before taking them on, take note of the nearby heket groups. At least two small heket groups have patrol paths that go very near the large Skale group.

quests/quest:gww:17102/sections/objectiv.text: Recover the Ashford strongbox from the bandits.
Return the strongbox to Devona in Ashford.

quests/quest:gww:17102/sections/walkthro.text: The quickest route to the strongbox is from Ashford Abbey. Head across the worm-infested farmland until you reach a bandit camp marked by a campfire and crates. You do not need to clear the entire area; while there are Bandit Raiders and Bandit Firestarters in the vicinity, only the Bandit Blood Sworn surrounding the strongbox are immediately hostile. Be careful not to aggro too many bandits at once, especially the Firestarters, whose ability to use Flare can be deadly to lower level characters. After defeating the foes, pick up the strongbox and take it to Devona for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17102/sections/notes-1/.text: Sometimes a Wolf will attack the Bandit Firestarters and a long fight will start. It's safe to go up close and watch, because the Wolf will be busy and the Firestarters won't attack you unless you start a fight with them. You can even walk right up to them with the strongbox and they won't do anything.
Higher level characters (particularly Elementalists with Fire Storm) can farm this quest for dyes and/or Worn Belts.

quests/quest:gww:25316/sections/objectiv.text: Tell Mantle Knight Karriya of Miraba's bandit problem.
Deliver the Token of Janthir to Miraba.

quests/quest:gww:25316/sections/walkthro.text: Map travel or walk to D'Alessio Seaboard and talk to Mantle Knight Karriya. He will give you a Token of Janthir for Miraba and promise to do something about the bandit problem. Deliver the token to Miraba to get your reward.
This quest (and its prerequisite, Duties of a Lionguard) can be easily completed with Report to the White Mantle active, as both require talking to Mantle Knight Karriya.

quests/quest:gww:282276/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Barbarous Shore in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282276/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282276/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Barbarous Shore in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282276/sections/target-.text: This explorable area is to the southeast from Camp Hojanu. It is the furthest east one can go in Kourna.
This is one of the few places in Kourna where you may obtain Lightbringer bounties.
A Preserved Red Iris Flower can be found in a chest in the southern Corsair area.
There are four bosses close to each other in the southern Corsair area; use caution when approaching them, especially in hard mode.
In hard mode, the Corsair Grapplers in this area can instantly wipe an entire party as they deal extremely high area of effect physical damage.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.6% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
You can avoid killing 3-5 of the hidden Mandragor groups by first clearing the western area, crossing the river using the southern route, and defeating a pride of low-level lions nearby.
The lions in this region are all located in the east, across the bridge. They're all in one pack, and they all start out as hostile; they are however still charmable.

quests/quest:gww:56517/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Hammer Gate. Talk to Gate Guard Hollis.

quests/quest:gww:56517/sections/walkthro.text: The Hammer Gate is situated in Old Ascalon, to the west of Ascalon City. Leave the city and head west (following the quest marker) until you see Gate Guard Sebastein. Talking to him will reveal that he has seen neither Duke Barradin nor the contingent of troops that followed him. He further mentions that Gate Guard Hollis will know more. Continue west towards the quest marker to find Gate Guard Hollis standing before the Hammer Gate.

quests/quest:gww:25280/sections/objectiv.text: Go to Piken Square and see if Duke Barradin needs assistance.

quests/quest:gww:25280/sections/instruct.text: "Oh, I can tell you exactly where Duke Barradin went. Yes, he and a company of red-cloaked Vanguard troops passed north through this very gate. We rescued a deserter not long after that. Seems they fell under heavy attack, and the duke decided to push through, wanted to find refuge in the ruins of Piken Square."

"Listen, my duties keep me here at the Wall, but if you want to try to break through the whole Balthazar-cursed Charr army to meet up with Barradin, gods protect you, I say. No doubt the duke will greet you with open arms."

quests/quest:gww:16335/sections/objectiv.text: Join the Centaur troop in Turai's Procession.
Stand your ground against the horde of nightmare creatures.

quests/quest:gww:16335/sections/environm.text: Olunoss Windwalker, Tusked Howlers, and Tusked Hunters will spawn in Turai's Procession after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:16335/sections/walkthro.text: When you reach the Centaur troops, two groups of Margonites will charge in (one from either side of the mound). Each group contains eight Margonites: two Margonite Clerics, two Margonite Seers, two Margonite Executioners and two Margonite Reapers. Once a group is eliminated another will spawn immediately. There is a total of four waves: the first will have three groups of Margonites, as will the second. The third wave will have only two, both on the right. The fourth wave will have only one group on the left, with a Margonite Necromancer Boss. There are three spawn points, to the left, right and back of the mound next to the shrine. The three groups now meet at a gathering point in the middle.

Note: Moving to either side of the battlefield (i.e. not staying at the three-way focal point) allows a party to take out one group at a time. This still leaves a crowd of two groups at the focal point, but it's more manageable. There is a nearby resurrection shrine (on the north side of the mound).
Since the Margonite groups tend to bunch up, area of effect skills are very useful.
Lightbringer's Gaze, Panic and other interrupt skills to interrupt the Margonite Clerics' use of Spell Breaker and Aegis.
As there will be plenty of corpses to work with, a minion master (or two) will be enormously helpful.

quests/quest:gww:16335/sections/notes-1/.text: Taking out the Clerics is crucial when the waves come.
Mirza Veldrunner can die without affecting the success of this quest. If he dies, just rezone and turn it in.
If a group doesn't come for some time, they may have become stuck behind a rock and need to be found.

quests/quest:gww:203387/sections/objecti.text: Kill Baubao Wavewrath in the Undercity.
*BONUS* Kill Baubao Wavewrath in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203387/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203387/sections/walkthr.text: The shortest route would be to enter the Undercity from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), if unlocked. There are plenty of Kappa surrounding Baubao who use Turtle Shell, so plan accordingly.

quests/quest:gww:203387/sections/notes-1.text: Baubao will not spawn if When Kappa Attack is active.

Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Chung, the Attuned Zaishen quest, since that quest is available from the Zaishen Bounty signpost on the third day after this quest (based on the Zaishen Bounty cycle) and both bosses are found in the Undercity.
Sometimes Baubao's mob will aggro a mob of Am Fahs nearby, making the fight easier for you.
Consider using this to your advantage as it only has to be attacked by you once to be "killed" by you.

quests/quest:gww:69312/sections/requirem.text: Must have witnessed Vael's first dialogue with the player in Grothmar Wardowns, completed The Missing Vanguard, and have re-zoned. See Vael's Notes for details.

quests/quest:gww:69312/sections/objectiv.text: Follow Torch Harrowkeeper. Do not alert him to your presence.
Eavesdrop on the Charr while they discuss their plans.
Talk to Vael. See how he wants to proceed.
Follow the Charr to their meeting with the Grawl leaders. Crash the meeting and eliminate all hostiles.
Bring the Charr Intelligence to Captain Langmar.

quests/quest:gww:69312/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is very straightforward and can easily be done with heroes and henchmen. Keep out of Torch Harrowkeeper's range when you follow him until the quest updates with crashing the party. Continue following him out of range until they reach the meeting. When Torch Harrowkeeper says his line "GREETINGS GRAWL..." you can safely kill them, or listen to the rest of the dialogue. Regardless, one of the Charr will drop the Charr Intelligence quest item which you will have to take to Captain Langmar, claiming your reward.
It is advised to map-travel to Longeye's Ledge to get to Captain Langmar. Not only is it faster, but you won't receive the next quest until you rezone.

quests/quest:gww:69312/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest is given by Vael west of the forest in Grothmar Wardowns. Torch Harrowkeeper will be spawned just east of Vael and you have to follow him to the beach.
When the Charr meet with the Grawl, do not engage immediately, even if the quest log tells you to "eliminate all hostiles". Wait until the Grawl has responded "*oot!*" or else the quest will fail.
After completing this quest, Chaelse Flameshielder will not spawn again until after you have completed Plan A.
After completing this quest, you must leave and re-enter Grothmar Wardowns before Plan A becomes available.

If Torch Harrowkeeper dies and is resurrected, he will drop a second Charr Intelligence. It is possible for a chest to spawn in the Sacnoth Valley portal, preventing the Grawl from attending the meeting.

quests/quest:gww:64239/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Olrun about the bear.
Clutch the Club of a Thousand Bears.
Defeat the bear using the club given to you.
See Olrun Olafdottir for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:64239/sections/walkthro.text: You get a hammer to kill the bear with:

Although you are given a bear club, you only have to be wielding it when the bear dies for the quest to be considered successfully completed. This means that you can fight the bear normally using other weapons to weaken it, and then switch to the club for the killing blow.
Bear Club/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
Hammer attacks can be used when the club is equipped.

quests/quest:gww:64239/sections/notes-1/.text: Female characters receive the quest Bear Club for Women instead of this quest which is given by the smitten Olaf Olafson inside the Olafstead.
This quest has a special map zone it shares with the female version. This map zone is named Varajar Fells, but is not the same as the explorable area.

You can use any weapon to beat on the bear, only the finishing blow must be with the Club of a Thousand Bears equipped. Degeneration and interrupting the bear's Troll Unguent work, as does spirits and traps. Using the Ursan Blessing elite skill can be effective.

When resigning in the mission area you will not die, after the timer runs out you will be transported back to Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells but you will be alone without your party members if you had any to begin with.

It is possible by shadow stepping past the Norn Guards to explore Varajar Fells and reveal additional parts of the map by walking through the inactive portals to Battledepths, Raven's Point and Verdant Cascades. However, the map is populated with foes, so be prepared to deal with them or run past them.
Quest can glitch making the bear un-killable even when the Bear club is equipped the entire fight.

quests/quest:gww:64012/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Olaf about the bear.
Clutch the Club of a Thousand Bears.
Defeat the bear using the club given to you.
See Olaf Olafson for your reward

quests/quest:gww:64012/sections/walkthro.text: You get a hammer to kill the bear with:

Although you are given a bear club, you only have to be wielding it when the bear dies for the quest to be considered successfully completed. This means that you can fight the bear normally using other weapons to weaken it, and then switch to the club for the killing blow.
Bear Club/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
Hammer attacks can be used when the club is equipped.

quests/quest:gww:64012/sections/notes-1/.text: Male characters receive the quest Bear Club for Men instead of this quest which is given by the smitten Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells on the way to the Raven's Point entrance.

This quest has a special map zone it shares with the male version. This map zone is named Varajar Fells, but is not the same as the explorable area. Notably, the portals to Battledepths, Raven's Point and Verdant Cascades are inactive.

It is possible by shadow stepping past the Norn Guards to explore and reveal additional parts of the map by walking through the inactive portals. However, the map is populated with foes, so be prepared to deal with them or run past them.

You can use any weapon to beat on the bear, only the finishing blow must be with the Club of a Thousand Bears equipped. Degeneration and interrupting the bear's Troll Unguent work, as does spirits and traps. Using the Ursan Blessing elite skill can be effective.

When resigning in the mission area you will not die, after the timer runs out you will be transported back to Olaf Olafson in Olafstead but you will be alone without your party members if you had any to begin with.
On rare occasions the quest can glitch making the bear un-killable even when the Bear club is equipped the entire fight.

quests/quest:gww:25608/sections/objectiv.text: Protect the villages of the Yatendi Canyons from attack. You have [6...0] Margonite groups left to destroy.
See Whispers Adept for your reward

quests/quest:gww:25608/sections/walkthro.text: This is quite a straight-forward defensive type quest, however to get to the initial trigger point, you will have to defeat several groups along the way (including 4 bosses: Corporal Suli, Hajok Earthguardian (Insect), Makdeh the Aggravating and Tain the Corrupter).
The deeper reaches of the fortress hold several Kournan and Margonite groups, but you can ignore those, you only need to defend the fortress gate from the units arriving from the north.

When you arrive at the quest point (the gate of the fortress), this is the trigger for 6 Margonite groups to advance and attack at the quest point, coming to you as three waves of two groups to kill. The first two groups are mostly Warlocks and Bowmasters, the next two waves are primarily Executioners and Reapers, and the final two waves are a mix of Bowmasters, Sorcerers, Executioners, and Reapers.

Elementalist ward spells that cover the gate, or Necromancer wells that buff the party (or debuff the enemies) can be very useful on this quest. Good use of aggro and body blocking may also enable use of area of effect spells to quickly wipe out the Margonites.
When the Margonites have been defeated, return to the Chantry of Secrets for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25608/sections/notes-1/.text: There is a resurrection shrine near to the trigger point, with a Margonite hunt blessing, so this quest can be used to farm Lightbringer points.
If using heroes and/or henchmen, it can be helpful to pin them to the middle of the gateway where the quest fights take place, to ensure they do not run far or overaggro.

quests/quest:gww:282604/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Bjora Marches in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282604/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282604/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Bjora Marches in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282604/sections/target-.text: Travel due north from the town of Gunnar's Hold to find the portal to Bjora Marches. This area is also directly adjacent to Longeye's Ledge.
A locked chest will occasionally spawn behind the zone portal leading to Norrhart Domains; there is no way to reach it.
Be mindful of Wurm and Mandragor pop-ups.
Lord Glacius the Eternal appears only as your party approaches its spawn location amongst a group of Stone Summit Gnashers.

Consider vanquishing this area with the quest Leader of the Pack active. Although it will increase the amount of foes you must kill (Destroyers), you'll also gain one Alpha Tundra Wolf and five Tundra Wolf allies that will follow your party, even after you defeat all of the Destroyers.

quests/quest:gww:199395/sections/objecti.text: Take Tahlkora and stop the general from making a deal with the Corsairs in Blacktide Den.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:199395/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 15 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:199395/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Blacktide Den mission.

quests/quest:gww:199395/sections/notes-1.text: In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.

quests/quest:gww:13723/sections/objectiv.text: Go to Nebo Village with the Militia Weapons. Talk to Etham the Artisan and trade the weapons for blankets.
Take the blankets to Captain Greywind.

quests/quest:gww:13723/sections/rewards-.text: Received physical damage -2 (while in a Stance)

quests/quest:gww:13723/sections/walkthro.text: Captain Greywind will give you a Militia Weapon chest. Take it west with you to Nebo Village. You will encounter some tengu just after entering Nebo Terrace, and you may pass some ettins in the fields, but most if not all of the enemies should be easy to avoid.
Talk to Etham the Artisan in Nebo Village and trade the weapons for blankets. Then simply return the way you came and give the blankets to Captain Greywind to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:13723/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest pairs well with The Weaver of Nebo, since both require talking to Etham the Artisan.
If it is your first time visiting Nebo Terrace, consider unlocking Beetletun or Bergen Hot Springs while there for easier return trips.

quests/quest:gww:17996/sections/objectiv.text: Find Scout Melthoran in Reed Bog.
Find Dark Oak in the Falls to the southwest.
Return the bloody heart to Dark Oak.
Return to Deep Root and tell him of Dark Oak's warning.

quests/quest:gww:17996/sections/walkthro.text: On entry to Reed Bog from Ettin's Back talk to Scout Melthoran, then take the left hand route heading south. This way, you can encounter and slay Drogo Greatmane (located at the "A" on the map) and pick up his Bloody Heart before meeting Dark Oak, which can help speed up the quest immensely. Otherwise, you'd have to re-zone between The Falls and Reed Bog and re-fight all the enemies on the way.

In the Falls, head south and follow the map to reach Dark Oak. There are a lot of Maguuma Spiders and Redwood Shepherds on the way, so warriors might want to bring "Shields Up!", or monks bring Aegis, to help defend the party and mitigate some damage. Condition removal or Healing Breeze can also be helpful.

quests/quest:gww:17996/sections/notes-1/.text: Even if you are on a female character, Scout Melthoran will refer to you as a "braver man than I".
The vision may refer to the coalition of the White Mantle (lions) and the winged, claw-footed Mursaat (angels/carrion birds).
