quests/quest:gww:23862/sections/walkthro.text: Head out into the Domain of Secrets and make your way to Terick situated due west. When you find him, he will make a short taunting speech, turn hostile and attack the party. Upon his defeat, Terick will respawn as the demonic necromancer boss, Razakel. Once Razakel is defeated, return to the Gate of Secrets for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23862/sections/notes-1/.text: Lightbringer's Gaze can be used on Razakel, but not Terick.
This quest combines well with the quest Open Season.

quests/quest:gww:66626/sections/notes-1/.text: If you do not have one of the two required quests, you cannot pass the door next to the Scrap of Parchment. You can still access the portal to Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #10 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
You only need to complete one of the two quests to receive credit towards completion of Master of the North and the Master Dungeon Guide.

This dungeon can be repeated immediately after clearing it as long as you claim the quest reward before waiting out the clock. When you return to Sparkfly Swamp, you can pick up either of the two quests.
Because mobs are composed of large numbers of the same creature types, Disease and Edge of Extinction can be devastating.

There are enough corpses for several minion masters; however, Ghosteater Beetles (with Consume Soul) and Khabuus during Giriff's War (with Spiritual Pain) have skills that deal additional damage to summoned creatures.
Blooming Nettles spawn Nettle Spores which turn into Nettle Seedlings; killing the Blooming Nettles first will prevent the party from being overrun.
When the spores become seedlings, they trigger on-death effects, including Soul Reaping and Assassin's Promise.
The collector, Blonk, stands between the two portals; Heart of the Shiverpeaks and Sparkfly Swamp.
Key Differences (Difficulty):
Giriff's War (Red Side): Involves fighting Khabuus, a Mesmer boss known for Energy Surge; often seen as simpler for hero teams if you handle the boss well.
Tekks's War (Yellow Side): Involves fighting Z'him Monns, a Ritualist boss using Spirit Rifts, which some find harder to manage but others find easier to counter with specific builds.
You cannot get past the first room unless everyone in the party has at least one of the two quests in their quest log.
Only one of the two quests can be active for the party; if Giriff joins you, Tekks will leave and vice-versa.
If one member of the party has one of the quests active, that quest will become active for the other players upon entry into the dungeon.
A boulder trap can be seen on first level on the upper part of the map but it apparently doesn't trigger. Sometimes the two hekets near shrine, are invincible. Re-zone to continue the dungeon.

quests/quest:gww:66626/sections/shared-q.text: Get this quest from Tekks in Sparkfly Swamp and cross the log to Bogroot Growths. Killing one of the two duelling frogmen in the entrance room will cause the initial dungeon gate to open. The first level of the dungeon consists of two groups of Red Gokir, one with a Boss, and a number of swarms of Blooming Nettles, Nettle Seedlings and Nettle Spores. The Gokirs are tenacious, but can be handled by separating the swarms into manageable groups. Avoid the nettles, as much as possible, but if forced to fight them, kill the spores first. That may allow your group to bypass the rooted nettles and seedlings.
This level also contains an exit into another dungeon in the Central Shiverpeaks, very close by the entrance.

The second level is populated with plants in the initial area, followed by appearances of Incubi. Beyond the second shrine the party will meet a snaking corridor of beetles. After the corridor the Gokir await. Walking to the right hand side of the room will trigger a boulder that will kill all of the Gokir in this room - when they are dead the door to the penultimate room will open. Killing the Gokir Patriach near the boss lock will provide the key required to open the door.

In in the final room, the dungeon boss Z'him Monns and the two Gokir Amini with him must be defeated to spawn the Bogroot Chest. It is recommended to pull away one of the groups of frogmen before pulling Z'him Monns.
Upon activating this quest by speaking to Tekks, the quest Giriff's War will be reset. The same will count the other way around.
Due to the large amounts of corpses in Bogroot Growths dungeon, minion masters are useful.

These quests affect the spawns in this area:

South of the beach where Sskai, Dragon's Birth is located.
West of the beach where Sskai, Dragon's Birth is located.

quests/quest:gww:4424/sections/objective.text: Talk to Horticulturist Hinon and find the whereabouts of the mehkuunah plant.
Bring back a sample of the mehkuunah plant to Librarian Kahnu for analysis.
See Librarian Kahnu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:4424/sections/walkthrou.text: Start out from Tihark Orchard and head out of the west exit to speak to Seborhin Protector Zuor to gain entry to the Garden of Seborhin. Tahlkora must be in your party to explore this area before conversion to Nightfallen Garden.

Although the plant sample is a short walk due north from the entry point to the Garden, the party will have to go and speak to Hinon first in the central ampitheatre. Be aware that there is a mob of djinn and roaring ethers nearby, and on approaching the plant, rain beetles and behemoth gravebanes will spawn.
Once the plant sample has been acquired, map back to Mihanu Township and return to Kahnu in the Halls of Chokhin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:4424/sections/notes-1/b.text: If this is first time exploring the area, then Hinon may also have 2 additional quests to give: Plague of Frogs and Which Way Did He Go?, which can easily be completed at the same time as this quest.
Also, you cannot use the Horticulturist Hinon who spawns during the Tihark Orchard mission. You must find your way to the one in the Garden of Sebhorin explorable area.

If you have completed the Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission, you will not be able to complete this quest until you complete Abaddon's Gate, as Garden of Seborhin will be replaced with Nightfallen Garden.
Hinon in the dialogue refers to Kahnu as "old herbalist" and "he", however, Librarian Kahnu is a young female.

quests/quest:gww:4999/sections/objective.text: Help Zerai the Learner decide between Norgu and Goren.

quests/quest:gww:4999/sections/walkthrou.text: Map to Honur Hill, head into Resplendent Makuun and follow your quest marker to Zerai the Learner who is nearby. Speak to Zerai, and decide which of the two heroes: Norgu or Goren, should be sent away to act as bodyguard for Midauha.
Choose carefully: The one you choose will not be your hero until after the completion of the Nightfall Campaign.

quests/quest:gww:4999/sections/notes-1/b.text: This is the start of the quest chain that leads to a new hero, either Norgu (a mesmer) or Goren (a warrior).
You get the hero that you do not recommend to Zerai. If you want Norgu, recommend that he take Goren.
If you chose incorrectly, do not speak to Norgu or Goren. Head back to an outpost and abandon this quest. You can start over by accepting it again from Zerai.
Once you have made your selection, the other hero is not available for that character until that character completes the Nightfall campaign.

If you leave this quest unaccepted until the campaign is completed, you can get both the "Gain Goren" and "Gain Norgu" quests. Take this quest, and speak to Zerai in Resplendent Makuun, sending away Norgu, but do NOT speak to Goren. Speak to Prince Bokka without leaving the zone to complete "Gain Goren", and return to Goren to complete this quest. You gain both rewards this way.

If you have the Gain Norgu and Gain Goren quests in your quest log, or complete them Confirmed that abandoning both quests allows the follow-up to be picked up. Have not confirmed if it is available after completing either quest or if only the one corresponding to the opposite hero is in the quest log or completed., this quest will still be available, but the follow up quests will not.

quests/quest:gww:25715/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the Demon Underlords to release the magical bindings placed on the entrance to the spawning tunnels. 0...2 of 2 Demon Underlords remain.
See Adept of Whispers for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25715/sections/walkthro.text: During the first part of this quest, eighteen groups of six Stygians attack, organized into three sets of six groups. The first three groups attack once the quest is taken, and converge near the Adept of Whispers. Whenever a group is defeated, the next group in the set will attack. For group composition, see below; the most common foes will be Stygian Hungers, which make tanking ineffective due to using skills that bypass spell prevention, armor, and damage reduction.

Effective strategies include trapping, spiking, "Can't Touch This!", and Panic to avoid damage or increasing the tank's maximum health with skills such as Signet of Stamina. Traditional tanking is effective against other monsters in the area. Alternatively, each group can be individually pulled, and it is easiest to take on one set of group at a time as each set of groups, if encountered before they converge at the Adept of Whispers, are far from the other two and do not spawn the other sets.

For inexperienced teams it's worth noting that a Blinding Flash air elemantalist equipped with Extend Conditions can completely negate physical damages, and can easily keep crowds both crippled and blind when using "You Move Like A Dwarf!" simultaneously with Blinding Flash (since it has no cast time). This can help inexperienced groups to get through this area until they become more confident and switch to more offensive builds. In conjunction with Extend Conditions, a source of Deep Wound could be considered. An intermediate step for groups could then be to force crowds to stick with the tank by using Shared Burden since the AI prefers to target the nearest target when subject to movement impeding skills.

After all the waves have been defeated, your party must defeat the two Stygian Underlords; the first is located at the far end of the southwestern hill while the second is located at the far end of the northern hill. The southwestern hill is fairly straightforward, merely requiring careful pulling to prevent being overwhelmed. The northern hill has numerous popups that can easily overpower the party if they do not trigger them slowly. Most monsters on the hills can be individually pulled. The Underlords themselves are similar in power to the regular Stygians.

quests/quest:gww:20302/sections/objectiv.text: Stave off the assault of Abaddon's forces in Nightfallen Jahai.
See Keeper Jinyssa for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:20302/sections/walkthro.text: Go into Nightfallen Jahai from the Gate of Torment and wait for the demons to come. They will come in 4 waves. The third wave consists of multiple Arm of Insanity demons plus a boss generically labelled as a Blade of Corruption (you can recognize the boss profession by the color). The final wave contains several Rain of Terror plus another generic boss labelled as a Shadow of Fear. In each wave, it is imperative to bring down the spellcasters first, since they can cause the most trouble.

If you can use a tank as a barrier, keeping the enemies at a distance, this quest becomes a lot easier versus having your whole party take the aggro. Also, the monoliths to your right as you enter the area will inevitably be aggroed at some point, so you may as well pull them over early, either before the waves start or at least during the early, easier waves. For this quest, your Lightbringer skills and title will be invaluable.

quests/quest:gww:20302/sections/notes-1/.text: During the quest The Oddbodies, you will have 6 extra allies who can make the difference against the 3 waves of demons without dying (you would however have to start from the Gate of the Nightfallen Lands to recruit them first). Just try to take down each wave as quickly as possible.

quests/quest:gww:25721/sections/objectiv.text: Journey into the trenches of the Stygian Veil and kill the Stygian Lords. 4...0 of 4 still remaining.
See Adept of Whispers for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25721/sections/walkthro.text: The four Stygian Lords are each at a different place in the area. Each trench has a few hidden spawns that will ambush the party. Upon entering any trench and getting near the half-way point, a large spawn of melee creatures will appear at either end of the trench and then run to the opposite side (sandwiching whoever is inside). Also, one or two Tormentor demons will spawn on the two cliffs overlooking the trench. It's recommended that the party have someone go in and trigger this spawn first before they enter the trench. This player can either just die in there and get Rebirthed from the cliff above or they can use a teleportation skill like Recall to return to their party members.
The Stygian Lords on the map are as follows:
A monk with a stationary group of Tormentor demons as well as a hidden spawn of the Stygian creatures that will appear upon entering the alcove he is found in.
An elementalist with a large hidden spawn in the alcove he is found in.
A mesmer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures and a few hidden Torment Claws.
A necromancer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures.
The party should pay attention to the patrols roaming near each boss, especially in the case of the elementalist, as one patrol can come from behind the party and surprise them.

After taking the reward for the quest, six Smothering Tendrils will appear and the Dreadspawn Maw will open. Make sure, before taking the reward, that the area with the large maw is clear and that all party members clear are up by the Adept of Whispers so they do not get killed by the Tendrils' special attack. Killing each of the Tendrils will spawn a group of Torment Claws and Stygian creatures.
Killing the Dreadspawn Maw spawns a Stygian Chest and progresses the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for a walkthrough.

quests/quest:gww:17471/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Nerashi on the Marga Coast. She is holding a Kournan scout prisoner there.
Interrogate Kehtur and extract any valuable information you can.
Destroy the scout group guarding the Kournan peasants and liberate the prisoners.
Lead the Kournan peasants to the safety of the Sunspear Sanctuary.

quests/quest:gww:17471/sections/environm.text: Upon completion of this quest, Benera, Dzawan, and Megundeh will spawn in the Command Post.

quests/quest:gww:17471/sections/walkthro.text: Meet up with Nerashi in the western part of Marga Coast, at point 1. Talk to Kehtur; the dialog choices don't matter. A group of Kournan Bowmen have spawned with the three prisoners to the North, at point 2. Kill them and then escort the prisoners to the entrance of the Sunspear Sanctuary, at point 3 (luckily, they will run as fast as you). Make sure the quest updates before leaving the zone. Consider bringing "Charge!" or similar party-wide Increased Movement Speed in order to get back to the Command Post faster.

quests/quest:gww:17471/sections/notes-1/.text: After interrogating Kehtur, you must select the dialogue option "I don't have any more questions for you." to progress the quest.
An additional chest might spawn near the scout group that guards the peasants.

quests/quest:gww:24017/sections/environm.text: Upon completion of this quest, Kerendu, Mubata, and Sinbi will spawn in the Command Post.

quests/quest:gww:24017/sections/walkthro.text: Meet up with Kerendu in Sunward Marches. After some dialogue, Kournan soldiers will approach and attack. After defeating them, lead Kerendu to the Command Post entrance. Although there will be few enemies en route, Kerendu and his two sons will not fight.
Make sure to wait for the NPCs to catch up before leaving the Sunward Marches, as the quest is only marked as complete when they have almost reached a point just before stepping through the portal.

quests/quest:gww:24017/sections/notes-1/.text: If you have the quest And a Hero Shall Lead Them active, you can obtain two additional Sunspear allies near the Command Post resurrection shrine; they are guarded by a small group of Kournan Bowmen and Priests.
The group of Kournan soldiers spawns in mid-air.

quests/quest:gww:282577/sections/notes-1.text: Despite the objective description, this quest does not require killing 25 foes, but requires vanquishing the area. The quest is still completed if the area is vanquished by killing less than 25 foes. See Bukdek Byway#Notes for details on 0-kill or low-count vanquishes.

quests/quest:gww:282577/sections/instruc.text: "Clear at least 25 enemies in the Bukdek Byway near Kaineng City 'near Kaineng City' instead of 'in Kaineng City' or 'near Kaineng Center' in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282577/sections/target-.text: Factions characters will travel north from the Marketplace through here on their way to Kaineng Center for the first time. Non-Factions characters will be required to leave Kaineng Center and travel through this area as part of the primary quest Welcome to Cantha. Many secondary quests take place here.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:

If Chasing Zenmai is active, there are several ways you can get credit for vanquishing by killing fewer than 10 foes (depending on your starting outpost), since that quest allows you to enter a section initially devoid of any foes. Party members must not have Eliminate the Am Fah or Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood active.
With The Afflicted Guard active, only one kill is needed (start from Kaineng Center).
With The Drunken Master active and with The Afflicted Guard inactive; to get credit for the vanquish, you only need to defeat Drinkmaster Tahnu (if you start from Kaineng Center).
With neither of those active, take the Missing Daughter, which spawns around 10 foes.

Without those three quests active, you can still reduce the kill count to less than 60: approach Bryan from the west, but send only heroes and henchmen to him; do not let any players get within compass range. Defeat the three Jade Brotherhood groups that this triggers and clean-up the remaining mobs on the eastern side of the area (do not venture further west, as this will trigger additional foes, potentially raising the required number to the default).
Any party members that have completed Cleansing Bukdek Byway must also take Memories of Purity.
Initiate Zei Ri will help you vanquish if you have the quest Cleansing Bukdek Byway (or its hard mode equivalent) active, but only until the last Afflicted is killed.

quests/quest:gww:295340/sections/objecti.text: Travel to Shadow's Passage and investigate the meeting.
Speak with the attendees to find out what the criminals are planning. Avoid the group you are disguised as and mind your tongue. The wrong words will draw unwanted attention.
Go listen to the criminal's speech. Leaving early will blow your cover.
See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:295340/sections/shared-.text: During this solo quest, you will be under the effects of the Dastardly Disguise, which makes you look like a member of one of various thug groups. The quest is straightforward: enter the area, talk to several NPCs, listen to a speech, and then make a hasty retreat. However, there are several pitfalls that can cause the quest to fail:
During the talking phase, giving three bad answers or talking to an NPC that recognizes you as an impostor (i.e. you are disguised as one of them).
During the speech phase, getting too far away from the crowd (e.g. to prepare to escape) — this causes everyone to become hostile and the quest will fail.
During the escape phase, if you leave the area too quickly — wait until your quest log updates your success, otherwise you will not get credit (even if you have done everything else correctly).
You need to give at least three good answers to the relevant NPCs.
You can start moving away once the PC says "What, no, I'm not an imposter."
A speed boost (even Drunken Master) is helpful to keep you ahead of any foes, but the quest can be completed without one.
It is also possible to distract the foes using spirits and minions.

quests/quest:gww:283691/sections/objecti.text: Meet up with the Krytan courier in Kaineng Docks.
Talk to Courier Falken to get a new move.
Defeat all enemies on the way back to Kaineng Center. Don't get knocked out.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283691/sections/walkthr.text: In Kaineng Docks, you need to equip a pair of Brass Knuckles or Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles in order to begin. If you have not completed any of the other brawling quests, Falken will give you a pair. Talk to him again so that he transports you to the quest area.

After you arrive in Bukdek Byway, talk to the courier again to start the quest. As is implied from the dialogue, Falken has no idea where to go and will lead you on one of the longest possible routes to Kaineng Center. Most foes will either pop-up or start off as friendly (green dots), which forces you to wait for the required dialogues to trigger before moving between groups.

If you do not like brawling, an easy way to complete the quest in normal mode is to follow him and let him kill all the foes. If he dies, he will self-resurrect, allowing you to avoid fighting altogether. However, this takes much longer (about 2-3x longer, i.e. around 50 minutes or more) and you will not receive any drops or experience from the foes unless they are within your aggro bubble.

The quickest (and most profitable) method is to take the lead and stay slightly ahead of him, attacking red dots as they appear and getting close to green dots before they turn red. Several of your opponents use ranged attacks: either take them out first or move out of their line-of-sight (e.g. around a corner) while you tackle their melee-range allies. As with any brawling quest, if you get knocked out, click on the icon for STAND UP! and press the keypad shortcut (default: 8) simultaneously — this practically guarantees that you will recover in time.

The toughest fight is in the central square, where you might face several groups at once, especially if you have trouble defeating the first few before the next mobs pop up. Worse, unlike the rest of the zone, there are few obstacles to block ranged attacks. You can just keep standing up and trying again, but if that proves unreliable, start to move backtrack your original path. This takes you away from the spawn points and brings you closer to natural barriers. Falken will continue to self-rez and will eventually whittle down your opponent to a manageable number.

The final fight is just outside of town. The pre-fight dialogue is long enough that you will lose any built-up adrenaline. Falken will target Li Ho Yan; you can either gang-up on him or focus on Tai Soon; either way, you can probably just mash keys to successfully defeat the pair.
This is a valuable place to farm experience or cash:
Since the quest is not repeatable, it must be abandoned and retaken. Alternatively, map to the Marketplace before the quest updates.
Assuming you identify and sell all drops, players can expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.

If the inventory fills up, there is a Merchant (Peasant Shopkeeper) about 2/3 of the way through (near the last big fight). Players can return here before rezoning, to sell a few items and pick up anything left behind.
With practice, players can gain ~135,000 experience points per hour using experience scrolls.

Players can use this as a less-risky method of gaining experience towards the Survivor title, as they have 10 seconds after being knocked out to STAND UP!. (The death counter will not increase unless the timer runs out before standing up successfully.)
If Falken does more damage to an enemy when it dies, the player will gain the experience but any experience scroll effects will not be renewed.
The drops are significantly better in hard mode, although some players find it easier to kill foes quickly in normal mode.

It can be difficult to maintain the experience-multiplier for experience scrolls that require killing a foe every 30 seconds, since there are three places where there are built-in delays. However, it is possible to use a single 5-minute scroll no matter how long it takes you to complete the mission.

Players can maintain both adrenaline and any experience bonus if they drag out the last fight before the end-bosses: Rush the last three foes and Falken will move forward (after pausing briefly), triggering the final dialogue. Players need to keep the fight going for about 45 seconds before the bosses become hostile. However, it's easier to just use an extra scroll for the final battle: the cost is relatively low compared to the average drops and the lost adrenaline is not a deciding factor in the final fight.
Alternatively, it's fairly trivial to maintain a Scroll of Slayer's Insight for the entire duration of the quest so long as you deal more damage to the bosses than Courier Falken.

quests/quest:gww:283691/sections/notes-1.text: Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles can be used, instead of regular Brass Knuckles.
Although Falken is affected by standard attacks, players are only subject to damage from skills.
Unlike the player, Falken does not gain health after a foe dies. To keep him alive, lead the way.
As with other solo quests, summoning stones cannot be used. However, sweets that increase speed or reduce skill activation times can be (e.g. Red Rock Candy or Birthday Cupcakes).
If a player dies shortly before finishing the quest and Falken manages to kill Li Ho Yan and Tai Soon by himself, the quest will still update and count as completed.

Beyond the square where you encounter Jade Brotherhood mobs appearing in waves, there's a chance that if you trigger hidden mobs when Falken is knocked out, he may stand there and no longer move. If this happens, you are forced to restart the quest.

quests/quest:gww:284878/sections/objecti.text: Meet up with the Krytan courier in Kaineng Docks.
Talk to Courier Falken to get a new move.
Defeat all enemies on the way back to Kaineng Center. Don't get knocked out.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:284878/sections/notes-1.text: There is at least one difference between this quest and the same quest in Normal mode:
There are 4 more bosses to fight.

quests/quest:gww:12024/sections/objectiv.text: Find the kidnapped guard in Wajjun Bazaar.
Kill the Am Fah guarding the captive.
See Emperor's Hand for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:12024/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is straight-forward. Entering from either The Marketplace or Nahpui Quarter, make your way to the area just past the entrance to The Undercity. A large group of hostile Am Fah guard the guardsman. Take them out and the quest is complete.

quests/quest:gww:12024/sections/notes-1/.text: You can still complete this quest even if It Ends Here is active in your quest log.
Even with Seek out Brother Tosai active in your quest log, the Am Fah surrounding the guard will be hostile.

quests/quest:gww:14620/sections/objectiv.text: Infiltrate the Am Fah and eavesdrop upon the Am Fah, without being noticed, to learn the location of the Orrian Tomes.
Capture the Orrian Tome from the Am Fah.
See Minister Jaisan for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14620/sections/walkthro.text: For the quickest route, enter Wajjun Bazaar from Nahpui Quarter, then head to the entrance of the Undercity. Soon after entering, at point 1, you'll come across 2 bandits standing on a bridge. Wait until they finish talking before you attack, that way the quest will update. After the quest updates, kill the bandits and follow the path to 2, where the Am Fah Leader is. Kill him and the Orrian Tome will drop. Return the Tome to Minister Jaisan to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:16668/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy a suitable target and use the Signet of Capture to acquire a skill.
See Elder Jonah for your reward.
You receive a Signet of Capture after obtaining this quest for the first time.

quests/quest:gww:16668/sections/walkthro.text: There are quite a few bosses in the general area; see Marga Coast for image of Boss locations. Any boss will do, though.

quests/quest:gww:18414/sections/objectiv.text: Help Cynn and Mhenlo rescue the Merchant Caravan.
See Laris Dankworth for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18414/sections/walkthro.text: You'll find Cynn and Mhenlo near the Resurrection shrine by the Pockmark Flats exit. After accepting the quest from Cynn, take your group into Pockmark Flats. When you reach the Merchant Caravan, a group of Storm riders will attack; defeat them. Then speak with Laris Dankworth (who may be back toward the Resurrection shrine) for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18414/sections/notes-1/.text: If you start the quest and then enter Pockmark Flats from Serenity Temple, Laris will be swarmed easily and die. However, if you proceed to the area where Laris should be, you can kill the swarm and complete that step of the quest, but you must leave through the north portal into Eastern Frontier and return to Pockmark Flats in order to speak to Laris for the reward.
If NPCs are aggroed, Mhenlo may say his second line before the Caravan Guard's answer. The initial dialogue plays even for non-Tyrian characters, who cannot accept the quest.

quests/quest:gww:14345/sections/objectiv.text: Kneel and plant seeds in each of the farmer's fields.
See Villager Hijai for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14345/sections/walkthro.text: This is a relatively simple quest involving no fighting, and takes only about 1-2 minutes.
Use the emote /kneel to plant the seeds at each location.

quests/quest:gww:14345/sections/notes-1/.text: Similar to Study Buddy, if you completed the Zen Daijun mission with this quest in your Quest Log, you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.

quests/quest:gww:25227/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the Casualty Report to Warmaster Tydus.
Return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25227/sections/walkthro.text: Simply map travel to Ascalon City and talk to Warmaster Tydus, then return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25227/sections/notes-1/.text: All professions can do this quest, but only necromancers get a skill as a reward.
This is a non-repeatable quest. If completed under any other profession(s), this skill reward will have to be acquired from a skill trainer.
This quest continues the storyline of Fallen Soldiers, even though this quest can be completed before Fallen Soldiers.

quests/quest:gww:66627/sections/notes-1/.text: If you do not have the required quest, you cannot advance beyond the door on the first level before the first collector near the Torn Cloth.
Killing a Becalmed Djinn on level 3 will cause a number of hidden monsters to spawn.
Fire Jet and Fire Dart turrets can be disabled by killing the Flame Guardians.
This dungeon has many foes that are not fleshy.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #1 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
Roaring Ethers sometimes spawn inside a wall and walk through a wall in level 2 and get stuck.

quests/quest:gww:66627/sections/shared-q.text: The main issues with this dungeon are the groups of Elementals, bring spell caster shutdown and spread out when facing them.

Go north through the tunnel and head left through the flame traps, then proceed northwest. You need to kill the Infernal Siege Wurm in the trench for the Dungeon Key - casters and ranged attacks can reach it from the cliffs east of the wurm, but you will have to venture into the pit to pick up the key (be wary of flame traps). Head west for the dungeon gate and to the portal to level 2.

Kill the southern Regent of Flame to obtain the Dungeon Key. The southern route is shorter and poses fewer problems for melee characters as there are fewer burning surfaces. After unlocking the gate be wary of the burrowing Infernal Wurm.

If you kill the Becalmed Djinn then the spiders will patrol super-fast around the room, in addition to procuring at least one additional spider group. After clearing the spiders out, head for the gate - just as you reach the gate a Flame Djinn will appear.

Stand your group close to the Djinn when fighting it, as this will lower the damage inflicted by Consuming Flames (equip heroes with melee weapons) and also the amount the Djinn is healed by. Pain Inverter and knock downs are particularly effective. Unlock the gate with the key it drops. Carefully cross the Elemental infested area, heading left when in the room with the bridges and multiple Wurms.

After aggroing Ilsundur, Lord of Fire, 2 lava boulders will appear: One lava boulder travels clockwise around the inner perimeter and the other counterclockwise around the outer perimeter, so flag heroes not engaged in melee in between. Like other boulders they will instantly kill a player (but will not inflict death penalty).

Ilsundur has no natural health regeneration, so he can be worn down with patience if you are having problems. Note that Ilsundur uses Firebomb, which forces heroes, henchmen and even pets to hold a bundle. AI controlled allies will drop it immediately and cause area of effect damage. If you find yourself holding it, you should drop it away from any allies. Also, be mindful of the two lava boulders previously described.

It is highly recommended that when the dungeon has been completed, you wait for the timer to finish counting down so that you will be transported to Sacnoth Valley where you can claim your reward from Swithin Nye.
Caster shutdown - useful against the many Roaring Ethers, Burning Spirits and Flowstone Elementals.
Pain Inverter or knock downs - useful against the Flame Djinn & Ilsundur.
There are not many corpses on levels 1 or 2, so minion masters won't be suitable.
You do not have to complete the dungeon to finish this quest. If you already have the quest item you can obtain the reward directly. This is useful for Survivors.

quests/quest:gww:25646/sections/objectiv.text: Find the Hamou Ukaiou and destroy it.
See Lendu the Fisherman for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25646/sections/walkthro.text: Lendu the Fisherman is near the center of Zehlon Reach. After getting the quest, locate Hamou Ukaiou in the waters almost directly north of Lendu. It is alone so it is not difficult to take it down, although you may want to make sure you have the skills to counter the poison condition. Be careful when fighting him, as the ranger boss, Ensign Lumi - who is level 19 and is accompanied by four level 10 Corsairs - can sometimes spawn nearby.

quests/quest:gww:25646/sections/notes-1/.text: Lendu is good on his word to bury his friends, as two gravestones appear when you come back later next to the nearby town's southeastern bridge.

If you read the graves it shows that the two people who died were husband and wife, though if you look at the two bodies lying around the Hamou Ukaiou, they are both male. Lendu also speaks of Shankulu as "her".

quests/quest:gww:66993/sections/notes-1/.text: This dungeon can only be entered via prompt in the required quest.
This is the only place where Golden Rin Relics and Diessa Chalices are dropped.
Corpses of Charr can be found throughout all three levels.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #3 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.

The Bone Fiends and Servant of Murakai in the final room are not vulnerable to skills that affect summoned creatures, even though they are identified as being summoned. There are several rare bugs that can prevent the party from completing the dungeon:
Level 1: The Keeper (and minions) can spawn behind the door to the next level, making them impossible to kill without enough ranged damage.
Level 3: If the Keymaster of Murakai is allowed to travel all the way back to its resting point, the dungeon key may drop over the edge of the lava stream, making it unreachable.
Some foes do not consistently engage the party as expected:
The group of Charr near the area map may get stuck in the wall.
Leaving Faze Magekiller just out of the Danger Zone will leave him friendly and his group will attack him.
After The Keeper is defeated, the mobs that subsequently spawn do not attack unless engaged, even if they are inside the aggro bubble.
Leaving Tyndir Flamecaller just out of the Danger Zone will leave him friendly and his group will attack him.
The Master and his minions sometimes spawn behind the door to the third level, making them harder to kill.

Despite being collectors, Dextarr Dirtdigger and Lars Bridgeater do not have [Collector] appended to their names, and do not appear on the mission map. There are graphical display errors when standing in certain parts of the room with Murakai.

quests/quest:gww:66993/sections/shared-q.text: The Temple of the Damned features the Cathedral of Flames with a heavy population of undead, Enchanted weapons, and Charr.

The first level is straight forward. Kill Faze Magekiller to obtain the dungeon key, open the door and proceed to the next area. The Keeper and his group of restless spirits are in that area. Killing The Keeper opens the door to the next level.

On the second level there is a dungeon map to the south of the staircase. Tyndir Flamecaller guards the locked door on the east side of the level. Beyond that door, Vraxx the Condemned patrols with a group of Plague Zombies which can be easily pulled and dispatched. Next, carefully pull and clear the Enchanted and undead patrols around the edge of the chamber. Finally, defeat the Master to open the door to the next level.

Either quickly kill the Keymaster of Murakai, or follow it to the location of the dungeon floor map and kill it. The Keymaster will drop the dungeon key when slain. Proceed around the central chamber to the western side of the level. After unlocking the locked door, wait for the Murakai's Steward to finish speaking and slowly pull as many popups as possible from the room. Stay outside the range of the poison darts before killing the Steward and his group at the hill top. With his dungeon key backtrack to the first ramp and proceed north through a nearby tunnel which will take you to the northern side of the main chamber. Clear any undead along the way and run up the northern stairway to the boss door as fast as possible to minimize damage from the fire darts. It is not recommended to run through the center of the chamber as there are a lot more fire darts to contend with.

In the boss room there are Plague Zombies and Bone Fiends that can be easily dispatched before battling with Murakai. When Murakai uses Murakai's Consumption her power meter fills up, which allows her to use Murakai's Storm of Souls. Interrupting Murakai's skills will prevent her from dealing much damage and she will die with only moderate pressure.
Murakai, Lady of the Night#Tips for defeating Murakai
Minion masters are less useful in this dungeon as there are small numbers of exploitable corpses, and the undead can make short work of them using Ray of Judgment and Banishing Strike.
The Charr and the undead are hostile to each other and you can just let them fight each other.
The Charr have high fire damage and the undead use powerful lightning spells, so pre-protting is crucial to mitigate massive amounts of damage.
Beware of the undead popups in this dungeon.
Holy damage, such as from Light of Deldrimor, is very effective against the skeletons and zombies.
Poison Dart, Poison Jet or Poison Spout can hurt the enemy as well as you, so use flags and proceed carefully around them, and possibly pull enemies into these traps.
After accepting the reward, you have to return to Doomlore Shrine first if you want to go for another run, or simply change to a different district.

quests/quest:gww:22312/sections/objectiv.text: Journey with Zhed Shadowhoof to the Ancestor Tree in Turai's Procession.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:22312/sections/environm.text: After accepting the reward and until the completion of the following quest (Mirza's Last Stand), the Wandering Priest at the Resurrection Shrine nearest Mirza (that gives the Monster Hunt bounty) will not spawn and the Melandru's Watcher will also not spawn when kneeling at that Resurrection Shrine.

quests/quest:gww:22312/sections/walkthro.text: Map travel to Venta Cemetery. Continue to Turai's Procession and speak with Mirza.

quests/quest:gww:204575/sections/objecti.text: Destroy the corsairs invading Chahbek Village.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.

quests/quest:gww:204575/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 15 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:204575/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Chahbek Village mission.

quests/quest:gww:10148/sections/objectiv.text: See Captain Elora for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10148/sections/walkthro.text: Start from Gyala Hatchery and head north into the Maishang Hills. The Ancient Elder Naga are located just outside the portal, immediately to the east of your starting location. You will have to fight one group of (Archaic) Kappa along the way.

If you do not have access to the hatchery, start instead from Eredon Terrace and head due south, fighting several groups of monsters along the way, including the necro boss, Sessk, Woe Spreader. When you reach the coast, activate the resurrection shrine outside of Gyala Hatchery and then head east to the Elder Nagas.

quests/quest:gww:10148/sections/notes-1/.text: The Ancient Elder Naga is a category of Naga, composed of the Elder Naga Warrior, Archer, and Ritualist.

quests/quest:gww:14676/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Prophecies on the account

quests/quest:gww:14676/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Mhenlo at Bejunkan Pier.
Speak to Armian to book passage on the good ship Sea Swift, bound for Tyria.
Speak to Lionguard Neiro in the foreign administration center and gain entrance to Lion's Arch and the lands of Kryta.
Speak to Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, to inform him you have arrived in Lion's Arch.

quests/quest:gww:14676/sections/walkthro.text: Just follow the quest marker and talk with the relevant people. There is no fighting involved in this quest.

quests/quest:gww:14676/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest unlocks Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).
Although Prophecies and Nightfall characters cannot obtain this quest, a Factions character can use this quest to ferry them to Lion's Arch.

Should your whole party die in the Bejunkan Pier area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), they will be resurrected at the shrine near Mhenlo and can continue with the quest; however, should they die in Lion's Gate, you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to the Kaineng Center.
See Campaign travel and Ferry for additional information.

quests/quest:gww:202581/sections/objecti.text: Kill a group of Charged Blackness in the Underworld.
*BONUS* Kill a group of Charged Blackness in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:202581/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:202581/sections/walkthr.text: When you enter the Underworld, you'll arrive at the yellow spot on the map. Finish the first part of Clear the Chamber to open the doors, then proceed south towards Twin Serpent Mountains. Until then, you will mostly encounter warrior foes.

Move up the mountains, keeping your distance from the Obsidian Behemoths and their traps. Several groups of Charged Blacknesses patrol here. To finish this quest, one of their groups needs to be killed.

quests/quest:gww:14879/sections/objectiv.text: Follow Rurik and help him defeat the Charr.
Return to Prince Rurik for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14879/sections/environm.text: Upon accepting the quest, Prince Rurik will spawn outside the city gates in Lakeside County, alongside an Academy Monk and an Ascalon Guard. They will begin running to engage the Charr who spawn at the gate to the Northlands.

quests/quest:gww:14879/sections/walkthro.text: Exit the town and meet Prince Rurik just outside Ascalon City. Stand by him for a few moments and he will start running along the road to the Northlands.
At several locations Rurik will stop and wait for you if you wander too far, forcing you to get close to him to resume his run.
Kill the four Charr located at the gate once you get there. You can let Rurik and the two NPCs handle them on their own, as they are more than capable to defeat the group by themselves.
Though the monk that follows Prince Rurik is quite an efficient healer with her Heal Other spell, you may wish to keep your distance from the Charr if you are at low level.
You can talk to Rurik right afterwards for your reward or map travel and receive it from him in Ascalon City.

quests/quest:gww:14879/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be used to help reach level 10 in pre-Searing, since it is a quick way to kill up to four level 5 foes. Map travel back to Ascalon City after killing the last Charr, abandon the quest from the quest log, then talk to Rurik to take it again.
The June 6, 2018 update made it possible for a solo player to travel to The Northlands. Killing the Oakhearts will allow for additional experience per run.
If the Charr are killed without Rurik, they will respawn upon zoning. This allows for rapid farming by repeatedly killing the group and traveling to The Northlands.
Consider stopping to pickup a Red Iris Flower — one almost always spawns along the way to the gate. Press Alt to see where it is.
It can be worth a detour to kill the Rogue Bull (as long as you have not completed A Mesmer's Burden).
Ben Wolfson will not spawn in Lakeside County during this quest.

The objective to meet up with Rurik outside of Ascalon City is counted separately from the objective to defeat the Charr, despite being one line in the quest log. Charr can occasionally spawn behind the gate.

quests/quest:gww:25473/sections/objectiv.text: Find out if the Charr Ranger is using the catacombs. Speak to Brother Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey.
Ask Necromancer Munne if she has any information on the Charr.
Seek out Oberan the Reviled deep within the catacombs. Ask him about the Charr Ranger.
Return to Rurik in Ascalon City and show him the sharp charr tooth.

quests/quest:gww:25473/sections/walkthro.text: Take the southwest road from Ascalon City to Ashford Abbey and speak with Brother Mhenlo. From there, enter the Catacombs; you will find Necromancer Munne just inside to your right.

Oberan the Reviled is a bit harder to get to from Necromancer Munne's position, as you have to fight your way through various undead and Deadly Crypt Spiders (use the quest marker on the Mission Map as a reference point).
Alternatively, entering the Catacombs from the Green Hills County portal (north of the Barradin Estate) offers a much faster and safer trek to Oberan.
Once you obtain the Sharp Charr Tooth from him, you can simply map travel back to Ascalon City for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25473/sections/notes-1/.text: This is a good way to get to Oberan the Reviled for Necromancers to grab the skill quest The Accursed Path, as this quest leads you straight to him.

quests/quest:gww:320080/sections/objecti.text: Take out Wyle Brimscourge and use the key to access the lower level.
Take out the Charr patrols. [3...0] remain.

quests/quest:gww:320080/sections/walkthr.text: Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map).

Level 1: Fight your way south down the winding path towards the Dungeon Lock. The enemies you encounter will be the same as on your last trip through this floor, except for the addition of some Shard Elementals and Hulking Shard Elementals near each patch of crystalline ground, which are just slightly stronger versions of the Cave Elementals encountered previously. At the south end of the dungeon, there will be a large chamber with numerous Charr, grawl, and elemental foes, so pull carefully to avoid over-aggro, and be mindful of two Charr Hunters circling the perimeter. Wyle Brimscourge will also be patrolling the area, and although he is a high-level warrior, he can be pulled and fought by himself, making him relatively simple to defeat. Time your most damaging abilities for when he uses Frenzy or Healing Signet. If you cannot withstand his attack damage, consider retreating up the slopes to the north to the edge of his following range, or using a pet or fire imp to tank. Wyle will drop a Dungeon Key, allowing you to open the lock and enter the portal to level 2.

Level 2: Follow the passage down and east through some grawl, and as you turn to the north, you will see a vast chamber full of grawl and some patrolling Charr groups. Carefully cross to the north side of the chamber, pulling groups and keeping an eye on their patrol routes. Head for the western stairs on the north side, leading up to a room with more Shard Elementals and crystalline ground, then head directly north to encounter the first of three Charr patrols. Each patrol consists of one Charr Patrol Leader and a pair of Charr Patrol Stalkers. The stalkers are in a separate group and can easily be engaged separately from their leaders. Once you have killed this patrol, continue north past some more Shard Elementals to a passage leading to a crystal gate, where you will find the second patrol. Finally, head east past some oakhearts and ironhearts to find the third patrol in the northeast corner of the dungeon. Once all three patrols are dead, map travel back to Piken Square to claim the rewards.
The Charr Patrol Leaders do not need to be killed to progress the quest. Only the Charr Patrol Stalkers are counted.

quests/quest:gww:320080/sections/notes-1.text: The Charr Patrol Leaders start moving when they are approached, and will walk to a new location if they are left alone. The central leader moves northwest and stops at the entrance to the chamber filled with rock-crushing machines, the northern leader heads southeast through a tunnel filled with crystals and walks all the way to the middle of the large atrium chamber, and the northeastern leader merely steps out to the entrance of the tunnel he is found in.
If any party members have not completed Long Thought Forgotten, the western entrance to the dungeon will be closed, requiring the party to travel to the eastern entrance.
The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten active in their quest log.
Although this quest can be acquired without Reforged Mode enabled, the quest NPCs will not spawn and the objectives will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.

Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it significantly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.

By using the eastern dungeon entrance, running swiftly through the portal to level 2 when it is open, and moving very carefully on level 2, it is possible to complete this quest without fighting any Charr groups inside the dungeon except Wyle and the Charr Patrol Stalkers.
The objective to rendezvous with Adept Mullenix completes immediately upon entering the Tunnels, even if the party uses the eastern entrance.

quests/quest:gww:63292/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the Charr expeditionary force in Norrhart Domains.
See Artificer Mullenix for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63292/sections/walkthro.text: If leaving from Gunnar's Hold, avoid the first few Charr groups you see and run north following the green arrow until you hear the Charr Wardkeeper dialogue, "Humans! Hierophant Burntsoul was right! [...]" Now you can start killing off the three groups at the starred location on the compass. Head south to find two more sets of Charr waiting for you to aggro them. Pull back onto the top of the ramp, wait for the Charr to ball up on the bottom of the ramp, and use area of effect skills to take them out. If they run away, wait until they return and repeat for any stragglers.

quests/quest:gww:63292/sections/notes-1/.text: In normal mode, the low level Charr from this quest do not count as enemies for the Norn Hunting Party blessing.

quests/quest:gww:25522/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Aidan just outside of Piken Square.
Return to Ivor Trueshot for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25522/sections/walkthro.text: Meet Aidan just outside of Piken Square and talk to him. Follow him to kill 4 Charr Stalkers and then slay another group of 4 Charr Stalkers to pillage the 4 Charr Supply Depots (Chests). The chests may drop zero to three items per chest. Make sure to flag your Henchmen or Heroes away.
Finally kill Kaargoth Bloodclaw (Necromancer Boss). Walk back with Aidan to Piken Square for the reward. Aidan must survive to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:9271/sections/objective.text: Explore Arborstone for Sekai the Mapmaker. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Ferndale. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Melandru's Hope. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Drazach Thicket. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
See Sekai the Mapmaker for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9271/sections/walkthrou.text: The order of the explorable areas you go through doesn't matter. Simply get to each green marker to complete the quest. For exact locations of the markers, see the maps to the right - the order of the locations does not matter. Each area is easiest to start from the following outposts:
For Arborstone start from Altrumm Ruins.
For Ferndale start from House zu Heltzer.
For Melandru's Hope start from Lutgardis Conservatory.

In this area, there are several groups that have wide ranged patrol areas that overlap. Due to this, they can overwhelm unprepared/unobservant players. It is best to watch their patrol paths and engage them where they don't overlap.
For Drazach Thicket start from Brauer Academy northern exit.
Do not leave an area before finding all five marker locations, otherwise you will have to restart that explorable area.

quests/quest:gww:9271/sections/notes-1/b.text: Several quests that give Kurzick faction for Befriending the Kurzicks are located in the areas you have to explore and may be done while you visit the five places.
One method to complete this quest is to vanquish all the listed areas, since a vanquish pretty much requires you to sweep the entire area.
Consider waiting until the Zaishen Vanquish Challenge quest of each corresponding area is available.

quests/quest:gww:10182/sections/objectiv.text: Explore Mount Qinkai. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Boreas Seabed. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Archipelagos. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
Explore Maishang Hills. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
See Sekai the Mapmaker for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10182/sections/walkthro.text: The order of the explorable areas you go through doesn't matter. Simply get to each green marker to complete the quest. For exact locations of the markers, see the maps to the right - the order of the locations does not matter. Each area is easiest to start from the following outposts:
For Mount Qinkai, start from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon)
For Boreas Seabed, start from Zos Shivros Channel
For Archipelagos, start from Jade Flats (Luxon)
For Maishang Hills, start from Bai Paasu Reach
Do not leave an area before finding all five marker locations, otherwise you will have to restart that explorable area.

quests/quest:gww:10182/sections/notes-1/.text: You will encounter several bosses along the way. It may be wise to bring Signet of Capture with you.
Several quests that give Luxon faction for Befriending the Luxons are located in the areas you have to explore and may be done while you visit the five places.
One method to complete this quest is to vanquish all the listed areas, since a vanquish pretty much requires you to sweep the entire area.
Consider waiting until the Zaishen Vanquish Challenge quest of each corresponding area is available.

quests/quest:gww:11341/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Factions linked to Guild Wars Nightfall on same account

quests/quest:gww:11341/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Imperial Guardsman Linro in Kaineng Center.
Travel to the Undercity. Zenmai must survive.
Stop the Am Fah from creating new afflicted soldiers.
Return to Clerk Arlon in Kamadan with Zenmai.

quests/quest:gww:11341/sections/environm.text: During this quest, the number of foes in Bukdek Byway will be reduced to only 1-10, which makes vanquishing easier. See Bukdek Byway notes.

During this quest, some bosses in the Undercity or several bosses in that explorable area during Winds of Change will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her.

quests/quest:gww:11341/sections/walkthro.text: See campaign travel for information on travelling to Cantha and Elona.

Leave from Kaineng Center and follow the quest map to Zenmai. After you talk to her, Zenmai will disappear into the Undercity. Proceed south to the entrance to the Undercity and follow the quest map to Lale the Vindictive. After you defeat him, a series of Am Fah will appear which you must also defeat. Following these battles, speak to Zenmai again. Then map travel back to Kamadan and speak to Clerk Arlon for your reward.

To complete the quest, Zenmai must stay alive the entire time. One option is to repeatedly order a Monk player or hero to use Healing Prayers or Protection Prayers skills on her. For players that are not level 20 yet, flagging your heroes and henchmen to tackle the mobs would be a good idea. This also minimizes the chance of Zenmai dying, as she will stay behind with you.

quests/quest:gww:11341/sections/notes-1/.text: Having this quest active can drastically reduce the number of foes required to vanquish Bukdek Byway, less than 10 kills if combined with The Afflicted Guard, The Drunken Master or Missing Daughter, down to 60 otherwise.
For the Guild Wars Nightfall campaign, Plague in Cantha given by Funwa Shento in Kamadan is associated with this quest.
For the Guild Wars Prophecies campaign, Mhenlo's Request given by Firstwatch Sergio in Lion's Arch is associated with this quest.
Combines very well with Mayhem in the Market if you are using a Factions character in this quest, as the number of Afflicted in the region are significantly reduced.
The Torment creatures are affected from your Lightbringer title effect as usual.

Once you talk to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway, you need to escort her to the Undercity. If you zone away from Bukdek Byway or enter the Undercity before she arrives, you need to re-enter and talk to Zenmai again. If Zenmai is missed after you have entered the Undercity, exit back to Bukdek Byway and re-enter.

This quest replaced the now removed quest Gain Zenmai. If Gain Zenmai was completed, this quest can not be accepted. Likewise, if you have Gain Zenmai you can not start this quest until it is abandoned.

quests/quest:gww:200551/sections/objecti.text: Kill Chung, the Attuned in the Undercity.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:200551/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:200551/sections/walkthr.text: Head to the Nahpui Quarter outpost and enter the Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar, as Chung is much closer to that exit than the Bukdek Byway exit. Be careful when approaching his spawn location, because he will not appear until you approach his location; and when he does appear, two other groups of Am Fah will also popup for an ambush. These groups can all be pulled separately; there is no need to try to kill everyone at the same time.

quests/quest:gww:200551/sections/notes-1.text: Killing Chung in his alternate location during the quest Eliminate the Am Fah does not count toward completion. He must be killed at his normal spawn in the Undercity.
His group is spawned automatically during the quest It Ends Here.
If a party member has Seek out Brother Tosai active, the walk to the Undercity will have allied Am Fah on it.
If a party member has the quest Chasing Zenmai active (particularly, if said party member has reached said quest's second objective in the quest log), he will not spawn at the marked location.

quests/quest:gww:12177/sections/objectiv.text: Find the historical monument in Surmia.
Find the historical monument in Nolani.
Find the historical monument of King's Watch.

quests/quest:gww:12177/sections/rewards-.text: The weapon bonuses listed in gray are not mentioned in the quest log.

quests/quest:gww:12177/sections/walkthro.text: While the first monument can be reached right after obtaining the quest, the two others are located further away and usually require completion of additional missions.

The Historical Monument of King's Watch is located a distance away from Fort Ranik in Regent Valley. Simply have the quest active in your log, and follow the green star on your map. It is recommended to combine this quest with The Red-Cloaked Deserter and Regent Valley Defense since they lead to the same vicinity. If you have the quest Counting the Fallen (from the same quest giver), you can also start from Sardelac Sanitarium and head Southeast, collecting the Ascalon Census on the way.
The Historical Monument of Surmia is found near the end of the Ruins of Surmia mission which takes place shortly after the Fort Ranik mission.

The Historical Monument of Nolani is located in Diessa Lowlands, just outside the Nolani Academy (the last mission outpost in Ascalon) . You have to turn to the left and walk upstairs. Be careful of the large mob of gargoyles as it can kill an unprepared team.

quests/quest:gww:12177/sections/notes-1/.text: The Grim Cesta awarded through this quest is the only item that can reduce your health to 55, as popularised by the "55 Monk" style of farming builds.
As such, this item is likely to be your first valuable reward. If you have no plans to use it, consider selling it to other players.

quests/quest:gww:283681/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Bukdek Byway
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283681/sections/shared-.text: Start from Kaineng Center and follow the quest markers through Bukdek Byway, and destroy three groups of Afflicted. Non-Dervishes should avoid bringing enchantments, or be prepared to deal with an over-abundance of enchantment removal skills.

quests/quest:gww:283860/sections/objecti.text: Travel to Haiju Lagoon with Initiate Tsuriai.
Protect Initiate Tsuriai while she cleanses the lagoon.
See Initiate Tsuriai for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283860/sections/shared-.text: Cleansing Haiju Lagoon/Guide for a detailed walkthrough

Your goal is to protect Tsuriai while she stands in the lagoon to conduct her cleansing ritual. Several groups of Afflicted will attack her from three directions (west, south, and east). After completing the ritual, any remaining Afflicted will disappear. If she dies, the quest fails and you must rezone to try again.

Head northwest from Zen Daijun to meet up with Tsuriai then head north to the starburst on the map. After she begins her chanting you have a few moments to organize your party before being confronted by the Afflicted. Keep her alive for the minute or two she needs; you do not actually have to kill any of the foes (although this will obviously make keeping her alive easier).
While standing in the water you will be under the Corrupted Haiju Lagoon Water effect until the ritual is complete.
As Initiate Tsuriai is compelled to healing the player, she can be pulled out of the aggro-range of the enemies by using life-sacrificing skills and moving to the other side of the island.

quests/quest:gww:283875/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283875/sections/shared-.text: Leave from Durheim Archives and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. Try to only engage one group at a time.
With the exception of Initiate Zei Ri, all ministry allies do not resurrect if they are killed.

quests/quest:gww:283618/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Pongmei Valley.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283618/sections/shared-.text: Leave from Boreas Seabed or Maatu Keep. Follow the quest marker to an Afflicted group with an abnormally large Afflicted warrior boss; use melee counters (such as Empathy and Soothing Images). Avoid applying conditions to the boss, as it will use its only heal. You must kill all the Afflicted there, so it pays to focus on the healers first and leave the boss until the end.
If you wait a short while after defeating the Afflicted, you will see a Ministry Captain approach and initiate a dialogue.

quests/quest:gww:283869/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Rhea's Crater.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283869/sections/shared-.text: Starting from Seafarer's Rest, follow the quest markers and eliminate the three mobs of afflicted.
The subsequent groups will not spawn until the previous group has been defeated, forcing you to finish the groups in order.
Initiate Zei Ri leaves the party list before defeating the final group of afflicted, resulting in Zei Ri attempting to heal the Afflicted.

quests/quest:gww:283683/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Shadow's Passage.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283683/sections/notes-1.text: Completing this quest almost always results in vanquishing the area, since the foes consist entirely of the three groups of Afflicted and one group of Jade Brotherhood (except if they happen to survive getting caught between the party and the Afflicted).

quests/quest:gww:283683/sections/shared-.text: Start from Dragon's Throat and follow the quest markers and eliminate three groups of Afflicted. Just before the third, a small group of Jade Brotherhood will pop up; they are hostile to the Afflicted, so if you maneuver carefully, they can do some of your work for you.

quests/quest:gww:283745/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Shenzun Tunnels.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283745/sections/shared-.text: Leave from either Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District (outpost) and follow the starburst towards the center of the map (north from Maatu, west from Sunjiang). Choosing Maatu Keep will mean that you will end up fighting Rai Zhon the Manipulator, whilst the selection of Sunjiang District means that you will fight 3 mobs instead of 2 en route to the quest marker, but don't have to face any bosses provided that you hug the wall when passing by Xi Lin of the Flames.

At the starburst you will meet the five Initiates and the dialogue will begin. After the first bit of dialogue, groups of Afflicted will head towards where the starbust now is - within the middle of sewage water, just north of the initiates. From here you can take multiple actions:

Head west to where the first group will come from and kill the groups from this area first. From here, they will come one right after the other from two directions and it is easy to avoid half of the mobs. After killing the waves that come from the west, you can head back to the center and pull those that remain away.

You can retreat to the way you came from and deal with fewer groups and more pulling up a closer ramp, allowing better ranged damage. After four or so groups approach down the other ramps, a group will turn up behind you.
Stay in the middle and brace yourself. Doing this will most likely end in a wipe, but you won't fail the quest and can simply return to the spot to finish what remains.
After killing the waves, the party leader character will state that there's one more group left - this group will pop up in the center of the sewage water. Killing them will complete the quest.
Killing the last group of Afflicted will complete the quest even if foes from previous groups remain.
Among your allies, only Zei Ri self-resurrects (the other remain dead once they lose all their health once).
If Zei Ri fails to resurrect after a death, you will be unable to complete the quest; you must rezone and start over.
The final wave of Afflicted can spawn even if there are foes remaining from previous waves. If this happens, you need only defeat the final group to receive credit for quest completion.

quests/quest:gww:283872/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in the Silent Surf.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283872/sections/shared-.text: There are 2-3 waves with several groups in each wave. The groups in each wave stagger from each other, but do overlap. It is easy to get quickly overwhelmed. Fortunately, there is a resurrection shrine nearby, either at the entrance if aligned with the Luxons or on the island to the northeast if aligned with the Kurzicks.

However, you can stay away from where the Afflicted converge and pull foes away from the area to make the encounter less deadly. You do not need to kill all the afflicted to complete this quest. This quest can be completed by only killing five (1-5) groups of Afflicted:

Start from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), hug the west (left) wall towards the boats, and flag your team near the Mob (3) spawn point. Pull the starting Mob (1); once eliminated, use speed boosts to swiftly aggro Mob (2) that spawns near/behind one of the further boats before it moves to the center. After these are killed, Mob (3) will spawn behind you, near the original flag-point. Mob (4) will spawn right behind the boat that's closest to you. The last group, Mob (5), spawn relatively far away to the east of your likely location, but will move towards the boats before moving towards the center. After killing this group, the quest should be completed.
You do not need to kill all of the Afflicted. There is a spawn point to the southeast of the Afflicted gathering spot. During the second wave, the mob that triggers the end quest spawns from there.

quests/quest:gww:25425/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the carved buckeye to Soar Honorclaw.
Meet Dao Weng in Panjiang Peninsula and kill him.
Return to Soar Honorclaw to let her know you have succeeded.
See Headmaster Lee for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25425/sections/walkthro.text: First travel to Aerie. The fastest way is to first maptravel to Ran Musu Gardens and then go south. After talking to Soar, maptravel to Tsumei Village and then leave for Panjiang Peninsula. Weng and his four guards are nearby and not difficult foes if you bring allies. Any henchmen will do. Then return to Aerie before getting the reward in the Monastery.

quests/quest:gww:283611/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in Sunjiang District.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283611/sections/shared-.text: To complete this quest, your character must have successfully completed the missions: Boreas Seabed, Arborstone, and Sunjiang District, otherwise a gate will block the path to the last group of Afflicted that must be defeated.

Start from Zin Ku Corridor and head south into the Sunjiang District. The Am Fah encountered on the way to the first quest marker do not use Winds of Change builds and so are trivial to defeat. Follow the quest markers and kill off the Afflicted groups.

While it might look like an equidistant route to approach this quest from the south, the Am Fah in Pongmei Valley do use the Winds of Change builds and so are much more difficult than the Zin Ku Corridor route.

The final group spawns very near the fourth group, namely near the Ranger's Construct boss. There's a risk of aggro before recuperating from the previous fight; consider pulling the fourth group further away from the tunnel, and then pulling the final group away from the Shiro'ken.

quests/quest:gww:283600/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the Afflicted in the Undercity.
See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283600/sections/shared-.text: If you have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) you can begin this quest from there and head directly to the Undercity. If you don't have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), then start in the Marketplace, exit to either Bukdek Byway or Wajjun Bazaar, and enter the Undercity from there.

Once in the Undercity, just follow the quest markers to eliminate the five groups of Afflicted. The Am Fah shouldn't be a challenge and are hostile to the Afflicted; take advantage of this. If patient, the Kappa will be eliminated, reducing needless distractions to your heroes, minions, etc. For two of the final three groups, you can make use of the Am Fah to weaken the Afflicted.

quests/quest:gww:283865/sections/require.text: Access to Zen Daijun (explorable area), which requires completing the Zen Daijun mission.

quests/quest:gww:283865/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the plagued aspect of Zunraa.
Defeat the rotten aspect of Zunraa.
Defeat the tainted aspect of Zunraa.
Defeat the infected aspect of Zunraa.
Defeat the diseased aspect of Zunraa.
See Initiate Tsuriai for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283865/sections/shared-.text: The standard enemy party size here is 4 or 6, and the enemy party size around each Shrine of Zunraa is 6, not including the afflicted aspect of Zunraa. Careful pulling is recommended as the groups tend to bunch up near each other.
Caution: when approaching some of the Shrines of Zunraa, a nearby mobile group of 4 enemies will approach to attack you. Take care of them first, before engaging the group around the shrine itself.
The groups surrounding the afflicted aspects of Zunraa can be pulled separately. It appears that the afflicted aspects of Zunraa do not heal or interact with them in any way.
Pain Inverter is extremely effective against the aspects of Zunraa, as well as Afflicted Elementalists.
Mesmers capable of interrupt and skill disabling are a good idea here.
AoE skills will not be highly effective, as enemies tend to spread out somewhat.
Five of the Elite skills in Smiting Prayers are available for capture during this quest.
If you have the "unwelcome guest" quest. The area will bug and you will not get Zunraa spawns

quests/quest:gww:16621/sections/objectiv.text: Clear the chamber of any grasping darkness. You have [3..0] groups remaining.
Destroy the Terrorwebs around the statue of Grenth.
See Reaper of the Labyrinth for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:16621/sections/walkthro.text: Important note: This quest is a legendary death trap for players new to the Underworld. It is important to advise these players not to take the quest before entering to avoid any problems caused by the groups of Grasping Darknesses spawned by this quest. Clearing the area of all Bladed Aatxes before taking this quest is beneficial. However, aggroing a number of Aatxes and Grasping Darknesses at the same time may serve as a stress test for the party, and show whether it is up to the challenges of The Underworld.

When a player accepts this quest three groups of Grasping Darknesses spawn nearby. Two of the groups spawn on the upper level of the beginning area and begin patrolling there. The third group spawns further away and will patrol from that point to the upper level of the beginning area and back. If the players stay on the lower area they will remain out of aggro range. The groups consist of three or four Darknesses each and aren't difficult to defeat for a prepared party.

After eliminating all three groups the doors out of the beginning area will open, revealing the paths to the rest of the Underworld. There are two paths which take you to the next target of the quest, the Terrorweb Dryders. The north-western path is shorter, but leads the party to a tight passage which leads to the destination chamber filled with enemy groups. When approaching from this direction it is hard to pull enemies one group at a time. The north-eastern route is a bit longer and has some small enemy groups in it, but pulling of the groups in the chamber is a lot easier from this side.

Be sure to kill all other enemy groups before attacking the Terrorwebs, because after you kill them a Reaper of the Labyrinth will spawn near the statue of Grenth in the chamber. If there are any enemies left at this point they might attack the Reaper and kill it, causing the party to be taken back to to the outpost from which they left to the Underworld. Speak to the Reaper to receive the quest reward. You might also want to save the quest reward for later on so that you can remove Death Penalty with it.

Important note: Advise all players to not take any further quests from the Reaper. Each of the quests offered spawn additional enemies, which might be hard to fight without extra preparations such as clearing certain areas of their regular enemy groups. Also, the quests Escort of Souls and Unwanted Guests are almost impossible to complete at the same time, because in Escort of Souls you need to protect a group of New Souls following your party and in the other you will face the nearly invincible Vengeful Aatxes.

quests/quest:gww:16621/sections/notes-1/.text: Although the Reaper of the Labyrinth is credited as quest-giver in your quest log, it is the Lost Soul next to where you start in the Underworld from whom you can obtain this quest.

quests/quest:gww:282482/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Cliffs of Dohjok in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282482/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282482/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Cliffs of Dohjok in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282482/sections/target-.text: The Cliffs of Dohjok connects to quite a few other locations. The fastest way is to travel southwest from Sunspear Great Hall to Champion's Dawn, which also exits onto the eastern edge of the Cliffs of Dohjok.
Nightfall characters will be led through here as part of the quest Leaving a Legacy. Non-Nightfall characters will come here as part of the A Land of Heroes quest.

If you wish to level up early and quickly, the primary quest Leaving a Legacy (the one where you get Dunkoro) will allow you to clear this area quickly and safely, since you get the help of Dunkoro and a group of Diggers as allies. The bonus from bounties will give quite a bit of experience. To get even more, flag any hero and henchmen far away and just clear the area with Dunkoro and the Diggers, so that you will get the full amount of experience per kill.
