A chest will spawn after defeating an Ancient Vaettir, and spawns a torch that you can light the other braziers with. Keep in mind that any torch can be used and thus carrying just one torch through the level is sufficient.

In the first level, you need to defeat the Reaper of Destruction, which is a dervish boss, and several Destroyers that will spawn around it to get the dungeon key. You must kill all the Destroyers (including the ones that have not spawned behind the boss yet, if the boss is lured) for the dungeon key to drop. You also can summon a Dwarven Ghost if you have Light of Deldrimor close to where you pick up the area map. There are two hidden treasures in the exit area with the drakes.

At the second level, the dungeon key is located in the western portion. When you pick up the key, several Destroyers will spawn between your party and the dungeon gate. There is a potentially frustrating section on this level that requires you to light a torch, run past a gauntlet of ice-jet traps, and then light another pair of braziers (in order to make a bridge appear). It is possible to do this without a speed boost skill, but it is advised to bring one. With or without, you may have to try this several times before you succeed. This can be accomplished simply by running between the ice wall and the ice-jet traps (behind them). There is enough space to run behind them when they are on and down the middle of the chamber when they turn off.

The third level is very short. You will notice a group of Dwarves, and they will be attacked by several waves of Destroyers coming from all sides. Survive the waves, and the end boss, the Plague of Destruction will show up at the end of it. Kill it to clear the dungeon, and pick up your reward from the Destroyer Chest. Note that surviving the waves of Destroyers is generally harder than defeating the Plague of Destruction.

quests/quest:gww:63652/sections/notes-1/.text: A speed boost can make it easier to run torches (especially on level 2), but you can manage without one.
You generally can drop the Unlit Torches after opening a passageway as there are several chests containing new unlit torches that you can find along the way.
Once you kill the Reaper of Destruction on level 2, your route to the exit will fill with spawns of destroyers.
If you are having trouble, you can run away from the destroyers and wait for nearby ice traps or remaining foes to weaken the groups enough for you to finish off the rest.
Destroyers are resistant to fire damage and immune to Burning. Several foes here (Elementals and Nightmares) are not fleshy.
If you save the northeastern group of Dwarves then they will patrol towards Captain Sargen's unit - potentially helping your group engage with the Destroyers.
The quest log could update itself as "Completed" after killing the waves of Destroyers but not the Plague of Destruction.

quests/quest:gww:25406/sections/requirem.text: You must have Monk or Mesmer as your primary or secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:25406/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Lo Sha again to begin the test.
Defeat Su or survive for 2 minutes.
See Instructor Ng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25406/sections/walkthro.text: Using a hex removal skill will not ensure your survival; bring a healing skill as well. Alternatively, just hurt Su enough and you will complete the quest, regardless of how much time remains.

quests/quest:gww:25406/sections/notes-1/.text: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
Lo Sha claims the skills are provided by him, when they are provided by Instructer Ng.

quests/quest:gww:282114/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Dejarin Estate in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282114/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282114/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Dejarin Estate in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282114/sections/target-.text: From Yohlon Haven, head east through Arkjok Ward and Pogahn Passage.
Alternatively, from the Sunspear Sanctuary, one can head north into the Command Post then east through Jahai Bluffs and south east through Kodonur Crossroads.
The majority of Kournan troops are level 16 (normal mode), but level 20 troops can be found inside the fort and when certain quests are active.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
Due to a large number of foes that inflict damage with physical attacks, having some melee counter skills is recommended.
The central fort and its surrounding areas contain a large number of Kournan military, some with overlapping patrols. Pull carefully.
Podaltur the Angry's Spirit Rift is capable of dealing over 500 damage in one hit.
Acolyte of Dwayna can be difficult to take down because of her powerful self heals; bring interrupts or skills that can inflict Daze. She does little damage, except for her critical hits.

For characters that chose Margrid the Sly over Master of Whispers during the quest Mysterious Message, or who have accepted the quest but not yet begun it, Dehjah and three Water Djinn will always spawn near the northern exit. These NPCs are actually part of the quest Secrets in the Shadow, which can no longer be completed.
After you have killed every soldier in the central fort's garrison, the Commander on the nearby bridge can still call Kournan Siege "to summon siege fire from any nearby garrisons".

quests/quest:gww:282340/sections/objecti.text: Clear Deldrimor Bowl in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282340/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282340/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Deldrimor Bowl in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282340/sections/target-.text: This explorable area will be traversed as part of the primary quest To Kryta: Refugees.
It lies to the northwest of Beacon's Perch and is along the only route connecting outposts in the Northern Shiverpeaks to outposts in Kryta.

Groups of 3 to 5 Refugees will spawn and move from Beacon's Perch towards to the Griffon's Mouth exit. They will attack hostile foes along the way, making them helpful allies (or additional corpses to exploit).
These quests will affect the spawns in this area: Hungry Devourer, The Deserters and To Kryta: Refugees.
The Deserters spawns three allies (Cynn, Mehnlo and Devona) next to Beacon's Perch's exit that can be useful for vanquishing or farming.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 150–210 foes.

Shiverpeak Protectors are competent healers due to Aura of Faith. If your party cannot overcome their combined healing, it is recommended to restart and adjust builds/party since this area is full of centaurs with up to 3 to 4 Shiverpeak Protectors per group. Try more offensive setups like playing with only one healer.
Do not base your party build around conditions, since Shiverpeak Protectors use Mend Ailment and Purge Conditions.
Enchantment removal skills are highly recommended.
Centaurs do not possess hex removal skills, degeneration hexes such as Crippling Anguish or Life Transfer are incredibly cost-effective counters to Healing Breeze.
If the Hungry Devourer quest is not active, Moro Stormcalf is the only foe that uses spells that can target your party, so avoid bringing Guilt and Mistrust.
All of the damage inflicted by non-boss foes is from attacks, making melee counters very effective.

Shiverpeak Longbows use Winter and Shiverpeak centaurs have additional armor rating against cold damage, so avoid using elemental damage, since your party will constantly be within range of a Spirit of Winter (i.e. destroying a Spirit of Winter will cause another Shiverpeak Longbow, possibly in another centaur mob within spirit range of the mob your party is attacking, to create another Spirit of Winter). If using a spirit spammer build, consider using Gaze of Fury on a Spirit of Winter.

There are two groups of three centaurs that patrol clockwise around the map. One group patrols the upper half and one group the lower. If you have not yet vanquished the map, running counterclockwise around the entire outer edge should reveal these groups.
The resurrection shrines in this area do not always show the light animation of an active resurrection shrine:
Upon entry from Anvil Rock, the shrine animation at the Anvil Rock shrine does not work.
Upon entry from Beacon's Perch, the shrine animation at the Beacon's Perch shrine does not work.

quests/quest:gww:25516/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the Reaper Slayer before it reaches the mountain top.
Return to Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25516/sections/walkthro.text: As soon as you take the quest the Slayer will spawn at the bottom of the hill and will move slowly towards the Reaper whom you need to defend. As there is enough room to maneuvre, make sure to do all fighting away from the Reaper. The Slayer itself should pose no threat, however after it will spawn four Keepers of Souls, four yellow Terrorweb Dryders and four silver Terrorweb Dryders. These groups will slowly advance to the Reaper simultaneously. It is possible to pull the Keepers of Souls forward to buy some time, but due to the close proximity of the groups this may instead cause all 12 dryders to follow.

In order to survive it is essential to spread the party out and negate the danger from AoE damage. The key to victory lies in the clustering of the dryders, where they easy to keep in check with AoE damage and skills like Panic. Due to the sheer number of dryders perfect clusters are hard to force, so deal with the situation as it develops and focus on dryders that are near each other.

It is possible to accept the quest reward after the death of the Slayer, but make sure you take out the groups of Keepers of Souls and Terrorweb Dryders before leaving. Otherwise, they will destroy the Reaper, causing your removal from the Underworld.

quests/quest:gww:21272/sections/objectiv.text: Kill the harpy leader, Render, in the Forum Highlands.
Exterminate the heket commander, Harrk Facestab, in the Forum Highlands.

quests/quest:gww:21272/sections/walkthro.text: Accepting this quest dramatically increases the number of Harpies and Hekets that spawn in Forum Highlands, as part of the well-established war between the two species. The quest marker points to Render first and Harrk Facestab second. You can dive right in or wait for the hostile groups (and Vabbian Guard patrols) to weaken each other, finishing off the survivors (including the bosses). Head back to Kamveh to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21272/sections/notes-1/.text: After completing this quest the heket and skree groups between Tihark Orchard and Jennur's Horde are replaced by Kournan and Margonite groups.
When keeping this quest exclusively for farming:
The extra 75 Skree Harpies can be farmed for Bolts of Cloth, Feathers, Skree Wings, and Tanned Hide Squares.
It also synergises with another quest She Hungers, increasing Juicy Heket Legs drops.
If playing with a reduced party, consider bringing Frozen Soil to counter the Skree resurrect skills: "We Shall Return!" (Skree Singers and Render) and Renew Life (Skree Griffins).
If you leave the area having only killed one boss, the quest will reset from the beginning again.

quests/quest:gww:21283/sections/objectiv.text: Find the harpy roosts in the Wilderness of Bahdza and eliminate them. You have [4...0] roosts remaining.
See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21283/sections/environm.text: Korrub, Flame of Dreams will spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza after this quest is completed.
Screecher and Scratcher will no longer spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza (except before or during Population Control) after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:21283/sections/walkthro.text: This quest requires to eliminate 4 groups of Harpies. Each of them have level 28 Elders and level 2 Hatchings, which makes them a large group but actually weak. All nests are located directly south from Dzagonur Bastion's portal. Follow the quest marker to find each of them. Return to Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21283/sections/notes-1/.text: If you keep the quest without claiming its rewards, the Skree Harpies spawned by it can be farmed for Bolt of Cloths, Feathers, Skree Wings and Tanned Hide Squares.
You cannot capture Visions of Regret until this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:25484/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the renegade slave spirits before they can harm the spirit of Primeval King Jahnus.
See Primeval King Jahnus for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25484/sections/walkthro.text: [Incomplete source section] Kill the groups of Slave Spirits that approach King Jahnus. The quest fails if he dies.

quests/quest:gww:25484/sections/notes-1/.text: Both this quest and its sister quest, Refuse the King, give the same rewards.
Complete this quest quickly after receiving it, otherwise you might have trouble reaching the king in time to save him from the onslaught of slaves.
This quest is sometimes used to farm Dead Swords, which frequently drop from warrior Slave Spirits.

quests/quest:gww:205970/sections/objecti.text: Reclaim the Asura Gate to the Central Transfer Chamber from the Destroyers in the Depths of Tyria.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:205970/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:205970/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Destruction's Depths quest.

quests/quest:gww:64061/sections/objectiv.text: Gather 3 Destroyer Cores. You have [3...0] of 3 left to collect.
See High Priest Alkar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:64061/sections/walkthro.text: Destroyer Cores are dropped by Destroyers, which can be encountered in large numbers in the Raven's Point dungeon, and during the A Gate Too Far or G.O.L.E.M. missions.

quests/quest:gww:25664/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Dajwa on the Cliffs of Dohjok to help him recover his ring.
Help Dajwa find and slay the skree harpy that stole his pie.
Search the harpy nests for the missing ring. You have searched n of 5 nests.

quests/quest:gww:25664/sections/walkthro.text: Foes in this quest will be of level 8, if you and your heroes/henchmen are lower, you can leave it for later until you level up a bit. An alternative approach is to start from Jokanur Diggings which provides level 9 henchmen.

Enter the Cliffs of Dohjok and speak to Dajwa. Follow the first quest marker location to a corpse, and subsequently to all of the harpy nests. Due to the close proximity of the nests with each other, it is easy to get overwhelming aggro if you charge right in. Pull harpies to isolate each group and dispatch them with ease. Try to take out the Skree Hatchling early, to remove their healer. Eventually you will find the ring. Return to Champion's Dawn and see Dajwa for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25664/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest Queen of the Quarry spawns three sunspears allies which can strengthen your fire power to complete this quest.
Can be used for farming Sunspear Promotion Points in Cliffs of Dohjok.

quests/quest:gww:282548/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Diessa Lowlands in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282548/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282548/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Diessa Lowlands in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282548/sections/target-.text: This area lies northwest of the Breach and northeast of the Nolani Academy mission outpost. Many secondary quests will lead to or through this area.
The following quests affect the spawns in this area:
Then and Now, Here and There
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
The Diessa Chalice is likely a relic of this area, plundered by the Charr as their invasion pushed the borders of Ascalon.

Vanquishing: 271–393 foes. There are many hidden groups of devourers on the eastern half of the map, with a large number of them closely-packed in the tar-filled northeastern end. As such, it is recommended to clear the rest of the map before venturing to the northeastern corner.
Consider starting from Yak's Bend in order to have a party of six to make vanquishing easier. Consider continuing into Flame Temple Corridor and Dragon's Gullet as well.
With patience, it is possible to bring a party of eight from Temple of the Ages.

If arriving from Ascalon Foothills, take note that sometimes a group of hydra (4 or 5) will spawn at that exit a few minutes after the map has loaded. If this happens and they were not intercepted, they will run all way to the Flame Temple Corridor exit, passing by in front of Grendich Courthouse. Upon arrival, they have been reported to either patrol (possibly as 2 groups) to and from the exits, or linger at the Flame Temple Corridor exit.

The Charr Hunters can be devastating, but you can often use the terrain to your advantage. Have one character pull the enemies while the rest of the party is around a corner; this effectively separates the melee fighters from the rangers and can make the larger Charr groups much more manageable.
As with other Ascalon maps, many foes in this area are Charr - consider displaying your Ebon Vanguard rank for the Rebel Yell effect for bonus armor and energy gain on kill against Charr.
The Stone Elemental groups are hostile towards each other. The exit to Nolani Academy has no physical Resurrection Shrine, even though it appears on the Mission Map and is functional.

quests/quest:gww:10941/sections/objectiv.text: Hunt down and kill the Discord Wallow. Retrieve its discord sinew and return to Vasili Lutgardis.
See Vasili Lutgardis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10941/sections/walkthro.text: The Discord Wallow is situated roughly in the middle of Drazach Thicket and can be reached from either Brauer Academy or Saint Anjeka's Shrine. Once killed, the Discord Wallow will drop the quest item, Discord Wallow Sinew, which you must pick up and return to Vasili Lutgardis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11965/sections/requirem.text: You must have Necromancer, Mesmer or Assassin as your primary or secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:11965/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Mei Ling again to begin your test.
See Instructor Ng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11965/sections/walkthro.text: You will have been provided with one or more skills that allows you to remove one or more enchantments from an enemy. Use these to strip Pe Wan of his elite skill.

quests/quest:gww:11965/sections/notes-1/.text: Life Sheath's functionality was redesigned since this quest was introduced making its removal rather ineffective; if stripped he will reapply it within two seconds, making the quest unusually difficult.
It thus may be easier to take any fast rate of damage; if three hits are dealt every 2 seconds — one to trigger Life Sheath, one to redo what was healed, one to damage, then he will die eventually.
If you are an assassin, try letting his life sheath absorb a normal attack after the first move of your combo, then you can finish your combo before the next life sheath.

At level 10, with 5 points each in Dagger Mastery, Shadow Arts, and Critical Strikes, using Unsuspecting Strike, Fox Fangs, Twisting Fangs and Shroud of Distress, maintaining Shroud while using the attack skills (with the above in consideration) will ensure safe, but slow, completion.
Taking skills that apply health degeneration such as Faintheartedness, Life Siphon, and Conjure Phantasm will negate the effects of Life Sheath altogether.

Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are Weh no Su. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.

quests/quest:gww:25691/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out and destroy the Titan, Securis Phasmatis.
Find and defeat the remaining Titan, Letum Contineo.
See Scorch Emberspire for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25691/sections/walkthro.text: If you took this follow up immediately after completing A Flickering Flame (while still in the Domain of Secrets) then the two bosses can be found a short walk south from where you defeated Ignis Cruor.

Otherwise, you must return to the Gate of Secrets and collect the quest there, then travel west in the Domain of Secrets until you find the two bosses next to each other (one a Warrior the other a Mesmer). Note that these titans spawn next to each other, and do not break down into lesser titans when they die. When you have killed one you can safely move on to the other.

quests/quest:gww:25407/sections/requirem.text: You must have Warrior, Ranger, Mesmer, Elementalist or Ritualist as your primary or secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:25407/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Talon Silverwing again to begin your test.
See Instructor Ng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25407/sections/walkthro.text: You will have been provided with skill that allows you to prevent an enemy from activating skills. Use this skill against key enemy skills, and it's an easy match.

quests/quest:gww:25407/sections/notes-1/.text: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.

quests/quest:gww:282697/sections/objecti.text: Clear Diviner's Ascent in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282697/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282697/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Diviner's Ascent in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282697/sections/target-.text: These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
This area accounts for approximately 1.4% of the Tyrian Cartographer title.
There are hidden Sand Wurms and devourers scattered about the area.

There are also several groups of scarabs, but they are all concentrated near teleporters and between the tall obelisks. Avoid the teleporters and travel around the obelisk areas to reduce the number of foes to kill.
You do not have to kill burrowed Sand Wurms to vanquish the area, even if they have previously attacked you.
The Hydra boss group patrols a long route. The best place to wait for that group is in the small path that connects the upper and lower halves.
If having trouble finding the last foe, try checking the portal to Salt Flats, a lone Sand Drake can be located there.

quests/quest:gww:200425/sections/objecti.text: Deliver the Eye of Janthir to Loamhurst.
*BONUS* Find and deliver five Chosen to Loamhurst.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:200425/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:200425/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Divinity Coast mission.

quests/quest:gww:200425/sections/notes-1.text: It might be easier to complete the first bonus objective in normal mode, since the five Chosen can die more quickly in hard mode.

quests/quest:gww:25486/sections/objectiv.text: Head east from Foible's Fair to the woods. Destroy the skale brood.
Return to Vassar for your reward.
Vassar will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:25486/sections/walkthro.text: Leave from Foible's Fair and head east, then curve southeast into the woods. This area is teeming with bandits and level 3 black bears. The bears are little more than a nuisance, but watch out for the Bandit Firestarters spamming Flare. Your new Backfire skill is very helpful against them.

Once you have the river skale brood in compass range, it will begin moving along the path accross the woods towards Foible's Fair (so if you came from Foible's Fair it should come your way). It has an extended aggro range so pull it cautiously to avoid engaging other nearby enemies at the same time.

The skale brood is a dangerous foe for low level characters, capable of both healing with Aura of Restoration and dealing damage with Ice Spear. Maintain Backfire as much as possible and refrain from removing it too soon with Shatter Delusions.

quests/quest:gww:25636/sections/objectiv.text: Go to where the water sparkles like diamonds and the dunes hide gold from the Elders.
Travel east past the place where men sleep on stilts. Reach the tower that lies on the edge of the world.
Follow the Queen's gaze south and find an ill tempered bear guarding his cave.
Pass the wrathful bear and run to the doors of the sanctuary that clings to the land as the maiden of the sea pulls it towards her bosom.
Face northwest and walk thirty-five paces. From beneath the Arch of the Twin Queens, gaze upon the great pillars that have stood since ages past.
Stand at the feet of the pillar that lies in eternal slumber.
From the sleeping pillar, travel west towards the spot where man's creation meets its end.
Beyond man's creation a huge boulder hugs the dunes. Find the treasure buried on the lee of the stone.
Kneel down and search the sand for the buried treasure.
Take Bobo back to Ashigun and collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25636/sections/walkthro.text: Ashigun does not give you any clue where to go for this quest, nor do you get an arrow to help you. All you have to go on is his cryptic clues given to you through the objectives. The first thing is to go to the Mehtani Keys and you will get the next clue. Then travel east past the small village and over to the tower standing alone in the northeast corner of the map near Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands. Head south and to where Behrdos will yell at you. Go past him to the Cyclone Palace's door at the southeast corner of the map. Then head northwest and stand under the arch. Look towards the pillars for your next clue. Run over to the pillar that has fallen down. You will then be directed to the west where there is a sunken ship. Once you get to the ship you will get an update telling you there is a huge boulder beyond the ship. It is a short distance west of the ship. Go to the far side of the boulder and it will tell you to kneel in the sand to find the treasure. /kneel to find Bobo. Once you have Bobo head back to Ashigun in Zehlon Reach and return it to him.

quests/quest:gww:25635/sections/objectiv.text: Lead Vidaj to the relics in the Lahtenda Bog. You have 5 areas left to explore.
Lead Vidaj out from the bayou.

quests/quest:gww:25635/sections/walkthro.text: Meet with Vidaj outside of Blacktide Den. Follow the quest marker to each of the different spots. Clear enemies in your way, and be wary of pop-ups.
You need to keep this NPC alive, he is only level 10 and can be easily killed. Though being a monk with healing prayers skills helps him survive.

A good way to ensure completion of this quest is by using the "Hero flag All" command below your radar and send your company ahead first while you stand behind, since Vidaj follows you, he will be safely away with you. As he is a monk, he might attempt to heal your team so make sure he doesn't engage and get into harm's way.
After exploring the third marker on the mission map, a small group of four low level corsairs will approach the party. Dispatch them and continue.
After you have explored all areas of interest, you must lead Vidaj back to the entrance to Blacktide Den in order to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25635/sections/notes-1/.text: You can also do the quest War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance) while working on this quest.

quests/quest:gww:215682/sections/objecti.text: Kill a Dragon Lich in the Great Battle Field.
*BONUS* Kill a Dragon Lich in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:215682/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:215682/sections/walkthr.text: A Dragon Lich is found in the Fissure of Woe guarding the entrances of the Shadow Army encampment at the Great Battle Field.

quests/quest:gww:282898/sections/objecti.text: Clear Dragon's Gullet in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282898/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282898/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Dragon's Gullet in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282898/sections/target-.text: The shortest distance to get here is leave from Grendich Courthouse and keep heading northeast, through the Diessa Lowlands and the Charr-controlled Flame Temple Corridor.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
Then and Now, Here and There
The Charr and Hydra are hostile to each other, but they rarely overlap.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
You can explore most of the zone without the Tar effect during the Special Ops: Dragon's Gullet quest.
The fast-moving hydra group in the southwest corner can be easily missed due to its long patrol route. Be careful so that they don't rush your party while you're fighting other hydra.
Consider bringing a party of six starting from either Borlis Pass, Yak's Bend or even a party of eight from Temple of the Ages.
Vanquishing during The Titan Source drastically increases the number of foes and changes all spawns to either Titans or Charr.
Party-wide speed boost skills will help counter the effect of walking in the tar.

quests/quest:gww:12687/sections/objectiv.text: Kill as many of the afflicted as possible before the timer runs out. Kill an afflicted boss to gain a time bonus.

quests/quest:gww:12687/sections/rewards-.text: This mission rewards gold based on the formula below. Values are rounded down. Additional bonuses are awarded for beating the daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best scores.

quests/quest:gww:12687/sections/walkthro.text: There is a 15 minute time limit for this mission, which is extended by approximately 61 seconds for each boss killed. There are two strategies for extending the time limit:
To cover long distances quickly, bring party-wide speed boosts, e.g. "Charge!" or "Fall Back!".

Remain in the same area and wait for groups to respawn (making sure that there is a boss in the group to extend the time limit). Groups respawn ~2 minutes after being defeated, so you will have to kill 3 or more bosses per cycle in order to extend the timer indefinitely.

quests/quest:gww:12687/sections/notes-1/.text: As with all challenge missions, foes do not drop items when killed.
After 30 minutes, players will suffer from Extensive Plague Exposure.
Enemies aren't resurrected, but new ones are spawned. This means that each boss killed will give an additional morale boost and leave an additional corpse.
Some bosses will spawn in multiple locations.they may also leash from across the map, further testing is needed
It is possible to kill enemies before the start of the mission, if they patrol close enough to the gate. These kills do not count towards your score, but will be respawned as normal.
The bosses in this mission respawn after being defeated; the death of respawned bosses still adds time to the mission timer.
Scores were previously kept on a leaderboard on the official guildwars.com site.
The Afflicted Mei will despawn immediately after spawning.
Killing a boss may not grant additional time.

quests/quest:gww:15363/sections/objectiv.text: Slay kuskale and harvest their flesh for bait. You need [5...0] more hunks of fresh meat.
Place fresh meat in the basket by the shore to lure the ferocious beast.

quests/quest:gww:15363/sections/walkthro.text: Enter Arkjok Ward from the Command Post and there will be skale at the lake. Kill enough to get the required 5 hunks of meat and place them in the Drake Cage. When the Ferocious Drake appears, attack it until it becomes neutral.

quests/quest:gww:15363/sections/notes-1/.text: If you follow the Drake it leads you to the entrance to the Command Post. This only makes sense since apparently the Drake is now tamed and villagers have made it a guardian named Toma.

quests/quest:gww:21113/sections/objectiv.text: Koss must be present to continue.
Take Koss to meet Wekehsa on The Floodplain of Mahnkelon.
Escort Wekehsa to his meeting place.
Defeat Lord Yama the Vengeful and his guards.

quests/quest:gww:21113/sections/walkthro.text: Travel into The Floodplain of Mahnkelon and find Wekehsa who is waiting just outside Rilohn Refuge. Follow Wekehsa to his meeting with the banana scythe buyer, Lord Yama the Vengeful. Once there, defeat Lord Yama and claim the scythe for yourself!

It is a relatively short journey along the north side of the floodplain, and along the way, the party will encounter several groups of drakes of various types: Irontooth Drakes, Sand Drakes, and Obsidian Furnace Drakes.

quests/quest:gww:21113/sections/notes-1/.text: Sand Drakes are from the Crystal Desert, Grand Drakes & Lightning Drakes are from Kryta, River Drakes are from Ascalon (pre-Searing), and Obsidian Furnace Drakes are from the Fissure of Woe.
The insect boss, Zelnehlun Fastfoot, and its group of hidden insects will not spawn while this quest is active (and you have Koss in your party).

If the player hasn't advanced enough in the Nightfall storyline, the doors in the north part of the Floodplain will remain closed, but the Corsairs will still spawn on the other side. Wekehsa may try to pursue the Corsairs and shall halt progress in the quest until they are killed. Consider bringing a hero or henchmen with skills that don't require line of sight.
Koss will resurrect whenever he has a line of dialogue.
The quest may be kept active for farming Chunks of Drake Flesh or Spiked Crests. To maximize your drop rate, send Koss to die and do not speak with Wekehsa.

Unlike other quests with a required hero, you are not provided with a green note in the quest log reminding you to include Koss in the party. Wekehsa still holds the Banana Scythe after you get rewarded.

quests/quest:gww:283204/sections/objecti.text: Clear Drakkar Lake in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283204/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:283204/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Drakkar Lake in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:283204/sections/target-.text: Just south of the Norrhart Domains exit is a path that leads to a small enclosed valley. A rabbit stands at the start of the path. It will start downwards to the center when you approach. Be warned that this is a trap. If you follow the rabbit to the center, Nulfastu Earthbound will spawn with about five dozen Vaettir around you and along the path. These are levels 15 to 20 in normal mode. To be safer, you can send someone to trigger the ambush while you wait atop the path and then fight your way down. Note that once triggered, the path also contains additional hidden Vaettir. For exploration purposes, you can circle the valley without triggering the spawns; just keep away from the center.
The area around the frozen lake is the most dangerous; be aware that many small groups of Chilling Wisps circle the frozen lake in a counter-clockwise direction.
If you wish to fight less, avoid triggering the rabbit hole trap in the southeast.
There are many other spots where hidden Vaettir will spawn, most notably in corners, around clumps of trees, and the graveyard between the two Sifhalla exits.
If you talk to Kilroy Stonekin, additional Stone Summit will spawn in their encampment.
Koren Wildrunner's group patrols a long route around the frozen lake and sometimes the surrounding areas as well.
Sometimes you need to kill charmable animals to complete the vanquish.

quests/quest:gww:282796/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Drazach Thicket in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282796/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282796/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Drazach Thicket in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282796/sections/target-.text: The Defenders of the Forest is the primary quest that will lead characters through this area.
Drazach Thicket lies between Saint Anjeka's Shrine, Brauer Academy, and the Eternal Grove.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
A New Escort (Wardens are replaced by Dragon Mosses near the entrance of Saint Anjeka's Shrine.)
Discord Wallow Lyre
In the Army Now
The Defenders of the Forest
Due to their different teams, the Wardens and Mantises will fight each other.
Exploring this area will contribute approximately 2.6% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 207–281 foes.
There are 4 hidden Oni groups:
Along the northwestern route moving away from the Eternal Grove.
Along the western edge, near the center.
A short distance south from Saint Anjeka's Shrine.
A short distance northwest from Brauer Academy.
There are also two Warden spawns.

Occasionally, Chkkr Thousand Tail's group doesn't spawn as expected when you enter the bosses range. If this happens, they can instead spawn at Chkkr's location when you spawn either Bezzr Wingstorms or Bazzr Icewings group. If you've been through the whole map while vanquishing and are missing a group, check if this has happened.
de:Drazachdickicht

quests/quest:gww:283084/sections/objecti.text: Clear Dreadnought's Drift in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283084/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:283084/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Dreadnought's Drift in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:283084/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
There are hidden Azure Shadows in this area.
Beware the range and height advantage of the Tundra Giant groups in front of the Statue of Dwayna.
Consider bringing enchantment removal due to the possibility of as many as four Dolyak Masters spawning in the same group.

Due to how far this location is, consider vanquishing Snake Dance, Dreadnought's Drift and Lornar's Pass in one go. Leaving from Camp Rankor to accomplish this will also allow for a party size of 8, where an exit from Beacon's Perch restricts the party to 6 members.

quests/quest:gww:66488/sections/objectiv.text: Free the Dredge slaves by slaying Stone Summit Taskmasters.
Discover what the Stone Summit Dwarves are searching for in the Vloxen Excavations.
Seek and destroy Zoldark the Unholy.

quests/quest:gww:66488/sections/walkthro.text: Best starting point to enter Vloxen Excavations for this quest is from Vlox's Falls, then head east into the dungeon where you will find groups of Stone Summit and Dredge Slaves. You will soon find the boss Taskmaster Durgon; defeating him will release the first Slaves and drop the Boss Key to the second level. The best tactic to defeat him is to first kill the healer. Light of Deldrimor will reveal a Dwarven Ghost near the area map.

On the second level, you must seek out and defeat Taskmaster Kurg and Taskmaster Bellok. If you are playing in hard mode, it is advisable to pull Bellok's group away from the nearby Resurrection Shrine (they will follow quite far); otherwise, a party wipe, will respawn you to close to the enemies and you might easily reach -60% Death Penalty. After Bellok is eliminated, a Dredge Slave will show the way to some Dwarven Powder Kegs to blast through a cracked wall and gain access to the entrance of the dungeon's third level. There is a lever in the southwest of the southeastern chamber which disables the Poison Dart traps; however, it is out of the way. Light of Deldrimor will reveal a Dwarven Ghost near a Beacon of Droknar past the second door opened by the master gear. There is a Hidden Treasure near Taskmaster Kurg.

On the third level you will need to find Sotanaht the Tomb Guardian, who holds the key to access the dominion of Zoldark the Unholy. The third level also contains 2 levers which disable all the Poison Dart traps there: one in the northwest of the northwestern room, and one in the northwest of the northeastern room (just beyond Sotanaht the Tomb Guardian).

To kill Zoldark the Unholy, kill his minions until he stops resurrecting them. He loses health every time he resurrects one, and he cannot heal so he will continue losing health with every resurrection. He will be easy to kill once he is unable to resurrect his minions.

quests/quest:gww:66488/sections/notes-1/.text: Light of Deldrimor rewards are listed in the Vloxen Excavations entry.
In hard mode, Frozen Soil will prevent the Dwarves on the first two levels from resurrecting their fallen.
Three minutes after everyone in your party opens the reward chest, you will be automatically mapped to Umbral Grotto, even if you began in Vlox's Falls.
Prepare for Ranger foes striking you from height advantage, which can lead to higher than expected spike damage.
When facing Taskmaster Kurg, you can pull him or his allies away from each other. If you kill him first, the nearby Dredge will rise up and help you kill the remaining foes.
If you wipe near the fourth Master Gear, you will respawn at the entrance to this level (since that will be the closest resurrection shrine).

The Ancient Undead respawn every two minutes (until Zoldark dies). (Be careful of those close to the Boss Lock; if you draw them towards the nearby resurrection shrine, you can make it difficult to reach the Boss Key.)
After killing Zoldark, all remaining foes will disappear, allowing you time to safely open Locked Chests and look for Hidden Treasures.

quests/quest:gww:3198/sections/objective.text: Defeat the Kurzick House in an honorable duel.
See Duel Master Vaughn for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:3198/sections/walkthrou.text: After obtaining the quest just outside of Brauer Academy(1), follow the path north. Duel Master Vaughn will make his own, albeit slow, way up to the dueling grounds but you can just head off on your own. There are two groups of Wardens that can drift into your path; either defeat them or wait until they're out of aggro range and make your way past. There are also a few, seemingly random, Oni spawn points, spawning either a lone or 3-strong group of Oni. It is best to hug the wall as you make your way to the dueling grounds so as not to aggro the Wardens and Oni simultaneously. You can also opt to take the blessing from the priest for 100 gold, completing the quest will yield 150 gold and all slain NPCs will gain you more faction points.

Once you reach the dueling grounds(2) continue to hug the wall round and plant Frozen Soil if you have it. Try not to place it too close to the opposing team as they will destroy it if they get too close. When you're ready approach the quest marker and everyone will turn hostile. Note that Duel Master Vaughn is completely irrelevant at this point. It is actually possible to complete the duel before he announces that the duel has started. Approach when you're ready.

The opposing team will be wandering around aimlessly until you approach. When you get close enough they will turn hostile and will bunch together. The team you face is determined randomly. You face either:
House Brauer, led by the mesmer Lord Brauer.
House Durheim, led by the necromancer Count Durheim.
House Lutgardis, led by the ranger Lord Lutgardis.
House Vasburg, led by the warrior Baroness Vasburg.

The first two, Brauer and Durheim, are somewhat similar to fight. They both deal a reasonable amount of damage and their elementalists cast Unsteady Ground which should be avoided. Being purely spell-casters they clump together rendering AoE spells such as Firestorm and Meteor Shower highly effective (making Cynn come in handy). Be careful if you're facing Count Durheim as his double damage (see notes) Defile Enchantments can be devastating, especially in concert with Unsteady Ground.

House Lutgardis isn't too problematic as you don't have to rely on your henchmen scattering effectively from AoE spells. The majority of the team bunch together so, again, AoE spells will come in handy. Due to rangers having inherently better armor against elemental damage it may be worth taking spells such as Spiteful Spirit and Reckless Haste as well. The team isn't as fragile as Brauer's and Durheim's so you may need to reapply Frozen Soil. Remember to do it a small distance away from the battle to prevent it being destroyed.

House Vasburg is composed chiefly of melee characters so spells such as Ward Against Melee could prove useful. The team clumps together around your team so if everyone remains still AoE spells can again prove effective. However, the AI for henchmen and heroes may cause them to run around your group, resulting in it being difficult to keep enemies in the AoE. Spells such as Spiteful Spirit are especially useful. This battle is likely to be slightly longer so, again, remember to replant Frozen Soil far enough away to stop it being attacked.

More generally, always target the Monk first (see Kurzick Duelist for a guide to identifying the profession of each duelist). An interrupter will make the duel easier as the Monks are very effective, carrying Word of Healing. It's also best to take out the team before the House leader as, being technically a separate party, they can't resurrect their 'team' mates.

If you are having trouble defeating one particular group you can use the alt key to ascertain which House you are facing as you run down the hill past the first set of Wardens. If it is not to your liking you can simply re-zone.
After the battle speak to Duel Master Vaughn to receive your reward. Then if you are farming faction simply map back to Brauer Academy and start again.
Teams
House Brauer Duelists
A team of three mesmers including Lord Brauer, three elementalists and two monks.
House Durheim Duelists
A team of four necromancers including Count Durheim, two elementalists and two monks. They have strong anti-melee skills and spiking capability.
House Lutgardis Duelists
A team of five rangers including Lord Lutgardis, two monks and one ritualist.
House Vasburg Duelists
A melee-oriented team of three warriors including Baroness Vasburg, three assassins, and two monks.

quests/quest:gww:3198/sections/notes-1/b.text: Although they are not technically bosses, the attacks and skills of the teams leaders inflict double damage.
The team leaders are not part of the same party as the rest of the teams, so they can be pulled separately.
The professions of the duelists can be identified by their appearance.
The Duelists carry resurrection signets. Bringing a skill such as Frozen Soil will help.
This run can be completed in 2-3 minutes with a meta hero team.

The duel won't start if you kill Lord Brauer too fast. The duel may start afterwards. You can reduce the likelihood of this bug by ensuring Duel Master Vaughn reaches the training grounds, and stops moving, before you enter the training grounds. You can use Incoming or Fall back to help speed up Duel Master Vaughn to his destination. Rarely, the enemy team won't spawn at all and the reward can immediately be collected.

quests/quest:gww:320374/sections/walkthr.text: It is advised to bring a full party, as well as skills and weapons dealing holy damage. This quest can be difficult with henchmen and not enough firepower, as the spawning rate of the Furious Ghosts is high and they attack from various angles, making AoE spells less effective. The henchmen are also quite frail meaning that keeping them alive for the pyre part can be tedious.

Follow the quest marker after entering the area (the left path is a dead end anyway). Walk towards the three pyres indicated on the map. To ignite a pyre, simply stand close to it (a charging bar will appear) until the quest updates and flames appear; no particular item is needed.

Entering the range of a pyre will initiate the spawning of Furious Ghosts, which will run towards the pyre until it is ignited. The rate at which the bar progresses depends on the difference between the number of party members in range minus the number of foes.

Blunted, Fractured, and Withered Spirits are encountered on the path. They will not respawn unlike the Furious Ghosts. It is recommended to make sure the area is clear of them before entering the pyre's area, as the continuously respawning Furious Ghosts in addition can easily overwhelm the group. If the party lacks the damage to clear the Furious Ghosts quickly enough, one can attempt to tank them outside of the pyre range while some party member stands in the capture zone. Once the pyre has been ignited, the remaining Furious Ghosts will despawn.
Once all three pyres are ignited, return to Ghost of Althea near the middle pyre to accept the reward.

Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. If you hug the left side of the bridge as you cross it you have a good chance to not aggro the second group. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two groups of Am Fah, with a more manageable placement, as well as a statue of Balthazar (point 2) that you can kneel in front of while Favor of the Gods is active to acquire Morale Boosts and blessings. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter Chung, the Attuned (point 3). As you approach Chung more enemies will drop from above, so be ready for a fight.

quests/quest:gww:25458/sections/objectiv.text: Find Count zu Heltzer. Try to negotiate a ceasefire between the Kurzicks and the Dredge.

quests/quest:gww:25458/sections/walkthro.text: Map to House zu Heltzer and speak with Count zu Heltzer, then return to Moleneaux for the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25458/sections/notes-1/.text: If exploring Ferndale for the first time, players should be aware that Moleneaux is located right outside of the entrance to Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick), and gaining access to this outpost before mapping back makes getting the reward much more convenient.

quests/quest:gww:13736/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out Terick in the Domain of Secrets.
Escort Terick through the Domain of Secrets and search for a means of escape.

quests/quest:gww:13736/sections/walkthro.text: Start from the Gate of Secrets and meet Terick just outside the portal. After talking to Terick, your quest pointer will update and direct the party to a point due west of the Gate of Secrets. You will need to escort Terick along the way. Terick remains friendly, but does not join your party as an ally so he appears to be in no danger of attack from creatures along the way.

On reaching the quest point, Terick taunts the party about their impending death, and a group of Margonites spawn around the party, while Terick runs off to the south. Defeating the Margonites will complete this quest. Your character must live for the quest to be completed. If you cannot hold your own and survive, send your heroes in and direct their attacks from afar.

quests/quest:gww:13736/sections/notes-1/.text: You may consider doing this quest at the same time as All Alone in the Darkness, which takes place in the same area and follows a similar route.
Sometimes after defeating Abaddon's forces the quest is updated as failed.

quests/quest:gww:16671/sections/objectiv.text: Escort the souls to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale.
See Mayor Alegheri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:16671/sections/walkthro.text: The safest way to do this quest is to clear all the way to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale before taking any quests from the Reaper of the Labyrinth. There should be one or two pairs of Bladed Aatxes and four groups of Grasping Darknesses along the way. There is also a group of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights that patrols near the statue of Grenth in Forgotten Vale.

Take the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments from the Reaper of the Labyrinth which will spawn three Terrorweb Dryders at the monument of Forgotten Vale. Destroy the Terrorwebs and speak to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale which appears after this. Have him teleport you back to the Reaper of the Labyrinth and take the Escort of Souls. After accepting this quest a group of six New Souls will spawn and start to walk to the vale. At the same time, four groups of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn, one in the starting point of the Underworld,didnt have this happen just now, talk comment from 2015 asks the same, rng or hm only group? one in the wide hallway that connects the Labyrinth to the Vale, at the gate between that hall and the vale, and finally one group of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn between Mayor Alegheri and the bridge to the Labyrinth.

Do not teleport back to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale, which leaves the New Souls to walk to the first group of Mindblade Spectres. Instead, have one group member start the quest while the rest of the group stands at first spawning point and kills the group before the New Souls arrive. Try to stay ahead of the group of New Souls or have a good watchful monk.
Note: New Souls will walk towards Vale and will die before you can finish backtracking.

quests/quest:gww:16671/sections/notes-1/.text: Delay taking the quest Wrathful Spirits given by the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale until after you have finished Escort of Souls. Otherwise the hostile Tortured Spirits may kill one of the New Souls, causing you to fail the quest and be ejected from the Underworld.

Taking this quest spawns an additional group of Mindblade Spectres in the starting chamber; kill this group before taking the quest Unwanted Guests.didnt have this happen just now, talk comment from 2015 asks the same, rng or hm only group?
On rare occasions, the Mindblades do not attack the New Souls, making far easier to complete this quest.

quests/quest:gww:20864/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Kwaju. He can show you around the estate.
Scout the estate with Kwaju and Koss.

quests/quest:gww:20864/sections/walkthro.text: Exit into Dejarin Estate from Pogahn Passage and proceed northeast to meet Kwaju. He can be found a little southeast of the garrison. Lead him to each of the three checkpoints. He will not begin talking until the nearby enemies have been killed.

quests/quest:gww:283758/sections/objecti.text: Clear Ettin's Back in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283758/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:283758/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Ettin's Back in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:283758/sections/target-.text: The primary quest White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard will lead you through here.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.6% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.

There are a lot of popups in this area. Hidden devourers riddle the area to a point where large swathes of the southern central half are empty except for hidden foes. The small green area in the east also hides Moss Scarabs amongst the few Thorn Stalker Sprouts. Consider heading east last.

A few groups of Thorn Stalkers patrol a long route in the center and may be missed. Backtrack in the opposite direction to find them. There are also groups of Maguuma centaurs patrolling large areas to the northwest which can be missed easily.
North of Ventari's Refuge are a few groups of centaurs that travel fast, and may be missed.

Area of effect opportunities are very limited on this vanquish. For this reason, Elementalists should consider elites like Invoke Lightning, and Mesmers should avoid elites like Panic or Keystone signet.
It is unnecessary to bring hex removal skills, since a boss with Life Siphon is the sole hex on this vanquish.
With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the Temple of the Ages.

Ever Closer to the Edge (Hard mode)

quests/quest:gww:289557/sections/objecti.text: See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289557/sections/notes-1.text: The Quest Log doesn't display the gold or experience rewards for this quest, though gold and experience are given when the quest is turned in, and are displayed in the initial quest dialogue.

references.title: Ever Closer to the Edge (Hard mode)

quests/quest:gww:289557/sections/shared-.text: Start from Leviathan Pits, follow the quest markers through Gyala Hatchery, and protect the Luxon Diplomats. They are high level healers, but you will get attacked by enemies that spawn from three different directions, be sure not to leave them unprotected against attacks from behind.

references.title: Ever Closer to the Edge (Hard mode)

quests/quest:gww:289557/sections/shared-.text: The best place to defend is behind the diplomats, just under the bridge that leads up to the ship, and between the two rocks there. There your party is protected from ranged attacks and projectile spells at nearly all sides. This greatly reduces the damage that your party takes. Your healer is also within range to heal the diplomats as needed.

references.title: Ever Closer to the Edge (Hard mode)

quests/quest:gww:289557/sections/shared-.text: You can use the technique of flagging a minion master hero near the Diplomats to have the NPCs follow away from the initial location (such as to the southwest) to heal minions, meaning that you can fight in one direction rather than three.

references.title: Ever Closer to the Edge (Hard mode)

quests/quest:gww:25524/sections/objectiv.text: Give the experimental elixir to Fadden Hathorn in Sardelac Sanitarium.

quests/quest:gww:25524/sections/walkthro.text: Just map travel and follow the objectives; there are no challenges involved.

quests/quest:gww:25615/sections/objectiv.text: Explore the area outside the Citadel and kill any remaining heket. [6...0] of 6 heket groups remain.
Defeat the heket leader and his comrades.
See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25615/sections/environm.text: Bull Trainer Giants, Hunting Minotaurs, and Kunan the Loudmouth will spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza after this quest is completed.
The Hekets in Wilderness of Bahdza (Beast Sworn Hekets, Blood Cowl Hekets, Blue Tongue Hekets, Brokk Ripsnort, and Stoneaxe Hekets) will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:25615/sections/walkthro.text: Head out from Dzagonur Bastion and follow your quest pointer to each of the 6 heket groups in turn, that are all clustered in the north-east corner of the Wilderness of Bahdza. After killing the 6 heket groups, make your way to the heket leader, Brokk Ripsnort, who is accompanied by one final heket group.

quests/quest:gww:15367/sections/objectiv.text: Find Grahm in the Sage Lands.
Slay Gale Stormsend and obtain the Lilac Eye.
Return the Lilac Eye to Trader Versai.

quests/quest:gww:15367/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Druid's Overlook and find Grahm in the Sage Lands by following the quest marker. After speaking with him, head northwest towards The Wilds and follow the northern path back east. As in most areas in the Maguuma Jungle, beware of large popup groups of Maguuma Spiders and Moss Scarabs. Gale Stormsend can be found alone at the end of the path in the waterfall area, and fights with Empathy and Cry of Frustration, but should be easy for a group to take down. When Gale is dead, pick up the Lilac Eye and return to Trader Versai.

The quest does not actually require speaking to Grahm, so the fastest way to complete this quest (other than trading for the Lilac Eye) is to enter the Sage Lands from The Wilds and go directly to Gale Stormsend.

quests/quest:gww:15367/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest Wisdom of the Druids is done near where Gale Stormsend is found. Doing both quests at the same time can save time.

quests/quest:gww:25698/sections/objectiv.text: Slay Flesh Gluttons to help the Wandering Soul recover his memory. You have [5...0] of 5 left to kill.
See Wandering Soul for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25698/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from Gate of Fear, travel to the most north-eastern shrine in the Domain of Pain, there you will find the Wandering Soul Jutu.

The Flesh Gluttons will spawn with a squad of Margonites in the Leech Tunnels, the triangle-shaped area around the three nearest resurrection shrines in the east. Consider clearing this area at first before accepting the quest if you have problems with dealing both the regular patrols and those from the quest.

The Flesh Glutton and the Margonites are technically two separate groups, so either part of the patrol can be pulled seperately if needed. When fighting the entire patrol it's advisable to kill the Margonites at first since a Flesh Glutton will spawn a Pain Titan which again will spawn two Madness Titans upon death.

quests/quest:gww:25698/sections/notes-1/.text: Consider clearing the Leech Tunnels before accepting the subsequent quest A Fleshy Operation, since it will spawn groups of torment creatures.
Taking this quest will spawn an additional chest near one of the Flesh Gluttons.

quests/quest:gww:282849/sections/objecti.text: Clear Fahranur, the First City in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:282849/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:282849/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Fahranur, the First City in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:282849/sections/target-.text: Even though the area outside the ruins is freely accessible, the ruins themselves are not accessible for Nightfall characters until after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.
There are no primary quests that take place here but several secondary quests do, including the first two of Scholar Chago's quest chain (starting with A Perplexing Plague) and Defender's Choice.
Although Istani civilization (and the Order of the Sunspears) originated here, Fahranur has been completely abandoned since the Scarab Plague.
The fallen statue head in the opening cinematic of the Nightfall campaign appears to be the one that lies near the exit into Jokanur Diggings.
Librarian Gahmir Lenon's dialogue in the Halls of Chokhin hints at a connection between the First City and the kings of Orr.
The entrance into the ruins is protected by falling crusher traps.
Dying from being crushed does not cause Death Penalty and does not count as a death (for Survivors).
The traps will kill player characters, but will not kill Heroes.

This area has a large number of low level Skale enemies near the entrance to the city itself. Characters with low Sunspear rank may want to kill these for the The Honorable General quest since there is a Sunspear Scout that provides Skale Hunt at the beginning of the map.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
Consider starting from Blacktide Den for a party size of 8.
Study the patrol paths of the mobs outside of the city ruins before engaging; many of them overlap.
The quest A Perplexing Plague in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.

During Defender's Choice, Arred the Unready starts as hostile and turns friendly so that he may be interrogated. Some players have reported being unable to complete their vanquish unless they have decided to kill him instead.

quests/quest:gww:66436/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the disappearances of Anton and Scout Winslow.
Defeat the Charr and rescue Scout Winslow.
See Captain Langmar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:66436/sections/walkthro.text: After taking the quest, head east across the bridge and then follow the arrow to find Anton. Once he has joined you, go around the corner towards the Charr camp.

Kill the Axemaster and the Blademaster awaiting outside the camp. To complete the quest, you only need to kill the group of Charr without the boss in it standing beside Scout Winslow - it is possible to lure this group out of the camp to avoid aggroing Chaelse Flameshielder's group. It would be a good idea to bring AoE shutdown (to combat resurrection skills) such as Panic if you want to kill the boss group though.
You can then map back to the outpost and then go back into Grothmar Wardowns to speed up receiving the quest reward.

An easier, but slightly longer, way to complete this quest is to first complete the Against the Charr quest. Once that mission is complete you will spawn back in the Charr camp, but there will only be one small group of Charr with only one Prophet. Kill them and walk up to Winslow and the quest is complete.

Complete this quest and Plan A simultaneously. There will be fewer Charr in the camp (especially if you can kill the small group guarding Winslow before the main group returns). Even if you end up fighting the main force it is predominantly made up of Axemasters and Blademasters, who can be pulled and dispatched with relative ease.
If the Plan A quest is available, then Vael can be triggered to temporarily empty most of the camp
Bring the Siege Devourer from north of the camp / from Dalada Uplands.
If you find that the mob overpowers you, lure them out towards the entrance. Stand well clear and draw the group bit by bit. Once the mob has been killed, the Winslow group will fall pretty easily.

quests/quest:gww:66436/sections/notes-1/.text: You only need to kill the group closest to Winslow, the other big group may survive.
This quest is the first in the chain leading to the acquisition of Anton as a hero.

quests/quest:gww:25232/sections/objectiv.text: Collect [10..0] more family crests from the fallen soldiers.
Return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25232/sections/walkthro.text: Start at Piken Square. Head straight to the West and walk along a narrow path on the right. When reaching the marked point you will find several Charr Overseers and Martyrs there. After killing the Overseers first, the Martyrs second and finally the other Charr, you can click on each dead soldier lying on the ground. Each body holds a family crest (needs a slot in your inventory). After collecting 10 of them you can travel back for the reward.
Consider doing this alongside Supplies for the Duke to give the nearby Charr additional targets.

quests/quest:gww:25232/sections/notes-1/.text: The storyline of this quest continues in Casualty Report, even though Casualty Report can be completed before this quest.

quests/quest:gww:67208/sections/requirem.text: You must first listen to the conversation that Sergeant Weststar is having with his troops just outside Longeye's Ledge in Grothmar Wardowns.

quests/quest:gww:67208/sections/objectiv.text: Discover the fate of Jenn Valefield.
Discern the fate of Chance Redding.
Divine the fate of Sergeant Weststar.

quests/quest:gww:67208/sections/walkthro.text: This quest can be completed without fighting at all (e.g. by running). However, the following quest The Hunting of the Charr cannot.
After listening to the conversation, go to Dalada Uplands and head down to the southeast corner where the portal to Sacnoth Valley is. You may want to pick up the Siege Devourer on the way.

Look for the Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon nearby and investigate the corpse to obtain the quest. Head through the portal into Sacnoth Valley. Once there follow the quest marker that points to the location of each NPC you need to contact. After speaking to each NPC they will follow your party to the next location.
Jenn Valefield is to the south sitting beneath a tree in a field with a dozen stone elementals nearby.
Chance Redding is your next target. He is located in the middle of the zone, just south of where the zone name appears on the World Map.
Sergeant Weststar is in the southwest corner of the zone, having followed Rake Blazeclaw here. Speaking to Sergeant Weststar completes the quest.

quests/quest:gww:67208/sections/notes-1/.text: Enemies cannot target nor harm Jenn and Chance.

quests/quest:gww:289099/sections/objecti.text: Find Imperial Guard Miyuki in Wajjun Bazaar.
Ask around to find out where Imperial Guard Natsumi has been.
Head to the location Miyuki has suggested.
Defeat Meijun, Vengeful Eye and his allies.
See Lei Jeng For your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289099/sections/walkthr.text: Miyuki is just south of The Marketplace, battling a single Jade Brotherhood member. Help her defeat and interrogate him. Search for more Jade Brotherhood Members and Peasants in Wajjun Bazaar. Depending on the NPC you speak to, some of the options will increase the progress bar more than the other options, while other options won't increase the progress bar at all. Jade Brotherhood Members have a higher effect on the bar than the peasants with one exception. If you ask Peasant 1, "Who's your daddy?" he tells you his father is Yon Ruino. Speaking to Yon Ruino will greatly increase the bar's progress. After you have found enough evidence, head towards the Jade Brotherhood headquarters on the dock north of Wajjun Bazaar. Defeat Meijun's party to finish the quest. Make sure that Miyuki follows you while you gather information, or you will not be able to finish the quest, as Miyuki tends to get stuck between the NPCs and gets left behind.
The most efficient way of gathering evidence:
Head to Miyuki at the start
Continue past her to defeat and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 1, picking the first option.
Head directly west to speak to Peasant 1, picking the third option.
Retrace your steps northeast until Yon Ruino is visible and speak to him.
Head west along the waterfront and speak to Peasant 5, picking the first option. This will be enough to fill the bar in Normal Mode.
For Hard Mode, continue west along the dock and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 5, choosing option two, which will be enough to fill the bar.
From here, continue on as normal to defeat Meijun and his group.

quests/quest:gww:289099/sections/notes-1.text: Peasants don't have much information to share. You gain the most progress by speaking to the Jade Brotherhood Members.
Make sure Miyuki is following you to "the location Miyuki has suggested", as she can get stuck on the way there, and the quest won't update without her presence.
Miyuki will become stuck on NPCs along the way, a simple fix is get her unstuck on any she does so that the quest will update when you head to the location of Natsumi.

quests/quest:gww:11305/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Prophecies installed on the account

quests/quest:gww:11305/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to the Arid Sea in Tyria and find the bones of Shanrah's husband.
Strike down Khepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path and free the souls of Rotal's daughters.

quests/quest:gww:11305/sections/environm.text: Shanrah will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:11305/sections/walkthro.text: Rotal's bones are located at the south end of the Arid Sea. Rather than using map travel, it is faster to find the Forgotten Guardian at the northwestern end of Crystal Overlook and have him teleport you to the Arid Sea.
After speaking with Rotal, you will need to kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path.
Travel back to Shanrah in Elona for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11305/sections/notes-1/.text: When you return to Shanrah for your reward, her daughters, Kyrisah and Meymo, will be standing next to her.

The Bleached Bones east of the Dunes of Despair in The Arid Sea was the first mention of this story, which remained incomplete until Nightfall was released. If a player does not already have the quest from Shanrah, it will make no mention of either the quest or trying to find her.
This quest can be completed at the same time as the Kepkhet Marrowfeast Zaishen quest.
This is one of very few quests requiring you to kill a pre-existing boss.

quests/quest:gww:23980/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Ailonseh Dejarin about Koss and the family estate.
Deliver Ailonseh's letter to Zudash Dejarin.

quests/quest:gww:23980/sections/walkthro.text: Exit into Arkjok Ward from Yohlon Haven. Ailonseh is just a little way to the East of the portal, she will give you a letter when she sees Koss. Talk to Zudash Dejarin in Yohlon Haven for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18218/sections/objectiv.text: Find the ghosts of Barris and Tamra Lefey.
Lead the ghosts to the gates of Ascalon City.
See Elise Lefey for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18218/sections/walkthro.text: Kneel at the statue of Dwayna in Sardelac Sanitarium. The Avatar of Dwayna will appear with a quest marker over her head. Speak with her to get the quest.

This quest is easiest to do if you leave from Ascalon City. Head west and keep along with the Wall, and continue to hug the wall. You'll fight some Gargoyles and Hulking Stone Elementals while hugging the walls. You'll pass Master Ranger Nente and a collector at the statue of Balthazar (the former entrance to Green Hills County in pre-Searing Ascalon). Continue heading west, and you'll encounter some Devourers that pop out of the ground. Once the hills break, veer southwest (the exit to the Breach will be to the northwest). You'll have to clear any enemies surrounding the ghosts before they'll follow you, but approach the ghosts and they'll speak (point A on the wiki map).

Head back east once you've found the ghosts. It should be an easy walk back, but you may encounter some stray Hulking Stone Elementals. You'll lead the ghosts back down near the clearing between Ambassador Zain's caravan and Warmaster Grast (point B). Elise and Toby Lefey will run down from the broken wall, and another dialogue will ensue between the ghosts, later joined by Elise and Toby. The ghosts disappear when the dialogue is finished, and you can speak with Elise to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21957/sections/objectiv.text: Obtain a Drake Kabob from Chef Lonbahn in Kamadan.
Obtain a bowl of Skalefin Soup from Chef Panjoh in the Astralarium.
Obtain a plate of Pahnai Salad from Chef Volon at Champion's Dawn.
See Royal Chef Hatundo for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21957/sections/walkthro.text: Since the locations of all the chefs can be looked up in your Quest Log, the only problem you're faced with is actually acquiring the ingredients for each dish. All three chefs function like collectors - you'll be able to exchange one Chunk of Drake Flesh for a drake kabob in Kamadan, two Skale Fins for skalefin soup in The Astralarium, and two Iboga Petals for pahnai salad in Champion's Dawn. As for where to get those:

Iboga Petals are the easiest to get. Simply farm your way through all the Fanged Iboga wandering across the Plains of Jarin. If you're somewhat low-level, you'll have to watch out for some of the level 6 variety crawling around, but in all, it won't be difficult to gain the two petals for the salad. You can also go to Churrhir Fields and fight Iboga Root if you are low level.

Skale Fins will, as the name implies, drop from any of the Skale species. There are some low-level Skale in the Plains of Jarin, but it won't be easy solo-farming them for the fins. You'll be fighting your way through quite a lot of these critters if you explore Istan, though, so if you just try to finish all quests in the region, you'll most likely end up with more than two of these.

A Chunk of Drake Flesh is the hardest to acquire. They drop off Irontooth Drakes, which are quite rare in the starting areas (though you can find one surrounded by termites near the Astralarium, and a couple in the shallow water just east and north of the Champion's Dawn portal in Plains of Jarin), and even then, they're level 10. The drop rate isn't all that magnificent, either. Trying to get this immediately will become tedious very quickly. If you're desperate to complete the quest without leveling up first, you can always buy some from another player. Beware, though, because the prices charged for these items are definitely not of the 'cheap' variety.

Hint: Try to do this quest alone, it will increase the drop rate for all the ingredients. If you have any higher level characters you can use them to solo and then place the items in your Xunlai Storage for your other characters.

quests/quest:gww:21957/sections/notes-1/.text: Unlike most quests, there appears to be no chat screen notice about Royal Chef Hatundo taking the items.

quests/quest:gww:9632/sections/objective.text: Protect the emperor's cook as he serves soup to the poor.
See Imperial Guardsman Kintae for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9632/sections/walkthrou.text: Follow the western edge of the Bukdek Byway until you reach Imperial Chef Yileng. You can wait for the two mobs of Afflicted to approach your position, but it is safer to move up the ramp the Chef faces and block the Afflicted right on the bridge, fighting them there.
Sometimes the second group of Afflicted gets stuck with fighting the peasants by the big hole before both of the bridges. If so, you'll have to run all the way down to the hole and kill them there.

quests/quest:gww:23159/sections/objectiv.text: Sate Toma's appetite. Lower the Health of a targeted enemy to 20% to activate Toma's Feeding Frenzy skill.

quests/quest:gww:23159/sections/walkthro.text: Take Toma around the Marga Coast and attack enemies, but do not kill them, so that Toma can use Feeding Frenzy. Toma's hunger level decreases with each enemy eaten. When it is zero, return to Chuno to collect the reward.

quests/quest:gww:23159/sections/notes-1/.text: Once Toma has eaten his fill, he will remain with the party until within compass range of Chuno. He will continue to fight for you, and swallow opponents, which makes him a valuable ally. Since this quest is not repeatable, consider saving this quest for a skill capture or vanquishing run.

If Toma dies after eating his fill, the game informs you that you have failed the quest, but your quest log indicates that the quest has been completed. It seems the log is accurate, since you can claim the reward even with Toma dead. Simply rezone and accept the reward.
Toma does not spawn during Undead Defenders.

Most of the secondary quests from the town will also require the player to travel through this area.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:

Melodic Gaki Flute
