quests/quest:gww:5065/sections/walkthrou.text: Meet up with Library Envoy Chukeht (4) in the Hidden City, and follow the quest pointer to each of the djinn lords (1) and (2). After doing this, head to the large open area where the altars are (3). It is a very good idea to clear this area of djinn before activating both Altar of Water and Altar of Fire, since even more djinn will spawn when you do. After placing the essences on the altars (i.e. touching both), you must flee back to the entry portal of the Hidden City; do not map out, as this will leave the quest unfinished. Instead, wait for Chukeht to arrive at the entrance. Once he slowly walks towards the exit, the quest will update. quests/quest:gww:5065/sections/notes-1/b.text: There are popup djinn throughout the area, including multiple Ruby Djinn; bring skills to remove burning.

quests/quest:gww:69171/sections/objectiv.text: Inquire with Giriff about helping the red Gokir tribe.

quests/quest:gww:69171/sections/walkthro.text: Upon entering, minion masters can make use of the frogmen corpses lying around. Rescue the Gokir from his duel with the yellow Ophil frog. Once the Ophil is dead, the Gokir will turn friendly and start to hop towards a gate. Simply follow them and help the Gokirs out. After clearing the first small cavern, the party can continue. The Gokir will not follow.

Nettle Spores, when aggroed, cast Spore Explosion transforming into a harmful plant. Therefore it is advisable either to run through the whole cavern or take the fights slowly, pulling a few at a time.

After clearing the cavern with plants, keep to the northern walls ending up amidst a Gokir war party. Upon arriving in their midst they start charging an Ophil party down the cavern hallway. Follow the Gokir until you reach a fork. Here the Gokir will stop, once again leaving your party.

Take the southern path, which leads to the stairs to the next level after fighting through a few more frogmen and plants. Beware of the poison traps while fighting. Once past the traps you enter another plant infested cavern. Running through is a good option here as most of the enemies are Spores, just watch out for the Fanged Ayahuascas.

The first two caverns are plant infested. If your party is not strong enough, it is advised to run through, running from clearing to clearing to heal from the poison. In the second cavern, there are Incubi patrols - try not to aggro too many at once.
Beyond the Beacon of Droknar there is a corridor filled with beetles, which are quite easy to defeat as long as you don't over aggro.

In the third cavern there are a great deal of Ophils which seem to have captured a group of Gokir. Once you reach the shrine the gate opens to the Ophil Patriarch's room. He is surrounded by Gokir corpses, which can once again helps out your minion master. Upon slaying him, the patriarch drops a boss key.
Continue south fighting Ophils along the way and open the boss lock with your newly acquired key. Past the gate are three invisible traps in the corridor that inflict poison and crippled.

Khabuus is surrounded by 3 parties of Ophils along with his own bodyguard of 2 Amini. Careful pulling is effective if wanting to fight Khabuus last - but beware of Ophil Nahualli healing the lured foe and then causing the aggro of another group of frogmen. After killing Khabuus, a Bogroot Chest will appear, and the quest is completed. If you don't talk to Giriff to claim your reward before the timer runs out, you can get it once you are returned to Sparkfly Swamp, as he is close by.
There are plenty of corpses here for a minion master.
Consider bringing hex removal to counter the Ophil Tlamatini and Fanged Ayahuascas, who also interrupt.
Bring something to help counter the spike inflicted by Stormcloud Incubi, such as "I Am Unstoppable!".

quests/quest:gww:69171/sections/notes-1/.text: Upon activating this quest by speaking to Giriff, the quest Tekks's War will be reset. The same will count the other way around.
The two amphibians fighting at the very beginning of the dungeon might not die. In order to continue with the dungeon, you may need to rezone.

On the first level, you might have to rezone numerous times because all of the amphibians are dead, thus you can't progress because the door doesn't open. Every time you rezone you MUST re-talk to the quest-giving NPC (Giriff/Tekk) to follow you into the dungeon.

quests/quest:gww:67725/sections/walkthro.text: Hayda is just north of the portal you enter Sparkfly Swamp. Fight your way with Hayda to the location with the White Mantle, but do not approach Ambassador Kharnige yet. Kill any enemies on periphery of the White Mantle group to ensure that you don't have any nasty surprises while occupied with the Mantle.

Now approach the Ambassador, while Hayda is talking to him, position your group on the eastern edge. Once the Mantle turn hostile you can take out the Ambassador's group first and then deal with each group as it approaches. The foes this quest spawns should not pose too great a threat to a party of 8.
Note: If Hayda dies, she will resurrect automatically once there are no enemies in her vicinity, like all Eye of the North allies.

quests/quest:gww:67725/sections/notes-1/.text: When you first see her, she will be close to a group of Angorodons. There is a good chance you will fight them if you aren't careful. If you end up fighting them, a group of wandering Raptors will come upon you if you don't kill the prior group fast. Lure the Angorodons away before doing anything with her, and fight them there.
NPCs Giriff and Tekks are just north of the White Mantle groups, so you can recruit one of them as an ally before engaging the White Mantle.

Sometimes Hayda will get stuck on the resurrection shrine and you will have to restart the quest. It's possible that enemies may get trapped in terrain or otherwise be missing (including having run to the other side of the map, which also requires a restart.

quests/quest:gww:70081/sections/rewards-.text: After the party defeats the final wave, a Chest of the Brotherhood will spawn, which drops a Cloth of the Brotherhood and a Destroyer Core (in Hard Mode one Cloth of the Brotherhood and 5 Destroyer Cores) for each member.

Each party member will be awarded 3000 Delver Reputation points should they break the monthly record.
Each party member will be awarded 6000 Delver Reputation points should they break the quarterly record (3 months).

quests/quest:gww:70081/sections/walkthro.text: The main mission area contains three entrances to a room with the Baby Dragon. The rear entrance connects to an elevated loop that encircles the arena. There are two side gates which lead to pathways and monster spawn points. In the center, the baby dragon rests on an elevated platform.

You will be attacked by six waves consisting of different types of Destroyers. A new wave starts immediately after the last destroyer of the previous wave has been killed. The party gains a morale boost every time a new wave starts.

The first wave consists of a constant swarm of weak level 10 and 15 Destroyers of Souls and Destroyers of Hordes, along with some level 20 Destroyers of Thoughts for about two minutes and thirty seconds (last spawn at 2:25). Splitting into two groups along the two paths and killing the monsters at their spawn points is effective. Alternatively, you can let the Destroyers pile up one side and spam heavy AoE skills to clear them all at once.

The second wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion and Destroyers of Deeds. The Destroyers of Deeds block most attacks with Lightning Reflexes, making this the hardest wave for groups consisting mainly of physical damage dealers. They also use Debilitating Shot and Savage Shot, which can incapacitate your casters. Meanwhile, the Destroyers of Compassion will try to wreck your backline. This is one of the more difficult waves. Focus on killing the Destroyers of Compassion first as they deal catastrophic amounts of damage.

In the third wave, Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts dig out of the ground throughout the entire arena. If not aggroed, they will circle around the area and attack the Baby Dragon from behind. It is advisable to spread out your party in order to defeat the wave as quickly as possible, being sure to have at least one party member targeting the destroyers on each bridge.
The fourth wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion, Destroyers of Flesh, Destroyers of Sinew, Destroyers of Bones, and a few Destroyers of Souls coming down both side exits.

The fifth wave consists of Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts coming through all three exits, while Destroyers of Lives pop up within range of the Baby Dragon. Interrupt the Destroyers of Lives and dispatch them quickly, as they do massive fire damage, and inevitably target the baby dragon if left alive for too long.
The sixth and final wave consists of four Bosses: the Hand of Destruction and the Heart of Destruction from the left spawn, and the Mind of Destruction and the Flesh of Destruction from the right.
Destroyers are immune to burning and have (at least) +20 armor against fire damage; they have a -20 penalty against cold damage.
There are enough corpses for at least 2 Minion Masters. Several Death Magic skills deal cold damage.
Some Deldrimor skills have extra impact against destroyers, especially Alkar's Alchemical Acid.
Display the Stout-Hearted title effect, which increases skill damage against the destroyers (while healing skill users).
Certain hero team comps can successfully complete the challenge without any player input.

Accompany Goren while he finds his armor.

quests/quest:gww:25686/sections/walkthro.text: This quest involves protecting Goren, a level 18 hammer warrior while he collects his belongings through Resplendent Makuun, surrounding the Bokka Amphitheatre.

His AI has two behaviors: He will follow your lead while walking through the area. But will start to rush in by himself when approaching any of the three quest marker spots. Everytime he runs alone by himself, he risks quest failure since his survival is one of the objectives. If your team set-up is not suited and need to retry, consider taking bonding skills like Life Bond to ease the job.
Escort and protect this ally while searching 3 items (his weapon, armor and a sparkling rock) to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25686/sections/notes-1/.text: If you are not in a hurry to acquire Goren, it is easier to complete Gain Goren than this quest, since that quest only requires you to speak to Prince Bokka the Magnificent in Resplendent Makuun. quests/quest:gww:22172/sections/objectiv.text: Take Goren and his Sparkling Rock to the Hidden City of Ahdashim to hide the rock.

quests/quest:gww:22172/sections/notes-1/.text: The baby dragon resides inside the Hidden City, after the completion of the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25487/sections/objectiv.text: Protect Archivist Ithimar from the Nightmares.
Return to Archivist Ithimar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25487/sections/walkthro.text: Take the path heading directly East outside of Lion's Arch and follow it North until you reach Archivist Ithimar. As soon as you accept the quest, groups of Nightmares will begin spawning around the foot of Ithimar's pedestal, one group at a time. There will be two groups of 2, one group of 3, and finally a group of 4, with each group only appearing once all of the Nightmares in the previous group have been killed. The Nightmares are fairly weak, especially in small numbers, relying on Touch of Agony combined with Dark Aura for moderate AoE spike damage. However, be careful about casting spells on yourself or your allies, since you may be hexed with Mark of Subversion.
After clearing all the groups, talk to Ithimar again for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25487/sections/notes-1/.text: The Nightmares will not actually attack Archivist Ithimar, and cannot damage him even with Dark Aura.
During the quest, Archivist Ithimar will be animated as if he is activating a skill, but no skill is actually being used.
If you rezone before all the Nightmares have been killed, you will need to speak to Ithimar and ask him about the quest to cause the Nightmares to spawn again.
If you keep the quest active, the Nightmares can be farmed for Piles of Glittering Dust and Shadowy Remnants. In Normal Mode, the Nightmares are level 15, making them a good source of experience.
If you intend to farm the quest, consider also keeping The Ascalon Settlement active for the allies it provides.
On some occasions a Krytan/Locked Chest will spawn as soon as a group of Nightmares appears.

quests/quest:gww:15105/sections/objectiv.text: Look for Grawl invaders along the road. Eliminate them.
Return to Warmaster Grast for your reward.
Upon accepting the quest, Warmaster Grast will provide you with a Starter Sword and give you the following skills:

quests/quest:gww:15105/sections/walkthro.text: Two of your newly acquired skills, Sever Artery and Gash require a sword to function. Equip the Starter Sword provided by Warmaster Grast and head southwest down the road. Along the way, you will encounter several non-hostile Stone Elementals. You may try out your sword skills on them to learn that these creatures of earth are immune to Bleeding, rendering your new condition-based combo ineffective.

Continue past the elementals to find a a patrol of three Grawl Invaders close by. Being flesh and blood, they are susceptible to your blade. Use your basic attack to build up your Adrenaline. Once you have amassed 3 strikes of Adrenaline, use Sever Artery to inflict the Bleeding condition. When you reach 5 strikes of Adrenaline, follow up with Gash to inflict a Deep Wound on the bleeding target. Notice that each adrenal skill has its own independent Adrenaline pool.
Once the Grawl threat has been eliminated, return to Grast to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:284010/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:284010/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Grothmar Wardowns in the Charr Homelands of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:284010/sections/target-.text: The first time you appear with Rebel Yell activated, Weststar's squad will appear once, talk for a bit, and then leave for the outpost. Wait for them to finish so that you can do the Vanguard-side skill quests later.
The Black Wolves in this area cannot be attacked.

Chaelse Flameshielder, the boss in the Charr camp, can be hard to kill due to multiple healers or simply due to the amount of resurrect skills. Bring the appropriate skills to interrupt or counter resurrection if your party does not have sufficient fire power. You can use the cliff to provide some protection and hold aggro.

Alternatively, you can avoid this group entirely by completing Against the Charr first; you will spawn in the middle of the camp and Chaelse does not spawn. However, if Plan A is active, then the camp will be filled with hordes of charr and your team will likely wipe.
Only Charr Dominators, Charr Avengers, Charr Blademasters, and Charr Axemasters can resurrect; the monks (Charr Menders, Charr Prophets, and Chaelse Flameshielder) cannot.
As with any area in the Charr Homelands, if at least two player characters are in the party, several Siege Devourers can be mounted which can make vanquishing much easier.

quests/quest:gww:25614/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to the eastern side of Resplendent Makuun. Explore the last known position of the raiding party.
Find the captured guard captain and assess the situation.
Escort the freed guards from the heket lair.
Hand over the freed guards to the rescue party.
See Prince Ahmtur the Mighty for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25614/sections/walkthro.text: If you do this quest immediately after Population Control, it's probably easiest to walk straight back across the Wilderness to Resplendent Makuun, since the route will be clear after doing the previous quest.
If you do this quest later, it's best to start from the Honur Hill outpost, and take your party along the northern edge of Resplendent Makuun to the first objective.

In either case, follow the quest pointer and make your way towards the missing patrol's last known position. Unfortunately, few members of the patrol remain; they have no doubt been slain by the heket in the area. However, the captain and 2 guards are still alive and being held prisoner, so the party must make haste to the next point and rescue them from the roaming creatures!

Having rescued the still living members of the patrol, escort them to Captain Portir and his rescue team on the eastern side of Resplendent Makuun, where you can hand over the freed guards and their captain.
To collect your reward from Prince Ahmtur, map back to Dzagonur Bastion and walk back to the Citadel in the Wilderness of Bahdza.

quests/quest:gww:25614/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with The Show Must Go On.

quests/quest:gww:13993/sections/requirem.text: Gwen does not already have a Flute. (Monk Monk characters see notes, below, as the quest is slightly different.)

quests/quest:gww:13993/sections/walkthro.text: Guide to meeting Gwen Once you get the quest from Gwen, follow the southwest road until you come to the river. Go across it and you should find the Broken Flute on the beach. Return to Gwen for the reward.

quests/quest:gww:13993/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest is mechanically unusual. Rather than having a normal quest window, it is accepted through "normal" dialogue, and the quest reward will be accepted automatically after returning the flute to Gwen.

If you form a party with anyone who has already started or completed this quest, or has given her the new flute or new cape, then Gwen will not give you the Tapestry Shred. Afterwards, everyone that will form a party with you and enter this area will have the same situation. This quest is not necessary for monks to obtain the Tapestry Shred. If you give her the new flute, new cape and flowers, she will give you the Tapestry Shred. If you are in a party with some one doing this quest (giving her the broken flute) after your party member gives her the broken flute and you need to speak to her she will give you the 250 experience points. She will say "Your friend found my flute. Thank You." If you abandon this quest, Gwen will not give it again.

quests/quest:gww:205872/sections/objecti.text: Guard the turtle caravan from the Gyala Hatchery.
*BONUS* Keep all five young turtles alive.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:205872/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:205872/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Gyala Hatchery mission.

quests/quest:gww:283630/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Gyala Hatchery in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283630/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:283630/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Gyala Hatchery in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:283630/sections/target-.text: Exit north from Leviathan Pits. Although Gyala Hatchery shares its border with the outpost of the same name, it cannot be reached from there.
On the western edge (near the area with washed out color on the map) is a huge Irukandji encased in a block of jade, in the center of a Flooded Jade Mine.
Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.8% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
Exploration is best done during the mission as, if you avoid triggering the turtles, you can explore most of the area without having to fight anyone.

The Outcasts, Fish and Leviathans are hostile to each other. If you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 30-40. Jacqui The Reaver and Reefclaw Ragebound also fight, and one of them will eventually kill the other. If Jacqui survives the fight, he might start fighting Whyk Steelshell's group next and get killed by them.
There are four spots where hidden Oni will popup:
Two at the large island in the southwestern corner.
On the large eastern island, Bahnba Shockfoot and his Yetis are on a narrow path. Three Oni are on the other parallel path.
Two more on a spot just north of the previous spot, close to the path of the Naga patrols.
No foes have hex removal and all are fleshy, so hex spells and minion masters work well here.
The northern portal to the Gyala Hatchery's outpost is missing the white hazy barrier usually associated with Factions and Prophecies area transitions.

quests/quest:gww:284504/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Haiju Lagoon on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:284504/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:284504/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Haiju Lagoon on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:284504/sections/target-.text: Exit from Zen Daijun or travel northeast from Seitung Harbor through Jaya Bluffs.
The primary quest To the Rescue will lead Factions characters here.

These quests will affect the spawns in this area: An Unwelcome Guest, Sentimental Treasures, Skin the Snake, The Bog Beast of Bokku, The Captured Son, The Naga Source, The Thieving Nanny, To the Rescue and To Zen Daijun.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.17% to the Canthan Cartographer title.

You can reduce to as little as 61 if Cleansing Haiju Lagoon is active or completed. Note that finishing this quest will remove all of the enemies, including the bosses, and replace them with scavengers.
There are hidden groups of Naga mobs near the small cave at Daochu Village.

Tin Dao Kaineng can be dangerous due to the boss' Spirit Rift. Try to pull the two nearby groups apart. Daze the Naga boss to make it easier to interrupt. Keep spread out. Be prepared to flag heroes and henchmen away to avoid the rifts or to retreat.

quests/quest:gww:25240/sections/objectiv.text: Ambush the Charr in the tar pits south of Piken Square. Strike down Grimm Sharpfang.
Return to Duke Barradin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25240/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Piken Square and move south to the tar pits, kill Grimm Sharpfang and the Charr around him. Some Ascalon Militia will be attacking from the south as you arrive at the tar pits which can provide a useful distraction. Once Grimm Sharpfang is dead, return to the Duke in Piken Square for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:199595/sections/objecti.text: Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in Perdition Rock.
*BONUS* Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:199595/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:199595/sections/walkthr.text: Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.
If you go clockwise through its patrol path:

You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.

quests/quest:gww:199595/sections/notes-1.text: This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path

quests/quest:gww:63891/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the spirit sighting areas. You have 3..0 areas left to explore.
Exorcise the spirit of Tanto the Grim.
See Magni the Bison for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63891/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Olafstead and follow the first quest marker, located on a small island to the northwest. As the party approaches, Xandra's dialogue will begin and Tanto the Grim will appear with a mob of Regrets. You will have the environmental effect Haunted Ground on you and your party. Be wary of the Ice Imps that populate the island—consider pulling them away from the marker so you do not have to fight both groups at once.

After defeating the Regrets, travel east to the next quest marker. Tanto will appear again, this time with a mob of Sorrows accompanying him. Once the Sorrows are killed, the quest marker will update.
Tanto waits at the final marker. Approach him carefully—several Shock Phantoms are hidden in the area. After a short dialogue, Tanto will turn hostile and several Anguishes will spawn.
Killing Tanto and all the Anguishes will complete the quest.

Tanto actually spawns the moment the party enters Varajar Fells, and does not respond until they have reached the appropriate quest trigger. Consider clearing spawn points 2 and 3 before investigating the first quest marker to avoid being overwhelmed by more than one mob at a time.

quests/quest:gww:63891/sections/notes-1/.text: The required spawns for this quest will not appear if A Good Deed is active.
Despite the description, you can fulfill this quest without Xandra in your party.

quests/quest:gww:215794/sections/objecti.text: Kill Havok Soulwail in Darkrime Delves.
*BONUS* Kill Havok Soulwail in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:215794/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:215794/sections/walkthr.text: The walkthrough is the same for the quest The Misanthropic Jotun Principle given by Einarr Frostcleft in Bjora Marches just west of the entrance to the Darkrime Delves. If you enter without the quest, the door inside will be shut. Einarr and another Norn will follow you during the quest but don't help.

quests/quest:gww:68991/sections/rewards-.text: A Warrior 24 Dwarven Ghost at or near every Resurrection Shrine
3 Hidden Treasures by the Area Map/Jacado the Putrid
2 Hidden Treasures under Ice Jet north of Cracked Wall
2 Hidden Treasures under Ice Jet on path to Erasklion the Prolific
2 Hidden Treasures by Resurrection Shrine at end of level
1 Hidden Treasure to the north of said end-level shrine, by an (inaccessible) area with what appears like scaffolding amongst swamp/jungle shrubbery
1 Hidden Treasure just north of the above and some stairs
2 Dwarven Ghosts in second chamber (with exit)

quests/quest:gww:68991/sections/notes-1/.text: If you do not yet have the quest Heart of the Shiverpeaks, Budger Blackpowder does not appear, so the Cracked Wall on the first level cannot be passed. You can still navigate between the Battledepths and Bogroot Growths.
For tips on how to defeat Cyndr, see the boss' page here.

If you have killed Cyndr the Mountain Heart before (either in Normal mode or Hard mode), you don't need a quest to complete this dungeon. Simply enter the dungeon and complete it. The final boss will be Magmus instead of Cyndr, who breaks into Jellies when killed. All of those Magma Blisters must be killed before the Mountain Heart Chest will spawn.
If you do not have the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest, Budger Blackpowder is available to provide powder kegs for your party. He is located prior to the Cracked Walls on each level.

1,500 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in Normal Mode, and 750 points are awarded for subsequent completions. 2,250 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon in hard mode for the first time, and 1,125 points are awarded for subsequent completions.
Entrance from Bogroot Growths is far to the southwest of the entrance from the Battledepths, and the Bogroot path is much longer.
On level 2 there are a total of five Dwarven Ghosts, even though the level has fewer than 30 enemies.
On level 3, there are no fleshy foes and there are several foes with Burning Immunity.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #18 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.

quests/quest:gww:68991/sections/shared-q.text: The main difficulty of this quest is encountered on the third level of the dungeon, where players must defeat Cyndr the Mountain Heart - which can be extremely difficult for single players and it is recommended to team-up with others, as the party will need to drop three kegs on the Wurm to enable it to be damaged.
Getting there

Start from Eye of the North (outpost), head west and use the portal to Battledepths. Head along the north tunnel to the Dwarves' encampment and talk to King Jalis Ironhammer (point K on the wiki-map) to pick-up the quest. Cross the hall, and head east to avoid the Chromatic Drakes - kill the two groups of Djinn and then follow the wall to the Asura Gate to the dungeon entrance.
It is also possible to enter this area from the first level of the Bogroot Growths dungeon as long as the quest has been obtained, but the route is difficult and long.
Level 1
Head either south or northwest upon entry and then head in a southerly direction past the resurrection shrine.
The south route only has Undead to fight (but is probably easier for groups unable to take down multiple healers).

The northwest route has spiders (the Lifeweavers can be difficult to kill), regular undead and a massive room of traps and Chained Clerics (which can be avoided by running through with an organised party).

Find Budger Blackpowder at any of his possible spawn points (marked with green dots on the wiki-map) - he gives you some free Aged Dwarven Ale. He will follow you through the entire dungeon, providing you with Dwarven Powder Kegs which can be used to breach Cracked Walls - as well as knocking down and causing 50 damage to foes when dropped. Pull foes to avoid over-aggro.
Once at the Cracked Wall, talk to Budger to receive a Dwarven Powder Keg. Drop the item in front of the obstacle to destroy it and proceed forward.
Level 2

This level can be completed by only fighting two/three groups. By quickly heading north at the start you can avoid aggroing a slowly patrolling group of Skelk. Destroy the wall with a Powder Keg. Once at the portal eliminate the Skelk group to open it.
Level 3
This is the final level. There is an Area Map immediately after the entrance, which will reveal the locations of two Cracked Walls and the chamber where Cyndr the Mountain Heart resides.

There are Aggressive Oozes, Flowstone Elementals, Magma Blisters and Burning Spirits along the way. Be careful with these last ones when turning left to blast the second wall as there will not be much space to avoid their area of effect attacks.
Cyndr the Mountain Heart

After breaching the second wall, an apparently empty room awaits. Enter the room slowly and beware of Cyndr the Mountain Heart that appears. It cannot be damaged at all while protected by the "Mountain Heart Carapace". To destroy its Carapace, the player(s) must drop three Dwarven Powder Kegs close to it. A blue progression bar will indicate when the wurm is vulnerable, after which it turns red and regenerates its Carapace (additional keg blasts can deal 50 of damage points). Depending on the party's overall firepower, it is possible to defeat Cyndr in one single attempt.

Cyndr can deal a high amount of damage to bunched up teams (such as heroes) while also destroying kegs with Pyroclastic Shot, and its Flame Burst can kill a low armor character (such as a caster) in one hit. The lava on the ground also inflicts burning. As such, it is extremely difficult to take the wurm down the normal way if you're the only player character of your team.

One possible tactic is to lure Cyndr close to the tunnel's entrance and use life stealing skills which can bypass its carapace while being protected from its attacks inside the tunnel. Your party must be positioned away from the entrance to lure effectively.
For more details on how to kill Cyndr, refer to this boss-like foe's page.

Once the boss is killed and the Hammer of the Great Dwarf retrieved from the Stone Pedestal, a Mountain Heart Chest will spawn which grants every player a reward. Wait for the three minutes countdown timer to expire to be returned next to King Jalis to claim the quest reward and take the next quest.
Skill recommendations
Life stealing skills and skills that inflict bleeding, poison and/or disease ignore the damage immunity of the wurm.
Ward Against Elements and Ward Against Harm.
Protective Spirit to protect the runner(s), who should also have a speed boost skill.
Budger Blackpowder will drop an Aged Dwarven Ale when talked to in the Heart of the Shiverpeaks during this quest (only receivable once).
Cracked Walls do not block line of sight; you can use ranged attacks to take down foes on the other side.

quests/quest:gww:209241/sections/objecti.text: Defeat the great evil at Hell's Precipice.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:209241/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:209241/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Hell's Precipice mission.

quests/quest:gww:11987/sections/objectiv.text: Find Rangil Ironbow in Traveler's Vale.

quests/quest:gww:11987/sections/walkthro.text: Go out from Yak's Bend and start down the path toward Borlis Pass. When you come to the split in the road, go either west or north; you can avoid more enemies on the west path. Both paths re-join near an iron bridge. Cross the bridge and turn west, stopping just before the entrance to Iron Horse Mine to talk to Rangil and receive the reward.

quests/quest:gww:11987/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest leads into a long quest arc, beginning with Minaar's Trouble. Because the quest giver for those is some distance from the nearest town, it will save some time to do the arc in one trip.
Rangers and monks can further save time by doing the quests Stone Summit Beastmasters and The Wayward Monk alongside this quest arc.
Although this quest serves to lead players to Rangil Ironbow, it is not a prerequisite to Rangil's quests.

Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can learn all six skills by waiting until you can change your secondary profession, then taking and abandoning the quest once with each secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:17631/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the supplies to Ellie Rigby in Ascalon City.
Return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17631/sections/walkthro.text: Return to Ascalon City, where you'll find Ellie Rigby standing to the east of Warmaster Tydus. Hand over the supplies, then head back out into Old Ascalon. As you exit the city, you'll witness a heated standoff between the king and Prince Rurik, which ultimately ends with both returning to the city. Speak with the Ambassador and get your quest reward.

quests/quest:gww:13656/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out Herdsman Mehnosi on the Marga Coast.
Protect the cattle while Herdsman Mehnosi moves them to a safer location. At least 3 cows must survive.
See Herdsman Zekanu for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13656/sections/walkthro.text: The herd must be escorted from southeast of the garrison to the entrance of Nundu Bay. First clear the path between the locations of any enemies that normally spawn there. Then talk to Herdsman Mehnosi, at point M on the quest map, to start the herd moving. Two groups of Kournan military, at points K on the quest map, will spawn and attack the herd. The first group attacks just southwest of the garrison and the second group attacks along the path between the garrison and Nundu Bay. Intercept and destroy these groups before they come in range of the cows. Then just wait until the herd reaches its final destination. Go to Herdsman Zekanu at point Z on the quest map for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13656/sections/notes-1/.text: The dialogue to start this quest plays when you first come to the village during Hunted!, but you cannot start it until after that quest.

If you clear the way to Nundu Bay, then immediately run to the first spawn location after talking to Herdsman Mehnosi. When the cows are out of compass, they stop follow the Herdsman making this a simple quest to complete.

quests/quest:gww:63654/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Burol Ironfist while you have a Hero in your party to begin the Hero tutorial.
Use your Hero to capture area one.
Use your Hero to capture areas two and three.
Order your Hero to return to area one.
See Burol Ironfist [Hero Tutorial] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63654/sections/rewards-.text: Take this to Arkor Leadfoot in Boreal Station to receive a weapon of your choosing.

quests/quest:gww:63654/sections/walkthro.text: The quest takes place at a small instanced area. You will on top of a small platform with no way down. Your heroes will be at the foot of the platform. Any henchmen in your party will be removed.

Burol's monologue will start but you can go ahead and use the flag to direct your heroes to the first pillar marked "Area One". When they are near it, the progress bar on your screen will slowly turn blue. It is captured when it is completely blue. Eventually Burol will tell you to move your heroes to "Area One" and then to "Area Two" and "Area Three". When that part of the quest dialogue appears, three level 5 Snow Wolves will appear at the base of each of the latter two areas. Your heroes will make short work of them. Once all three areas are captured and the enemies dispatched, move them back to "Area One" to complete to quest. Claim your reward when you return to Boreal Station.

quests/quest:gww:63654/sections/notes-1/.text: On completion of the quest, you will be returned to Boreal Station after 30 seconds.
Even though it's destroyed the Asuran Gate is still shown active.
Obtaining a drop from the wolves (ie. festive drops) will open the Unclaimed Items interface when you're warped back to the Boreal Station.

quests/quest:gww:13487/sections/requirem.text: Players must listen to the whole conversation between Chitundu, Beastmaster Yapono, and Nehdukah, before the quest becomes available.

quests/quest:gww:13487/sections/objectiv.text: Help Nehdukah find an impressive warthog
Keep Nehdukah safe while he tames the impressive warthog.
Take Nehdukah and the tamed warthog to Yapono and Chitundu.

quests/quest:gww:13487/sections/walkthro.text: A fairly straightforward quest. With Nehdukah following, head up to the water front northwest of the Sunspear Great Hall. On a piece of land jutting out into the water is an Impressive Warthog. Nehdukah will begin to tame the beast. During this time, a group of about five or six Mandragor Slither will attack. Keep Nehdukah's health up and keep fighting. After the last monster has fallen, take Nehdukah back to Yapono and Chitundu, where they'll fawn over the piggy. After the dialogue, talk to Nehdukah for the reward.

quests/quest:gww:13487/sections/notes-1/.text: Non-Elonian characters will encounter Nehdukah with the warthog already tamed.

Despite what the dialogue implies, defeating the spawned mandragor is what advances the quest, not Nehdukah taming the warthog. If you rush Nehdukah past the warthog and into combat with the Juvenile Bladed Termites and Irontooth Drake in the water, he will still say his lines while fighting, but the quest will not advance until you go back and kill the mandragor.

It can be advisable to complete or at least take this quest as soon as possible. Otherwise, Nehdukah's conversation with his friends will play every time you exit the Sunspear Great Hall, which you are likely to do multiple times while progressing through the Nightfall storyline.

This quest will be registered as completed if the player is in a party with another player that has already completed this quest. If doing this quest with a non-Elonian character in party, Nehdukah will not follow the party.

quests/quest:gww:10600/sections/objectiv.text: Aid the Keepers as they defend their position from Margonite forces.
Assist the Keepers as they fend off additional Margonite forces.
See Keeper Kauniss for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10600/sections/walkthro.text: The initial group of Forgotten are just to the northeast of the Gate of Secrets in the Domain of Fear (marked point 1 on the map) and will probably be under attack from torment creatures as you approach. Despite the need to save them, the party needs to be careful to avoid aggroing additional patrolling creatures as the team reaches the Forgotten.

The party will be attacked by several waves of creatures. The early waves will be made up of Earth Born Titans, Rotting Titans, Wild Growths, Wind Born Titans and Water Born Titans. Later waves will be made up of Margonites, and the final waves will be made up of three Shiro'ken Assassins. You do not need to defeat the Shiro'ken in order to move on to the next step of the quest.

After these waves have been defeated, the quest pointer will move to indicate another group of Forgotten over the bridge southeast of the Gate of Secrets (marked point 2 on the map), and the process is much the same: defend and defeat the several waves of creatures.
The surviving Forgotten from the initial group will follow the team to the second site and combine with the second group of Forgotten to provide some aid in the defense.

While the composition of attackers remains the same, the waves for this second group spawn faster and come from two different locations. Additionally, a small mob of Terrorweb Dryders can prove to be a troublesome menace, as they (usually) appear at the worst possible times.
The final wave consists of Shiro'ken Assassins, and, once again, you do not need to defeat them.

quests/quest:gww:10600/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with The Last Patrol for some extra allies.
Chests near Tyrian Titans may contain Magmas Shields.

Initially heading to the second quest point and defeating all the enemies there will cause the quest to be marked as completed. Enemies will still spawn at the first point if one then proceeds there, although the quest will still be considered complete.

quests/quest:gww:275671/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Holdings of Chokhin in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:275671/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:275671/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Holdings of Chokhin in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:275671/sections/target-.text: This area lies beyond Mihanu Township, which is found on the northwestern corner of the Mirror of Lyss.
If your character goes with Margrid the Sly instead of the Master of Whispers, then the primary quest Greed and Regret will lead your character here.
The structure in the northeastern corner is the Halls of Chokhin, a library maintained by Prince Mehtu the Wise.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.6% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
There are no enemies inside the Halls of Chokhin.
The plant groups outside the Halls of Chokhin patrol very close to each other. Engaging a group without pulling will very likely draw in another one or two groups.
The Madness of Prophecy quest in particular significantly reduces the number of insect spawns.

Neither What Lies Beneath nor I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet completed

quests/quest:gww:63167/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the fissure on the Plains of Jarin near Kamadan.
Enter the fissure in the Plains of Jarin.

quests/quest:gww:63167/sections/environm.text: Once this quest, I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet or What Lies Beneath has been completed, the fissure, chasm and crevasse become permanent interactive objects of their respective explorable areas.

quests/quest:gww:63167/sections/walkthro.text: Go out into the Plains of Jarin and head south. Once you reach the fissure, click on it to be taken to the Caverns Below Kamadan. Inside you will face a circle of Corsairs. They are all level 7, and so shouldn't pose much of a threat. If you follow the path, you will eventually run into a level 11 Corsair Lookout. He will be accompanied by a level 8, a level 7, and a level 3 Corsair. When you continue along the path, you will come to a large room, where 5 Corsairs of various levels (none over level 10) will run toward you. Turn north and run to the end of the hallway. Then turn east, where you will soon see two dwarves. Pass them and continue, and you will soon hit a cinematic. The Beginning of the End is the follow-up primary quest that is automatically added to your quest log.

quests/quest:gww:63167/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest concludes automatically at the end of the cinematic; the follow-up quest, The Beginning of the End, is automatically accepted.
If you are below level 20 you will be buffed by Journey to the North within the Eye of the North expansion.
If you have any of the other Eye of the North access quests in your Quest Log, finishing one will remove them from your Quest Log.

quests/quest:gww:289239/sections/objecti.text: Find and rescue Ryun Grayfeather at Jaya Bluffs.
Defeat the Ministry of Purity Forces engaging you.
Catch the Ministry of Purity Sergeant.
Survive the battle between the Sensali and the Ministry of Purity.
See Soar Honorclaw for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:289239/sections/shared-.text: Follow the quest markers from Seitung Harbor in order to locate Ryun Grayfeather; it is possible to avoid the Ministry of Purity and Sensali forces battling it out as you make your way north. Once Ryun is found and his dialogue with the Sensali concludes, they will turn hostile and attack. The quest will not fail if Ryun dies, as he will automatically revive after the skirmish if your party does not wipe. Shortly after disposing of the Sensali, Ministry troops led by Jiao Kuai the Swift will approach from the east, and will also turn hostile after dialogue is completed. Continue following quest markers as you "chase" Jiao Kuai, being careful not to over-aggro enemies other than the Ministry groups you'll fight along the way.

Once Jiao Kuai reaches Sizhou Hall, he will confront the player alongside Commander Chui Kantu just before a Sensali group appears as well, and both will attack the player. Note: In order to avoid wiping at this stage, flag your team just outside Sizhou to the southeast along the ridge protected by a rock wall before triggering the quest dialogue and let both sides take each other out. If you're lucky there will only be a handful of enemies left for you to handle, resulting in an easy finish.

quests/quest:gww:25478/sections/objectiv.text: Find the refugees in Shenzun Tunnels.
See Emperor's Hand for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25478/sections/walkthro.text: The hardest part of this quest is finding Imperial Guardsman Yang to get it. While he isn't far from the entrance to Zin Ku Corridor, he is on a different level which requires going to the northern end of the area, climbing up, then heading back south, with several large groups of Jade Brotherhood along the way.

Once you have the quest, simply enter Shenzun Tunnels from Tahnnakai Temple and follow the quest marker. There are few foes along the way. Talk to all three refugees in the order indicated by the quest marker, then go to Raisu Pavilion to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25308/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Old Mac in Deldrimor Bowl.
Feed Joe [10...0] more Succulent Juniper Meats.
Speak with Old Mac in Deldrimor Bowl.
Return to Master Saberlin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25308/sections/walkthro.text: Head out from the outpost, talk to Old Mac, and then follow the path to where the plants are. There are some Centaur patrols to clear out first, but once that's done, the Succulent Junipers are easy kills. Then just feed Joe and go speak to Old Mac again.

You have to keep Joe alive to feed him; if he dies, you will need to re-zone to finish the quest. However, you can continue to collect Succulent Juniper Meat after he dies. If you collect all 10 before returning to Beacon's Perch, you can feed Joe immediately after leaving the outpost. You can also collect the Succulent Juniper Meat before speaking to Old Mac so that Joe does not follow you into danger. Since you'll need to talk to Old Mac to continue the quest anyway, leaving Joe with him won't cost you any time.

quests/quest:gww:25308/sections/notes-1/.text: There are two spawn locations for the Junipers, noted on the map. Typically you need only one in order to complete the quest and if Joe gets stuck on a tree you won't see the second location until you find him and feed him.
There will be fewer centaurs after To Kryta: Refugees.
This quest is useful for farming Alpine Seeds. After initiating the first time, avoid speaking to Joe or Old Mac when you rezone.

Joe sometimes becomes stuck between two small trees If you have more then 10 pieces of meat in your inventory, and then feed Joe, he will take all of the pieces of meat from your inventory. After feeding Joe the 10 pieces of meat, if you leave the instance before talking to Old Mac he will not continue with his dialogue. However the quest will update allowing you to talk to Master Saberlin to collect your reward.

Because Am Fah Assassins can block and inflict blind, you should consider bringing spellcasters instead of physical attackers. Follow the enemy spawns and you will reach some dwarves. Vekk and Ogden Stonehealer will also be there. A cinematic will start after which you will automatically get the quest The Beginning of the End.

quests/quest:gww:275750/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Ice Cliff Chasms in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:275750/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:275750/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Ice Cliff Chasms in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:275750/sections/target-.text: This area can initially be entered from Boreal Station after doing the requisite quest to enter Guild Wars Eye of the North.
The area outside Boreal Station is a popular place for chest runs or to farm experience (for pets, heroes, your character, or the Survivor title).
It is almost completely safe: the Snow Wurms spawn in fixed locations, they do little damage (even in Hard Mode), and they do not attack unless you attack them first.
On average, a runner can reach two locked chests in less than two minutes.
The portals to the Battledepths and Norrhart Domains are closed until your character uses the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments to view the First Vision cinematic.
This area is easier to map if either Service: In Defense of the Eye or Snowball Dominance are active.
The Ice Imps and Stonewolves are hostile to each other.

The first time you visit this zone, a dialogue occurs between Jora and Sif Shadowhunter, which prevents Tjorvi Throstson from spawning. If you want to get Norn blessing right away, rezone through Boreal Station before continuing.
There are hidden Mountain Aloes in the southern areas, mostly near the Mountain Pinesouls.
In normal mode only a single group of Chilling Wisps spawn on the central frozen lake, while in hard mode an additional group of Chilling Wisps and multiple groups of Ice Imps spawn there too.

quests/quest:gww:276108/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Ice Floe in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276108/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276108/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Ice Floe in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276108/sections/target-.text: This area is mostly optional. Getting to Marhan's Grotto is usually the reason to traverse this area.
This area is easily reached by exiting Thunderhead Keep to the southwest.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.7% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
When approaching the possible spawn point of Frostbite, if it does spawn, there will be a hidden group of Azure Shadows.
Some Mursaat groups have long patrol paths, so to find them you might need to backtrack to places you've already cleared.

There are Mursaat patrols in this area which are made up of 2 groups. When they stop patrolling they sometimes become one group. So when vanquishing it is advised to lure a group of Mursaat away while they are still patrolling.
It is not advised to attempt this vanquish if your armour is not infused. You will die from Spectral Agony.
Ice Imps have very high DPS, careful flagging (and if using spirits, precasting) is essential.

Sometimes two groups spawn right next to the Marhan's Grotto resurrection shrine. If you start from that outpost and wipe on them, it's possible to get in an endless wipe loop with the two imp groups camping the shrine. In this case it's best to restart from the outpost.

quests/quest:gww:276434/sections/objecti.text: Clear Icedome in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276434/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276434/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Icedome in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276434/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.44% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Many enemy groups are close together, so pull carefully to avoid taking on more than one mob at the same time.
Some players find it better to enter from Talus Chute, because your party will get aggroed immediately when arriving from the Frozen Forest.
There is a group of two Stone Summit that roam around the eastern portion of the map counter-clockwise that can be missed if not encountered with other foes, which may require you to trace your path.
The Mission Map will sometime fail to capture and track the player's location within Icedome, causing it's position to not be centered.
The map beyond the portal to Talus Chute doesn't extend far enough. When looking in the distance, a sea can be seen. After crossing the portal, that sea is replaced with mountains.

quests/quest:gww:18006/sections/objectiv.text: Get information about the shipment of identification kits from Kupekanu at Champion's Dawn.
Recover the lost shipment crate from the band of corsairs at the Cliffs of Dohjok.

quests/quest:gww:18006/sections/walkthro.text: The first part of this quest is merely meant to get you to the outpost Champion's Dawn. It should not be hard to get there, though you should watch out for several Mandragor emerging from the soil while you travel there. In the outpost, talk to Kupekanu, and he'll tell you that his last shipment was stolen by corsairs. Head out to the Cliffs of Dohjok and use your compass to get where you need to be. There are three groups of two corsairs here, with one group having the aid of Suubay the Greedy. Once Suubay is defeated, the Shipment Crate will drop. Pick it up and take it to Shatam for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18006/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be performed at the same time as Scholarly Affairs and Leaving a Legacy.
Although the leader of the corsair robbers has a name of his own (Suubay the Greedy), he is not a boss.
