quests/quest:gww:25699/sections/walkthro.text: After picking up the quest, speak to Koss in the Command Post, then map to Camp Hojanu to head into the Barbarous Shore. From there, the quest pointer will lead you to Hasahk the Clever waiting a little to the south, nearby.
After talking to Hasahk, a mob of corsairs will appear to the north, keen to recover the wares that Hasahk "borrowed" from them. Defeat the group to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25699/sections/notes-1/.text: After completion of this quest, Hasahk the Clever will appear in the Command Post as a rare material trader NPC.
Dunkoro also offers the quest Melonni Goes Recruiting. The player can only choose one of these quests, the other becoming unavailable, which is similar to the Mysterious Message quest.
Hasahk's presence in the Command Post bears no significance to the function of the Command Post since both types of material traders are already present.

quests/quest:gww:23979/sections/objectiv.text: Take Koss to Yohlon Haven and speak with Herbalist Makala about the Elixir of Strength.
Join Herbalist Makala on a zephyr hedger hunt in Arkjok Ward.
The potion is ready! Talk to Herbalist Makala to obtain it.
Test your newfound strength by slaying Slort Nilbog.
See Herbalist Makala for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23979/sections/walkthro.text: Map to Yohlon Haven and speak to Herbalist Makala, then walk out into Arkjok Ward to begin the zephyr hedger hunt with him. Makala will direct the party to a point half-way up the west side of Arkjok Ward (see the map for exact location), where they will find a zephyr hedger to slay.

Once it is slain, Makala will concoct his potion and dispense it to the party, which will give them the condition The Elixir of Strength, just in time to test it on the approaching creature: Slort Nilbog. Funnily enough, the potion doesn't make you any stronger, and while it's in effect, prevents you from attacking the creature.
Don't worry, the effect is soon dispelled by Makala and you can defeat Slort Nilbog normally.

quests/quest:gww:23979/sections/notes-1/.text: Although the quest isn't long in itself, it can be shortened with good preparation. Slort is vulnerable to damage from Traps and Spirits that are placed in his path before the elixir is taken. Since he is level 5, he dies easily, and the quest is instantly completed when he dies. Spirit Spammers can make short work of Slort, wiping him out in one or two seconds.

Necromancer Minions are apparently immune to the elixir's effect. If any remain from the Zephyr Hedger fight, minions may attack and kill Slort before the quest dialogue "The elixir should kick in any any second now..." even has a chance to display.

The effect of the elixir often does not end on henchmen, heroes, animal companions and sometimes the player character. However the effect is removed upon zone change or their death. Once in a while, Slort won't spawn.

quests/quest:gww:63655/sections/objectiv.text: Find and destroy Krak Flamewhip's elite cavalry unit in Jaga Moraine.
See Undrath Blastrock for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63655/sections/walkthro.text: Start from Sifhalla. Leave out through the portal and head east. Krak Flamwhip and his party of two Stone Summit Arcanists and four Stone Summit Herders patrol counter-clockwise around the southwest area of the zone. If you have difficulty finding them, try staying put near the resurrection shrine of Gunnleif at the middle of the map and let the patrol come to you. Kill the entire patrol, then return to Undrath for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63655/sections/notes-1/.text: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Prenuptial Disagreement, and Anything You Can Do.

quests/quest:gww:200140/sections/objecti.text: Kill Kunvie Firewing in the Unwaking Waters.
*BONUS* Kill Kunvie Firewing in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:200140/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:200140/sections/walkthr.text: There is an Oni popup group just to the east of Kunvie, so it is important to spawn them separately and kill them well away from any possible aggro. Kunvie and their group hit hard, so make sure that one well-protected party member or a tank takes the multiple Ride the Lightning, and be sure the party is spread out to avoid multiple AoE skills. Also Pain Inverter helps a great deal in killing Kunvie.

quests/quest:gww:10709/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the Kurzick supplies to Quartermaster Mikhail.

quests/quest:gww:10709/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, you will receive a bundle of Kurzick Supplies, which you must carry to Quartermaster Mikhail. Follow the map marker and fight your way through Ferndale. This quest triggers eight Luxon spawns along the various paths to Lutgardis Conservatory, though you will only need to encounter a few of them on the way, just dispatch them and go on. Should you drop the bundle along the route, it will ping the compass map to remind you to pick it up.

About halfway, you will see Mugra Swiftspell and some Dredge. It is possible to sneak past this group without a fight. At the next fork, turn left and immediately right again. On this way you will encounter two groups of Wardens. Try to lure the second group near where you fought the first group, because next to the second group's spawn place will also be a Luxon and Oni popup location, which can be deadly for your party. When you can target Quartermaster Mikhail, there is only one popup group of Wardens left (in the narrow corridor) and a group of Luxons right in front of Mikhail. You can just run past both of these and get your quest reward.

quests/quest:gww:10709/sections/notes-1/.text: You can rush through (using a running build) without fighting; you are not required to kill the Luxon groups.
This quest is suited well as a pointer for the way from House zu Heltzer to Lutgardis Conservatory, since Quartermaster Mikhail stands right in front of the entry to Lutgardis.

This quest works well with the other Ferndale repeatable quest Scouting Ferndale. The last group of that quest is not far from the beginning for this one, and the rewards are next to each other just outside Lutgardis Conservatory. Therefore start from Lutgardis, do Scouting Ferndale and finish with this quest.

If Lutgardis Conservatory is under Luxon control, the Luxon Guards at the resurrection shrine will attack any hostile Luxons. Sometimes the Luxon groups will spawn even if this quest is not in your Quest Log, though once you have completed the quest they will not spawn again.

quests/quest:gww:280639/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Lahtenda Bog in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280639/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280639/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Lahtenda Bog in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280639/sections/target-.text: Can only be accessed via the Blacktide Den outpost, even without completing the Blacktide Den mission beforehand. The primary quest War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance) will lead Nightfall characters to this area.
This is one of the few areas in Guild Wars where the ambient environment of the area resembles nighttime.

If a character completes the mission Blacktide Den and never actually enters the area separately, the label will not appear on their map. Keep this in mind when going for the Vanquisher and Cartographer titles.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.

Most, if not all, of the quests that take place here increase the total number of foes. The master difficulty quest What Do You Do with a Drunken Shauben? in particular will increase the total number of foes by at least a hundred.
Habab the merchant is available if your bags are starting to get full.
Condition removal skills will come in handy here, due to the foes inflicting a variety of conditions, including disease, bleeding, and cripple.
There are a lot of hidden Mandragors throughout this area, especially the northern half.
Vanquishing this area up to 10 times on an Elonian Support weekly bonus will allow any character to achieve Legendary Spearmarshal.

quests/quest:gww:10143/sections/objectiv.text: Rendezvous with the Obsidian Flame and prepare for the assault on the Shadow Blades.
Lead the Obsidian Flame to the place where the Shadow Blades are meeting. Destroy the rival organization.
See Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10143/sections/walkthro.text: There are three ways to complete the quest. The first two reduce the number of foes before meeting with your allies, while the third attempts to reduce the threat on the Obsidian Flame (the "lambs") by exploiting the game mechanics. Following the most direct route tends to end in failing the quest because the assassins are dying very easily. Only one of your assassin allies needs to survive to get credit for the quest.

Exit Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) into the Undercity. Proceed across the bridge, killing the afflicted mob. Follow the route on the map to the north, avoiding The Afflicted Miju, then west (along the passage pointed to by the quest marker), and turn east. This provides enough time for the afflicted to pop out of the ground around the monk boss and approach the party.

Kill the nearest two mobs of afflicted and then the monk boss; being careful of Miju's Ray of Judgment, which can easily wipe your heroes or henchmen. Slowly kill the afflicted in the corridors leading to the west, luring mobs to avoid dual aggro. Once you reach the tunnel with the water droplets falling into a pool on the ground, return to the corridor where you fought Miju to fetch the Obsidian Flame Assassins.

Lead them to the tunnel you just cleared, and beyond to the waiting Shadow Blade Assassins. Flag any heroes or henchmen into the mob of Shadow Blade Assassins. They will remain friendly until the end of a brief dialogue, after which they will attack both the party and the Obsidian Flame Assassins. If you have flagged the team well, you can defeat the Shadow Blades with little or no Obsidian Flame casualties.

Non-Canthans without access to the Local Quarter can enter the Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar. You can speed things up considerably if you have Seek out Brother Tosai in your quest log, since this makes the Am Fah in the bazaar friendly. Once inside, proceed north and defeat the Am Fah within the Undercity on your way to the tunnel with the dripping water (near the quest marker on the map). Otherwise, follow the the same steps above.

This method is the most direct, but depends on a well balanced team of heroes and/or henchmen that you will micromanage. Take the north exit from the The Marketplace (toward Bukdek Byway), then head east, cross the first bridge, and head to the Undercity portal (only two foe groups are en route). The Obsidian Flame assassins are allied immediately on entering the Undercity. Instead of leading your allies into danger, flag the heroes ahead to engage foes while the quest holder remains safely behind with the assassins. Repeat this process until you reach the Shadow Blades and defeat them. The Obsidian Flame will say, "Come and face your nightmare, Shadow Blades", even though they are not within aggro range. As soon as the last Shadow Blade dies, the quest log will update and you can return for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10143/sections/notes-1/.text: It helps to eliminate the Afflicted along the route between the two groups before speaking with the Obsidian Flame Assassins, to prevent the assassins from being killed along the way and forcing you to restart the quest.

It can sometimes take several minutes after the first Shadow Blade assassin turns hostile for the rest to follow suit. Backtracking to the Obsidian Flame's rendezvous point may help to resolve this problem when it occurs.
Some of the dialogue is misleading:
All the action takes place in the Undercity, but the Ask dialogue directs you to Shenzun Tunnels.
Although a Shadow Blade Assassin states, "her blade took three of my fingers", he appears to have all ten fingers intact.

quests/quest:gww:13730/sections/objectiv.text: The Centaurs need more gray giant tusks. Collect [3...0] more before returning to the village.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13730/sections/walkthro.text: Any time you slay a Nomad Giant or a Sadistic Giant, they have a small chance of dropping a Giant Tusk. Collect 3 of these tusks and return them to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13730/sections/notes-1/.text: The three Giant Tusks can be collected quite rapidly by going in and out of any portal to The Shattered Ravines with a solo build and repeatedly killing the nearby giants. The 3 giants by the entrance to Lair of the Forgotten are particularly convenient.

The quest log mentions slaying gray giants and collecting gray giant tusks, but what is actually needed are regular giant tusks which drop from Nomad Giants and Sadistic Giants (and not from Awakened Gray Giants).

quests/quest:gww:63656/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Bjora Marches and enlist the help of the tundra wolves, 6 of 6 remaining.
Head south to meet the oncoming Destroyer threat.
See Hogni Truthseeker for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63656/sections/rewards-.text: For 10 minutes your party gains double XP from combat.

quests/quest:gww:63656/sections/walkthro.text: After obtaining this quest from Hogni Truthseeker in Drakkar Lake, you can map travel to either Longeye's Ledge or Gunnar's Hold. If starting from Longeye's Ledge, travel west until you reach the cave of Tundra Wolves (point 1 on the map). If starting from Gunnar's Hold, travel north to the cave. Along with the wolves will be an Alpha Tundra Wolf. You'll need to defeat all of them in battle in order for them to become allies. Travel south to point 2 on the map where you will be faced with four waves of 3-4 Destroyers, in Hard Mode they will be in larger groups of 4-5. Wait for them to come to you in order to buy a little time between each encounter so you can regenerate health and energy. Take care not to enter the portal to Norrhart Domains while fighting, as in that case you will have to begin again by defeating the wolves. Once you defeat the Destroyers, map travel to Olafstead and head to Hogni Truthseeker to obtain your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63656/sections/notes-1/.text: After defeating the Destroyers, any surviving wolves will remain with your party and so can be useful in killing foes in or vanquishing Bjora Marches.

quests/quest:gww:283439/sections/objecti.text: Meet Imperial Guard Lei Jeng in Xaquang Skyway
Find and capture the missing Fire Drakes: [5...0] of 5 remaining.
Prevent the Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood from taking the Drakes.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283439/sections/walkthr.text: Start from Senji's Corner and pick up Lei Jeng a little ways off to the west of the exit. You will see a "Heat Gauge" bar that you will use to find the Missing Fire Drakes. The bar goes from blue to red. When filled, it means your party is very close to a Fire Drake. Note that the gauge actually shows Lei Jeng's proximity, not your character's proximity. You must locate the Fire Drakes in the correct order, as they do not spawn all at once.

Start by heading east towards the corner, where you will find the first Drake. Bring its life down and it will join as an ally. The second drake is towards the northwest of the first. This one will initially run away. Just follow it until it turns hostile, then defeat it. The third drake is past the burnt area filled with Vermin, accompanied by Am Fah that turns hostile as you approach. The fourth drake is east of the third, on the other side of the map. It's accompanied by a group of Jade Brotherhood. The final drake is at the exit to Bukdek Byway, where you will have to fight both Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood. (They will not attack each other).

quests/quest:gww:283439/sections/notes-1.text: The quest will succeed even if your allies die: Lei Jeng and any rescued Fire Drakes will resurrect automatically.
Consider Vanquishing Xaquang Skyway at the same time:
You need to kill most of the local enemies to complete the quest; there will be relatively few left.
Although the 182 foes will be tougher (i.e. Hard mode spawns from Winds of Change) and they will be slightly greater in number, you will have Lei Jeng and rescued Fire Drakes as allies.
Save the fifth Drake until near the end, since this allows you to keep your allies.

quests/quest:gww:283733/sections/objecti.text: Meet Imperial Guard Lei Jeng in Xaquang Skyway
Find and capture the missing Fire Drakes: [5...0] of 5 remaining.
Prevent the Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood from taking the Drakes.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283733/sections/environ.text: While this quest is active, Ghial the Bone Dancer and Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte will not spawn.

quests/quest:gww:283733/sections/notes-1.text: The spawn points of the Missing Fire Drakes in this quest are different from the spawn points of the normal mode version.

quests/quest:gww:283733/sections/shared-.text: Start from Senji's Corner and pick up Lei Jeng a little ways off to the west of the exit. You will see a "Heat Gauge" bar that you will use to find the Missing Fire Drakes. The bar goes from blue to red. When filled, it means your party is very close to a Fire Drake. Start by heading east towards the corner, where you will find the first Drake. Bring its life down and it will join as an ally. The second drake is towards the northwest of the first.
