Save the fifth Drake until near the end, since this allows you to keep your allies.

quests/quest:gww:11406/sections/environm.text: Once this quest is completed, the Old Chest will no longer spawn in Wajjun Bazaar.

quests/quest:gww:11406/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from Nahpui Quarter, follow the upper-level street that is right next to Paomu and Qian. Continue following it down, fighting Am Fah along the way, until you find an Old Chest. Click on it to receive the Tattered Bear quest item. Return it to Kaya for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11406/sections/notes-1/.text: If you have Seek out Brother Tosai active in your Quest Log, you will not have to fight any of the Am Fah at all.

quests/quest:gww:18392/sections/objectiv.text: Acquire a bear pelt. Many bears can be found in Wizard's Folly.
Take the bear pelt to Alison the Tanner in Ashford.
Go to Barradin Estate in Green Hills County and deliver the cloak to Little Thom.

quests/quest:gww:18392/sections/rewards-.text: Battle Axe of Fortitude (Serpent Axe skin)

quests/quest:gww:18392/sections/walkthro.text: You can find Wizard's Folly southwest of Ashford. Follow the road and signs and go through the portal. From there, you will see a snowy area, though don't go there. Instead, you can find Black Bears roaming the green surrounding it. Kill them until one of them drops a bear pelt. Return it to Alison, and you'll be given the cloak. Travel to the Barradin Estate and give it to Thom to be rewarded.

quests/quest:gww:18392/sections/notes-1/.text: The reward wand Cane of Shelter is unique among wands: it consists of the Cane (domination version) and Staff Wrapping of Shelter; normally these items cannot be combined in any way. This wrapping can be salvaged from the cane, but cannot be attached back or replaced with any other staff wrapping.

quests/quest:gww:68712/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the source of the malfunctioning golems.
Defeat the total protection security regulator golem.

quests/quest:gww:68712/sections/walkthro.text: In the first level, you must kill Xien to get the dungeon key. He appears and disappears at several points in the dungeon. Just keep heading towards level two and you'll eventually be allowed to kill him for the key. The boss icons on the map for this level mark the locations of Flame Guardians. For an easier trip, destroy these boss Golems to disable the Fire Dart traps along the way.

To obtain the dungeon key you must destroy the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem. In order to destroy the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem, you need to pick up the nearby Flux Matrix and bring it to the Unstable Magical Energy Storage, then drop it next to the Golem to damage it. This may take 2-3 times until the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem is finally destroyed.

In the third level, destroying one of the the 2 Flame Guardians will disable half the Fire Dart traps around the TPS Regulator Golem. Destroying both Flame Guardians will disable all the Fire Dart traps within the area. To make destroying the TPS Regulator Golem easier, you can attempt to lure the Flame Guardians and/or the TPS Regulator Golem down the stairs of the Fire Dart trapped area. After destroying the TPS Regulator Golem, Oola's Chest will appear within the area of the Fire Dart traps, so it is recommended to destroy the Flame Guardians.
The golems tend to bunch up together since they are warriors and dervishes. Bringing skills that cause area of effect damage is recommended.
Minion masters will find that there are few corpses to animate and Skelk Corrupters use Verata's Aura.
Conditions are prevalent here, especially blindness and burning. Skills to remove conditions are very helpful.

Do not confuse this dungeon with the entry in the Hero's Handbook - which is also called Oola's Lab. Despite having the same name, the handbook requires you to complete the quest The Elusive Golemancer.
Insects and golems are both hostile to each other. You can use this to your advantage.

quests/quest:gww:320074/sections/require.text: A Bastion In the North completed

quests/quest:gww:320074/sections/objecti.text: Find a way into the underground tunnels.
Explore the remainder of this floor.
Exit the tunnels and report to Adept Mullenix.

quests/quest:gww:320074/sections/environ.text: The gate barring the western entrance to the Forsaken Tunnels dungeon opens after completing this quest.

quests/quest:gww:320074/sections/walkthr.text: Exit Piken Square through the northern gate and head northeast until you reach a bridge leading north, then loop around on the west side through some Charr groups and pass under the same bridge. Continue east and a little bit north, then turn southeast across another bridge, and you will come to a Charr campsite. Alternatively, you can reach the campsite by crossing the large southeastern bridge near Piken Square, then following the northern cliff and passing through a Charr-infested ruin, continuing a little further north on the other side. Just to the north of the campsite along a dirt path, you will find a small cave entrance nestled behind a tree and guarded by a lone Cave Elemental. Within that cave is an entrance to the Forsaken Tunnels.

Enter the dungeon and make your way south, defeating enemies along the path. When you reach an oakheart grove lit by blue wisps, your party leader will remark on a patch of blue, crystalline ground. Patches like this are scattered throughout the dungeon and inflict the Crippled and Dazed conditions if stepped on, so be careful to avoid them while you are in danger. Once you reach the southern wall, turn west and you will come to a large area with numerous grawl and some Charr, as well as a Dungeon Lock. Make sure to go relatively close to the lock so that objective 3 updates properly, otherwise you'll need backtrack later. You can avoid most of these enemies if you turn sharply to the north and cross the crystalline ground under a Titan effigy, but make sure that you approach close enough to trigger your character's dialogue.

Continue north along the route towards the quest marker. You will have to defeat or run past one group of four Charr similar to those in the Northlands; be aware that Vanguard Initiate does not function in the dungeon, so you may have less armor than you are used to. At the top of the winding path, you will find a lever which you can pull to open the exit leading back into the Northlands. Make sure the quest is listed as complete in your quest log before you leave; you can then map travel directly back to Piken Square to claim the reward from Adept Mullenix.

quests/quest:gww:320074/sections/notes-1.text: Although this quest can be acquired without Reforged Mode enabled, the quest objectives and dialogue will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.

Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it significantly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
The Forsaken Tunnels cannot be entered if either Across the Wall or A Bastion In the North is active in the map.
Along with some lower level foes, foes here are level 6-8, and never more than 4 in a group.

The quest marker for objective 3 is misleading. The star is close to the exit, but the objective only updates when you get close to the Dungeon Lock. The gate before the exit from the tunnels has no collision, and can be passed through regardless of whether the lever has been pulled. After exiting the Forsaken Tunnels, the quest marker is placed in The Northlands. To complete the quest, travel to Piken Square (pre-Searing) and talk to Adept Mullenix. The player's dialogue lines will trigger multiple times if there is more than one player in the party with the quest active. It is possible to skip the second dialogue if the player goes through the trapped area with crystals to the right. If doing so, quest objectives won't properly update. If the player exits the area through the final portal, all quest objectives will be reset, forcing the player to go all the way back to the first entrance (having to go twice through the tunnels with respawned enemies).

quests/quest:gww:211063/sections/objecti.text: Kill Lord Jadoth in the City of Torc'qua.
*BONUS* Kill Lord Jadoth in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:211063/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 60 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:211063/sections/walkthr.text: In the City of Torc'qua, complete the quest The City of Torc'qua to spawn Lord Jadoth. See Mallyx the Unyielding (quest) for tactics against him.
The Zaishen quest only requires killing Lord Jadoth himself, but doing a bit of extra work to kill his mob will progress the Mallyx the Unyielding quest and reward you with a Torc'qua Chest.

quests/quest:gww:206080/sections/objecti.text: Kill Lord Khobay in the Lake of Fire.
*BONUS* Kill Lord Khobay in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:206080/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:206080/sections/walkthr.text: As per the quest Khobay the Betrayer.

quests/quest:gww:277115/sections/objecti.text: Clear Lornar's Pass in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:277115/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:277115/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Lornar's Pass in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:277115/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.6% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.

The main difficulty is the Stone Summit in a fort on the eastern side of the map. Two particularly large groups are located there, one of which contains two Dolyak Masters and one Dolyak Rider. See the talk page for discussion and tips on how to defeat this mob.

It is recommended to start from Camp Rankor and vanquish Snake Dance and Dreadnought's Drift along the way. While this takes a while, you have a party of 8, making it easier than starting from Beacon's Perch.
The Grawl Crones use Verata's Aura - make sure you have a way to deal with this if your party includes a minion master.
The hidden Frost Wurms are mostly along the path that circles the frozen lake as well as north of the tunnel that connects to that path.
In normal mode, if you enter this area from Beacon's Perch, you will need heroes instead of henchmen, because the latter are too low level compared to the foes here.

When trying to enter the Underworld at the Temple of Grenth, you will be unable to enter with henchmen as they are not Ascended. Likewise if your character is not Ascended, or achieved the Factions (Weh no Su) or Nightfall (Hunted!) equivalents, your character cannot enter.
When you enter the area from Beacon's Perch, the gate back in is closed; however, you can still walk through it.

quests/quest:gww:68711/sections/objectiv.text: Discover the whereabouts of Lady Glaive's crew and free their spirits.
Avenge the crew of the Queen of Fools by destroying Fendi Nin.
See Crewmember Shandra for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:68711/sections/walkthro.text: The first level is self explanatory: find the area map, kill the Cursed Brigand that has the dungeon key and proceed to the second level. Take care to not warp to Gadd's Encampment. If you started from Gadd's Encampment, you will have to fight your way towards the Arbor Bay entrance to get Crewmember Shandra or else the door for the dungeon lock will remain closed.

Kill the Cursed Brigand to the immediate left of the portal. When it dies, a chest spawns with an unlit torch, which you will need for most of this level. Take down the mob that blocks the way to a lit brazier and then light all the flame braziers in the circular graveyard room. Be ready for a large mob of undead and enchanted that spawn in a random spot within the room after the final one ignites; they must be killed before the exit door will open for you. Next, make your way to the tiled room to light the 2 of 4 unlit flame braziers, spawning yet another mob including a Cursed Brigand. Kill the Brigand to get the dungeon key to exit the level (he can be pulled away from his group). Leave the torch behind and head for the exit to the next level.

The third level is similar but with more undead mobs, and careful pulling is recommended here. Once again, you need to light up a series of flame braziers to gain access to the final area. These are farther apart than on the other levels, but can easily be lit without a speed boost if you are careful about clearing any groups of foes in the way.

After entering the level, take out the group of undead and enchanted to your right, blocking the first unlit brazier. Open the nearby chest to get a new torch, light it on the nearby brazier, light the now unblocked brazier, then drop the torch for the moment. There are 2 groups of foes and a patrol along the route to the second unlit canister; pull carefully and take them out one at a time. Recover the torch to light the next set of braziers until you come to the entrance of the large chamber with the final set of containers to be lit.

There are several groups in this chamber, but you only have to take out 3 or 4: a group that spawns near the entryway; a group that spawns near the boss lock; the group that spawns with a Cursed Brigand (who carries the final key); and perhaps one more group. After taking out the group near the entrance, light the two stands to the left and right of the entrance. Then, carefully walk around and between any other mobs to light two braziers up the center of the room and two more in the back. If you have heroes and henchmen, flag them to the back so they do not accidentally aggro any foes and take down the Brigand's group, which has now spawned. From this position, you can also confront the group blocking the boss lock, safely leaving room to maneuver and retreat.

Take the zig-zag corridor protected by Poison Spouts and give your party a chance to heal before killing two Bone Dragons and some undead archers. These are the last of the ordinary groups in the dungeon. The final area contains Fendi Nin and his archer body guards.

Fendi Nin has two forms: as an undead and as a soul. When you kill him in his undead form, a group of Damned Crewmen will replace the Skeleton Archers accompanying him and he will turn into the Soul of Fendi Nin. Keep spread out: the Crewmen will spike clumped party members with Clamor of Souls and Fendi attacks with armor-ignoring area of effect damage; they can quickly wipe an unprepared party, especially in hard mode. Fendi remains in his soul form for approximately half a minute, after which time he will revert back to his undead form and the crewmen will revert back into archers. Repeat the process until the soul form has been destroyed to finish the dungeon.

Note: the Damned Crewmen spawn wherever the Skeleton Archers were, so you can kill the Archers then lure Fendi Nin away from where the Archers were killed and the Crewmen will not aggro when the Soul of Fendi Nin spawns. However, Skeleton Archers spawn on top of Fendi Nin when he reverts to his undead form.

quests/quest:gww:68711/sections/notes-1/.text: Ward of Stability and Ward Against Melee are very useful, since much of the difficulty of the dungeon comes from the knock downs caused by Skeleton Wizards and Zombie Brutes.
Blind is also prevalent; skills such as Sight Beyond Sight and Antidote Signet can help.
Holy damage is highly effective against the Skeletons and Zombies.
Rising Bile, if placed on the soul form before it reverts, will still proc proving an effective way to do damage to the soul form while dealing with the archers and regular form.
Since Zombies are the only fleshy creatures in the dungeon, skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here.
Remember to keep your party spread out before engaging Skeleton Wizards to mitigate their AOE damage.
Consider clearing rooms and areas of all foes before lighting flame braziers.

Lighting all braziers in the southwest room on 3rd level (where you get the last key) opens a secret passage near the very beginning of the 3rd level (Northeast corner of the map). Consider running back to that secret area to collect hidden treasures.

You may not receive credit in your Dungeon Guide for this quest even after talking to the correct NPCs. Fendi Nin might not spawn at all, making it impossible to finish the quest and forcing the player to resign and restart.

quests/quest:gww:25432/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Raitahn Nem inside Minister Cho's Estate.
See Raitahn Nem for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25432/sections/walkthro.text: This quest starts in Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area), from the northeastern exit from Ran Musu Gardens. Outside, you will meet Raitahn Nem who will join your party as an ally. Follow and defend him all the way to the quest marker. Once you have found Jaje Niya, the two will talk out their dialogue, after which you can speak with Raitahn Nem to obtain your reward.
Nem is on a scripted path, so he is leading you, not the other way around. Be prepared for a wandering route.
Keep Nem within earshot at all times. He has been known to disappear entirely if he gets too far from your aggro bubble.
Note that he will sometimes pause and yawn. Sometimes he will run back and forth like he's lost. There's nothing to do but wait for him to get motivated onwards again.
Nem will often ignore enemies in his path until he has aggroed the next group. Be wary of this, and accept that it will happen.

You will be unable to accept the reward for this quest from the version of Nem in Ran Musu Gardens. Either accept the reward when Nem finds his "treasure", or re-enter Minister Cho's Estate while partied with another player who has the quest in their log but has not yet completed it.

quests/quest:gww:25432/sections/notes-1/.text: This is the first of the two attribute point quests available for Factions characters. Completion of these quests is necessary to gain the full 200 attribute points for your character. The second quest is An Unwelcome Guest.
If Raitahn Nem dies it will cause the quest to fail, and you will need to exit the map and restart it.
If you run away from Raitahn Nem and kill enemies too early, he will stop moving, making it impossible to complete the quest.
If you stay too long in the explorable area spawn zone (even if you don't click on him) Raitahn Nem will leave you and do the quest himself causing him to die and the mission to fail.

quests/quest:gww:66371/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Koris Deeprunner when you're ready to begin the hunt for King Hundar's lost treasure.
Raid the ancient cave to recover King Hundar's treasure.
See Koris Deeprunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:66371/sections/walkthro.text: Upon entry, you can take Dwarven Raider from the Beacon of Droknar. The destination is all the way South. You will encounter massive numbers of fragile Snowmens which pose little threat. There are Ice Darts and Ice Spouts spread through the area, avoid them as much as you can.

After a short walk inside, a Mischievous Snowman will send two Ice Boulders your way, dodge them or your party will be killed instantly. The Area Map can be found at the second Beacon of Droknar, but the quest is pretty straight forward and it is not of much use.

At the third Beacon of Droknar, turn east to get the Dungeon Key which drops after defeating the Angry Snowman at the very back of that little room. Procede slowly in there, many Snowmen and Ice Darts stand inside. The darts will deactivate after killing the key holder. Unlock the Dungeon Gate and fight the group immediatly behind it.

Head east, and battle Freezie and its large Snowmen army. This boss will drop the Boss Key, which opens the door right behind. Enter this chamber to trigger the final dialogue which spawns the Chest of Wintersday Past to collect your rewards.

quests/quest:gww:66371/sections/notes-1/.text: Mid-way through the quest, you will find Wintersday Moa along the western side of the cave before the dungeon gate.

This is probably the best place to farm Deldrimor points. Large amounts of points can be farmed from here, as there are 170 enemies in a relatively small area. The mobs are also level 15 and relatively easy to kill.
To repeat the quest, you must zone out then back again after accepting the quest reward. For instance, changing districts after receiving the reward.

In normal mode, a typical run takes 10-15 minutes, and yields approximately 1000 Dwarven Reputation points. In hard mode, a typical run takes slightly longer, and yields approximately 50% more Dwarven Reputation points.
Sometimes Koris Deeprunner will get stuck at a locked chest, making the quest impossible to complete.

quests/quest:gww:25683/sections/requirem.text: Telling Dzaga that Kehtmah sent you during initial dialogue
Mutually exclusive with Money on the Side

quests/quest:gww:25683/sections/objectiv.text: Go with Dzaga and his band of smugglers to the rendezvous.
Break up the deal and hand out some Sunspear justice.
Kill Dzaga and Sakku, and put an end to this smuggling ring!

quests/quest:gww:25683/sections/instruct.text: "Now is your chance to prove yourself a loyal Sunspear. Infiltrate Dzaga's gang and follow him to the rendezvous. When you get there, use the advantage of surprise to break up the deal and bring the smugglers some Sunspear justice It's your choice. Remain loyal to the Sunspear cause, or go along with Dzaga's Gang and make some money on the side."

quests/quest:gww:15551/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the Luxon Supplies to Quartermaster Hector

quests/quest:gww:15551/sections/walkthro.text: You need to get supplies to Quartermaster Hector, near the entrance to Cavalon. Kurzick NPCs will ambush you as you go there. Once you reach the Quartermaster, he will be attacked by two Scuttle Fish, so make sure to kill all potential enemies in the area before reaching the Quartermaster.

quests/quest:gww:15551/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest is useful for increasing vanquish numbers with easy kills for the area.
The Kurzick equivalent is Kurzick Supply Lines.

quests/quest:gww:9625/sections/objective.text: Seek out a homeless Canthan in need.
Find another homeless Canthan in need.
See Officer Chitaro for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9625/sections/walkthrou.text: Once in Bukdek Byway, you have to take the Elonian Mirrors to the Homeless Canthans in order. The locations of the Homeless Canthans are on the map to the right.

quests/quest:gww:203643/sections/objecti.text: Kill Magmus in the Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203643/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203643/sections/walkthr.text: He appears in Heart of the Shiverpeaks on your character's second trip through. Your character must have completed the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest to reach Magmus. Make sure no one in your party has that quest active, or Cyndr the Mountain Heart will spawn instead.

quests/quest:gww:278410/sections/objecti.text: Clear Magus Stones on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:278410/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:278410/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Magus Stones on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:278410/sections/target-.text: Discounting quest influences, it has been reported to range from 367 to 409.
The groups of Wind Riders can interrupt most skill usage and apply heavy area of effect damage with Cry of Frustration. Try to spread out before engaging to minimize the shutdown.
Beware of hidden Arachnids when you traverse narrow tunnels or valley passes.

The density of mobs in the area makes it possible to complete this vanquish while under the effects of a single Hunt Rampage bonus, which would allow one to earn approximately 12,000 Asura reputation points per hour.

quests/quest:gww:276176/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Maishang Hills in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276176/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276176/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Maishang Hills in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276176/sections/target-.text: The Stolen Eggs primary quest will lead characters from Cavalon through this area on the way to Gyala Hatchery.
This area is the northeastern-most area of the Jade Sea region, hence it is initially accessible only via the Archipelagos in the southwest.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
Attack the Kurzicks!
Challenge of Strength
In the Army (Luxon)
Scouting Maishang Hills
Stolen Eggs
If you come here from Cavalon via Archipelagos, note that there is no priest with bounty at the shrine at the Archipelagos exit.
Vanquishing: 150–274 foes.
Scouting Maishang Hills spawns Kurzick groups, making it much longer.
Enter from one of the three outposts to get the blessing for vanquishing. The shrines nearest the Archipelagos exit have no Kurzick or Luxon Priests.
There are 5 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of 3 or 4 of them):
The path heading south from Eredon Terrace.
The path heading southwest from Eredon Terrace.
Southeastern path from the Balthazar shrine.
Southwestern path from the Balthazar shrine.
The narrow path to the west of the high bridge near the center.
When vanquishing, remember to visit both areas of sea; the one near Cavalon has 1 group, while the sea area near Gyala Hatchery has 3.
Exploring this area will contribute approximately 3.1% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
The resurrection shrine near Eredon Terrace has both the statues of Dwayna and Balthazar overlapping. Only the Champion of Balthazar can appear.
de:Maishang-Hügel

quests/quest:gww:277328/sections/objecti.text: Clear Majesty's Rest in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:277328/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:277328/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Majesty's Rest in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:277328/sections/target-.text: From Kryta, either leave from Temple of the Ages and head west through the Black Curtain and Talmark Wilderness or from Fisherman's Haven and travel north through Stingray Strand and Tears of the Fallen, then northwest through Talmark Wilderness.
From the Maguuma Jungle, leave from the Wilds or Druid's Overlook and head east/northeast (respectively) through Sage Lands.
Enter the Mausoleum (only during Commandeering a Mortal Vessel)
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 44–85 foes. All the visible enemies are concentrated in the eastern half, so it is recommended to start from Temple of the Ages and approach from Talmark Wilderness.
If you avoid triggering too many popups, you can realistically complete the vanquish with around 55 kills.
This explorable area is home to Rotscale.
The popups on the eastern side include Reed Stalkers in the water, hidden Grasping Ghouls near undead spawns, and one or two spots with Fog Nightmares and Smoke Phantoms.
The western side has close to a dozen spots of hidden spiders (where there are trees overhead) and devourers (in the dry brown areas).

Although Majesty’s Rest is considered to be in Kryta, it is divided into a Maguuma Jungle area and a Krytan area, each with their own typical vegetation, landscape and foes. Chests in the Maguuma Jungle area will be Krytan Chests, but Maguuma Keys can drop from foes there.
Your party gains three Mad King's Guards as allies during Commandeering a Mortal Vessel.

quests/quest:gww:25276/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out a suitable target and use the Signet of Capture to gain a skill.
See Magi Malaquire for your reward.
You receive a Signet of Capture after accepting this quest for the first time.

quests/quest:gww:25276/sections/walkthro.text: There is no real "set" course for this quest; simply find a boss, kill it, and use the Signet of Capture to capture a skill from it. This may take some time, as you are only able to "capture" a skill from a boss with the same profession as your primary or secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:25276/sections/notes-1/.text: When progressing through the campaign, bosses generally do not have elite skills to capture until reaching the Crystal Desert.
Some skills (that have not been unlocked on an account previously) are only available later in the Prophecies Campaign from skill vendors but can be captured much earlier from bosses.

quests/quest:gww:19398/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.
Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.
Go to The Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.
Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.
Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.
Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.
Seek out and destroy Mallyx the Unyielding in his Ebony Citadel.
See High Priest Zhellix for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:19398/sections/walkthro.text: The quest consists of four separate parts done in four separate zones of the Domain of Anguish. You may enter any of the four areas in any order to complete the quest. Completing an area and killing the Overlord in the area updates the quest and causes a chest to appear which drops Anguish Gemstones for each party member (see notes below). For further details, see the articles on the individual quests and overlords.
Lord Jadoth
In the City of Torc'qua, complete the quest The City of Torc'qua to spawn Lord Jadoth.

Four groups of Margonites will spawn outside the gates to the Stygian Veil. The first will rush to the city gates, and does not have any boss. It may be easily defeated by having the players to stand on the hill right inside the city, and using a puller to lure the enemies so they may be attacked from above.

The second and the third groups will each have a boss, Shaunur the Divine and Turep, Maker of Orphans. These groups are also significantly larger than the previous one and may pose a threat to players who engage them head on. After both groups have been destroyed, Lord Jadoth himself and his group will step forward, standing in front of the gate to the Stygian Veil. Those enemies have two Margonite monks, and so may be hard to defeat.

A strategy to defeat the three boss groups is by forcing them to split. Each of the three groups moves as a single whole, so directly pulling them will result in an entire group following. However, if players stay within the walls of the city, at the eastern position of the map, it's possible to use a Longbow to attack and so pull the enemies. Some will try to hit the players through the walls, while others will move all the way around the city gate and so engage the players directly - when that happens, if the players retreat, all enemies will try to move directly back to their original position, and those who are within the city walls will be separated from those outside. This will end in smaller groups that are easier to defeat.
When all groups are completely wiped, the quest will update and a Torc'qua Chest will spawn, containing Margonite Gemstones for everyone.

In HM, the combination of Repressive Energy and Quickening Zephyr results in severe energy denial. It would be advisable to take away caster Heroes' weapons (wands and staves should be removed, they should ideally have only a focus item) to prevent them from auto-attacking and disabling particularly energy intensive skills. For those who are running a BiP hero, disabling Protective Was Kaolai and Life (commonly included in a BiP hero build) helps. The player should try to engage outside the range of Quickening Zephyr as much as possible. Martial professions that rely on energy, Assassin's in particular, will have a difficult time due to the nature of energy denial.
The Greater Darkness
In Ravenheart Gloom, complete the quest chain To the Rescue! → The Rifts Between Us → Deathbringer Company, after which The Greater Darkness will spawn and taunt you.

When moving closer to its initial spawn point, two of the Darknesses will spawn. All three are easily defeated, but killing the group will spawn five more of the Darknesses, and whenever one of these the Darknesses is killed, it spawns five Earth Tormentors.

Once you kill the three initial darknesses, run away to break aggro (leaving minions/spirits behind will help). The five the Darknesses that spawn are separate groups and can be pulled individually. By doing so, you will only face five Earth Tormentors at a time. A well-timed area of effect snare or Aegis will render them mostly harmless, allowing you to decimate the group before it hurts.
After killing all 33 foes, the quest will update and a Ravenheart Chest will spawn, containing Torment Gemstones for everyone.
The Fury
In The Foundry of Failed Creations, complete the quest chain The Foundry of Failed Creations → Foundry Breakout to spawn The Fury.

He will be accompanied by several mesmer and elementalist Guardians of Komalie and two Margonite Anur Ki. They will spawn at their usual location as soon as the quest reward for Foundry Breakout is accepted - make sure General Yendzarsh is nowhere near their spawn point when finishing the quest, or they'll spawn right on top of you.
The group is easier to kill if it's split with careful pulling. Spread out to avoid their AoE damage. The elementalists (including The Fury) are susceptible to Pain Inverter.
When both the Fury and his group are destroyed, the quest will update and a Titan Chest will spawn, containing Titan Gemstones for everyone.
The Dreadspawn Maw
In the Stygian Veil, complete the quest chain Breaching the Stygian Veil → Brood Wars to spawn the Dreadspawn Maw.

She is not a targetable foe, but can be killed by destroying the six Smothering Tendrils that spawn along with her. The Dreadspawn Maw will have a progress indicator that shows her strength. Killing a Tendril will remove 1/12th of the bar and killing the Stygian mob that spawns afterwards will remove an additional 1/12th. All in all, all six Tendrils and their spawns must be destroyed for the quest to update. Killing a Smothering Tendrils also spawns a number of Torment Claws which are not required, but may get in the way if left alive.

Kill the Smothering Tendrils one at a time, then retreat to safe grounds before dispatching the Stygian mob. Engaging the Stygians amidst the Torment Claws is not recommended. Clear out any claws that are in the way before proceeding to the next Tendril.

If you have trouble retreating through the claws, retreat early and leave a dedicated party member behind to finish the Tendril - he will likely die, but everyone else is safe. Bring Rebirth and a means to remove Death Penalty when using this tactic.
After the Dreadspawn Maw is dead, the quest will update and a Stygian Chest will spawn, containing Stygian Gemstones for everyone.
The Ebony Citadel
The last part of the quest is at the same time the Elite Mission of the Nightfall campaign.
For all further information, see The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.

quests/quest:gww:19398/sections/notes-1/.text: All members of your party have a chance of getting Primeval Armor Remnants in their inventory while completing the quest.

Doing the four sub-quests successfully in one run, as opposed to doing each separately, causes the chests that appear once the areas are completed to drop an increasing number of gems. For example: the first chest drops one gem for each party member, next chest drops two gems per party member, third chest drops three and fourth chest drops four. These numbers are doubled in hard mode.

quests/quest:gww:277617/sections/objecti.text: Clear Mamnoon Lagoon in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:277617/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:277617/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Mamnoon Lagoon in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:277617/sections/target-.text: Exit from Druid's Overlook. Travel west through Sage Lands. The secondary quest Mysterious Message will take you here.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Hidden Life Pods are scattered around the area.

There are several large groups of Wind Riders that circle the lagoon; some patrol clockwise and some counterclockwise. Keep an eye on patrols to avoid being caught between two groups and spread out to avoid their area of effect interrupts.

quests/quest:gww:63339/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Artificer Mullenix when you are ready to duel with Knorr Oaken.
Stand as the champion for the Eye of the North and defeat Knorr Oaken for the sake of all humanity!
See Artificer Mullenix for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63339/sections/walkthro.text: Mano a Norn-o/Guide for a detailed walkthrough

quests/quest:gww:63339/sections/notes-1/.text: Knorr is not hostile during the initial 30 second countdown, allowing him time to insult you.
You will be returned to the Eye of the North 10 seconds after winning.
You can turn north and enter the Hall of Monuments: there is no portal and you will see all 4 tapestries (regardless of how many your character has displayed).
You can also win if you keep Knorr at less than 50% health for around 2 minutes.

quests/quest:gww:25665/sections/objectiv.text: Map travel to Kamadan and speak to Alekaya.

quests/quest:gww:25665/sections/notes-1/.text: To complete this quest you do not actually have to map travel to Kamadan, walking to Kamadan and speaking to Alekaya will also complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25665/sections/instruct.text: "Hey, guess what? My mom showed me how to map travel the other day! It's amazing! I just look at my map and select a place I've already been, and I go there instantly! It only works on cities I've marked with a big gold and green symbol, but once I start going to other towns and outposts I'll end up finding more places I can travel to instantly. I just saw you come out of town, so you should have a marker for town on your map. You should click on it and tell my mom thanks for inventing map travel!"

quests/quest:gww:280802/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Marga Coast in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280802/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280802/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Marga Coast in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280802/sections/target-.text: This area lies northwest from Yohlon Haven, the first outpost of Kourna that characters will arrive at, after completion of the Consulate Docks mission. The next primary quest from there, Hunted!, will lead characters through this area.
The Kournan military soldiers are of two different levels. Level 16 soldiers are found outside the fort; while level 20 soldiers are found inside or near the fort.
Along the beach to the southeast, there are several groups of hidden Frigid Skale. Proceed along the beach slowly.
There are also several hidden insect groups.
Vanquishing the area with the Feeding Frenzy quest active can be helpful, since your party will gain the help of Toma, a level 22 drake that can instantly kill enemies with low health.
When missing some foes, take a look to the southwest and southeast of the Fortress. Some Kournan groups have a long patrol area.
Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 2.9% towards the Elonian Cartographer title; portal jumping allows for an additional 0.1–0.2% leeway (see below).
The portal to Sunspear Sanctuary is bugged — it allows heroes to walk through it without bouncing (as they do elsewhere).

quests/quest:gww:25474/sections/objectiv.text: Follow Brother Tosai to the Undercity.
Follow Brother Tosai through the Undercity to meet your new master.
See Brother Tosai for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25474/sections/walkthro.text: Follow Brother Tosai through the Undercity until you reach the spot marked on the mission map. Once there, a group of afflicted will spawn. Defeat this group and others in the area. Eventually 2 or 3 smaller groups will spawn and attack from both directions. After defeating these groups a final group with 3 afflicted warriors and an assassin will appear. Defeat them to remove the effect of Chalice of Corruption and finish the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25474/sections/notes-1/.text: Once this quest is activated via drinking from the Chalice of Corruption, you will have a -2 health degeneration and a visual effect identical to disease until this quest is complete. The effect persists even in outposts, although you won't actually lose health in outposts. Abandoning this quest will also remove the effects of the chalice.
Does not work while you have quest "Mayhem in the Market" active. Tosai will not spawn near Master Togo as it is a Primary Quest.
After finishing this quest the Am Fah are once again hostile against you.

During Winds of Change, you can potentially overaggro at the fight location, so either pull the Am Fah away to kill them, or alternatively, move close enough to Brother Tosai to trigger the Afflicted attack, and let the Am Fah kill the Afflicted.
The last group of Am Fah may get stuck on the bridge to the south east of the battle area. In this case, you have to kill them there to trigger Brother Tosai's final speech.

quests/quest:gww:18834/sections/objectiv.text: Check on Pelei on the Plains of Jarin and see if she's safe.
Help Pelei by slaying 10 Killer Iboga. You have slain [0...10] of 10 Killer Iboga.
Inform Pelei that the area is now safe from Killer Iboga.

quests/quest:gww:18834/sections/walkthro.text: From Kamadan, leave for the Plains of Jarin. Grab the plant bounty from the Sunspear Scout outside of Kamadan so you can receive the double experience points for the plants and work on your Sunspear rank. Head west until you reach Pelei, talk to her, then turn south and kill the Killer Iboga (you can use the Ctrl key to locate them). Return to Pelei, and then go back to Kamadan to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18834/sections/notes-1/.text: 16 to 20 Killer Iboga spawn when you enter the area. If you killed too many of them before talking to Pelei, you will have to go back to Kamadan and re-enter the area to kill the last few you need.

You can use this quest to farm sunspear points, Iboga Petals, and Sentient Roots. Even after killing the required 10 Killer Ibogas, the plants will continue to spawn in the area until you talk to Pelei again to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:9904/sections/objective.text: Find Officer Chitaro and speak to him about medical supplies for the refugees.

quests/quest:gww:9904/sections/walkthrou.text: This quest requires little to no fighting and is a simple case of talking to another NPC once the quest has been obtained. It is quickest to start from Nahpui Quarter. Otherwise you will have to start from the Marketplace (this will take less time if you have the Seek out Brother Tosai quest active.)
Head west from Guardsman Pah, then head down the steps and around the coastline to Officer Chitaro. Two small groups of Am Fah may spawn along the way.

quests/quest:gww:276561/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Mehtani Keys in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276561/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276561/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Mehtani Keys in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276561/sections/target-.text: Characters will likely come here for the first time as part of the primary quest Isle of the Dead, which can be acquired after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.
Secondary quests that lead to this area from other locations include the Cyclone Palace, Corsair Invasion, and Double Dog Dare.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.3% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
Anti-melee skills are useful here as there are many warriors and dervishes in this area.

There are several random spots of hidden mandragors: northeast from the exit into Kodlonu Hamlet, the first island southwest from that exit, bottom of the bridge leading to the northern island, and the northeastern corner.
The Lone Raider quest gives you four additional allies that could be somewhat helpful to vanquishing this area.
The Cyclone Palace quest in particular will produce a lot more skale spawns.
The resurrection shrine that summons Lyssa's Muse in the village on the northernmost island has a statue depicting Balthazar.

quests/quest:gww:280880/sections/objecti.text: Clear Melandru's Hope in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280880/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280880/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Melandru's Hope in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280880/sections/target-.text: This area is largely optional if not for the Jade Quarry primary quest that leads to Jade Flats (Kurzick). It's also possible that one may be following the secondary quests of Rhythm Drinker Drum, The Beak of Darkness, Artistic Endeavors, or Charting the Forests when one first enters this area.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
Artistic Endeavors (adds a few additional Dredge foes)
Rhythm Drinker Drum (adds a single Drinker foe)
Securing Echovald Forest (adds lots of Luxon foes)
The bosses Nundak The Archer and Rot Foulbelly are part of the same mob and can't be pulled separately.
Exploring this area will contribute approximately 3.3% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
There are several hidden foes around Chkkr Brightclaw and Byzzr Wingmender that appear once each boss is aggro'd.

quests/quest:gww:25457/sections/objectiv.text: Hunt down and kill the melodic gaki. Retrieve its melodic horn and return to Vasili Lutgardis.
See Vasili Lutgardis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25457/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from House zu Heltzer, travel south from the portal to Ferndale. You should meet some Mantis and Dredge before seeing the Gaki just south of the resurrection shrine. You should be able to kill the Melodic Gaki and take its horn without aggroing the surrounding wardens. Take the horn back to House zu Heltzer to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25457/sections/notes-1/.text: You may wish to also have the quest The Experimental Weaponsmith active while performing this quest since both quests take you to the same general area in Ferndale.

quests/quest:gww:25688/sections/requirem.text: Koss Goes Recruiting neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:25688/sections/objectiv.text: Escort Melonni to meet her contact in the Sunward Marches.

quests/quest:gww:25688/sections/walkthro.text: The easiest way to do this quest is starting from Dajkah Inlet. Walk out to the north where the boss Eshim Mindclouder is located. You might be able to run in and update the quest without fighting that group. Return to Sunspear Sanctuary once the quest updates itself as completed.

quests/quest:gww:25688/sections/notes-1/.text: Dunkoro also offers the quest Koss Goes Recruiting. You can only choose one of the 2 quests, since the other will then become unavailable.
After completion of this quest, Jehrono will appear in the Command Post as an additional material trader NPC.

Although Jehrono is labeled as a rare material trader, he acts like a normal material trader. However, this bears no significance to the function of the Command Post since both types of material traders are already present.

quests/quest:gww:14227/sections/objectiv.text: Lead Melonni through the Marga Coast as she attempts to commune with the natural world.
Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the pond.
Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the rock formation.
Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the dying tree.
See Elder Jonah for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14227/sections/walkthro.text: Elder Jonah can be found at point J on the quest map just outside the southwest exit from the Sunspear Sanctuary. Go with Melonni to each of the quest points. At each one, groups of Corrupted Natures will attack. These groups are small and should pose no threat to a full party. A new group will spawn only after completely destroying the previous one. The final group also contains an Infectious Nightmare.

quests/quest:gww:14227/sections/notes-1/.text: From the Wandering Priest at point W on the quest map, you can obtain the Kournan Bounty blessing which gives you double XP from Kournan soldiers and 4 Sunspear promotion points for every Kournan soldier your slay. x2 in hard mode.
Spawns in Marga Coast will be different from normal when Melonni is in your party unless all players in your party have finished this quest.

quests/quest:gww:15063/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver the strongbox to Captain Greywind in the Ascalon Settlement.

quests/quest:gww:15063/sections/walkthro.text: After getting the quest and the Settlement's Strongbox from Bodrus the Outfitter, exit from Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head northwest to the Ascalon Settlement. Speak with Captain Greywind to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25413/sections/objectiv.text: Complete the Defense Against Hexes course.
See Headmaster Kaa for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25413/sections/walkthro.text: This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.

quests/quest:gww:25413/sections/notes-1/.text: Although you don't have to do the Advanced Defense Techniques, it is useful to do so, as you will gain a mesmer skill Clumsiness upon quest acceptance.

quests/quest:gww:25284/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the ruins of Ashford and defeat Ignis Phanaura.
Return to Vassar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25284/sections/walkthro.text: You will find Ignis Phanaura just south of the Sardelac Sanitarium alongside two additional gargoyles. When accompanied by henchmen or in a group, they shouldn't pose much of a threat. Beware of Ignis's Chaos Storm, which can deal a significant hit to both your Health and Energy over time. When you see him cast it, change your position to avoid the area damage.

quests/quest:gww:25284/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with Trying Times as Ignis will be along the way.

quests/quest:gww:10068/sections/objectiv.text: Find the author of the message.
See Great Reaver Rixor for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10068/sections/walkthro.text: Start from the Leviathan Pits, and head into Gyala Hatchery, then make your way to the green island found just to the south of the Gyala Hatchery (outpost). On the island, you will find Samti Kohlreg at his lonely vigil. Speak to Samti to update your quest then take the followup quest from him.
Map back to Seafarer's Rest to claim your reward from Rixor.

quests/quest:gww:25461/sections/objectiv.text: See Samti Kohlreg for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25461/sections/walkthro.text: You'll need to take a little trip round the Jade Sea to find each of the 3 message bottles in the explorable areas listed in the quest dialogue:
Maishang Hills (Year 2) - This bottle is just outside the Gyala Hatchery (outpost), step carefully and avoid the Kappa patrols.
Archipelagos (Year 3) - This bottle is due south of Cavalon in the middle of a group of Naga

Silent Surf (Year 4) - This bottle is due east of Unwaking Waters (Luxon), be careful at this bottle, since patrol routes for groups of Saltspray Dragons and Rockhide Dragons cross near it. Move carefully and you can probably avoid them.
When all 3 bottles have been collected, map-travel to the Leviathan Pits and return to Samti, following the same route you used to find him in the preceding quest.

quests/quest:gww:26070/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars factions on the account
Plague in Cantha neither active nor completed
Defend North Kryta Province not active

quests/quest:gww:26070/sections/objectiv.text: Find Mhenlo in North Kryta Province to learn more about the letter he has received.
Speak with Jiaju Tai to book passage to Cantha.
Speak with Dockhand Quangnai to learn more about the situation in Cantha.

quests/quest:gww:26070/sections/walkthro.text: Travel north through the portal into North Kryta Province. Mhenlo will be waiting for you just outside of town. Mhenlo will send you to the docks inside Lion's Arch to speak with Jiaju Tai to book passage to Cantha.
Your ship docks at Bejunkan Pier in Cantha. Immediately after getting off the ship you will find Dockhand Quangnai. He has your reward, a message from Mhenlo and another quest to give you.

quests/quest:gww:26070/sections/notes-1/.text: Mhenlo won't spawn with Evil Residents or Evil Residents Code: Harmonica in the quest log.
This quest unlocks the Kaineng Center port (once you have traveled to Bejunkan Pier).
Having this quest active or completed will make Plague in Cantha unavailable.

While walking along Bejunkan Pier, there are two level 20 monsters that attack the party. At the end of the battle, the conversation continues, then the allies in the party wave just before entering Kaineng Center.

Whenever a character who has not visited Cantha enters Lion's Arch, unless this quest or Plague in Cantha is in their log, the message "To unlock travel to Cantha, accept the quest Mhenlo's Request from Firstwatch Sergio" will appear.
See Campaign travel for additional information.

quests/quest:gww:17616/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Sergeant Clark in Regent Valley.
Escort Sergeant Clark back to Warmaster Grast.

quests/quest:gww:17616/sections/walkthro.text: Warmaster Grast is located close to Ascalon City, talk to him and then head south-east to Regent Valley. Enter Regent Valley and you will see Sergeant Clark; talk to him and return to Old Ascalon explorable area. Sergeant Clark will be awaiting you with two or three Ascalonian Guards, and will start to follow you when approached. Escort Clark back to Warmaster Grast. Ensure his safety; he is a warrior and only has one skill, Healing Signet. Only Clark needs to survive. There are several Devourer pop-ups, so try not to over-aggro.

quests/quest:gww:17616/sections/notes-1/.text: The Ascalon Guards follow Sergeant Clark, not the player. If Clark dies, the guards will no longer follow the party.
The additional allies can make this quest useful for vanquishing Old Ascalon and Regent Valley.

quests/quest:gww:13724/sections/objectiv.text: Find Minaar Stonesledge in Iron Horse Mine.
Escort Minaar back to Traveler's Vale.
Return to Rangil Ironbow for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13724/sections/walkthro.text: Once you obtain the quest, go into the Iron Horse Mine and turn right. Follow the quest marker to Minaar Stonesledge and try not to lure too many mobs at once — the Summit Beastmasters use Giant Stomp which knocks down anyone within earshot range. Once you arrive at Minaar, lead him back to the portal but do not enter it. Wait for the quest to update and then go through to see Rangil for your reward. Alternatively, clearing the path from the portal to Minaar of enemies before interacting with him will remove all risks of him dying.

quests/quest:gww:13724/sections/notes-1/.text: Despite the quest tracker indicating you should zone into Traveler's Vale to continue the quest, doing so before triggering Minaar's dialogue will revert the quest to finding him in Iron Horse Mines.
Minaar is not actually found in the mine, but rather the Ettin cave east of it.
Before heading out to take this quest, take Helping the Dwarves from Grand Mason Stonecleaver in Yak's Bend, as it leads directly to Rangil Ironbow.

quests/quest:gww:25312/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Iron Horse Mine and kill Ore Darkwhip.
Deliver the war machine plans to Rangil Ironbow.

quests/quest:gww:25312/sections/walkthro.text: Go back into Iron Horse Mine and take the same path you took to reach Minaar. Continue on past the cave and you will find Ore Darkwhip just on the other end of the mining area. He'll drop the war machine plans when you kill him. Grab them and take them back to Rangil.

quests/quest:gww:25312/sections/notes-1/.text: If you attempt this quest with multiple players, only one "war machine plans" is required to complete the quest. Have the player that picked up the plans talk to Rangil and everyone can complete the quest.
The Battle Axe given as a reward uses the Dwarven Axe skin and deals slashing damage.

quests/quest:gww:281481/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Mineral Springs in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281481/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281481/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Mineral Springs in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281481/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.

Vanquishing: 182–241 foes. There are hidden Azure Shadows in the cave leading towards the Ancient Seer, hidden Frost Wurms at Maw the Mountain Heart's spawn point, and an occasional hidden Juniper Bark near Pinesouls.
Do not bunch up while engaging the Avicara, or the Avicara Fierce can quickly decimate the party.
The Avicara are hostile to the few Tundra Giants found here.

Technically, there are fewer foes during Defend Droknar's Forge, but due to the Titans that spawn from other Titans, there are more foes to kill. The extra Titan spawns do not count towards vanquish completion.

During Defend Droknar's Forge, the spawn locations of the Avicara bosses are fixed. In the northern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Hyl Thunderwing, Nhy Darkclaw, Wyt Sharpfeather. In the southern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Ryk Arrowwing, Syr Honorcrest, Myd Springclaw.
The Avicara and Titans are hostile to each other.
A main attraction of Mineral Springs is Lyssa's ice cave to the north east. This cave is the only place where the Icy Dragon Sword can be found through monster drops.
See Gift of the Traveler given by Nicholas the Traveler for the inscribable version.
The cave also contains an Ice Beast which drops the Spectral Essence. This can be given to the Seer at the end of the ice cave to infuse a character's armor.

The last point of interest in the cave is a broken shrine to Lyssa. Morale Boosts and Holy Blessing can be acquired from the statue of Lyssa. Icy Ground is not inflicted by walking on the ice in the cave.

For faster and more efficient skill capping, do not go to the closest group. Head north/northeast to where there are 3 Avicara spawns. There you will have 3 of the 6 possible bosses, and thus a greater chance to find the one you need. You may also go to the nearest spawn and hold the hotkey to highlight enemies to check if the boss is there. If it is not, just run back to Tasca's Demise and back to Mineral Springs. Remember not to resign or you'll have to cross Tasca's Demise again.

quests/quest:gww:203908/sections/objecti.text: Neutralize the danger to Minister Cho.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203908/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 15 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203908/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Minister Cho's Estate mission.

quests/quest:gww:276518/sections/objecti.text: Clear Minister Cho's Estate on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276518/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276518/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Minister Cho's Estate on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276518/sections/target-.text: The only entrance is from Ran Musu Gardens.

If Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate has been completed and Memories of Purity is not active, all spawns will be replaced by Scavenger type enemies. It is recommended to activate the quest when vanquishing the area.
These quests affect the spawns in this area: Lost Treasure and Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate.
Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 2.6% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
There are no bosses in this area, so avoid skills that recharge with Morale Boost (i.e. Resurrection Signet and Sunspear Rebirth Signet).
Since you can only have a party of four, having a spirit spammer helps.
There is a chain of islands to the northeast with foes that cannot easily be seen from the beach. Likewise, there are more foes inside the caverns to the southeast.

quests/quest:gww:17655/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy a suitable target and use the Signet of Capture to acquire a skill.
See Minister Jaisan for your reward
You receive a Signet of Capture after accepting this quest for the first time.

quests/quest:gww:17655/sections/walkthro.text:
To use a Signet of Capture which you received from Minister Jaisan, you need to equip it on the skill bar and find a suitable powerful foe, or in other words, a boss with corresponding profession. Many bosses can be found in three explorable areas which are accessible after you have arrived at Kaineng: Bukdek Byway, Wajjun Bazaar and The Undercity. Also, bosses with all Factions professions can be met while doing the mission Vizunah Square. You may capture any skill from a boss, however, capturing an elite skill is preferable because you get the additional experience and powerful skill as well.

 Upon capturing this skill, you will have completed the quest. Then you see Minister Jaisan; as your reward, you get a second signet of capture, 2,500 Experience and you may keep the skill you captured in order to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:295336/sections/objecti.text: Arrive at the rally before the Ministry of Purity and warn Xin Ji of their attack.
Escort Xin Ji and the other demonstrators to Xaquang Skyway.
See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:295336/sections/shared-.text: Your goal is to successfully escort the demonstrators out of harm's way. However, the quest will succeed as long as Xin Ji survives.

As soon as you enter the zone, head towards Xin Ji to trigger the initial dialogue. Once that ends, start moving towards each successive quest marker; these lead you through the most efficient escape route. If you start right away, you can evade the ministry troops even after they start following you. Along the way, reinforcements will spawn, but as long as you keep moving, you will be able to lead Xin Ji to safety.

As soon as you reach the bridge near the Xaquang Skyway portal, the demonstrators are removed from your party window, which completes the quest. You can /resign or map out or wait to see the cinematic, which begins after the last line of dialogue.

If you have trouble, you can distract your pursuers by flagging heroes or dropping spirits behind you. You can also bring speed boosts that affect allies, notably "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and/or "Incoming!".

quests/quest:gww:25617/sections/objectiv.text: Defend the Centaur Village. You have [5...0] groups of Kournan troops remaining.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25617/sections/environm.text: Until this quest is completed, the Wandering Priest at the Resurrection Shrine nearest Mirza (that gives the Monster Hunt bounty) will not spawn and the Melandru's Watcher will also not spawn when kneeling at that Resurrection Shrine.

quests/quest:gww:25617/sections/walkthro.text: You will need to rezone if you just received the reward for Centaur Concerns before you can receive this quest.

As you come up to Mirza, some non-hostile Kournans nearby are already speaking to Mirza and threatening the other centaurs, as they challenge the Centaurs, the Kournan Phalanx will execute a centaur that they are holding hostage.

When the kournans stop talking, Mirza will offer this quest. Note that hostile soldiers will start to arrive shortly after, even if you haven't taken the quest, although it is still possible to accept it from Mirza in the middle of the battle.

The Kournan soldiers will attack from both the north and south sides of Mirza's position, 3 small groups to the south, and 2 larger groups from the north. The second group from the north will have the Kournan commander, Captain Kuruk with them.
Do not leave Mirza unguarded, since he will not move from his position during the attack, and will die easily if left alone.

quests/quest:gww:25704/sections/requirem.text: Mutu, the Oldest Child quest not active or completed
Jedur, the Youngest Child quest not active or completed

quests/quest:gww:25704/sections/objectiv.text: Search the ruins of Fahranur to find where Nehbawa Wahmeh has hidden the family inheritance.
Misela Wahmeh must survive to recover her inheritance.
See Healer Zenwa for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25704/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, accept Zenwa's offer to transport you to the ruins of Fahranur. Once there, fight your way through the undead hordes to Nehbawa Wahmeh's inheritance, which is marked by the compass point.
Be careful walking around corners. Giant bells drop from above to crush the unwary.
If using a survivor character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before protection on an AL 40 target.
Once you make it to the inheritance, Misela will retrieve it, and you will be transported back to Issnur Isles.
If you are finding this quest difficult, start in Kodlonu Hamlet, which allows up to 8 party members and provides access to level 15 henchmen.

quests/quest:gww:25475/sections/walkthro.text: Aiko can be found in the southwestern part of Bukdek Byway, slightly north of the entrance to The Marketplace. She is surrounded by neutral Jade Brotherhood who will turn hostile on accepting the quest. After you beat these enemies you will have to escort her back to her father Taojo. He can be found close to Kaineng Center to the north. Without any other active quests you should have only one more fight if following the directions on the map. Aiko does not join your party as an ally which means she doesn't take damage and you don't have to look after her.
One of the easier ways to deal with the initial fight is to lure the Afflicted from Feed the Hungry over to the Jade Brotherhood while still neutral, allowing them to kill them.

Another way to deal with this fight is to flag your party by the entrance away from the Jade Brotherhood. Talk to to Aiko and when the Jade brotherhood turns hostile run to your party. The guards and the Jade Brotherhood start fighting first and you can finish them off.
Note: The quest reward must be claimed before leaving the area.

quests/quest:gww:18818/sections/objectiv.text: Find the shipment of ink somewhere on the Plains of Jarin.
Bring the box of ink back to Kailona and collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18818/sections/walkthro.text: Travel to the Sunspear Great Hall and walk out to the Plains of Jarin. Head west and then north, hugging the side of the building. Once you've cleared the building, head north towards the shoreline. You'll find the shipment of ink waiting for you there. Grab it, and then return to Kamadan to see Kailona.

quests/quest:gww:18818/sections/notes-1/.text: The Rune of Minor Vigor that this quest rewards may only be sold once per account. Once any of your characters have sold it to a rune trader, other characters cannot sell the quest reward rune to a rune trader. However, this seems to reset if you delete the character that sold the rune originally.

Kailona incorrectly suggests that using expert or superior salvage kits always destroys the armor to which they are applied; there is a minimum 50% chance to retain the armor (see salvage for details).

quests/quest:gww:25633/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Elder Belin to learn more about Moa'vu'Kaal.
Find and stop the skale performing the summoning ritual.
Warn Elder Jurdu in Beknur Harbor about the skale activity near his village.

quests/quest:gww:25633/sections/walkthro.text: After talking to Elder Belin in Zehlon Reach, travel to Beknur Harbor. Head out the east gate into the Issnur Isles and follow the quest marker. You will find Moa'vu'Kaal a short distance away surrounded by a group of 7 Skale Lashers. Moa'vu'Kaal will already be present by the time you get there (you cannot prevent him from being summoned), so you only need to defeat him to complete the quest. Map back to Beknur Harbor and speak to Elder Jurdu to receive the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25633/sections/notes-1/.text: The Decline text might be a reference to the Nightfall campaign, as this is exactly what you do.

quests/quest:gww:211725/sections/objecti.text: Kill Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh in Sparkfly Swamp.

references.title: Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)
Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)

references.title: Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)
Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)

quests/quest:gww:211725/sections/rewards.text: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:211725/sections/walkthr.text: Head east from Gadd's Encampment. He patrols in a small area just to the north west of Bloodstone Caves. He is often accompanied by a patrol of raptors. Earthbind, Weakness, "Can't Touch This!" and/or Pain Inverter are particularly effective.

references.title: Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)

quests/quest:gww:202816/sections/objecti.text: Take Dunkoro through the Moddok Crevice into Vabbi.
*BONUS* Complete the mission by following Dunkoro's suggestions.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:202816/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:202816/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Moddok Crevice mission.

quests/quest:gww:202972/sections/objecti.text: Kill Mohby Windbeak in the Gyala Hatchery.
*BONUS* Kill Mohby Windbeak in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:202972/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Copper Zaishen Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:202972/sections/walkthr.text: Enter from Leviathan Pits. Go towards the gate where the Outcasts and Luxons are fighting. You can try to slip by them while they fight, but in hard mode the Outcasts kill the Luxons quite quickly. After you pass the gate, take the left side of the fork and hug the hillside going northwest. Then go towards the massive jade wave - there are many north-south groups with overlapping patrol paths along the way that can be avoided, or farmed for reputation (approximately 60 enemies, including 4 bosses). Be aware of over-aggroing as new patrols arrive. From there you will be able to scout out the boss patrolling along the jade. Try to pull foes away first as they may get aggroed while you fight the boss.

quests/quest:gww:199400/sections/walkthr.text: As you approach his location, spread out the party, using flags for heroes and henchmen; Rocktail's siege attack can easily wipe an entire party. That same spike also makes the boss vulnerable to damage reflection skills, especially Pain Inverter.
A group of Charr appears near the devourer's location; you can pull Rocktail away or just wait for the patrol to move away.
You can use the nearby Siege Devourer to tank against both the Charr party and Rocktail.

quests/quest:gww:25735/sections/walkthro.text: Simply go to Chaplain Phyratyss and get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25735/sections/notes-1/.text: Money Back Guarantee is a special quest available for characters that completed the Finding a Purpose quest before the April 5, 2007 update. Finding a Purpose required 4 gemstones, one of each type, to finish, which are no longer required.

Kill the treacherous Sakku and his cronies!

quests/quest:gww:25680/sections/walkthro.text: After you accept the quest, Dzaga and his band leave for the little island to the south. There are some patrols in the way, it may be beneficial for you to clear them before accepting the quest. Once you arrive to the rendezvous, Sakku will come, start the dialogue and after that he summons a few adds and turns hostile. Kill him and make sure Dzaga stays alive.

If you are a Monk focused on support, Skill Chaining is a rather difficult part (depending on your secondary class). Support Monks tends to struggle with dealing enough damage, and chaining alone does not complete the quest. It is advised to alter your build to something more offensive. Temporarily investing points in Smiting Prayers is a good choice. Use interruption and knock-down skills such as Leech Signet (Mesmer) and Bane Signet, as it buys you some time to deal more damage. Otherwise, focus on your secondary class as much as possible.

Return the blessed cowbell to Eurus.

quests/quest:gww:18619/sections/walkthro.text: Simply exit Breaker Hollow to the west. The cowbell will be in the most remote Blue Oysters just outside. Generally you won't even need to fight.

quests/quest:gww:18619/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest star and the actual location of the Blue Oysters do not always line up.

This explorable area lies between Durheim Archives, Vasburg Armory, and Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).
Mhenlo will spawn as an ally if a character in the party has Into the Whirlpool active; he will provide additional healing for the party.
The boss Arbor Earthcall appears alone in the middle of the central lake, but on approach (he has a slightly larger aggro), 6 Warden of Seasons will popup around him.
There are at least 5 spots around the lake with hidden Warden spawns (3 or 4).
Along narrow paths be wary of hidden Warden and Blood Drinker spawns.
Afflicted are hostile to other enemies on the map - if you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 30.
This area is frequently speed cleared for Kurzick faction. This is called "Morostav Trail speed clear" (abbreviated as ).
Exploring this area will contribute approximately 2.7% towards Canthan Cartographer title.

Occasionally a foe may become stuck on one of the hedges near the spawn of Konrru, Tainted Stone. Attacks by the foe or party members will be obstructed from any direction, preventing damage from any skill that requires a line of sight. This may prevent an unprepared party from vanquishing the area.

quests/quest:gww:69890/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Justiciar Naveed at the Magus Stones.

quests/quest:gww:69890/sections/walkthro.text: Exit from Rata Sum to the Magus Stones and head down the hill to the right. You need to take out 2 groups of Wind Riders and another group of Krait (by the covered pool). When you arrive at (Point 1) on the map (by the Resurrection Shrine), you meet Justicar Naveed and are given the rest of the mission. Move through the gap to (Point 2) on the map (again by a Resurrection Shrine), killing the Krait groups found along the way, where you meet up with the group of White Mantle. After a short (but sweet) dialogue, return with the White Mantle to (Point 1), where Justicar Naveed awaits. Kill the (now hostile) White Mantle group and see Justicar Naveed for your reward. Don't forget to activate the Resurrection Shrines, even though the White Mantle will not attack your party until you return to (Point 1) and meet with the Justicar Naveed.

quests/quest:gww:69890/sections/notes-1/.text: If the White Mantle Scout gets stuck on an iguana or a locked chest the quest will not update when Justicular Naveed has laid his trap.
Until leading them back to Naveed, the White Mantle are considered allies and will aid your party; for example, Abbots will heal Necromancer minions.

This area allows earlier access to Fort Aspenwood than the Kurzick side as Aspenwood Gate (Luxon) is in this area, which lies before Cavalon. The Kurzick side requires the completion of the Sunjiang District mission to first gain access to House zu Heltzer before being able to reach Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick).

Northwest from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon) exit, on the first cliff overlooking it.
Middle point of the east-west path along the southern edge at its apex.

If you bring a Moa Egg to the sign in the water that reads Mourning Veil Falls, the egg will harden. This is part of the process required for obtaining a Black Moa Chick miniature.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
