quests/quest:gww:25653/sections/notes-1/.text: While a Skree Battle bounty would be handy considering the number of Skree encountered during this quest, the Sunspear Scouts that provide this bounty are located on the far side of the quarry.

quests/quest:gww:280143/sections/objecti.text: Clear Skyward Reach in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280143/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280143/sections/notes-1.text: Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (two days earlier) and The Scar (the next quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.

quests/quest:gww:280143/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Skyward Reach in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280143/sections/target-.text: These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 1.33% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Hydra are found more frequently here than anywhere else in the Crystal Desert so skills like Protective Spirit, Shelter, Spirit Bond, and Mantra of Flame are highly recommended.
There are a dozen Desert Griffons in the fingertip of land south of Augury Rock.
Near Diviner's Ascent, there are a couple of spots with hidden Rockshot Devourers.
There is also a short patrol of Enchanted near the Vulture Drifts portal.
The zone includes two landmarks with no known function:
A large skeleton (of an unknown creature) rests near Mourn Drakespur.
Just outside Destiny's Gorge is a spot with four pedestals, each with a ramp leading up to it.

quests/quest:gww:67428/sections/notes-1/.text: See The Last Hierophant for a walkthrough of that quest. This quest is gained automatically when entering the dungeon.
At least one party member must have completed EotN, otherwise Frida Unmoven will block the entrance.

This dungeon has five named levels: an entrance level, three intermediate levels (can be completed in any order or mode), and a final level. The intermediate and final levels are connected to the initial level.
You may complete the dungeon in multiple trips, since you can leave after defeating any of the boss-like foes on the quest list without losing your progress in The Last Hierophant.
You cannot enter Duncan's level until every party member has killed his henchmen (the other four boss-like foes) in the three intermediate levels.

You get Hard mode credit for this dungeon by killing Duncan at that difficulty level; the sub-bosses may still be killed in normal mode. This makes it easier to get credit for your Master of the North title and/or Master Dungeon Guide book.
If you failed to claim the reward from the Hierophant's Chest (either by exiting or wiping), you must start over.
The Spirits of Disenchantment, Pain and Shadowsong have 15 Communing in Normal Mode.
Bring Frozen Soil to counter the resurrection skills of the Stone Summit Dwarves.
Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #15 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.

quests/quest:gww:67428/sections/shared-q.text: General tips
This quest automatically appears in your quest log when entering the dungeon.
Quest progress is saved even when exiting the dungeon. This allows you to modify your party's build(s) for each boss, if required.

Unlike most dungeons, Slavers' Exile is not linear, and you can kill the first four bosses in any order. The initial room leads directly to each sub-level, with Duncan's room opening once the others are complete.
You don't need to defeat all of the bosses in Hard Mode to get the Hard Mode page for the dungeon book, only Duncan.
If striving to complete all the sub-quests in one go, consider bringing a few Identification Kits. There is a Weaponsmith in the main area to whom you can sell your items.
Most of the Stone Summit have some type of resurrection skill, consider bringing Frozen Soil.
Justiciar Thommis' level

There are two bosses on this level, Justiciar Thommis, and Rand Stormweaver. It is recommended to do both during the same run, otherwise the exit will be blocked. The main difficulty is the large number of Dwarves that tend to aggro at the same time. Be prepared to do hit and run, or to manage large groups.
Selvetarm's level

Aside from large groups of Dwarves (see above), there are three additional difficulties here. (1) Some places have chained clerics and reavers popups, which may overwhelm groups already engaged in a fight. Pulling is recommended, as well as tactical retreats. (2) At the door right before the boss, there are popups. Each time you kill them, a larger groups spawns. There are a limited number of groups, but unprepared groups may suffer a wipe. Pulling is recommended to avoid the new group appearing on top of you. Also, these use life-stealing skills. Focus fire and general caster-shutdown is recommended against them. (3) Selvetarm and his group use Jagged Bones and Death Nova to produce a self-renewing supply of undead bombs. Using Verata skills to steal his minions will help, or some form of spike AoE damage such as splinter barrage.
Forgewight's level
Enemies primarily consist of large groups of fire elementals and large groups of Stone Summit.

A general strategy against this is to have a dedicated Tank/Aggro manager, a Protection or bonder monk, and a few AoE damagers. Cast protective spells on tank, have them hold the aggro, then do as much AoE damage as possible to thin out the group. A ranger with Frozen Soil is highly recommended against Stone Summit to prevent resurrection, and Gaze of Fury to remove spirits when needed.
Duncan the Black's level

The mobs in this area are composed entirely of Stone Summit and Restless Dead popups. The Restless Dead use Vampiric Touch and Vampiric Bite quite a bit, which can be countered with "Can't Touch This!". Refer to the other sections for skills and tactics to counter Summit dwarves.
Duncan the Black awaits in a large room full of Restless Dead popups. Sweeping the room to popup and killing all foes makes the following fight easier.

When approaching Duncan, several groups of Spirits will appear. Not only will these spirits damage, blind and disenchant you, several of Duncan's skills profit from having a spirit within earshot as well. These spirits will respawn when killed, but it is possible to move them away using Swap before engaging Duncan.

Duncan himself uses Duncan's Defense, which deals twice the damage he takes back to you. Don't damage him too quickly, or your healers will struggle to keep you alive. This can be circumvented by using life stealing or health loss instead of damage. Due to his large amount of health, Spoil Victor works great.
Once Duncan is dead, the spirits will disappear.
You can leave the dungeon at any time between completing the rooms of the bosses. The game records any killed bosses as killed in the quest log. The log will not be reset.
This quest also rewards 5000 Norn reputation points for first time completion. 2500 Norn reputation are awarded upon repeat.

To gain access to Duncan's dungeon, all party members must kill the preceding four bosses Justiciar Thommis, Rand Stormweaver, Selvetarm and Forgewight as shown in The Last Hierophant quest. The 4 "defeat" lines must be crossed off leaving only "Destroy Duncan the Black" left undone. This situation is frequently abbreviated "4/5". Once you have completed the quest, you will need to retake it and kill the other bosses before you can face Duncan again.

quests/quest:gww:25340/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the Shadow Overlords. You have [4...0] Shadow Overlords left.
Return to Miko the Unchained for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25340/sections/walkthro.text: Clear the Burning Forest before accepting this quest, otherwise you will have to deal with the original mobs while you tackle those spawned by the quest. As long as you can control how many mobs you confront at once, the area is easy. However, it is often difficult to do this because they have overlapping patrol routes. If you start to get overwhelmed, get as far away as quickly as you can; the groups will sometimes follow you almost all the way back to Miko.
The quest itself spawns four additional groups, each consisting of a Shadow Overlord and three allies. Killing these groups is all that's required to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25340/sections/notes-1/.text: The Enslaved Hero you save makes a slow, safe walk back to the Forest of the Wailing Lord.
Unlike every other quest (except A Strange Request), the objectives include words highlighted in green.

quests/quest:gww:280431/sections/objecti.text: Clear Snake Dance in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280431/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280431/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Snake Dance in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280431/sections/target-.text: The easiest way to reach this area is to first get to Camp Rankor and head out its northwestern exit. Camp Rankor is usually reached only towards the end of the Prophecies campaign.

To reach here from the Northern Shiverpeaks, head south out of Beacon's Perch and through both Lornar's Pass and Dreadnought's Drift; the journey is dangerous for a party of 6 out of Beacon's Perch as the areas are filled with high-level foes. This area lets characters reach Droknar's Forge, and there is a Beacon's Perch - Droknar's Forge run to allow early access to late-game areas and prestige armors.

There are many spots with about five or more Stone Summit corpses that do not vanish like regular corpses, exploited or not. The northern ones sometimes have a Tundra Giant corpse among them or a single hidden Nightmare. This is perhaps indicative that the Stone Summit are having difficulty gaining a foothold in this hostile area.
There are many hidden Nightmare groups in this area, concentrated mostly around the center and towards the south.
Many of the foes in this area possess skills that cause knock down. Skills like Ward of Stability and "I Am Unstoppable!" will be useful.
The Tundra Giants are aggressive to Azure Shadows, and will knock them down with Giant Stomp if they are in the area.
Although this area's two Giant bosses share three spawn points, they are not guaranteed to spawn; sometimes neither will spawn, other times only one will spawn.

The northernmost spawn point for them is very close to the portal to Dreadnought's Drift, making it possible to rezone there to try and make a certain boss appear there if trying to Capture either's elite skill.
A few Blessed Griffon groups can sometimes be seen fighting other groups.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
The hidden Nightmare groups can be deadly if they are triggered while engaging another large group. Some of the hidden groups are up to 6 strong.
The Tundra Giants are concentrated in the center and the north. With their knock-downs, it can be relatively easy for them to score a kill if unprepared.
Blessed Griffons employ Spell Breaker, which can be annoying to parties that rely heavily on targeted spells.
In the north, along the high mountain path, there are several large overlapping patrols of Mountain Trolls and Tundra Giants. Take care to note their path before engaging.

For the quickest multiple profession skill capture running, it is best to start from Deldrimor War Camp and head west through Grenth's Footprint. This will bring you directly to the center of Snake Dance within a couple of minutes, thus closer to most of the bosses, which are in the north side of Snake Dance.

quests/quest:gww:25408/sections/requirem.text: You must have Warrior, Ranger, Elementalist or Assassin as your primary or secondary profession.

quests/quest:gww:25408/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Kai Ying again to begin your test.
Use snaring and kiting to force Zho into submission.
See Instructor Ng for your reward

quests/quest:gww:25408/sections/walkthro.text: You will have been provided with skill that allows you to slow down an enemy (Warriors will receive a skill to run faster). Use these to hunt down and defeat Zho.
A Ritualist or Ranger can body block the center of the gate with 2 spirits to prevent Zho from leaving. This allows one to defeat Zho with ease.

quests/quest:gww:25408/sections/notes-1/.text: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are Weh no Su. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.

quests/quest:gww:9269/sections/objective.text: Patrol the area and protect the Stone Singers from the raiding Luxon forces. 5 Stone Singers must survive. You have [8...0] out of 8 remaining.
See Count zu Heltzer for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9269/sections/walkthrou.text: Start from Altrumm Ruins. Follow the quest markers to the stone singers then protect them. The quest markers will lead you on a specific path (due to the complex nature of Arborstone's landscape), if you already know the locations of the singers you can find your own (possibly quicker path), or keep following the marker.

When you get to the places where Stone Singers are, as soon as you get close, they will plead for their lives and two or three groups of Luxons will spawn nearby within a few seconds and rush towards them. Each group of Luxons usually have about three units.

If there is only one Stone Singer, make sure your party quickly surrounds him in order to act as a shield. The Luxons will aggro your party and engage the soft targets, ignoring the singer. If you have one or more Ritualists in your party, setting up spirits around the singer will also help distract the attackers, therefore allowing you to easily attack without the worry of having to protect the Stone Singers.

The one location where it might be problematic is point 3 in the map above. There are three singers there and it could be hard to cover all of them since the Luxons approach from three directions, and there is usually a group of Stone Scale Kirin and Dragon Moss nearby that is hard to avoid. If you are playing with other players, spread out further and take on the individual groups. If you're playing this with henchmen, try to stand near the middle and move about as the Luxons approach to take the aggro. Please note that henchmen do not heal the Stone Singers. If this is difficult, then try to protect just one of them, since the quest can still be completed even if you lose a couple singers.

quests/quest:gww:9269/sections/notes-1/b.text: If you have the quest Wardens On the March active in your Quest Log and follow the path put forth by the quest markers, getting to the last marker will require you to go through the large mob of Wardens from that quest. They will be waiting on the stairs between points 7 and 8 (refer to the quest map), but of course you can either avoid this mob, or save time and do both quests at the same time.

If you find it too difficult to get past the mobs of the wardens in order to get to point 8, you can purposely die to get to the Resurrection Shrine. From there, backtrack all the way to the Altrumm Ruins exit and then use the back door to the cathedral. While it is a long way, there are no enemies along this route, so it easily lets you complete the quest.
Having the quest Charting the Forests at the same time is a also good idea as you will be easily able to complete the charting of the area with only minimal extra effort.
A Restoration Ritualist should drop healing / protection spirits near the Singers. If possible, prioritize keeping the singers alive over your party.

A Necromancer hero (Master of Whispers, Olias, or Livia) set up as a minion master is very helpful to divert Luxon attacks away from the Stone Singers which you are supposed to protect in order to complete the quest.

If you are doing this quest with just heroes and/or henchmen, sometimes your healer NPCs will completely ignore the Stone Singers. Follow the direction of the above map, doing this quest in reverse the last 3 singers will not appear as objectives on the map and you won't be able to complete all 8 requirements.
Pathing tip: After saving the trio, continue following the stream to the next point (which will be empty). After saving Treff, you will need to backtrack a bit; stay in the water until the wood ramp.

quests/quest:gww:25287/sections/objectiv.text: Escort Farmer Hamnet to Ascalon City
Return to Grazden the Protector for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25287/sections/walkthro.text: If you came from Ascalon City by the path on the hill, you've already cleared the path out and the quest is quite easy. There will be one extra spawn of devourers near the city. Even if you don't clear the path first, just try to keep the monsters off Farmer Hamnet.
Hamnet doesn't become an ally in the party window, but keeps himself alive with Heal Area. This could be annoying because it will heal adjacent monsters as well.

Remember, as with all other "escort NPCs to town" quests, to come close to the portal but not enter it. Wait for Hamnet to come near and the quest to update. Then return to Grazden and tell him Hamnet made it to town safely.

quests/quest:gww:25287/sections/notes-1/.text: Farmer Hamnet often gets stuck along the path and the quest has to be restarted to continue.
When Farmer Hamnet gets to the portal at Ascalon City, he can be seen walking beyond the portal. You can Shadow Step into Ascalon City without triggering the portal

quests/quest:gww:276821/sections/objecti.text: Clear Sparkfly Swamp in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:276821/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:276821/sections/notes-1.text: The quest dialogue indicates that Sparkfly Swamp is part of the Southern Shiverpeaks when it is actually part of Tarnished Coast.

quests/quest:gww:276821/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Sparkfly Swamp in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:276821/sections/target-.text: Saidra's Ashes can be found in the northwest corner of this area.
Including quest influences, it has been reported to range from 310 to 353.
Some Arachnid groups have additional hidden Arachnids that popup when you engage them. Approaching from the North is highly recommended.
Beware of overlapping patrols among the dinosaurs and the Heket.
If you accept either Giriff's War or Tekks's War, the associated NPC will follow you as an ally and help with the vanquish.
If you have not yet obtained Hayda as a hero, she will join as an ally for the vanquish if you have one of the associated quests and approach her location.
The quest Finding Gadd will spawn 3 Inscribed Ettin bosses, providing bonus reputation points for defeating them.
In the northwest area approaching the water is a view of a head carved from a mountain, with a waterfall flowing from its mouth.
The Zaishen Vanquish quest indicates that the Sparkfly Swamp is part of the Southern Shiverpeaks.

quests/quest:gww:280732/sections/objecti.text: Clear Spearhead Peak in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280732/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280732/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Spearhead Peak in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280732/sections/target-.text: The Elder Wolf will be charmed by an enemy ranger. He won't start charming it until you're close enough. One option is to flag your heroes close, and hope they can interrupt his Charm Animal skill.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Consider Mantra of Frost and some points in Inspiration Magic to counter the cold damage from Ice Imps and Siege Ice Golems. Spread out to minimize the effects of Maelstrom and Deep Freeze.
Sometimes, a mob spawns beyond the portal to Grenth's Footprint.

quests/quest:gww:77260/sections/requirem.text: The appropriate copy of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans.
A Charr Battle Plan Decoder from Captain Langmar.

quests/quest:gww:77260/sections/objectiv.text: Find and annihilate all three Charr companies in Dragon's Gullet.

quests/quest:gww:77260/sections/rewards-.text: 1,000 Vanguard reputation points [with Ebon Vanguard rank 7 or less]

quests/quest:gww:77260/sections/walkthro.text: You start in a random location in Dragon's Gullet. Charr patrols travel around the southernmost tar lake. There is a single Siege Devourer to the north, 2 more to the east, a large group of low-level Charr to the southwest and a group containing a single Charr Lord is to the north. After killing all 100 Charr, your party will be transported to Longeye's Ledge.

quests/quest:gww:77260/sections/notes-1/.text: To activate the mission, double-click on the decoder and drag and drop the associated Encrypted Charr Battle Plans into it. With the decoded plans still inside the decoder, talk to Captain Langmar, who will now have a dialogue option to enter the mission.
When you accept this mission, Captain Langmar takes both your decoder and the battle plans that were inside it, so make sure your party is ready to go beforehand.
The reward for this quest is received automatically after completing the objectives.
There is no reward if your Ebon Vanguard rank is 8 or higher.
If your party is defeated, you will need to acquire a new set of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans to restart it.
Walking through the tar lakes will not cause the Tar environment effect.
Capturing the Siege Devourer can make your task much easier.
The quest does not mention that the reward can depend on your rank and you will receive the success message even if you are ineligible to receive the reputation reward.

quests/quest:gww:77420/sections/requirem.text: The appropriate copy of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans.
A Charr Battle Plan Decoder from Captain Langmar.

quests/quest:gww:77420/sections/objectiv.text: Find and kill [Charr Boss Name], Charr legion leader.
You have 15 minutes to find and kill the legion leader before he escapes.

quests/quest:gww:77420/sections/rewards-.text: 1,000 Vanguard reputation points [with Ebon Vanguard rank 7 or less]

quests/quest:gww:77420/sections/walkthro.text: This mission is fairly short. Because the target of this mission is randomly assigned, and the bosses have different spawn locations, there will be no quest objective on your compass or minimap. You have 15 minutes to hunt your target through Flame Temple Corridor. As with other Special Ops missions, you will face a mix of high and low level Charr.

quests/quest:gww:77420/sections/notes-1/.text: To activate the mission, double-click on the decoder and drag and drop the associated Encrypted Charr Battle Plans into it. With the decoded plans still inside the decoder, talk to Captain Langmar, who will now have a dialogue option to enter the mission.
The area will include Ascalonian Chests.
When you accept this mission, Captain Langmar takes both your decoder and the battle plans that were inside it, so make sure your party is ready to go beforehand.
The reward for this quest is received automatically after completing the objectives.
There is no reward if your Ebon Vanguard rank is 8 or higher.
If your party is defeated, you will need to acquire a new set of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans to restart it.
The quest does not mention that the reward can depend on your rank and you will receive the success message even if you are ineligible to receive the reputation reward.

quests/quest:gww:77550/sections/requirem.text: The appropriate copy of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans.
A Charr Battle Plan Decoder from Captain Langmar.

quests/quest:gww:77550/sections/objectiv.text: Defend Grendich Courthouse from the Charr attackers.
At least one Ascalonian soldier must survive. [8..0] of 8 soldiers still living.

quests/quest:gww:77550/sections/rewards-.text: 1,000 Vanguard reputation points [with Ebon Vanguard rank 7 or less]

quests/quest:gww:77550/sections/walkthro.text: The 8 Ascalonian soldiers are positioned with four soldiers inside the courthouse, two at the top of the steps to the courthouse, and two at the bottom of the steps.

The Charr will attack in waves, alternating from the left and the right. Each wave contains a mix of level 8 and level 20 Charr, but as the mission progresses there are less level 8 and more level 20 Charr per wave. You will encounter Charr Hunters, Charr Flame Wielders, Charr Seekers, and Charr Flameshielders.
There will be a lot of exploitable bodies, but not a lot of time for making minions. Have skills that exploit corpses like Putrid Explosion or bring a minion master utilizing Aura of the Lich.
The Charr will tend to ball up when they run in and group toward the bottom of the steps. Having spells or attacks that are AoE will help a lot.

A lot of the damage dealt by the Charr is fire damage, the Charr Flameshielders will drop both Meteor Shower and Fire Storm while the Charr Seekers will use ignite arrows. Spread out to avoid too much damage, bring party heals, and prepare for fire damage.
Rebel Yell and Mantra of Flame can greatly cut down incoming damage and give you quite a bit of energy at the same time.

quests/quest:gww:77550/sections/notes-1/.text: To activate the mission, double-click on the decoder and drag and drop the associated Encrypted Charr Battle Plans into it. With the decoded plans still inside the decoder, talk to Captain Langmar, who will now have a dialogue option to enter the mission.
When you accept this mission, Captain Langmar takes both your decoder and the battle plans that were inside it, so make sure your party is ready to go beforehand.
The reward for this quest is received automatically after completing the objectives.
There is no reward if your Ebon Vanguard rank is 8 or higher.
If your party is defeated, you will need to acquire a new set of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans to restart it.
The quest does not mention that the reward can depend on your rank and you will receive the success message even if you are ineligible to receive the reputation reward.

quests/quest:gww:213797/sections/objecti.text: Kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna in the Archipelagos.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:213797/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:213797/sections/walkthr.text: The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty.

If taking the route from Jade Flats (Luxon), your party will only encounter Naga Warriors, Naga Archers, Naga Ritualists, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few Kappa. Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require attacks and attack skills to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use Blurred Vision and Shatterstone (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing blocking skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also interrupt with Distracting Blow and Concussion Shot, so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict blind or cause misses. Consider Signet of Binding for Destruction spirits created by Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.

quests/quest:gww:12175/sections/objectiv.text: Convince 5 Canthan Refugees to return to Kaineng City. You have convinced [0...5] of 5 refugees.
See Attendant Yoko for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:12175/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest in Maatu Keep head south through the exit to Pongmei Valley. At the bottom of the ramp there are 3 refugees. As you approach them they will wave to each other and begin walking in separate directions. There's no need to rush since they are only walking and you can easily get to all three of them pretty easily before they've gone very far. Next head a little farther south where there will be 5 more refugees who will again wave to each other and begin walking their separate ways as soon as you approach them. Just like before these are pretty easy to get to as well.

quests/quest:gww:12175/sections/notes-1/.text: The number of asked refugees does not reset itself if you re-zone, meaning you can do the quest through multiple visits of the same area.
Creatures in the area do not attack the refugees.
There are a total of 8 refugees, but only 5 of them will agree to come back.

quests/quest:gww:15366/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the graven monoliths and harvest their shards. Collect 10 more to complete your sample.

quests/quest:gww:15366/sections/walkthro.text: Continue to kill Graven Monoliths until they have dropped 10 Inscribed Shards then return to Awata for your reward. The Inscribed Shards are not quest items, make sure to not salvage or sell them.

quests/quest:gww:15366/sections/notes-1/.text: Unlike the other quests that are given in the Bone Palace, this is the only one that does not precede A Deal's a Deal, since one can acquire Sticks and Stones before turning in A Deal's a Deal.
You have to collect ordinary Inscribed Shards, even though the quest dialogue refers to glowing shards.
As with other quests, if you do not have room when you accept the reward, Awata will take the 10 shards but will not give you the Ancient Artifact.

quests/quest:gww:279434/sections/objecti.text: Clear Stingray Strand in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279434/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279434/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Stingray Strand in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279434/sections/target-.text: Exit from the Sanctum Cay or Fisherman's Haven.
The Royal Papers quest will affect the spawns in this area.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.94% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 150–170 foes. Has hidden Large Spined Aloes throughout the area.
The Inferno Imps deal AoE fire damage and cause Burning; they can be countered by keeping spread out and by using general anti-caster techniques and/or party healing.
The Caromi Tengu include warriors, rangers, and mesmers; bring melee counters for the first two and be careful of the AoE interrupts of the Caromi Wilds.

The Bog Skales use health degeneration and corpse exploitation. Consider bringing Interrupts and hex removal to use against them. A minion master can help reduce the available corpses for exploitation.

quests/quest:gww:25313/sections/objectiv.text: Track down and destroy Thorgrim Beastlasher in Iron Horse Mine.
Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25313/sections/walkthro.text: Make your way through Traveler's Vale towards Iron Horse Mine and you will find Artemis the Ranger by the metal bridge close to the portal.

After accepting the quest, enter Iron Horse Mine and head north. You will soon find Thorgrim Beastlasher and a group of three Summit Beastmasters. It is possible to pull Thorgrim alone, but if you aggro the whole group, be careful of their knockdown skills, Bull's Strike and Giant Stomp. Once Thorgrim is dead, return to Artemis to receive the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25313/sections/notes-1/.text: Because of her low level, Artemis can easily be killed by nearby Stone Summit. If this happens, use the Iron Horse Mine portal to reset.
Combines well with the Helping the Dwarves quest arc since it leads you past Artemis to get to Rangil Ironbow and the mine where Minaar Stonesledge is being held is just a bit further down the path.
The monk quest The Wayward Monk also leads to the same area.

quests/quest:gww:25645/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Miresh about your task.
Meet Miresh on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
Fight your way to the center of the skree harpy nest and retrieve a harpy egg. Miresh must survive.

quests/quest:gww:25645/sections/walkthro.text: Once you speak with Miresh, you'll find him again just inside the entrance to the Cliffs of Dohjok from the Zehlon Reach entrance.

The quest to retrieve the egg is straightforward; the main thing to be contended with is the fact that Miresh dies entirely too easily, voiding the quest. A good strategy for getting around this is to stand back a ways from the quest target, then send your heroes in just past the nest. Once they've distracted the harpies, run in and grab the egg, then run away before you attract the attention of the Skree. Once you get a bit away, you can talk to Miresh to finish the quest, then head back to clean up the rest of the Skree (and resurrect any heroes which may have died during the initial assault).

quests/quest:gww:12080/sections/objectiv.text: See Guardsman Tang for your reward

quests/quest:gww:12080/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from The Marketplace follow along the northern edge until you reach the bridge closest to the northwestern end. Getting to Quufu will be difficult; the small island has a number of enemies and a large group of them constantly patrols around it. Pulling one group of enemies will spawn another which may end up pulling another nearby group, leading to you quickly being swarmed and wiped. Quufu will initially be alone, but if you step in the immediate vicinity of the asterisk on your minimap, a mob will spawn with him. You can pull Quufu away using ranged attacks, and aggro him separately, preventing the additional spawns. Killing him ends the quest.

quests/quest:gww:12080/sections/notes-1/.text: Though Quufu has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns.

quests/quest:gww:23310/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to the Alkali Pan and request an audience with the undead warlord.
Defeat Kareh Ossa and his undead guards.
See General Farrund for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23310/sections/walkthro.text: Head west into the Alkali Pan and meet with General Farrund just outside the Bone Palace. Activate the Wurm Spoor and head North West following the quest marker on your compass.The wurms will deposit your party on land just before the warlord, Kareh Ossa, and a small group of Royal Guards, just south of the Ruins of Morah. After a short speech, Kareh and his guards will turn hostile and attack the party, but their small number can be easily defeated. When they are dispatched, talk with General Farrund for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23310/sections/notes-1/.text: Can easily be completed at the same time as the primary quest that follows the same route: Horde of Darkness.

quests/quest:gww:18174/sections/objectiv.text: Bring justice to all the unscrupulous peddlers.
You have eliminated [0...5] of the 5 peddlers.
See Emperor's Hand for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18174/sections/walkthro.text: Enter Wajjun Bazaar from the Marketplace and head west along the waterfront, dispensing the small groups of Jade Brotherhood you meet along the way. When approaching a peddler, four Am Fah Assassins will spawn. The peddlers themselves will not attack. Defeat Rai Kazu, then turn south and defeat Doctor Jung immediately afterward. Follow the quest marker southeast to Xang, and south again to Pe Ling. Follow the path to the west, which will then lead you southeast to Naiju.
Once all five peddlers and their summoned assassins are defeated, return to Emperor's Hand for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18174/sections/notes-1/.text: The Am Fah are level 26 in hard mode, while the peddlers are level 20 as usual since they are allied before approaching them.
This quest goes well with Closer to the Stars as the last peddler is close to Loud Kou, the NPC needed to finish that quest.
Leaving the area restarts the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25649/sections/requirem.text: Student Sousuke neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:25649/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Zehlon Reach and bond with Acolyte Jin through battle against one of Balthazar's Eternals.
See Field General Hayao for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25649/sections/walkthro.text: After talking with Field General Hayao after Zaishen Elite in the Plains of Jarin make your way to The Astralarium. Enter Zehlon Reach and proceed south to find Acolyte Jin, Balthazar's Eternal, and two Ghostly Griffons. Defeat the Eternals and report back to Field General Hayao at the Sun Docks.

quests/quest:gww:25650/sections/requirem.text: Student Jin neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:25650/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Zehlon Reach and bond with Acolyte Sousuke through battle against one of Balthazar's Eternals.
See Field General Hayao for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25650/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the quest marker to the location in Zehlon Reach (west of Astralarium). At the marker you will find Acolyte Sousuke near Balthazar's Eternal and two Ghostly Griffons. Defeat them to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25471/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Yijo Tahn outside of Shing Jea Monastery.
Escort Yijo Tahn to Tsumei Village.
Talk to Sister Choi Ju in Tsumei Village.

quests/quest:gww:25471/sections/walkthro.text: Meet Yijo Tahn in Sunqua Vale just outside Shing Jea Monastery. It is an easy but time-consuming task, because Yijo attacks non-aggressive mantids and kappa along the way, however, if you run all the way to Tsumei Village without stopping to wait for Yijo, he won't attack anything on the way because he'll be preoccupied with catching up to you. When you get to Tsumei Village, talk to Sister Choi Ju. She tells you to return to Yazoying for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25471/sections/notes-1/.text: Similar to Cash Crops, if you completed the Zen Daijun mission with this quest in your Quest Log, you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.
Yijo will not spawn if The Shrine of Maat or A Strange Request is active.
If Yijo accidentally damages an Ox during this quest, he will be able to attack and kill it

quests/quest:gww:25367/sections/requirem.text: Enter Sorrow's Furnace without To Sorrow's Furnace subquests.

quests/quest:gww:25367/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver 5 Scrolls of Rebellious Rhetoric to the Dredge Slaves.

quests/quest:gww:25367/sections/walkthro.text: This quest does not guide you with any quest marker. As you wander around Sorrow's Furnace, you will come across many Dredge Slaves scattered about singly. Simply talk to the first five that you come across to complete the quest.
It's useful to perform this quest while doing Tasca's Reprise and Political Ramifications, the other two quests that require that the main Sorrows Furnace quests not be active.

quests/quest:gww:15715/sections/objectiv.text: Find Ola the Fantastical in the Mirror of Lyss and convince him to perform in the new play.
Find Amadi and free her from the Kournans.
Convince Amadi she must appear in the new play.
See Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15715/sections/walkthro.text: Ola can be found very close to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh; head out of the east exit to reach him.

Ola has a lot of potential dialogue routes to go through before he'll accept the offer to act in the play (see below). One route however will end up with the player paying over 500 gold pieces to bribe Ola to appear in the play, so watch what buttons you click on! The easiest way to avoid this is to choose the second option everytime.

Amadi is being held prisoner in the south-western corner of Resplendent Makuun, so map-travel to Yahnur Market as the closest outpost, otherwise you will have to travel south from Honur Hill. There is a single group of Kournans guarding Amadi, and usually a small, separate, group of harpies patrolling nearby.
Once you've defeated the Kournans, chat with Amadi to complete the quest and head back to Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.
Alternative: You can go straight to Amadi from where you get the quest, and it will skip the part with Ola, and you can just go back to Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15715/sections/notes-1/.text: Despite what Ola says, Amadi is in southern Resplendent Makuun. If you do not pay Ola, he incorrectly refers to the play as "Springtime for Varesh" in his second last dialog. Speaking to Amadi will complete the quest even if you haven't recruited Ola.

quests/quest:gww:25362/sections/objectiv.text: See Galen Trask for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25362/sections/walkthro.text: Find Galen Trask in Grenth's Footprint, and lead him to Sorrow's Furnace. Once inside, speak to him to receive this quest. He wants you to pretend to be a slave, and to scout out five locations. He will cast Chains of Enslavement on you, which will render most Stone Summit friendly. The main enemies you'll fight will be rebellious Dredge, and nearby Stone Summit will help you. It is not possible to remove the Chains of Enslavement condition while inside Sorrow's Furnace during this quest, so don't worry about betraying your identity.

Galen Trask will sell you to Taskmaster Ironboot, who will lead you to Krak Flamewhip, who will offer five optional subquests that can be done whilst scouting the locations for Trask. These quests will take you to places close to the spots you'll have to scout for Galen. For more information on these subquests, see the entries: Cold One, Fire in the Hole, Gathering Resources, Unruly Slaves, and Wrenches In The Gears. If you don't want to bother with the subquests, simply follow your direction arrows to scout out locations. If you wish to do the subquests, have a look at Gathering Resources first and speak to Tharn Stonerift, as he will ask you to gather iron ore that can be found in the course of completing the other subquests.

Accepting a subquest from Krak Flamewhip will spawn a number of foes. The main Summit Slaves quest is a lot easier to complete without accepting any of these subquests. Alternatively, it's possible (though it'll take a long time) to complete the main Summit Slaves quest and then go to Krak Flamewhip to accept his subquests. These will be less difficult seeing that you'll already have killed most of the foes.

While journeying through the caves, carrying a Master Gear is unnecessary as these slow your movement rate and there is always one nearby in a working gearbox. Since the main quest (and all 5 subquests, should the player choose to do them) mostly consists of running, consider having at least one party member bring a party-wide speed boost skill.

When you have found a location the message "Quest Updated: Summit slaves" is displayed. Select the Summit Slaves quest in your quest log to see which locations you have visited. (Following the quest arrows in the order they appear results in a bit of backtracking, following the numbers on the wiki map would be quicker.)

quests/quest:gww:203200/sections/objecti.text: Locate and destroy the source of the spirit army in the Sunjiang District of Kaineng City.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203200/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203200/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Sunjiang District mission.

quests/quest:gww:203200/sections/notes-1.text: Similar to its Master's Reward, the mission can be completed in under 25 minutes in hard mode for this quest's first bonus objective.

quests/quest:gww:278224/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Sunjiang District in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:278224/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:278224/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Sunjiang District in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:278224/sections/target-.text: The Count's Daughter primary quest will lead characters through this area. Exit from Zin Ku Corridor. Can also be entered from Pongmei Valley if all party members have completed Tahnnakai Temple, otherwise the gates of the Sunjiang District portal in Pongmei Valley will be closed.
The kill count is substantially reduced during Cleansing the Sunjiang District (179).

The gate to the western region will be closed unless all players have completed Sunjiang District (and the necessary missions for this: Arborstone and Boreas Seabed). This prevents access to the Construct bosses.

Equinox can be captured before completion of Sunjiang District via killing the Ranger's Construct behind the closed gate by waiting for the boss to patrol close enough to the gate to be pulled with a flatbow.
The environmental traps of the mission are deactivated in the explorable area.

quests/quest:gww:278481/sections/objecti.text: Clear Sunqua Vale on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:278481/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:278481/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Sunqua Vale on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:278481/sections/target-.text: Exit from either Shing Jea Monastery, Minister Cho's Estate, or Tsumei Village. Quite a few quests from the monastery will lead you out here.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
These festival quests will also affect the spawns in this area:
Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 3.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
The fewest number of foes spawn during A Strange Request, which is part of the Dragon Festival.
A group of Kappa will jump out of the water if you approach too close the southeastern waterfront.
Similarly, a group of Naga will show up at the eastern end of the bridge over Lake Puang.
A single, hidden Lesser Oni can be found a short distance northwest from the Tsumei Village portal.
Around 3 groups of Crimson Skull drop from trees on the northern edge of the snowy area.
Zhengjo Temple has hidden single Mantids everywhere that spawn one at a time after you kill the visible Mantid Monitor next to their spawn spot. In total 2-3 hidden ones spawn for each visible enemy.
The Kappa and Mantids are hostile to each other, though they will only fight in Hard mode. The Red Yeti and a nearby Sensali are hostile to each other, and may both die fighting.

Wulk Cragfist spawns as a hostile for all characters and turns into an ally after being defeated, despite the fact that only Factions characters can take his quest, Revenge of the Yeti. Sometimes, a Water Buffalo (near the second rabbit cage) will spawn in the middle of two trees and be unable to move. Inside Zhengjo Temple, two Mantid Hatchlings will attack the Mantid Monitor near to where they spawn.

quests/quest:gww:22290/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Nightfall on the account
Sunspears in Kryta neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:22290/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Kormir at Bejunkan Pier.
Defend Kaineng Center from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
Speak with Kormir at Bejunkan Pier to arrange to travel to Elona.
See Seamarshal Bendro for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:22290/sections/rewards-.text: Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan unlocked.

quests/quest:gww:22290/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is an easier way to gain access to Nightfall than Sunspears in Kryta, the equivalent quest from Prophecies: the party size is eight (instead of six); henchmen are level 20 (instead of 10); your other allies will be more durable; and it can be easier to take advantage of the geography to bunch up opponents or avoid them.

After setting up your party, enter Bejunkan Pier and speak to Kormir who will transport you to a mission-instance of Kaineng Center. You will be confronted by Torment Claws and various other Chaos creatures (Grasps of Insanity, Scythes of Chaos, and Wrathful Storms). Your goal is to destroy the four Chaos Rifts (large purple bubbles) without succumbing to the foes.

Each time you stand near one of the rifts, a red progress bar will appear; it takes about 10 seconds to take down the rift and once removed, it cannot reappear. After you have banished the fourth rift, a countdown timer will appear (giving you some time to pick up any drops), after which you will be returned to the pier. Speak to Kormir again to take you to Elona. After a short cinematic, you will transported to the Sun Docks. Speak to Seamarshall Bendro to get credit for the quest.

There is no time limit for the quest so proceed slowly and avoid aggroing too many foes at once: mobs are close together and will easily cause a wipe if you move too quickly. Pull foes away from the Torment Claws so you can confront those individually; if you do get swarmed, focus on the claws first or at least interrupt their Torment Slash. A cautious team of one player and seven henchmen can easily succeed while even a well-balanced party of eight players can fail if they over-aggro.
Skills that mitigate damage to other allies are helpful, e.g. Shelter.
Interrupts to prevent the Torment Claws from using their skills.

quests/quest:gww:22290/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest unlocks Kamadan, Jewel of Istan (once you have walked through the portal from Sun Docks).

Do not leave the party immediately after the Chaos Rifts are destroyed; everyone must speak with Kormir a second time in Bejunkan Pier. If anyone is missing, you will not be able to travel to the Sun Docks in Elona.
You will get credit for completing the quest as long as the countdown timer begins and you wait it out, even if you are defeated.
Kormir will refer to any character as if they were a Canthan native and has no alternate dialogue.
See Campaign travel and Ferry for additional information.

quests/quest:gww:25707/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Nightfall on the account
Sunspears in Cantha neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:25707/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Lionguard Bedo to gain entrance to Lion's Gate.
Speak with Kormir in Lion's Gate.
Defend Lion's Arch from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
Speak with Kormir in Lion's Gate to arrange travel to Elona (see Notes below).
See Seamarshal Bendro for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25707/sections/rewards-.text: Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan port unlocked.

quests/quest:gww:25707/sections/walkthro.text: Talk to Kormir in Lion's Gate. She will ask you if you are ready to face the danger that has come to Lion's Arch. When you respond "yes", you will be taken to the mission. Your party will be in a mission instance of Lion's Arch, with mission rules. If your party is wiped out, the quest is failed.

There will be some fights with high level enemies, so it's strongly advised not to go alone. It may also be difficult to complete this quest using only the level 10 henchmen from Lion's Arch. You will, however, have four very hardy Lionguard Sentries following you.

You need to close four Chaos Rifts to defend Lion's Arch while fighting or avoiding groups of Wrathful Storms (level 24 elementalists), Scythes of Chaos (level 18 mesmers), Grasps of Insanity (level 22 warriors), and Torment Claws (stationary level 22 warriors) in the area. To close a rift, stand under it and wait to capture it. A red bar on the left side of your screen will indicate how far the rift has to go to close and how quickly it is closing. When the bar turns blue, the rift has closed.

Each rift is guarded by a Grasp of Insanity and either a Wrathful Storm or a Scythe of Chaos, sometimes with a Torment Claw as well. You may avoid killing them while you capture the rift, but they can capture the rifts back. Be wary of other groups that may be patrolling nearby. Once all four rifts are closed, a 30 second timer counts down. You must hold all four rifts during this time.
Once your party is ready, head to Lion's Gate and talk to Kormir. Travel to Elona and get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25707/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest unlocks the Kamadan, Jewel of Istan port in Elona (once you have arrived at the Sun Docks).

Make sure no party members leave after the Chaos Rifts are all destroyed, as you need to talk with Kormir (a second time) in Lion's Gate in order to travel to the Sun Docks in Elona. If all party members are not present, you will not be able to travel.

Consider completing Mhenlo's Request and Sunspears in Cantha rather than this quest. You fight the same enemies in both versions of this quest, but entering from Kaineng Center gives you a full party size of 8, level 20 henchmen with stronger builds, and more and higher-level NPC allies.

Whenever a character who has not visited Elona enters Lion's Arch, unless this quest or Sunspears in Cantha is in their log, the message "To unlock travel to Elona, take the "Sunspears in Kryta" quest from Lionguard Figo." will appear.
See Campaign travel for additional information.

quests/quest:gww:279502/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Sunward Marches in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279502/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279502/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Sunward Marches in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279502/sections/target-.text: Upon arrival at the Command Post for the first time, Dunkoro will offer a series of quests that will lead you here to build up the set of NPCs that will ultimately settle in the Command Post.
There is a group of Rampaging Ntouka in the northwestern corner which is much larger than the average group size for this zone. It has a patrol route that heads south.
Kournan military outside of the garrison are level 16. Those inside the garrison itself are level 20.
Additional allies (6) and foes during And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.0% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
The large group of Rampaging Ntouka, referred to above, is deadly if a party is not prepared for the damage spike.
To collect bounties, it is recommended to leave from Command Post going in a clockwise direction.

quests/quest:gww:10181/sections/objectiv.text: Escort the supply column to Piken Square.
See Quartermaster Aada for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10181/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, enter the The Breach. Once there a Hunter will whisper to you by the entrance. Head to Piken Square by following that hunter.

If you are starting from Piken Square, it is useful to combine this quest with "The Siege of Piken Square", "Fallen Soldiers" and / or "Army Life". If you do, you will automatically take the easiest way to find the Supply Bearers.

After talking to the Bearers you have to escort them back to Piken Square. Note that the Bearers are completely passive and provide no support along your way. To complete the quest, at least one of the Supply Bearers has to survive. The easiest way to ensure their survival is to head back the way you came (ahead of them) and destroy the Charr forces at the bridge before the Bearers get there. Do not enter Piken Square until the Supply Bearers catch up and you receive acknowledgement that the quest has been completed.

quests/quest:gww:320708/sections/objecti.text: Speak with Warmaster Tydus to accept his aid.

quests/quest:gww:320708/sections/walkthr.text: This quest is marked as completed upon accepting it. Speak to Warmaster Tydus again to accept the rewards.

quests/quest:gww:320708/sections/notes-1.text: The Superior Identification Kit and Superior Salvage Kit are usually not available this early in Prophecies, being only offered by merchants from the Crystal Desert or later regions.

quests/quest:gww:18843/sections/objectiv.text: Find and defeat the corsair raiding group that took Suwash. You have defeated x of 4 possible groups.

quests/quest:gww:18843/sections/walkthro.text: Head south from the Sunspear Great Hall. Engage groups at points A, B, C, and D. Be careful at each point as you may draw aggro from Stormseed Jacarandas, Preying Lances, Skale, Fanged Iboga, and Irontooth Drakes.

When you reach point D, the group will be slightly larger than the previous three groups, including a level 7 Corsair Bosun. Defeat them, and speak with Suwash. Travel back to the Sunspear Great Hall and speak with Sehti to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25523/sections/objectiv.text: Go to Ascalon City and talk to Symon about getting a copy of his book.
Find Artisan Daved in southeastern Old Ascalon and acquire 5 rolls of parchment.
Take the parchment to Symon the Scribe.
Deliver Symon's "History of Ascalon" to Witness Rastin.

quests/quest:gww:25523/sections/walkthro.text: This is a fairly easy quest, particularly for the amount of experience it gives. You can even have the 5 rolls of parchment in your inventory ahead of time to speed up the quest. You also don't have to go to Artisan Daved to craft it, merely obtain it by any means, but crafting it is far cheaper than buying it from the rare material trader. To craft, you need 25 Wood Planks in your inventory and 100 gold.

quests/quest:gww:25523/sections/notes-1/.text: After talking to Symon and receiving the book you can talk to him again and receive another book if you have the required amount of rolls of parchment even if you still have the first book in your inventory.

quests/quest:gww:201791/sections/objecti.text: Take Mhenlo and free the eight bound spirits in Tahnnakai Temple.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes (30 in Hard Mode).
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:201791/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:201791/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Tahnnakai Temple mission.

quests/quest:gww:278668/sections/objecti.text: Clear Tahnnakai Temple in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:278668/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:278668/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Tahnnakai Temple in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:278668/sections/target-.text: Zin Ku Corridor has the only entrance into this area.
These quests will affect the spawns in this area:

With the primary quest A Meeting With the Emperor active, there will be only 2 Temple Guardian foes to kill; however, be careful on your route or you will illuminate other foes that are still present to the north (a map is available here). It does not matter when you speak with the Emperor, as long as the quest is active.

When vanquishing normally, take care when engaging the numerous Jade Brotherhood mobs. Spread out the party before engaging, as the casters can easily cause a party wipe. Anti-melee skills and elemental damage protection or mitigation are recommended.
Jade Knights can cause serious damage to your back line, so it is recommended to take care of them first.

The shimmer on the exit portal to the Tahnnakai Temple outpost does not always show up, making it appear the same as any other door, so be careful you do not accidentally exit this area while vanquishing.

The northern-most tip of this area contains a feature not found anywhere else in Guild Wars: a multi-level spiraling ramp that leads from the lower temple area mostly inhabited by Temple Guardian foes to a much higher area occupied by the Jade Brotherhood. The upper section contains its own system of watery areas and bridges across them, so if that is actually "ground level" then the spiraling ramp provides a good indication of the depth of the temple shrines and the Zin Ku Corridor within the sewers.

quests/quest:gww:281139/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Talmark Wilderness in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281139/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281139/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Talmark Wilderness in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281139/sections/target-.text: You can get to this explorable area by heading north from Fisherman's Haven (with up to six in your party) or west from Temple of the Ages (with up to eight).
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.43% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 185–244 foes. There are hidden Fog Nightmares throughout the area, encountered either alone or in pairs.
The northern path have several Inferno Imps close to each other, instead of taking their full fire power, send a tank to lure them all and ball for attack.
If you start at Temple of the Ages for this vanquish, consider caravan vanquishing additional areas to the west since there are no outposts to the west that allow a party of eight.

This area is replaced by its War in Kryta equivalent and the level design changes after your character has completed either Prophecies or Eye of the North. If War in Kryta is completed and your character holds no Wanted by the Shining Blade bounty, you'll enter the War in Kryta version of the map without the War in Kryta spawns.

You can only return to the pre-WiK level design version by teaming up with someone which has not completed Eye of the North or Prophecies. This is relevant for cartography, as there's a sliver of map to the north-east that can only be uncovered when exploring the original map.

It has been reported that due to War in Kryta update content, both explorable area icons conflict with each other when vanquished, the World Map will sometimes display it red and others orange. Re-logging resolves this issue.

quests/quest:gww:281416/sections/objecti.text: Clear Talus Chute in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281416/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281416/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Talus Chute in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281416/sections/target-.text: These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
There are hidden Azure Shadows in the northwestern corner of the map.
Two groups of Tundra Giants are easy to miss. Both patrol a long route using the mountain top path on the westernmost side of the map - one patrols clockwise, the other counter-clockwise.
There are many forms of knock down in this area, between Giant Stomp and Water Trident. Bringing anti-knockdown skills can be a huge help.
A roaming group of Avicara may also lengthen your vanquish, they range over an area south and east of the nametag on the map.

Low-level creatures usually encountered in the Northern Shiverpeaks can be found wandering about various places in solitude. They have no special abilities that distinguish them from other low-level monsters, and do not appear to have any purpose or relation to any quest. In hard mode, their levels and skills are adjusted to a degree appropriate for the area, but they are still alone.
The "troll cave" can be found to the west of Droknar's Forge, which contains many Mountain Trolls and two Troll bosses. It was once a popular spot for farming.

It is possible to reach the edge of the map in the eastern Talus Chute. The terrain abruptly ends, with the sky and ocean visible beyond it. This "edge of the world" bug is an artifact of the way DirectX renders the world. It exists in all areas, but most have obstructions to prevent players from seeing it.
There is a group which can patrol through the Icedome portal and get stuck there, making vanquishing impossible.

quests/quest:gww:279928/sections/objecti.text: Clear Tangle Root in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279928/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279928/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Tangle Root in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279928/sections/target-.text: Exit from Henge of Denravi or travel through Ettin's Back and Dry Top from Ventari's Refuge. The primary quest Passage Through The Dark River will lead you through here.
Lone Jungle Trolls may be accompanied by a pair of hidden Life Pods and, rarely, a few Moss Scarabs.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.71% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
There are (at least) three ways to reach the upper pathways of Tangle Root:
Turn at your first left uphill after leaving Henge of Denravi.
Turn right after leaving Maguuma Stade.
Turn north uphill by Old Joness and the Statue of Melandru.
There a lot of hidden Moss Scarabs and Life Pods.

The count increases slightly during Defend Denravi. However, since you must kill many of these foes during the quest, some players find it simple to continue to clear the zone. If you choose to vanquish titans, be prepared for Wild Growth popups (only some of which can be avoided) and Rotting Titans.
In the southeastern section, foes are located close by on different levels; watch your aggro range.

quests/quest:gww:279054/sections/objecti.text: Clear Tasca's Demise in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279054/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279054/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Tasca's Demise in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279054/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
While Defend Droknar's Forge is active, there will be more foes to vanquish. However, you will not get vanquishing credit for the Titans that spawn from other Titans, whom you must also kill.
The Avicara near Mineral Springs are hostile to the Stone Summit.
Watch out for patrols before engaging the Stone Summit in the camp at the center of the zone.
An Avicara near Mineral Springs may spawn behind portal requiring to rezone.
A Shiverpeak Chest (or Locked Chest in hard mode) may sometimes spawn behind the portal to Mineral Springs.

quests/quest:gww:25366/sections/requirem.text: Enter Sorrow's Furnace without To Sorrow's Furnace sub quests.

quests/quest:gww:25366/sections/objectiv.text: See Marshall Whitman for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25366/sections/walkthro.text: The items are easily located by simply following the quest marker, although you can probably save time by knowing where to go to minimize the distance traveled. Each item is found in a plain Chest that appears only after defeating an enemy group that "guards" it (it's the group that's targeted by the quest marker). Each enemy group consists of the same set of Stone Summit, as noted in the NPCs section below. These groups are relatively easy to defeat, just be careful of not getting entangled with more than one or two enemy groups, since their locations are usually filled with closely packed enemies. After retrieving the five items, head back to Marshall Whitman for your reward.
Tasca's Axe - the platform overlooking the Stone Basilica.
Tasca's Compass - near the southwestern corner, in Darkhaven.
Tasca's Map - near a group of three Furnace Guardians guarding the entrance into the forge.
Tasca's Boots - a bit east from Molachev, on the northeastern outskirts of Darkhaven.
Tasca's Pack - at the bridge past Molenin, the bridge where Orozar Highstone runs to in Noble Intentions Plan B.

quests/quest:gww:283343/sections/objecti.text: Clear Tears of the Fallen in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283343/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:283343/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Tears of the Fallen in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:283343/sections/target-.text: Travel north from Fishermen's Haven or Sanctum Cay through Stingray Strand, or from Riverside Province through Twin Serpent Lakes.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 64–72 foes. A group of Bog Skale Icetooths may be difficult to spot in the southwestern corner, across a gap from Arris Weston.

quests/quest:gww:69039/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Tekks about helping the yellow Ophil tribe.

quests/quest:gww:69039/sections/walkthro.text: Get this quest from Tekks in Sparkfly Swamp and cross the log to Bogroot Growths. Killing one of the two duelling frogmen in the entrance room will cause the initial dungeon gate to open. The first level of the dungeon consists of two groups of Red Gokir, one with a Boss, and a number of swarms of Blooming Nettles, Nettle Seedlings and Nettle Spores. The Gokirs are tenacious, but can be handled by separating the swarms into manageable groups. Avoid the nettles, as much as possible, but if forced to fight them, kill the spores first. That may allow your group to bypass the rooted nettles and seedlings.
This level also contains an exit into another dungeon in the Central Shiverpeaks, very close by the entrance.

The second level is populated with plants in the initial area, followed by appearances of Incubi. Beyond the second shrine the party will meet a snaking corridor of beetles. After the corridor the Gokir await. Walking to the right hand side of the room will trigger a boulder that will kill all of the Gokir in this room - when they are dead the door to the penultimate room will open. Killing the Gokir Patriach near the boss lock will provide the key required to open the door.

In in the final room, the dungeon boss Z'him Monns and the two Gokir Amini with him must be defeated to spawn the Bogroot Chest. It is recommended to pull away one of the groups of frogmen before pulling Z'him Monns.

quests/quest:gww:69039/sections/notes-1/.text: Upon activating this quest by speaking to Tekks, the quest Giriff's War will be reset. The same will count the other way around.
Due to the large amounts of corpses in Bogroot Growths dungeon, minion masters are useful.

quests/quest:gww:66442/sections/objectiv.text: Locate and defeat the leader of the undead in the temple.
Find a sacked relic and return it to Gron Fierceclaw.
See Gron Fierceclaw [Merchant] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:66442/sections/walkthro.text: The Temple of the Damned features the Cathedral of Flames with a heavy population of undead, Enchanted weapons, and Charr.

The first level is straight forward. Kill Faze Magekiller to obtain the dungeon key, open the door and proceed to the next area. The Keeper and his group of restless spirits are in that area. Killing The Keeper opens the door to the next level.

On the second level there is a dungeon map to the south of the staircase. Tyndir Flamecaller guards the locked door on the east side of the level. Beyond that door, Vraxx the Condemned patrols with a group of Plague Zombies which can be easily pulled and dispatched. Next, carefully pull and clear the Enchanted and undead patrols around the edge of the chamber. Finally, defeat the Master to open the door to the next level.

Either quickly kill the Keymaster of Murakai, or follow it to the location of the dungeon floor map and kill it. The Keymaster will drop the dungeon key when slain. Proceed around the central chamber to the western side of the level. After unlocking the locked door, wait for the Murakai's Steward to finish speaking and slowly pull as many popups as possible from the room. Stay outside the range of the poison darts before killing the Steward and his group at the hill top. With his dungeon key backtrack to the first ramp and proceed north through a nearby tunnel which will take you to the northern side of the main chamber. Clear any undead along the way and run up the northern stairway to the boss door as fast as possible to minimize damage from the fire darts. It is not recommended to run through the center of the chamber as there are a lot more fire darts to contend with.

In the boss room there are Plague Zombies and Bone Fiends that can be easily dispatched before battling with Murakai. When Murakai uses Murakai's Consumption her power meter fills up, which allows her to use Murakai's Storm of Souls. Interrupting Murakai's skills will prevent her from dealing much damage and she will die with only moderate pressure.
Murakai, Lady of the Night#Tips for defeating Murakai
Minion masters are less useful in this dungeon as there are small numbers of exploitable corpses, and the undead can make short work of them using Ray of Judgment and Banishing Strike.
The Charr and the undead are hostile to each other and you can just let them fight each other.
The Charr have high fire damage and the undead use powerful lightning spells, so pre-protting is crucial to mitigate massive amounts of damage.
Beware of the undead popups in this dungeon.
Holy damage, such as from Light of Deldrimor, is very effective against the skeletons and zombies.
Poison Dart, Poison Jet or Poison Spout can hurt the enemy as well as you, so use flags and proceed carefully around them, and possibly pull enemies into these traps.

quests/quest:gww:66442/sections/notes-1/.text: After accepting the reward, you have to return to Doomlore Shrine first if you want to go for another run, or simply change to a different district.

quests/quest:gww:25459/sections/objectiv.text: Eliminate the wardens that threaten the Temple of the Dredge.

quests/quest:gww:25459/sections/environm.text: Once this quest is completed, Warden of Saprophytes will no longer spawn in Ferndale.

quests/quest:gww:25459/sections/walkthro.text: Go to the Temple of the Dredge and destroy the group of wardens there. When finished, return to speak with Moleneaux. Only the boss Warden of Saprophytes need be killed to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25459/sections/notes-1/.text: It is closer to begin this quest from House zu Heltzer or Saint Anjeka's Shrine than from Moleneaux's location.

The temple is also a key location in other quests, so it is possible to simultaneously finish or move along Melodic Gaki Flute, Charting the Forests, The Experimental Weaponsmith and The Beak of Darkness.

quests/quest:gww:15365/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the area plagued by graven monolith attacks.
See Officer Lohru for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15365/sections/walkthro.text: The temple is located in the southwestern corner of the Sulfurous Wastes and can only be reached via Junundu. Be careful of hidden Mandragors along the way, but otherwise you should be able to reach it without fighting. Once you near the quest marker, the quest is complete and you can map back for your reward; you do not have to clear out the temple.

quests/quest:gww:15365/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest Requiem for a Brain takes you to the same temple, so you may want to do both at the same time.

Since there's a good number of monoliths inside the temple, it's a good place to try to get Inscribed Shards needed for the Sticks and Stones quest. Otherwise you may have great difficulty farming for the shards later.
The three Margonite Clerics that spawn inside the temple while this quest is active are not allied to the monoliths; they will not heal the monoliths and they are in their own aggro group.
There is a Treasure Chest inside the temple area.

quests/quest:gww:24381/sections/objectiv.text: Negotiate a deal with Caretaker Palmor to buy back Zudash Dejarin's property.
"Evict" the Kournan soldiers from Dejarin land.
See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:24381/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, talk to Vadah who is also in Pogahn Passage. Next pay a visit to Caretaker Palmor in the Dejarin Estate. She will initially be hostile, so kill off the other soldiers and attack her until she is willing to talk. Backtrack to the location of the squatting soldiers and kill them.

The quest can be completed without having Koss in the party by simply defeating both Caretaker Palmor's group and the group that needs to be "evicted" from the estate. The quest log will continue demanding for Koss' attendance and not update until both groups are dealt with (thus not showing the location of the latter), at which point it will complete.

quests/quest:gww:25708/sections/requirem.text: Guild Wars Prophecies on the account
You must also have completed and accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh

quests/quest:gww:25708/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn more about the situation in Tyria.
Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Tyria.
Report to Lionguard Neiro in the foreign administration center and gain entrance to Lion's Arch and the lands of Kryta.
Inform Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, that you have arrived in Lion's Arch.

quests/quest:gww:25708/sections/walkthro.text: Map travel to the Consulate Docks. Walking there is impossible due to a closed gate. Talk to Mhenlo once, then talk to him again to set off for Tyria. When you get to Lion's Gate talk to Lionguard Neiro to open the gate into Lion's Arch.

quests/quest:gww:25708/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest unlocks the Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).

A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Tyria, provided that they have Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).

Although you can be taken to Lion's Gate by Mhenlo multiple times, Lionguard Neiro will only open the gates to Lion's Arch for you once, so you will need to abandon the quest and retake it for subsequent ferries.
Should your whole party die in the Lion's Gate area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan.
If a Guild Wars Nightfall character has used a ferry to get to the Consulate Docks early, they will still be able to obtain and use this quest later, after having completed The Time is Nigh.
See Campaign travel and Ferry for additional information.
