quests/quest:gww:25500/sections/walkthro.text: From Farmer Dirk, you have to travel South. The prize winning hog is a bit South of the entrance to Nebo Terrace. At the junction to the Nebo Terrace entrance, four groups of two level 15 Gypsie Ettins will appear. Once these are killed, you need to chase the hog back to Farmer Dirk, approaching it from the south so that it runs north. If it gets stuck along the sides of the path, back off a bit and wait for it to move out enough that you can redirect it. You don't have to get the hog into the pen, just as far as Farmer Dirk. When the path splits into two with the big tree in the middle, try to avoid letting the hog near the tree where it can get stuck when it moves through the tree. If this happens you have to rezone and start over again.

If you cannot beat the 8 Ettins (coming in pairs), you can still finish the quest. When you "meet" the hog (at the blue dot), push it as fast as possible towards the south so the incoming Ettins stop before detecting you. Then push him around the east-side hill following the red dots. At the yellow dot, you'll meet a random enemy group, which you can either kill or run through. Walk through the village once more, reach the farmer, and you're done.

quests/quest:gww:25500/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest combines well with The Ascalon Settlement, which provides 4 NPC allies.
During the War in Kryta, if Farmer Dirk is interrogated by Inquisitor Bauer, he will not offer this quest until you rezone.

quests/quest:gww:12149/sections/objectiv.text: Find Captain Yithlis in the Domain of Fear.
Find and defeat the demons surrounding The Unseen.
Return to Commander Thurnis in the Gate of Torment for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:12149/sections/walkthro.text: Enter the Domain of Fear and talk to Captain Yithlis. Head south into the swamp.

The goal of this quest is to kill three Portal Wraiths performing a ritual near The Mouth of Torment. There are many foes nearby: Torment creatures, Torment Claws, Terrorweb Dryders, Grasp of Insanities and Scythe of Chaos. Avoid over-aggro and proceed with caution (pulls, watch minions).
The Oddbodies do not have to survive to complete this quest.

quests/quest:gww:12149/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest combines well with: Holding the Line, A History of Violence, and Bad Fortune since it provides extra allies. Leave The Last Patrol undone to complete these quests first.
The extra allies are also useful for farming Lightbringer points in the Domain of Fear.

quests/quest:gww:38772/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Rahlon and the village men in Mehtani Keys.
Chase down the corsair and stop him before he makes it back to his friends.

quests/quest:gww:38772/sections/walkthro.text: [Incomplete source section] After accepting the quest, head out into Mehtani Keys and talk to Rahlon. The objective is to kill the Sneaky Corsair waiting on the small island nearby. However, when you approach, he will run away, and if he runs too far the quest will fail. It is difficult to catch the corsair, even with speed boosts and snares, mainly because you will be slowed down by other foes along the way. One of the easiest ways to complete the quest is to cut a wide path around him as shown in the map above and approach from the other side. He will start running towards you, giving you plenty of time to use a snare and kill him. Bringing ranged attackers can help to finish the runner if he slips through your initial attack.
See the Notes section for additional methods.

quests/quest:gww:38772/sections/notes-1/.text: Rahlon must survive to complete the quest. The rest of his group is immaterial for this quest.
If you don't have a sprint skill, you'll never catch the "Sneaky Corsair". Even if you do, you'll end up fighting the Mandragor that are hidden in the sand, along with other nuisances.
You can simply kill the corsair after he reaches his destination if you haven't talked to Rahlon, and then talk to Rahlon (after killing the Sneaky Corsair) to get your reward.

Another possibility is to clear the island as mentioned and then station your heroes and henchmen (if any) on a pass which he takes, such as a bridge. The corsair will follow his route and run right to your heroes and henchmen.

One last possibility is to again, clear the island as mentioned above, and then go talk to Rahlon (it doesn't really matter if you talk to him or not, really, because of how slow he and his group run). As you approach the Corsair, he'll begin running; just keep after him, and if you haven't equipped any sprint skills, don't worry- just cut as many corners as you can while doing this. You should finally be able to catch him about halfway through the explorable area, and kill him easily, before making your way back to Rahlon for your reward. If you should happen to run right by Rahlon's volunteer group at some point after killing the corsair, you'll notice that, even though they are all standing there, they're perfectly lined up with one another- giving the effect of there being just one man standing there.
If Isle of the Dead is active, be careful. A group of undead is near a hidden spawn of enemies on the path the corsair runs.

quests/quest:gww:21748/sections/objectiv.text: Find and speak to Salma in the Temple of the Ages.
Return to Watchman Arad for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:21748/sections/walkthro.text: If you have unlocked Temple of the Ages already, map there and speak with Princess Salma. Otherwise, the outpost is a long walk from either Lion's Arch or Fisherman's Haven, where you picked up the quest.

The travel from Fisherman's Haven to Temple of the Ages requires crossing four explorable areas. The starting outpost provides level 15 henchmen and a party size of six. The whole journey may seem to be a long trip, but it is actually quite quick as there are only a few foes in the way in each area. The only instances that need careful engagement are where there are different types of creatures standing close together, and skale groups with a Grand Drake. Consider hex removal since the Bog Skales use numerous hexes.

This route also crosses four explorable areas: North Kryta Province, Nebo Terrace, the Cursed Lands, and the Black Curtain. However, the henchmen are only level 10, and there is significantly more fighting along the way. It is advisable to unlock Bergen Hot Springs on the way and gain level 12 henchmen; if you have already been to that outpost, you can start there to skip North Kryta Province and half of Nebo Terrace. Be careful crossing the Cursed Lands, since many of the undead groups are close together, and head northwest to the northern portal leading to the Black Curtain. Be prepared for frequent applications of poison and crippled.

quests/quest:gww:21748/sections/notes-1/.text: The dialogue implies that this quest takes place after The Royal Papers, despite both quests being available from Watchman Arad simultaneously. The quest marker will not appear on the radar while in explorable areas, except at The Black Curtain.

quests/quest:gww:22001/sections/objectiv.text: Find Hanbahd the Anchorite in the Mirror of Lyss.
Protect Hanbahd the Anchorite from the attacking Margonites.
Hanbahd has fled to the Halls of Chokhin. Locate him, and find out what he knows about the ancient temple site.

quests/quest:gww:22001/sections/walkthro.text: Hanbahd can be found in the Mirror of Lyss a little to the east of the Kodash Bazaar.

The party's arrival at Hanbahd will trigger several waves of Margonite attacks, consisting of 2 or 4 creatures, that will try to kill Hanbahd. The party must keep Hanbahd alive to continue the quest. Once saved, Hanbahd will run off towards Mihanu Township, telling the players to follow and find him in the Halls of Chokhin. At this point, it's probably quickest to map to Mihanu Township and continue on into the Holdings of Chokhin.
Outside, follow the narrow passage on the south edge of the Holdings of Chokhin, to find Hanbahd at the end with your quest reward.

quests/quest:gww:22001/sections/notes-1/.text: Do this quest with The Search for Survivors or Reclaiming the Temple to use the 4 Vabbian Guards and the Vabbian Guard Captain to help protect Hanbahd the Anchorite.

quests/quest:gww:269412/sections/objecti.text: Investigate the Shining Blade cloak at the Scrying Pool.

quests/quest:gww:269412/sections/walkthr.text: Enter Watchtower Coast from Divinity Coast (outpost). The Shining Blade Cloak will be on a sunken path, shortly below the first W in "Watchtower Coast" on the map. (The cloak is also close to Beetletun, but the path is swarmed with Tengu.)

quests/quest:gww:18544/sections/requirem.text: Not being primary or secondary Mesmer.
Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Mesmer.

quests/quest:gww:18544/sections/objectiv.text: Go through Skyward Reach to Diviner's Ascent.
Slay all three tempest drakes in a single battle.
Return to Eulenias for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18544/sections/walkthro.text: This is easiest to accomplish leaving Elona Reach. Hug the south wall, moving to the teleporters, and continue eastward, hugging the north wall to where it makes a sharp northward turn, then straight out to the end of the area. The Tempest Drakes are immediately north of this position, and will not separate from their mob. Area of effect skills and some hit and run tactics will easily defeat all three very quickly. After the going through teleporter, if you do not hug the north wall, there is a good chance that you will aggro the Sand Wurm which dwells in the middle of this explorable area.

quests/quest:gww:277743/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Mirror of Lyss in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:277743/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:277743/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Mirror of Lyss in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:64057/sections/objectiv.text: Seek the great jotun living within Darkrime Delves.
Find the source of the roar heard from below.
Find a way to kill the giant jotun.
See Einarr Frostcleft for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:64057/sections/walkthro.text: Close to the start of the level, a massive snowball will be sent towards you but can be easily avoided by keeping close to the right hand wall. Go southwest through the opening and follow the map to the Dwarven Powder keg station - grab a keg and blow up the southern door. Follow the right wall, and then kill the Havok-kin you encounter, who drops a key. Blow up the ice wall with the keg, kill the Jotun group, and then unlock the gate with the key. Either cross the near bridge if it is down, or head north to the other bridge to cross the chasm. There will be groups of Vaettir that popup. Continue south and then pull the lever to lower the bridge - cross it and pickup the key (be careful not to harm yourself by triggering the Ice Jet traps). More Vaettir spawns will appear on the cleared path after pulling the lever. Backtrack and unlock the gate, and then continue to the portal.

Follow the path down the ramp until the terrain changes and you are in a dark room with a Cracked Wall opposite. A group of Jotun including a warrior boss will charge in. Take the middle route in the next room - and then avoid the two giant snowballs that roll down the hill. Kill the Jotun at the far end and then proceed slowly into the next room to deal with the Chromatic Drakes. Another Jotun boss awaits at the southern end of the room. Keep heading south and lure small groups of Jotun out of the room until you can pull Grelk Icelash out - killing it provides the key to level 2. Backtrack north, unlock the gate and proceed. Hard mode features an additional Havok-kin boss prior to the exit gate.
Head south and then loop back into the boss room where there are loads of stationary Jotun. Lure Jotun out until you can pull Havok Soulwail - kill her and then swoop in for the reward chest.
Hex removal - useful vs Jotun Bladeturners and Mindbreakers.
Anti-knock down - useful vs Giant Stomp which is used by melee Jotun, and various skills used by Chromatic Drakes.

quests/quest:gww:64057/sections/notes-1/.text: It's best to wait until the timer ends after opening the dungeon chest. You will be brought back next to Einarr Frostcleft, allowing you take the reward.
It is possible to pull each individual Jotun from around Havok Soulwail without aggroing her directly.
It's also possible to pull Havok Soulwail (after killing some Jotuns in front of her). Simply use a longbow/flatbow and shoot her several times until she hits you with melee attacks.

quests/quest:gww:64057/sections/notes-2/.text: While in the Darkrime Delves during this quest, Einarr Frostcleft and Kolgrim Bainwight cannot be targeted by foes and do not attack, take damage nor use any skills.
Upon completion of the Darkrime Delves portion of this quest, you end up in the Bjora Marches, just outside Volsung's Stead.
Ironically, when you go to talk to Einarr to claim your reward for this quest, he and Kolgrim start the beginning dialogue again.
When using Light of Deldrimor, the secret switch found in the Southern end of the third level opens the door found East of the boss room.
The "Reward dialogue" ignores the fact that Einarr accompanies your party in Darkrime Delves during the quest and was present when your party kills Havok Soulwail.

quests/quest:gww:25386/sections/objectiv.text: Find Yort the Bronze's ceremonial family sword.
Return the ceremonial family sword to Yort the Bronze.

quests/quest:gww:25386/sections/walkthro.text: The shortest route is to map to Augury Rock and then go north-west from there to enter the ditch. Follow the ditch until you find the Ancient Remains; once you click on the yellow text you will receive the sword. Then just map back for your reward.

An alternative (though slightly longer) route is to start from Heroes' Audience and walk north up the western side of Prophet's Path until you reach the grassy area the river flows through, then walk north-east along the river/grass until you find the Ceremonial Family Sword.
Although the Amnoon Oasis looks to be the closest outpost, if you leave from there, you will have to take a much longer route to be able to enter the ditch.

quests/quest:gww:14272/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road through Traveler's Vale to the Ascalon Foothills.

quests/quest:gww:14272/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the quest marker into Ascalon Foothills. Once you arrive, keep an eye out for various Hydras who use Meteor and Stone Fury who can blind you with Eruption. Once you get to Artisan Rudger, talk to him complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:9272/sections/objective.text: Go to Bukdek Byway and burn the diseased corpses.
Investigate the corpse thefts and find out where the bodies are being taken.
See Guardsman Kinri for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9272/sections/walkthrou.text: Leave for Bukdek Byway by way of Kaineng Center. The compass will lead you towards catching Corpse Thief Mang in the act of moving some corpses. Confront him and the quest will be complete.

quests/quest:gww:25477/sections/objectiv.text: Find Ke Feng's boss, Shae Wong, in Kaineng Center.
Find Ke Feng in the Undercity and inform him that his cover is blown.
Kill the Jade Brotherhood thug Noqui.
Return to Shae Wong and tell him what has transpired.

quests/quest:gww:25477/sections/environm.text: Once this quest is accepted, Baosen will no longer spawn in the Undercity.

quests/quest:gww:25477/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is triggered by talking to Baosen. Ke Feng and several Jade Brotherhood members will spawn. When Ke Feng's health is low he will turn friendly and the actual quest can be accepted from him. Travel to Kaineng Center and talk to Shae Wong. Return to the Undercity and go to Ke Feng's location. As you approach him Noqui will pop up in front of him and kill him. Kill Noqui.
After Noqui is dead, return to Shae Wong and accept the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25477/sections/notes-1/.text: You cannot save Ke Feng, no matter how quick your character or party is.
Senjo Wah can be asked about this quest, although he does not play any role in it.

quests/quest:gww:24300/sections/objectiv.text: Investigate the fate of the patrol under Captain Yithlis.
Defeat the attacking demons. Captain Yithlis must survive.
See Captain Yithlis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:24300/sections/walkthro.text: Start from the Gate of Torment, pick up the Monolith bounty for the single monolith you'll encounter. Make your way directly to the quest marker, you will not encounter any groups apart from those surrounding Yithlis. Though appearing to be an easy quest, it can become complicated by the outnumbering spawns and nearby patrols. Try to clear the area of hostile groups (especially patrols) before approaching Captain Yithlis (entering aggro range will add his group to the party window and will spawn a group coming to attack you from the direction of the Gate of Torment). Do not talk to Captain Yithlis until all nearby attacking mobs have been defeated. After defeating the attacking groups, you can pick up the nearby Torment Bounty to the west.

Talking to Captain Yithlis will start the spawn of an additional 4 groups of tormented creatures (all approaching from the north). Protect the Captain from the torment creatures, his allies don't matter for the purpose of completing the quest, but will aid you against the tormented foes.
After defeating the spawning enemies, talk to Captain Yithlis for the reward - he will also offer you the next quest, which happens in the same area.

quests/quest:gww:18546/sections/requirem.text: Not being primary or secondary Monk.
Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Monk.

quests/quest:gww:18546/sections/objectiv.text: Travel through the Salt Flats to Diviner's Ascent.
Find the Eater of Souls and destroy it!
Return to Nausuan for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18546/sections/walkthro.text: Although the quest says you must go through the Salt Flats to get to Diviner's Ascent, it is easier and faster if you simply map travel to Elona Reach and then walk northeast to the quest marker. The Eater of Souls will appear in the distance. As the player approaches; however, it will soon disappear and a swarm of Jade Scarabs will take its place. After defeating a total of three waves of enemies, the Eater of Souls finally reappears to allow itself to be defeated.
There are enough foes to power one or even two minion masters.

quests/quest:gww:18546/sections/notes-1/.text: If you keep this quest active, the groups of Jade Scarabs can be farmed for Jade Mandibles.

quests/quest:gww:25452/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Haiju Lagoon and talk to Scout Shenfai.
Head North to the beach to look for Naga. Report your findings to Scout Shenfai.
See Scout Shenfai for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25452/sections/walkthro.text: It's preferable to wait with this quest until you have unlocked Zen Daijun (outpost), as the route is shorter and the henchmen are of a higher level. Otherwise you have to travel from Seitung Harbor. In either case, make your way to Scout Shenfai, talk to him, and then travel north and then northeast. There are no extra foes on the route. Once near the beach, clear the normal nagas from the area, and then investigate the beach location indicated. A group of nagas will spawn, defeat them. This is repeated two more times. Take care to only trigger one group at a time. After that, you can go back and collect the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25438/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with [3...0] more masters on the training grounds of the Isle of the Nameless.
Return to the Guide on the Isle of the Nameless.

quests/quest:gww:25438/sections/walkthro.text: Head to the main area of the isle. There, talk to three nameless masters other than Master of Winds; the closest ones are Master of Combat, Master of Magic and Master of Area Effects.

quests/quest:gww:25438/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest marker will lead you to the Master of Combat, followed by Master of Magic and then Master of Conditions; however, you can speak any of the friendly masters in any order.

quests/quest:gww:25501/sections/objectiv.text: Get past the fire traps in the burning section of the catacombs. (Use bone horrors to trigger the traps.)
Return to Necromancer Munne for your reward.
Munne will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:25501/sections/walkthro.text: Follow Necromancer Munne, fighting enemies as you go. Eventually she'll stop at the beginning of a long hallway with three consecutive Flame Geyser trap runes on the ground.

These traps are especially deadly, dealing 500 elemental damage to unarmored targets, instantly killing most characters. Even rangers (which possess the highest armor against elemental damage among all professions) have to be at least level 6 with a good shield (e.g. the Serrated Shield) to survive. The game immediately demonstrates this destructive power by having a devourer spawn from the wall and run straight in the second trap, getting killed on the spot.
The idea is to use Animate Bone Horror; as the corpse is within the trap, the minion summoned from it will immediately trigger the trap, at the cost of it dying in the process.

Once the traps are removed, the path to the Tomb Nightmare is clear. Despite being level 4, the Nightmare is very weak. It is especially susceptible to cold damage, making Deathly Swarm particularly effective.
Go back to Munne to collect the reward. You can also map travel to Ashford Abbey and re-enter the Catacombs as she will be back at her original location.

quests/quest:gww:25501/sections/notes-1/.text: There are various ways to kill the Tomb Nightmare without confronting it directly:

If you have a flatbow or longbow, instead of triggering the last Flame Geyser, you can take advantage of the stairs' elevation to pull the Nightmare. It will try to get to you and run straight into the trap.

There's a ledge overlooking the Tomb Nightmare to the west of the last room, which can be more easily reached from the entrance in Green Hills County, north of The Barradin Estate, going then straight south then east. You can again pull the Nightmare with a bow and it will try to come straight to you, leaving you some time to kill it with ranged spells or attacks while it is still pondering how to reach you.
During the quest Vanguard Rescue: Save the Ascalonian Noble, two vanguard foes will spawn in the same spot than the Tomb Nightmare, and kill it in your stead.

You can use Devona to trigger the first trap which will likely kill her unless she's level 8 or higher. You will need to resurrect her with a Resurrection Signet to sacrifice her again to trigger the second trap.

quests/quest:gww:18547/sections/requirem.text: Not being primary or secondary Necromancer.
Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Necromancer.

quests/quest:gww:18547/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Prophet's Path and slay the Sacred Griffon of Amnoon.
Return to Zratha Kor for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18547/sections/walkthro.text: It is much quicker to leave from Augury Rock to complete this quest.

Head west from Augury Rock, veering south. You will encounter some Rockshot Devourers, some Scarabs, and a small handful of Minotaurs along the way. Take the groups one at a time, and you should not have too much trouble. The Devourers will probably lay a few traps down before you can engage them, so you should be prepared to deal with conditions like blindness and burning.

Continue heading southeast. You will encounter more Devourers and Scarabs. Kepkhet Marrowfeast will also be there, along with a rather large group of Scarabs. Avoid them and continue southeast. The Sacred Griffon of Amnoon will be surrounded by a small group of Desert Griffons. Kill the Sacred Griffon first as it is a Monk, followed by the Desert Griffons, or alternatively pull them separately as the Sacred Griffon is not part of the group. Return to Zratha Kor for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18547/sections/notes-1/.text: You can kill some minotaurs on your way to the Sacred Griffon of Amnoon, which helps you complete the quest Ghostly Vengeance.

quests/quest:gww:232300/sections/objecti.text: Engage Dhuum in the Hall of Judgment. Your entire party must enter the hall.

Protect the Reapers while they channel all their energy into Dhuum's Rest, a powerful enchantment developed to force Dhuum into dormancy. At least one Reaper must survive. There are 7..1 Reapers still standing.
Lay Dhuum low so the Reapers' magic can force Dhuum into dormancy.
See King Frozenwind for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:232300/sections/walkthr.text: While facing Dhuum, if you die or your death penalty hits 60%, you will be moved next to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale and turned into Spirit Form. Players must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; heroes are returned automatically. Consumables that remove death penalty or grant a Morale Boost can prevent this.

Death in Spirit Form is supposed to be permanent, since the Curse of Dhuum prevents the use of resurrection skills during this battle. But resurrection scrolls and "By Ural's Hammer!" still work, as does pre-casting delayed resurrection skills like Unyielding Aura before entering the room.

There are two goals in this battle. One is to fill the Dhuum's Rest bar, which is achieved gradually with the skill Dhuum's Rest used by the Reapers and by players in Spirit Form. The other is to damage Dhuum directly, bringing him below 25% health. When both goals are met, the fight is over and you can collect the reward from King Frozenwind.

Throughout the battle, make sure to kill all of the Minions of Dhuum and Champions of Dhuum that Dhuum periodically summons; if you don't kill them, they'll swarm your team. Because of the amount of skeletons and the easiness of killing them, Edge of Extinction is a good tool for keeping their numbers down. Avoid using the spirit form skill Encase Skeletal, since it prevents the target from taking damage; as more and more come it gets harder to keep them all in check and easier for them to swarm.

quests/quest:gww:24308/sections/objectiv.text: Escort the Oddbodies to the Gate of Torment
See Commander Thurnis for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:24308/sections/walkthro.text: Having survived the preceeding quest, escort Captain Yithlis and his patrol back to the Gate of Torment. You will be attacked by 3 mobs of torment creatures running at your escort on the way, so don't think you can take it easy!

Scythes of Chaos like to attack Yithlis and the spell casting party, running around the warriors so keep an eye on them. Consider killing Shadows of Fear first to ensure that you don't have to face exploding minions in addition to the other demons.

The enemy groups spawn on the route back to the Gate of Torment even between handing in the previous quest and picking up this one — so if you want to make sure all the Oddbodies survive, you can fight the mobs before you accept this quest. If you killed all enemy groups around the NPCs during The Missing Patrol, they stay safe in that spot while you are off hunting the quest mobs.

quests/quest:gww:24308/sections/notes-1/.text: You can use the Oddbodies to help farm Lightbringer points in this area. It may be worthwhile not to turn in the quest for this reason.
It is possible to avoid all of the mobs unscathed, with the exception of a few henchman/heroes.
The quest can be completed with just one member of the Oddbodies surviving.

quests/quest:gww:25491/sections/objectiv.text: Find the Basket of Apples. Take it to Mary Malone.

quests/quest:gww:25491/sections/walkthro.text: Travel south from Fort Ranik, then turn east toward an area with stone arches. Giant Needle Spiders will popup at the entrance of the path leading to the area and around the ruins. Kill them and then pick up the basket lying underneath a nearby tree.

Picking up the basket triggers an additional spider to spawn next to you immediately and others on the way back. In total, 6 additional level 2 spiders spawn while you carry the basket, 3 next to the arches, 3 others near the exit. Their spawn locations are about the same as the regular spawns.

As with most bundles, you cannot attack with your weapon and your movement speed is reduced while carrying the basket, though you can still cast most spells. Should you need to attack with your weapon, feel free to drop the bundle and pick it up again after the fight. Kill the spiders and return the basket to Mary to get your reward.
Caution: Do not map travel to save time; doing so will cause you to lose the basket, forcing you to fetch it again, similar to the strongbox in the Bandit Raid quest.

quests/quest:gww:25491/sections/notes-1/.text: Higher level characters can farm this quest for Spider Legs.
Sometimes a spider may spawn inside a tree.

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to the Guard of the Isles near the eastern gate to access the Forbidden Path.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to General Yurukaro in the Zaishen Elite refuge.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/rewards-.text: Unlocks the Zaishen Elite outpost for the account.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/walkthro.text: Speak to the Guard of the Isles near the eastern gate (he will refuse to talk to you if do not have this quest active). You will be taken to the other side of the gate, then just follow the winding Forbidden Path. If finding the gap in the cliff proves difficult, refer to the instructions given by Rioka.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/walkthro.text: Upon arrival in the Elite refuge, talk to Yurukaro and the quest will be completed.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/notes-1/.text: Roleplaying characters on accounts created prior to the January 19, 2006 update do not need to complete the Zaishen Challenge to acquire this quest.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/notes-1/.text: Outside of events, this quest is the only way to visit the Forbidden Path. If you want to enjoy the scenery, make sure not to collect the "reward".

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:25439/sections/notes-1/.text: Though the reward quest seems to be account-wide, the quest can be taken and accomplished by different characters of the same account. However you'll still need to complete the two previous quests.

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

quests/quest:gww:67232/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to the deciphered location in Varajar Fells.

quests/quest:gww:67232/sections/walkthro.text: In eastern Varajar Fells where Nifling the Chained usually is, Kerrsh will be waiting for you. Upon approaching, the crater will spawn the various facets faced in the preceeding quests one after the other. Defeat them all to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:67232/sections/notes-1/.text: You can reach the spawning site faster from the Central Transfer Chamber, if you have completed Destruction's Depths.
This quest is useful for farming Norn title points.
Under the Norn Hunting Party blessing, each Facet counts for 50 points.
Under the maximum hunt rank (after 250 kills), you can receive 1.8k (300/boss in normal mode) or 2.7k (450/boss in hard mode).
You can improve this further by waiting until you are under the effects of a Boss Bounty
You may map to Tarnished Haven and collect the reward from Kerrsh there, as well.
Kerrsh and the Facets will not spawn if A Good Deed and or Wintersday Cheer is active.

quests/quest:gww:11559/sections/objectiv.text: See Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11559/sections/walkthro.text: This quest takes place entirely in the Kaineng Docks. There are no enemies to fight, so you can do this solo if you please. First, speak with Deckhand Jakob at the end of the pier, then speak with Kevan at the base of the stairs, and finish off with Captain Ander at the top of the stairs.

quests/quest:gww:25482/sections/objectiv.text: Cross the river and destroy the plague devourer to get a poisonous stinger.
Deliver the poisonous stinger to Brother Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey.

quests/quest:gww:25482/sections/walkthro.text: Head south from Ascalon City and cross the river to reach the island cave (which appears grey on your map). Go around the western side until you reach the cave's entrance near Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn, and venture into the cave.

Although there are four more Carrion Devourers in the cave during this quest than usual, you can ignore most of them and the Lash Devourers, since they don't attack you unless a Diseased Devourer pops up. When this happens, focus on Diseased Devourers first, since they are level 0 and will die in one or two basic hits.

The Plague Devourer is located near the end of the cave and will pop up and attack you once approached. Despite the dialogue, it cannot poison you. Once you have killed it, two poisonous stingers will drop. Collect one of them and map travel to Ashford Abbey to give it to Brother Mhenlo.

quests/quest:gww:25482/sections/notes-1/.text: Since a devourer has two tails, it will drop two stingers; however, only one of them is needed to complete the quest. The other one can be discarded or ignored.

quests/quest:gww:25467/sections/objectiv.text: Enter the catacombs and destroy the Blood Fanatics.
Return to Kasha Blackblood for your reward.
Kasha will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:25467/sections/environm.text: Accepting this quest temporarily removes the Gargoyles and collector Karleen from the cavern near the Green Hills County exit. They will start spawning again once the Blood Fanatics are dealt with.

quests/quest:gww:25467/sections/walkthro.text: The fastest route to the fanatics is from the Barradin Estate. From there, head north following the quest marker, and cross the second bridge near the Catacombs entrance. Inside, go straight east to find the fanatics (see the quest map for reference).

Alternatively, you may map travel to Ashford Abbey and enter the Catacombs there. There is a hidden passage to the right, just behind Necromancer Munne. At the end of the cavern, follow the long path straight ahead littered with gargoyles. When the path forks, follow the quest marker to the stairs which lead to a crypt on the right, where the fanatics are located.
The fanatics themselves shouldn't pose any serious threat, dispose of them before returning to Kasha for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25467/sections/notes-1/.text: Although there are five fanatics, you only need to kill three of them. While Kasha tells you that the Blood Fanatics are fond of Dark Pact, they in fact use Vile Touch.

quests/quest:gww:25512/sections/objectiv.text: Tell Gareth Quickblade about the lost White Mantle patrol.
Meet the Shining Blade scouts in Silverwood.
Seek out and destroy the White Mantle patrol.
Collect [5...0] more ruined White Mantle armors.
Take the 5 ruined White Mantle armors back to Gareth Quickblade.

quests/quest:gww:25512/sections/walkthro.text: From Quarrel Falls, travel north to find Alari Doubleblade (see first map) and obtain the quest. Once you have the quest, map travel back to Quarrel Falls and talk to Gareth. It is suggested that first-time players not do this until you complete Bloodstone Fen, otherwise the actions you need to undertake in the quest will confuse you. Completing Bloodstone Fen will also put you right in Quarrel Falls.

Go outside and meet up with the Shining Blade Scout and two Shining Blade Rangers. They will head off to the north (see second map) for you to follow. They will aggro everything in their path and can die easily, but don't need to be kept alive for quest completion. Alternatively, you can head out of Bloodstone Fen (see third map). Kill the patrol, and pick up the Ruined Armors they drop. Map travel back to Quarrel Falls for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25512/sections/notes-1/.text: You can skip speaking to Gareth Quickblade by simply rezoning into Silverwood and killing the White Mantle patrol.
You can skip speaking to the Shining Blade Scouts by map traveling to Bloodstone Fen, then zoning into Silverwood, taking a left, and killing the patrol without them.

quests/quest:gww:25489/sections/objectiv.text: Head to the catacombs and find Pitney's prize bird.
Return to Pitney for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25489/sections/environm.text: For the duration of the quest, the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird will spawn in the ritual chamber of the catacombs.

quests/quest:gww:25489/sections/walkthro.text: After taking the quest, head to the Catacombs. You can enter from three locations, though Ashford Abbey is probably the quickest.

From Ashford Abbey: Head south down one set of stairs, then west down another to a Y-intersection. Take the northwestern path across a bridge and down yet another set of stairs. There are two paths north from this room: a near one which leads to a Flame Geyser, and a less obvious one on the far side of the room. Take the far one, then turn southwest after the second pillar. Deadly Crypt Spiders pop up along this section. Continue along this path until just before the walls change over to stone blocks, and you'll find a passage south. This passage leads to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.

From Green Hills County: Move past the Gargoyles and take the path south, turning west at the intersection. In the large circular room, head southwest and take the corridor south where Oberan the Reviled stands. After the corridor turns east, Deadly Crypt Spiders will start popping up. Where the stone wall on your right ends, take path south, and you'll come to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.

From Wizard's Folly: Simply follow the left wall to the northwest and you will enter a corridor with groups of undead. After two or three groups, you'll come to an intersection with corridors north, south, east (the way you came), and west. Turn south and head up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.

Approach the corpse to complete the quest. Be aware that two Crypt Fiends spawn when you get near the corpse. It is usually possible to complete the quest without spawning the Crypt Fiends. Return to Pitney for your reward.
Skills that deal Holy Damage, such as Bane Signet will help you get rid of the undead along the way quickly.
The Crypt Fiends are susceptible to Fire Damage, so even a low level character with a spell like Flare should have an easy time dealing with them.
The Corpse of the Prize Moa Bird can be used to Animate Bone Horrors to assist against the fiends.

quests/quest:gww:25503/sections/objectiv.text: Find the shrine of Melandru's statue along the path in the woods.
Use your Charm Animal skill on one of Melandru's Stalkers when it appears.
Return to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.
Master Ranger Nente will give you a Starter Bow and the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:25503/sections/walkthro.text: Head south until you reach a Statue of Melandru. Several Melandru's Stalkers can be found nearby. Target one of the beasts and use Charm Animal. The stalker will become hostile and attack while you are taming it. For safety, you may wish to use Troll Unguent beforehand, or you can stand close to the Statue of Melandru which provides health regeneration to any creature near it.

quests/quest:gww:25503/sections/notes-1/.text: Charming an animal other than a Melandru's Stalker stalls this quest. To finish it, you must relinquish your current pet to Jarrel the Tamer, pre-Searing Ascalon's only pet tamer, and try again.
It is a good idea to keep the Melandru's Stalker as the post-searing quest Endangered Species requires you to tame one, although you may tame one in post-searing, too.
If you have the quest The Hunter's Horn active, the spot you have to purify the horn is near where you charm the Stalker.

quests/quest:gww:18548/sections/requirem.text: Not being primary or secondary Ranger.
Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Ranger.

quests/quest:gww:18548/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Salt Flats and slay the Yxthoshth.
Return to Telius for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18548/sections/walkthro.text: For this quest it is best to bring some kind of interrupt, because of the Hydra that you will encounter on your path. You will encounter Storm Kin patrols on your way to Yxthoshth. Once Yxthoshth comes in to visual range, the Storm Kin near him will head right for you. Either kill the Storm Kin first then Yxthoshth or go straight for Yxthoshth.

quests/quest:gww:18548/sections/notes-1/.text: This is the only secondary profession quest to provide access to an elite skill.

quests/quest:gww:25420/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Zho and Sujun in Panjiang Peninsula.
Follow Ling Wong as she tracks the elusive red frog.
See Headmaster Greico for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25420/sections/notes-1/.text: If Sujun dies, you must rezone to try again.

quests/quest:gww:13728/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver Farrah's message to Little Thom.
Tell Farrah of the death of Little Thom.

quests/quest:gww:13728/sections/walkthro.text: Walk out of Fort Ranik and head to King's Watch in Regent Valley.
Walk out of Sardelac Sanitarium and head through Old Ascalon to King's Watch in Regent Valley
At the marked location on your map you will find the Corpse of Little Thom. Approach it until your character remarks on it, then return to Piken Square for the reward.

quests/quest:gww:13728/sections/notes-1/.text: Obviously, this is not Little Thom. It is simply an Ascalon Guard, who was probably set up by Thom to get away.
Sometimes, due to lag, when the player reaches Farrah Cappo after finding Little Thom, the quest does not finish. Instead, the quest reverts to finding him again.

quests/quest:gww:289159/sections/shared-.text: Leave from Tahnnakai Temple and head directly south to meet up with Miku. Once the mission has begun, follow the map route to eventually bring Miku to Ashu's location at the temple's center. Ministry of Purity groups spawn in each room that must be killed before moving onto the next. Furthermore, clearing the first group and every consecutive group within the temple will spawn more foes periodically at the temple's entrance, which will then chase after you. Note: These foes will not stay dead if you choose to fight them; they rez after being knocked out for a minute. Since it is not advised to fight the spawning foes, try to trigger every Hidden Switch in each room in order to close the gate to the previous room behind you. The important thing is to move quickly (kill group, trigger Hidden Switch, move on) because the gates do not stay closed forever, and eventually the Ministry forces will build up and easily outnumber you towards the end. Once Miku is brought to Ashu their dialogue will begin, and at that point the quest is completed (even if the Ministry rushes and wipes your party).
It is possible to shadow step to each Hidden Switch as they technically count as allies.

Miku must reach Ashu in order to trigger the final dialogue. If Miku dies along the way, she risks resurrecting behind a closed gate and staying there forever. Unless you can quickly trace her back before the pursuing ministry forces reach her, or are able to overwhelm you instead, you must restart the quest.

quests/quest:gww:47030/sections/objectiv.text: Capture the portal location to close the rift that provides the demons passage from the Realm of Torment.
See Voice of Whispers for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:47030/sections/walkthro.text: Head towards the rift, which is located north of the cave that you defended in the preceding quest. You will notice a list of stationary Torment creatures, with three groups of patrols around it. Two of the stationary foes are Torment Claws. It is advisable to clear off other mobs around the area before you engage the foes around the rift, to give you more space.

Start by pulling the patrols and taking care of them one at a time. Once the patrols are cleared, pull the stationary foes, which are not all in the same group. Once you kill the Torment Claws, be ready to retreat. When the rift starts closing, five groups of Torment creatures will spawn and charge to the rift's location in waves. It's recommended to retreat to a safe location and intercept just one or two of the groups away from the rift. Then just return and pull the remaining groups before closing the rift.

If you do not have any minions or spirits that automatically attack the Torment Claws, it is possible to close the rift before the reinforcements arrive. Once the rift is closed, the quest is complete, regardless of whether the reinforcements are still alive or not.

quests/quest:gww:25436/sections/requirem.text: Kill Yorrt Strongjaw and talk to Gull Hookbeak to get this quest.

quests/quest:gww:25436/sections/objectiv.text: Locate a powerful Yeti that Gull Hookbeak can kill to complete the Rite of Valor.
Eliminate the Yeti without killing Yrrg Snagtooth.
See Gull Hookbeak for your reward

quests/quest:gww:25436/sections/walkthro.text: You will find Gull Hookbeak on a small plateau/hill between the Silver Crimson Skull Coin Collector and Stolen Supplies Collector in combat with Yorrt Strongjaw. Kill Strongjaw first then speak to Gull to begin the quest. Follow the quest marker to the yeti outlined in the quest, Yrrg Snagtooth. After you have done this, kill the yetis around the boss without killing the boss. Weaken him to allow Gull to deliver the killing blow. Speak to Gull once more to accept your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25436/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest is useful to farm Stolen Supplies, since it causes additional groups of Yeti to spawn.
Be careful with henchmen and/or heroes during this quest, lest you accidentally kill Yrrg Snagtooth with AoE damage.
You will get credit for the quest if Snagtooth dies out of compass range of the other Yeti, regardless of how he dies.
Thus, some people choose to pull the boss away from the main battle.
This quest is (normally) mutually exclusive with Death with Honor, depending on which boss dies first.
Yorrt Strongjaw's death leads to this quest.
Gull Hookbeak's death leads to the other.
It is possible to complete both Death with Honor and The Rite of Valor by entering the area with another player who has not completed either quest.

quests/quest:gww:38765/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road from Yak's Bend to Borlis Pass. Defeat all Stone Summit raiders along the road.
Return to Captain Osric for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:38765/sections/walkthro.text: Enter Traveler's Vale and follow the quest markers along the road to Borlis Pass. At each marker, there will be a group of two or three Stone Summit dwarves who must be killed to reveal the next marker. Advance carefully, especially if you have other quests active in the area, pulling foes if necessary to avoid over-aggro. Once all nine groups have been killed, you can return to Yak's Bend to claim the reward.

quests/quest:gww:38765/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest Shiverpeak Stragglers will spawn a clump of about a dozen Stone Summit dwarves in the middle of this quest's path. They can be engaged with careful pulling or a strong party, but it is easiest to circle around using the eastern path and complete Shiverpeak Stragglers first, causing most of these additional foes to move south and out of the way.
The Way is Blocked takes place at the end of this quest's path, so it can be convenient to do both quests together if you can handle the additional Snow Ettins spawned by The Way is Blocked.

quests/quest:gww:25470/sections/requirem.text: Having killed the rogue bull during A Mesmer's Burden without abandoning said quest.

quests/quest:gww:25470/sections/objectiv.text: Search for a source of devourer eggs in Lakeside County. Collect one devourer egg.
Return to Old Mac for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25470/sections/environm.text: Upon accepting the quest, Old Mac will no longer walk up to Althea's stage to have a short argument with her.

quests/quest:gww:25470/sections/walkthro.text: This quest becomes available after killing the Rogue Bull as part of A Mesmer's Burden. It turns out that the bull (named 'Bill'), was owned by Old Mac. After rezoning and approaching the Ascalon City gate, Old Mac will appear near the resurrection shrine on the left. He will walk up to Lady Althea by her stage and have a short conversation with her. He will then walk back the way he came and stand just outside the entrance to Ascalon City; he will give the quest at any time after talking to Althea.

The best source of eggs is Duke Gaban's quest, The Egg Hunter, across the river from Ascalon City, at the Devourer Cave. You can also trade 5 Skale Fins to Brownlow just outside the entrance to Ascalon City, or 3 Dull Carapaces to Rownan in Regent Valley for an egg.
Once you have acquired an egg, return it to Old Mac to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25470/sections/notes-1/.text: If you have someone with you who is neither a primary nor a secondary Mesmer, Old Mac doesn't reappear. While Old Mac is talking to Lady Althea (before he gives the quest) he answers Althea a few moments before she says anything.

quests/quest:gww:4981/sections/requireme.text: Having chosen Goren to accompany Midauha in Istan in the quest Brains or Brawn.
Gain Norgu neither active nor completed

quests/quest:gww:4981/sections/objective.text: Write a short script with Norgu.
Perform with Norgu in Pojah Estates.
Protect Norgu from the dangers of Vehtendi Valley.
Destroy the heket that have overrun the performance area.
Register Norgu's play rights with Records Keeper Palin at the Writing Guild of Vabbi.

quests/quest:gww:4981/sections/walkthrou.text: The initial quest objective can be approached from either Honur Hill or the Kodash Bazaar. Going from Honur Hill will take you through Yahnur Market, and while this isn't an often frequented outpost, it may be worth seeing on your way through for exploration purposes. Going from the Kodash Bazaar may be easier.

From Honur Hill, head due south along the west side of Resplendent Makuun to arrive at Yahnur Market, then on into Vehtendi Valley. Although the first objective is due west of Yahnur Market, it will be necessary to take a route that turns south, west over the fields, then north to meet with Norgu. This area mainly has Heket, Behemoths and Kournans. The Behemoth Gravebanes act as minion masters and also inflict degeneration using hexes on the party, so kill them first if possible.
Very simply, head due south from the bazaar, you will most likely encounter Kournans and some plant mobs along the way.

On meeting Norgu at Jahinur (point 1 on the map), you'll get the chance to create a script via some multiple choice dialogue, then watch the audience response to his "masterpiece". After the first performance at Jahinur, you must escort Norgu north to his next engagement (at point 2), making sure he doesn't die on the way. As a level 18 mesmer, Norgu provides some assistance, casting Clumsiness, Mantra of Persistence, and Conjure Phantasm as required.
Once the last objective is activated, it's an easy matter of map traveling to the Kodash Bazaar and collecting your reward and a new mesmer hero.

quests/quest:gww:4981/sections/notes-1/b.text: On your way from the first play to the next engagement with the heket, the quest The Hanging Gardener can be picked up and completed soon after this quest is finished (see point 3 on the maps above).

If you are not in a hurry to acquire Norgu, it is easier to complete Gain Norgu than this quest, since that quest only requires you to speak to Korvus. The Gain Norgu quest also awards 500 more experience than this quest.

quests/quest:gww:25514/sections/objectiv.text: Retrieve the royal scribe's papers from the Tengu in Stingray Strand.
Return the royal scribe's papers to Watchman Arad in Fishermen's Haven.

quests/quest:gww:25514/sections/walkthro.text: Retrieve the royal scribe's papers by getting them out of a chest in Stingray Strand which is surrounded by a group of Tengu; you do not have to kill the guards. You can save some time by starting from Sanctum Cay, if you have unlocked that outpost. Be prepared for Skale, Inferno Imps, and the Tengu.

quests/quest:gww:277938/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Ruptured Heart in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:277938/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:277938/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Ruptured Heart in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280217/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Scar in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280217/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280217/sections/notes-1.text: Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (three days earlier) and Skyward Reach (the prior quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.

quests/quest:gww:280217/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Scar in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:320090/sections/objecti.text: Enter the tunnels and rendezvous with Devona. (first time only)
Enter the tunnels. (when repeating the quest)
Secure the key and and gain access to the lower level.
Find a way through the crystal gate.
Exit the tunnels and report to Devona in Piken Square.

quests/quest:gww:320090/sections/rewards.text: Devona joins your party (first time only)

quests/quest:gww:320090/sections/walkthr.text: The map in the Northlands points you towards the eastern entrance, but the western entrance is actually closer to Piken Square. Moreover, Artificer Mullenix is immediately present after going through the western entrance, making it likely the intended one.

Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map). If a player has not completed Long Thought Forgotten, this entrance will be closed, forcing you to go to the eastern entrance.

If any member of the party is doing the quest for the first time, Devona will join you as a level 5 ally, and the enemies you face will be similar to those found during Long Thought Forgotten and Charr in the Tunnels. Devona has a high damage output for her level, but she is not very durable against the enemies in the dungeon. Fortunately, if she is killed, she will resurrect herself as soon as no foes are within earshot.

On repeated visits to the tunnels, you will have to deal with additional Charr foes whose levels scale with that of the lowest-leveled member of the party, up to a maximum of level 18. It is advisable to bring Devona as a hero so that you can make use of skills unlocked outside Pre-Searing Ascalon.

This part of the quest is the same as Charr in the Tunnels, except that the inhabitants of Wyle Brimscourge's chamber may be slightly more numerous, and you will have to deal with the more powerful Charr on repeat visits. Fight your way down to the south end of the dungeon as usual, pull Wyle Brimscourge and kill him for the Dungeon Key, then run or fight your way to the Dungeon Lock and the portal to level 2.

Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during Charr in the Tunnels, but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some Shard Elementals, unless the nearby Ironheart has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the Elemental Crystal bundle they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.

You start at the middle of the south side of this floor, and will need to follow the purple path on the map to the right. Head northeast until you reach a large chamber filled with ruins and Charr, then hug the left wall heading north until you can start heading west again. Pass under the bridge, being careful of any Charr above. Just after the bridge, you may want to take a short detour south to clear out the Charr atop another bridge you will be passing under later. Continue west and you will reach a large foundry area, where your goal is to reach one of the stairways leading up to the higher walkways to the southwest. There is a resurrection shrine nearby, and from there you should be able to see the Boss Key lying on the overlook further south. After picking up the key, return to the red path on the map to the right, and fight your way around to the Boss Lock, then to the large open area to the southwest where Maz Scourgeheart and his elementals await you.

The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.

Maz will start with Fire Magic, including Mark of Rodgort, Fireball and Lava Font. After teleporting once, he will switch to Air Magic, with Lightning Javelin and Whirlwind to interrupt attackers and Lightning Strike to hit without line of sight. For the last confrontation he will use Water Magic, snaring his enemies with Deep Freeze and Shard Storm while protecting himself with Blurred Vision and Swirling Aura. In all three fights, he will also use Earthquake for AoE knockdown and Kinetic Armor to increase his armor rating.

His elementals are identical to the other elementals in the dungeon, and behave as a group. While they can deal significant melee damage at low levels, sufficient AoE damage should dispatch them quickly.

Maz and his minions shouldn't pose too much of a threat compared to the other mobs in the dungeon, especially if you are a spellcaster with high firepower. His spells are also slow to cast, giving you a generous window to spike him down before he becomes a problem. Armor-ignoring damage in particular bypasses Kinetic Armor, and Backfire will shut him down completely. Should you still face difficulties, equipping Devona with interrupts and/or enchantment removal can counter most of Maz's tactics.
Upon his death, Maz's Chest will spawn. After every player in the party has opened the chest, a countdown will start and the party will be returned to Piken Square.
Talk to Devona to finish the quest.

quests/quest:gww:320090/sections/notes-1.text: Although this quest can be acquired without Reforged Mode enabled, the quest NPCs will not spawn and the objectives will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.

Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it slightly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.

When repeating the quest, there will be additional Charr groups throughout the dungeon with no loot and levels that scale with the weakest member of the party. Players interested in speed clears and safer runs may therefore prefer to abandon the quest after opening the reward chest, though this means never unlocking Devona as a hero.
An alternative is to join a party with another player who is doing the first-time version of the quest, or with a player whose level is lower than 10.

The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge and the Elemental Crystal on level 2, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten or Charr in the Tunnels active in their quest log.

If another player in the party has Charr in the Tunnels active, the party can complete that quest by killing all of the Charr Patrol Stalkers, then use the portal back to level 1 to reset the map, enabling access to level 3 without returning to the surface. This makes the run slightly longer, but allows the party to kill three additional charr bosses along the way.
It is possible to kill Maz Scourgeheart by dealing damage at range (typically with spells such as Fire Storm or Symbol of Wrath or a bow with long enough range) without opening any crystal gate.

Once Maz is killed, the remaining Shard Elementals of the second wave (with the exception of the one carrying the Elemental Keystone) will have a special animation and stop attacking the players. They won't retaliate even when attacked.

quests/quest:gww:24533/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Palawa Joko. Find out how he moved his forces into Vabbi so easily.
Return the scepter to Palawa Joko.
Find the hidden passage to Vabbi.
See Whispers Adept for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:24533/sections/walkthro.text: Travel to the Bone Palace and speak to Palawa, who requires you to complete a small task before he spills the beans: retrieve his scepter from a former general in the Alkali Pan.

After killing the general, return the scepter to Palawa, who will tell you about his secret passage, without providing its exact location in Joko's Domain: in a pass between Joko's Domain and Vehjin Mines. Once you approach the entrance to the Basalt Grotto, your quest log will update; alternatively, if you already have the outpost unlocked, you can map travel there and exit into Joko's Domain.

quests/quest:gww:24533/sections/notes-1/.text: The Rebellious General is just south of Ruins of Morah, starting there will make the run shorter but you will have to fight two groups before you can enter a Junundu.

quests/quest:gww:14631/sections/objectiv.text: Collect [3...0] more Jade Brotherhood guild capes.
Return the 3 Jade Brotherhood guild capes to Bujo.

quests/quest:gww:14631/sections/environm.text: After accepting the quest reward, all the Am Fah in Wajjun Bazaar will be allies until you take either Refuse to Drink or Drink from the Chalice of Corruption. This also means that they will not ambush parties out near the areas closer to Nahpui Quarter. Because of this, it may be advantageous to hold off on completing this until you finish your quests in The Undercity and/or vanquish Wajjun Bazaar. The exceptions to this are the quests Captured, The Xunlai Agent, Deactivating P.O.X., and Street Justice. The Am Fah in the immediate area will still be hostile.

quests/quest:gww:14631/sections/walkthro.text: Simply map travel to The Marketplace and exit through the Wajjun Bazaar portal. Kill the 3 Jade Brotherhood Knights immediately outside and pick up the Jade Brotherhood Guild Capes. Map travel back to Kaineng Center to receive your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14631/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest marker will point you to the island at Wajjun Bazaar.
Players who complete this quest will not be able to capture Quivering Blade until the rest of the quest chain is complete, since Sun, the Quivering won't spawn.

quests/quest:gww:22013/sections/objectiv.text: Follow Hanbahd the Anchorite to the place where he hid the Lost Scriptures.
Eliminate the Margonites trying to steal the Lost Scriptures. Hanbahd must survive.
Bring the Lost Scriptures to Kachok.

quests/quest:gww:22013/sections/walkthro.text: Before accepting this quest it may be helpful to kill some of the wandering mobs nearby, since Hanbahd will move off very quickly when the quest is accepted and will not stand around waiting for the party.

Hanbahd will run off to an enclosed area a little to the west of his starting point, where the Lost Scriptures bundle item will appear when he arrives. This is also the trigger for several waves of Margonites to launch an attack on the party and Hanbahd.

When all the Margonites have been killed, pick up the Lost Scriptures and carry them back to Kachok, who is waiting in the library in the Halls of Chokhin, to collect your reward. Hanbahd will return to his original spot and you no longer need to defend him.

quests/quest:gww:22013/sections/notes-1/.text: Hanbahd is easy to protect, since he stands back in a corner away from the Margonites, the party simply has to ensure they stand forward of him to intercept the attacking creatures.

quests/quest:gww:15243/sections/objectiv.text: Find Ahmtur the Mighty and the other soldiers in the Mirror of Lyss.
Search for and rescue Nightfall survivors in the ruins of the Mirror of Lyss and the surrounding area. [3...0] of 3 survivor groups remain.
Escort Priest Tuwahan to the safety of the Kodash Bazaar.
Shuttle the family to the protection of the Kodash Bazaar.
Help the students reach the refuge of the Kodash Bazaar.
See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15243/sections/environm.text: These do not spawn if this quest is active:
The bosses Shezel Slowreaper and Yammiron, Ether Lord
Roaring Ethers and Ruby Djinns, which makes vanquishing easier since they are difficult to kill.

quests/quest:gww:15243/sections/walkthro.text: Start from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Prince Ahmtur and his guards just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Prince Ahmtur, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 Vabbi Guards will join your party to assist in the search for survivors. Do not map travel to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh, if so, the quest will not complete properly.

From here, it is a case of following the quest pointer to each of the 3 groups, and defeating any hostile groups encountered along the way. Note that the groups can be saved in any order, not necessarily the order listed in the objectives.
Survivors can be blocked by NPCs such as spirits, so ensure the survivors continue to follow or you may need to backtrack to collect them.
At each survivor group, there will be 3-4 Margonite groups patrolling nearby, so careful pulling of each group is required.

On arrival at the Kodash Bazaar, walk up to the entrance, but do not walk in (or leave the area) until the quest updates, otherwise the quest will not complete properly. The quest updates when Talgun, Priest Tuwahan, and Belanu reach the final quest pointer.

quests/quest:gww:15243/sections/notes-1/.text: The final dialogue with the family (Belanu, Charmah, and Kimab) doesn't always trigger. Try to have them arrive at the location at the same time to make it trigger.
The amount of chests is reduced while this quest is active.
The survivor groups follow the party around, but do not join as allies, so they are not attacked by hostile groups (except for any accidental AoE effects targeted on the party members).
The survivor groups move slowly and so care should be taken that they do not get stuck on any objects - all of the survivors are required to complete the quest.
It isn't necessary to use the Vabbi Guards, so you may start from Kodash Bazaar if you wish (i.e. you could clear the quest path of foes before talking to Ahmtur the Mighty).

Since the guards follow the party but not your commands, they may need to be led towards any hostile groups that you are attacking. This can be a problem for solo (with henchmen) players who use ranged attacks and skills, since you may have to move into close aggro range to ensure the guards start to attack.

Priest Tuwahan from this quest is quite close to Hanbahd from The Madness of Prophecy quest, and since you will have 5 guard NPCs to assist you, that quest can also be completed very easily while doing this one.
If you die and resurrect via a shrine, the survivors you have gathered will rejoin your party by running towards you from your previous point of death.

quests/quest:gww:9629/sections/objective.text: Travel to the secret location of the Shadow Blades' meeting. Avoid being spotted.
Eavesdrop on the Shadow Blades' meeting. Remain hidden.
See Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9629/sections/walkthrou.text: Start from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), enter The Undercity. Proceed across the bridge towards the quest marker, killing the single mob of afflicted in your path. Flag any heroes or henchmen at that spot, since any rogue spirits, minions or summons will cause the quest to fail.

Walk slowly north up the corridor that links to the shadow blades' meeting spot. Keep going until the quest updates and remain there until you you see the line, "May your blades guide you to the hearts of your enemies". Wait until the quest log updates and then you can map out.

Alternatively, you can flag a hero to the corner just east of the meeting spot, after removing their ability to aggro foes (set their AI to avoid combat, disable any damage skills, and remove their weapon).
Non-Canthan characters can head north from The Marketplace, killing the Am Fah in the way while heading South West, eventually proceeding down a ramp into the Undercity.
It is also possible to just do the The Challenge quest and get the quest completed by accident. Killing Tae Xang counts for both quests.

quests/quest:gww:67948/sections/objectiv.text: Keep the Margonite Portal Mages from summoning enough demons and Margonites to overwhelm the area.
Defeat the creatures guarding the Torment rifts to increase your score.
Defeat the Margonite Portal Mages to close the rift and earn a bonus score!

quests/quest:gww:67948/sections/rewards-.text: Scoring in this mission rewards experience and gold base on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.

Each party member has a random chance to obtain Mysterious Armor Pieces whenever a Margonite Portal Mage is killed. Like other armor pieces given in other Nightfall challenge missions, they do not drop on the ground; they are automatically placed in the player's inventory. These pieces can be used to upgrade the visual appearance of certain hero armor to Mysterious armor. This upgrade is available for Norgu, Goren, General Morgahn, Zenmai, and Olias. You also gain Lightbringer points if you achieve a daily, monthly or quarterly best score similar to the gold bonus.

quests/quest:gww:67948/sections/walkthro.text: Use the Mission Map (default hotkey U) to see all of the rifts and their current states. Gray rifts are inactive and have no units there. Red rifts are active and contributing to the rift progress. Use this information to save as much time as possible when moving between rifts.

Once the party zones in, there is a one minute countdown before the mission begins. Because not all the rifts are visible in the Mission Map to start, use this time to explore to the north and reveal the last three rifts.
Bringing Fall Back to move between rifts can save precious time.
The portal mages are powerful air elementalists. Their Invoke Lightning can wreak havoc on unprepared groups. There are a few steps teams can take to prevent wipes:
Bring skills that increase armor against elemental or lightning damage (Mantra of Lightning, Ward Against Elements).
It is highly recommended for monks to bring a form of damage mitigation, like Protective Spirit or Spirit Bond. Remember to preprot.
When engaging a portal mage, spread out so that the mage's Invoke Lightning will only damage one team member.
Rangers and Mesmers should bring interrupts. Interrupting Invoke Lightning is the best way to prevent damage.

While only the portal mage needs to be killed to close a rift, it is advisable to kill the surrounding creatures as well. This is because the monster would otherwise still be present should the rift reopen, leaving higher numbers of monsters near the next portal mage.

After clearing a rift, move away from it as quickly as possible. This is imperative because the rift may reopen while you are engaging a nearby rift, causing potential aggro problems from multiple monster groups.
The portal mage is not in the same group as the creatures guarding it, so if possible, pull the surrounding creatures before engaging the mage.

The portal mage is a boss giving a +2% morale boost when killed, so Resurrection Signets will be recharged frequently and provide a very effective resurrection skill. Skills that recharge slowly will also be ready for use after killing a portal mage due to the morale boost.

quests/quest:gww:67948/sections/notes-1/.text: Like most other Challenge Missions, monsters in this mission do not drop loot.
You can reach the Shadow Nexus through an east exit in Gate of Torment.

Find a playwright to pen a new script for the prince to enjoy.
Find Sijo and convince him to write a new play for the prince.
See Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15705/sections/walkthro.text: All the objectives on this quest take place in the Resplendent Makuun area.

After picking up this quest from Prince Bokka (point 1), straight away go and speak to Theatre Manager Daudi nearby to trigger the second objective (point 2). The playwright you need to find is in fact Kenyatta in the Honur Hill outpost on the west side of Resplendent Makuun (point 3). Unfortunately, Kenyatta is having a bit of writer's block and suggests that you go and find Sijo in Resplendent Makuun, from the quest pointer Sijo appears to be getting in touch with his muse up in the north-east corner of the explorable area (point 4).

However, as you find on arrival, Sijo the Stagnant has been done in (probably by the Djinn wandering nearby), but fear not, the body has a freshly written script on it! (click on the body to pickup the "Springtime for Varesh" Script quest item).
Return to Daudi with your new treasure, just remember to wipe the bloodstains off first!

quests/quest:gww:25419/sections/objectiv.text: Find and cure 3 sickened villagers. You have 3 sickened villagers remaining.
See Headmaster Amara for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25419/sections/walkthro.text: This is a straightforward quest. Head southeast out of Tsumei Village until you get to the quest marker. Use Mend Ailment on Fawn, Jia and Kin. Then map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Amara for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25419/sections/notes-1/.text: Sometimes only Fawn and Jia have the green mist of sickness around them. Kin can still be "cured" though.
Although it is told that the villagers are sick they are actually poisoned.

quests/quest:gww:25448/sections/objectiv.text: Head to Sunqua Vale and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces. [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
Head to Panjiang Peninsula and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces. [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
See the Emperor's Blade for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25448/sections/walkthro.text: There is a two pronged attack of Crimson Skull, from both sides of Tsumei Village. Start by defending the Sunqua Vale side: spread out near the portal and hold your position; the attackers will come to you. Once you have cleared out most of them, tackle the remaining stragglers. As soon as the quest updates (giving you credit for removing all groups), head back into town.

You can use the same tactics to defend the Panjiang Peninsula side, i.e. spread out and wait for the Skull to come to you. However, one of the groups will try to make an end run and attack you from behind. This can be an issue if you are using three henchmen; if you are, reposition your group closer to the resurrection shrine or otherwise backup so that the Canthan Guards can take some of the aggro while you regroup. Groups of Crimson Skull will also appear away from the main fighting area and head into the village to attack the villagers. Killing these groups do not count towards completing the quest.
Once you receive credit for defeating the last group, head back into town to collect your reward.
Note: You must complete the Sunqua Vale part of the quest first or else the final group in Panjiang Peninsula will not spawn.

quests/quest:gww:25448/sections/notes-1/.text: If you keep the quest active, the groups of Crimson Skulls can be farmed for Copper Crimson Skull Coins, Silver Crimson Skull Coins, and Gold Crimson Skull Coins.

quests/quest:gww:66435/sections/walkthro.text: The easiest way to complete this quest is to map travel to Doomlore Shrine and leave from there. Go directly south from the entrance until you find a hostile Siege Devourer. Kill it and its Charr rider, then mount it. Fight your way south-southeast through Dalada Uplands to get to Sacnoth Valley. After zoning you will still be riding the Devourer, which will make this quest much easier. Head south until you reach a burning forest. There you will find Ignus the Eternal. While approaching him watch out for Borrguus Blisterbark who patrols the area. Fighting both bosses at the same time will probably kill your team. Avoid the brightly burning trees, both upright and fallen, otherwise you will begin burning if you get too close. After you kill Ignus the Eternal head back to Captain Langmar for your reward.

references.title: The Smell of Titan in the Morning

Escort Necromancer Munne and the relic back to the sanitarium. "sanitarium" is lowercase here
