Haul the artifact back to the Sanitarium's entrance and present it to Munne. You must be holding the quest item when you speak to her to get your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25285/sections/notes-1/.text: The three Grawl that spawn as part of this quest will attack other Grawl that enter their aggro range.

quests/quest:gww:25426/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Kupah Beach in Kinya Province.
Place the Stone of the Elements on the stone pedestal.
See Headmaster Vhang for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25426/sections/notes-1/.text: Ronsu and Kai Ying can bug out when they appear, and instead of fighting will run towards the center of the map before vanishing when they get stuck.

quests/quest:gww:25426/sections/instruct.text: "So, you win a few duels and kill a few monsters and you think you have what it takes to be an Elementalist. Well, then, I have a task for you... a simple thing to be sure. Take this Stone of the Elements to Kupah Beach in Kinya Province. There you will find a stone pedestal. Place the Stone of the Elements upon the stone pedestal, and then return to me. It sounds straightforward, does it not? Just remember that the destination is often less important than the journey."

quests/quest:gww:25303/sections/objectiv.text: Defeat Ulrik the Undefeated in Traveler's Vale.
Return to Sebedoh the Mesmer for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25303/sections/walkthro.text: Ulrik is almost directly outside of Yak's Bend. He uses enchantment spells to boost his armor rating, so consider bringing enchantment removal skills. If these haven't been obtained yet, the henchman Dunham is equipped with Drain Enchantment. Ulrik's armor-boosting enchantments are Armor of Earth and Kinetic Armor, both of which apply bonus armor rating, and therefore do not stack. The largest bonus will be that of Kinetic Armor. As expected of a Mesmer quest, skills such as Backfire and armor-ignoring damage skills work wonders. Melee attack-oriented skill bars face not only Ulrik's armor bonus, but also Ward Against Melee. When Ulrik is defeated, return to Sebedoh in Yak's Bend.

quests/quest:gww:11215/sections/objectiv.text: Travel to Grendich Courthouse and speak with Warmaster Labofski to learn how you can help defend against the Titan threat.
Travel to the northwest region of Dragon's Gullet and kill the 3 Titan bosses.
Return to Vision of Glint for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:11215/sections/walkthro.text: The best strategy is to start out at Grendich Courthouse and travel to Flame Temple Corridor, killing any bosses encountered along the way for extra morale. Alternatively, it is possible to start from Yak's Bend to have a party of 6 members, but this requires to make your way through Traveler's Vale, Ascalon Foothills and Diessa Lowlands. In Flame Temple, you will encounter the Charr Lords. Pull them away from the patrols and take them on one group at a time, then continue on to the Dragon's Gullet.
Consider maxing out your morale before venturing into the lake itself.

Enter the lake from the southeastern shore, northwest of the resurrection shrine that makes for a convenient restart spot should you wipe while fighting the Titan Lords. A pair of Hand and Fist of the Titans will pop out of the tar to greet you.
In the lake, you will have to deal with the constant 30% reduction in speed from the Tar environment effect.

After you deal with the popups, you need to take out a number of titan patrols that circle the bosses. The patrols are made up of more Hands and Fists, and also Sparks of the Titans and Risen Ashen Hulks; the sparks should be your priority target as they are capable of some extremely lethal Fire Magic. The Risen Hulks are the least dangerous, and should be left for last as they split into another pair of Hand and Fist when they die.
A second group of pop-up warrior titans will greet you in the southwest corner of the lake.

After the lake has been cleared of patrols, it is time to complete the main objective. In the center of the lake are three Titan bosses: the Titan Lords you were sent here to dispatch. Among their ranks is a small group of Charr Lords. A good tactic is to kill the Charr Lords first then go for the Titans.

A solid tank who can rush in and keep the bosses focused on him is an excellent complement to an Elementalist with Maelstrom who can render the Mesmer and Necromancer bosses useless for about 30 seconds (10 seconds of interruptions plus more time as their skills recharge).
Titans are very resistant to physical damage, but less so to elemental damage - especially cold damage.
This can be easily accomplished with Icy weapon mods.

Alternatively, Winter will convert all elemental damage to cold damage. Because many mobs in the area use Greater Conflagration, physical damage will also often be converted to cold damage through Winter.
An interrupt Mesmer can help here by shutting down the Necromancer boss and prevent him from casting Malaise.
A good way to break the anti-caster combination is to kill the Mesmer boss before the others.
Consider equipping the Ebon Vanguard Title for access to Rebel Yell's Charr-mitigating effects.

quests/quest:gww:13638/sections/objectiv.text: Kill the Kournan guards holding the Centaur weapon crafters captive.
Offer the Centaurs a place with the Sunspears.

quests/quest:gww:13638/sections/environm.text: Two weaponsmiths, Grif Ebonmane and Kol Swordshanks, will spawn in the Command Post after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:13638/sections/walkthro.text: The easiest way to do this quest is to start from Kodonur Crossroads and head out into Dejarin Estate. This way you won't have any unnecessary encounters and will only have to fight two groups of Kournans guarding the Centaurs.

quests/quest:gww:13638/sections/notes-1/.text: Unlike other foes in hard mode, the foes spawned by this quest have the same level in normal and hard modes.

quests/quest:gww:25701/sections/requirem.text: The Broken Toy acquired via the /special command or the quest Miniature Companion: Nightfall must be in your inventory.

quests/quest:gww:25701/sections/objectiv.text: Gather whimsical essence by defeating the whimsical djinn.
You have gathered the whimsical essence.
Tell Mahk to infuse the toy with the whimsical essence.
Use Mahk's model toy to negotiate a contract with the Vabbian toy buyers.

quests/quest:gww:25701/sections/instruct.text: "The toy business has been slow because of all the trouble with corsairs and evil plants lately. People would rather buy swords and shields than puppets and magical gadgets."
"But Lyssa's fates have smiled upon me. Toy buyers from Vabbi have arrived. If I can show them something wondrous, I can get a Vabbian contract signed in gold and encrusted with gems."

"Hmmm. That broken toy you have there would be perfect. I could never get it to work, though. It needs to be imbued with essence from a whimsical djinn to activate its magic. Perhaps a hero such as you could acquire the essence for me."

quests/quest:gww:25692/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Keeper Jinyssa when all members of your party are ready to defend the Gate of Torment.
Defend the Gate of Torment from the attacking demon army. # of 3 attack groups remain.
Keeper Jinyssa must survive the battle.
See Keeper Jinyssa for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25692/sections/walkthro.text: Keeper Jinyssa transports you to the mission location. There is a one minute countdown timer before the first wave spawns. Your allies consist of one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Cursebearers to the northeast, one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Illusionists to the southwest and two Forgotten Sages, one Forgotten Arcanist and Keeper Jinyssa, a Mesmer, in the center. Waves attack from the northeast and southwest, with four groups in each wave and pauses between waves. Keeper Jinyssa dies easily if the player aggroes the attackers. Blades of Corruption, Rains of Terror, Scythes of Chaos and Margonite Sorcerers are particularly dangerous due to their high damage capacity.
The following is a chart of the waves' group makeup:

One way of completing the mission with heroes and henchmen is to use a tank on one side while the rest of the team defeats the group on the other side. Switch places after the enemies on one side are dead.
Due to high amount of corpses available, a minion master can be helpful.

quests/quest:gww:18415/sections/objectiv.text: Starting at the Frontier Gate, follow the road south through the Eastern Frontier and into Pockmark Flats.
Return to Warmaster Tydus for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18415/sections/walkthro.text: Simply travel to Serenity Temple and talk to the priestess.

There will be an inventory item given to you upon accepting the quest - make sure that you have enough space in your inventory for it. Be sure that you take it on your journey, or the quest will not update. If you lose it go back to Warmaster Tydus for a replacement.

quests/quest:gww:14927/sections/objectiv.text: Travel east from the Barradin Estate to Lakeside County. Head south to Ashford. Take the southeast bridge to Regent Valley. Once in Regent Valley, follow the road to Fort Ranik.
Deliver the message from Barradin to Lord Darrin.

quests/quest:gww:14927/sections/walkthro.text: If you have already unlocked Fort Ranik, simply map travel there to complete the delivery.

Otherwise, make your way to Regent Valley via Lakeside County or Wizard's Folly. Refer to the quest map for guidance. Once there, follow the road signs to Fort Ranik and hand the letter to Lord Darrin to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17707/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Watchtower Coast and stop the undead from reaching Beetletun.
Return to Elder Hezron for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:17707/sections/walkthro.text: The undead come in small waves but grow successively, culminating in a Bone Dragon accompanying the last wave. Move very quickly and use holy damage. If you die, there is a resurrection shrine very close by.
Waves 1, 2, and 3, have three groups of enemies each. Wave 4 has four groups. Wave 5 is the last wave, and has three groups, the last group being the Bone Dragon and a Damned Cleric.

quests/quest:gww:17707/sections/notes-1/.text: You only need to kill the last group of each wave to trigger the next wave to come. For the last wave, the final group is the Bone Dragon with a Cleric, and upon killing them, the quest will complete.
Abandon the quest after completing it and take it again to farm items during times with special drops, such as Wintersday, Halloween, etc.

On some of the groups, there are a large number of Level 1 and Level 3 enemies. It might be better to take them out quickly, to reduce the number of targets, and also to make it easier to concentrate your entire party's attack damage on the higher level monsters.
In the War in Kryta environment you may not need to fight at all: wait a few minutes near a quest mark until 2 groups of Peacekeepers kill all quest foes, then go after the reward.
If you don't succeed in stopping them you can just be resurrected nearby and return to finish the job, as the hordes will just wait at the Beetletun gates.
If you wait right in front of the gates, the large group of NPCs will engage the enemies as well and they do not need to survive for the quest to complete.

quests/quest:gww:13722/sections/objectiv.text: Seek out Galrath at the wizard's tower in Kessex Peak. Put an end to his villainy.
Return to Firstwatch Sergio for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:13722/sections/walkthro.text: Starting from the Temple of the Ages (in order to have a maximum party size of 8) head south through The Black Curtain towards Kessex Peak. You will immediately encounter a group of Reed Stalkers. After defeating the Stalkers follow the path leading to the southeast, making sure to avoid the poisonous water whenever possible. You will soon come upon a Damned Cleric, who once aggroed will be accompanied by Smoke Phantoms and a Wraith. Be sure to dispatch these foes quickly or pull them to the west, because a group of Hellhounds and a Necrid Horseman will be patrolling the area.

Continue following the path to the southeast, making sure to watch for more Undead, until you come to a three-way intersection. Take the southern path where you will soon run out of land and be forced to head west to circle around the poisonous swamp. You will encounter a group of Ancient Oakheart, possibly including the Tree of Judgment, as well as some Bog Skale Blighters and the occasional Spined Aloe.

When you come upon a path follow it to the east, being sure to cross over the bridge to avoid the fetid water. You will come upon another group of Reed Stalkers as well as several Forest Minotaurs. Continue heading east until you reach the portal to Kessex Peak.

In Kessex Peak, continue south, passing over the next bridge where you will encounter some Fog Nightmares and more Reed Stalkers. After dispatching the monsters turn towards the southwest and follow the canyon towards the Krytan coast. Be sure to watch out for Nightmares and Aloes that will pop out of the ground while you fight the Reed Stalkers that patrol the canyon.

Once you reach the end of the canyon turn south on the nearby path. Fen Trolls will be patrolling the path along with Ancient Oakhearts, and Forest Minotaurs. The Trolls and Minotaurs have very large patrol areas, so be especially careful not to find yourself stuck between two groups of enemies. When you come to the area where there are about 20 of them guarding the path, study their pattern of movement and aggro them from the north, one group at a time. Continue to follow the path to the southwest until you come to a floating castle overlooking a plateau. Head east until you come to a path leading up to where Galrath and his bandits are waiting.

You will find large groups of Verata the Necromancer's cultists blocking your path. Be careful to only aggro one group at a time; dispatching Verata's army is not easy and aggroing more than one group means almost certain death for lower-level groups or henchmen. If players or henchmen have obtained a high death penalty it may be very difficult to kill even one group. If this happens, it is possible with the right timing to slip past the cult and engage Galrath and his bandits. The Apprentices of Verata will spawn Bone Fiends so a Necromancer with corpse exploitation skills of their own can be very useful. A minion master may not be the best however, as the Apprentices will use Verata's Gaze to steal your minions. After defeating the cultists, head west and kill the bandits before taking on Galrath himself.
Once you have killed Galrath, simply map travel to Lion's Arch and see Sergio for your reward.

You may be able to find easier groups to fight through if, once you get to the main plateau area, you follow the northern edge from west to east, then south along the eastern edge along a path inhabited by a few Hill Giants. This path will also aid you if you are working on the cartographer title.
Similarly, pulling some of the groups away from the plateau may make the task of reaching Galrath slightly easier.

quests/quest:gww:13722/sections/notes-1/.text: The Long Sword which is given as a reward has a 10% furious mod which can be salvaged.
You do not need to kill every bandit to complete the quest, although it does make it easier to kill Galrath.
Bringing Frozen Soil can help to suppress resurrection by White Mantle foes if the War in Kryta is active, as well as by Shepherds of Verata.

quests/quest:gww:279584/sections/objecti.text: Seek out Galrath at the wizard's tower in Kessex Peak. Put an end to his villainy.
Return to Firstwatch Sergio for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279584/sections/walkthr.text: For the route to Galrath, see The Villainy of Galrath. He is surrounded by several groups of level 30 bandits. Careful pulling of these mobs is essential to avoid being overwhelmed. Be aware that the mobs tend to aggro simultaneously, so be prepared to conduct long pulls to string them out.

It is possible to engage the bandits from the foot of the cliff, where the path emerges from the northern valley. The main damage-dealers are melee assassins, so this can trim their numbers down with less risk to your party. You can also lure them into Verata's cultists, who are occupying the lower slopes of the hill; the ensuing fight will usually see the cultists quickly defeated, saving you some work in clearing the way to Galrath.
Bring Frozen Soil to counter the resurrection skills of the bandits.
Spiteful Spirit works well as the bandits tend to clump on the edge of the hill.
Galrath's Hundred Blades is vulnerable to Pain Inverter.
Bring something to counter the powerful bandit healers, e.g. shutdown skills such as Panic, anti-healing such as Lingering Curse, or be able to spike.
Mirror of Disenchantment will remove Healer's Boon from the monks.

quests/quest:gww:279584/sections/notes-1.text: This quest is not available to certain characters.
ArenaNet suggests that completing Hell's Precipice will enable those characters to receive the hard mode version. (Source.)
However, some players have been able to obtain the quest without taking that step.
Consets can help with making this quest easier.

quests/quest:gww:15152/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the duke's vineyard and kill all large aloe seeds.
Return to Little Thom for your reward.
Little Thom will give you a Starter Axe and the following skills upon taking the quest:

quests/quest:gww:15152/sections/walkthro.text: Head Southeast of the The Barradin Estate, to the Vineyard near the Farm. Kill all Aloe Seeds, (just go stand in the middle of the ring they form, and use Cyclone Axe once, they all should die.) then return to Little Thom for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15152/sections/notes-1/.text: It is not required to kill the Aloe Seeds with an axe to complete this quest.
This quest can be used to farm Unnatural Seeds

quests/quest:gww:25338/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the forest banshees. 5..0 forest banshees remain.
Do not harm the Wailing Lord.
Return to Rastigan the Eternal for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25338/sections/walkthro.text: The Wailing Lord resides in his forest in the northwest of the Fissure, though you will need to travel east then north through the Great Battle Field to get there. He and the Banshees are at the far end of the forest across a bridge. The bridge is guarded by a large number of Skeleton Army units, including pop-ups before, on, and after the bridge. Proceed with caution even if things look clear or you can be quickly overwhelmed.

Do not attack the Wailing Lord. You will be kicked out of the Fissure if he dies. Beware that because he's hostile he will take AoE damage and will be attacked by minions (if you have any). It is best to pull the Banshees, and any other enemy, across the bridge to ensure the Wailing Lord is unharmed.

Do not take the quest offered by the Wailing Lord unless and until the party is ready, as it can make for a speedy exit from the Fissure for the unprepared. You don't need to talk to the Wailing Lord at all to complete the current quest. You can just go back to Rastigan to pick up the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25338/sections/notes-1/.text: An unlocked Chest will spawn near the Wailing Lord when you complete the quest objectives.

quests/quest:gww:18549/sections/requirem.text: Not being primary or secondary Warrior.
Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Warrior.

quests/quest:gww:18549/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the Scar and slay the Orshad Chieftain.
Return to Agastos the Brave for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18549/sections/walkthro.text: Head south from Destiny's Gorge into The Scar until you reach a teleporter where groups of hydras patrol. Use the teleporter to enter the gorge. Losaru groups will be patrolling the oasis with a boss in the center. To avoid being overwhelmed, pull each group away from the others before killing them. Continue southeast until you reach a small river, and then head east until you get to an open area. The Orshad Chieftain will be in the center surrounded by patrols. Again, pull the groups one by one. Defeat the chieftain and then return to Agastos the Brave for your reward.

For those who have difficulty with hydras, an easier route is from the Thirsty River. There is a hidden entrance into the gorge to the extreme west of where the path opens up. Hug the southern wall and you will turn northward passing under a rope bridge guarded by a Dune Burrower at each end. This route is somewhat shorter as well, and there are 3 Losaru bosses that are fairly easy to kill, providing a nice +6% to your morale. An image of this route can be found on the discussion page.

quests/quest:gww:25257/sections/walkthro.text: Leave Serenity Temple and walk around the Pockmark Flats, killing any Hulking Stone Elementals you find. Large numbers of elementals can be found in the entrances to the large crater to the east, and they can sometimes be found in the crater itself. Once you have killed 10, the quest is fullfilled and you can go for the reward. Alternatively, you can find large numbers of Hulking Stone Elementals in Old Ascalon without any Stone Elemental elementalists accompanying them.
Keep hold of any Scorched Lodestones you find, since 3 will be needed for the following quest, The Geomancer's Test.

quests/quest:gww:25257/sections/notes-1/.text: Although Kendrick tells you to kill elementals in Pockmark Flats, the quest will update when you kill a Hulking Stone Elemental anywhere.

quests/quest:gww:25317/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Cynn in Traveler's Vale.
Help Cynn find Mhenlo in Iron Horse Mine.

quests/quest:gww:25317/sections/walkthro.text: The quest is quite easy, just meet Cynn outside of Yak's Bend and fight a few groups northwest into Iron Horse Mine. In Iron Horse Mine, take the right fork and kill the first group of Stone Summit, then talk to Mhenlo to get your reward. This quest is also right on the path of Minaar's Trouble.

quests/quest:gww:25317/sections/notes-1/.text: Mhenlo's apology does not appear in Team Chat. If you leave the Iron Horse Mine before accepting the reward, Mhenlo will not be there when players return, and they will have to abandon the quest and start it again. If Mhenlo dies before the party rescues him, Cynn will still say "You're not dead!" and the quest will still update.

quests/quest:gww:25490/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Ralena Stormbringer in Foible's Fair to learn Orion's whereabouts.
Find Orion in Wizard's Folly and convince him to come home.
Return to Sandre Elek for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25490/sections/walkthro.text: Travel to Foible's Fair and talk to Ralena Stormbringer for a lead on Orion. To find him, exit the outpost, following the road northeast until you reach a house on your left. From there, head west through the trees toward the quest marker.

There is a large number of level 3 Black Bears and Bandit Blood Sworn along the way; draw them out carefully to avoid being overwhelmed. Once you break the news to Orion about his romantic rival, travel back to Ascalon City and speak to Sandre Elek for the reward.

quests/quest:gww:25490/sections/notes-1/.text: Talking to Orion before talking to Ralena Stormbringer will initiate a dialogue with him, but he will not be swayed.
Orion starts walking as soon as you get done talking to him and, unless killed along the way, ultimately returns to Foible's Fair.

quests/quest:gww:13721/sections/objectiv.text: Follow the road through North Kryta Province to Nebo Terrace.
Talk to Etham the Artisan in Nebo Village.

quests/quest:gww:13721/sections/walkthro.text: Nebo Village is a small settlement in the northwestern part of Nebo Terrace. Leave from Lions Arch or D'Alessio Seaboard and follow the quest marker across North Kryta Province to Nebo Terrace. The village is a short walk northwest. Alternatively, players may map travel to Bergen Hot Springs or Beetletun and walk to Nebo Village from there (see map). Talk to Etham to complete the quest.
Pair this quest with Blankets for the Settlers (from Captain Greywind in Ascalon Settlement); both quests require visiting the same person in Nebo Village.

quests/quest:gww:271160/sections/require.text: Having watched the dialogue between the couple and the norn in the Hall of Monuments.

quests/quest:gww:271160/sections/rewards.text: Keiran Thackeray joins your party as a Hero.

quests/quest:gww:271160/sections/walkthr.text: Talk to Thackeray in the Hall of Monuments; he will eventually take you to the wedding site. During the wedding, speak to Olaf when he asks for someone to represent Gwen.

quests/quest:gww:271160/sections/notes-1.text: It is possible to shadow step away from a Vanguard Warrior using a skill like Heart of Shadow or Viper's Defense to "portal jump" outside Olafstead and walk around Varajar Fells.
If you didn't complete Norn Catering there will be no food table, just the flower arrangements.

The reward text reads, "You join Keiran Thackeray's party", an inversion of the usual text ("[Hero Name] joins your party"). Jora, Vekk, and Ogden retain their original names, whereas they usually switch to a generic name if their namesake is present in the area.

*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.

quests/quest:gww:14514/sections/objectiv.text: Acquire a devourer egg from Fadden Hathorn in the devourer cave.
Take the devourer egg to Pitney in Ashford.
Follow Pitney and kill the Queen Worm.
Return to Pitney for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14514/sections/environm.text: Once you kill the Worm Queen, even before turning the quest in, slightly fewer Plague Worms will spawn in the area.

quests/quest:gww:14514/sections/walkthro.text: Your first task is getting a devourer egg to use as bait. You can earn two by completing The Egg Hunter quest involving Fadden Hathorn, to whom Pitney directs you at first. Alternatively, you can barter for one with local collectors: trade 5 skale fins to Brownlow or 3 dull carapaces to Rownan.

Hand the egg over and follow Pitney to his field. He will use the bait to draw the Worm Queen out of the ground alongside several Plague Worms, who are hostile (in contrast to all the others in the area).
It is useful to clear out any roaming wolves nearby before engaging the queen to avoid getting overwhelmed, especially at lower levels.
Once the queen is slain, talk to Pitney (who should be standing nearby) for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14514/sections/notes-1/.text: Sometimes Pitney will get caught on Devona, and you will have to leave the area and try again. If you leave the area during this quest, you will have to obtain another egg in order to finish it.

quests/quest:gww:9630/sections/objective.text: Find the stolen storage vault and return it to Xunlai Agent Honlo.
See Xunlai Agent Honlo for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:9630/sections/walkthrou.text: After leaving from The Marketplace head east. You will encounter two groups of Am Fah after crossing the second of two bridges (1). Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two more manageably placed groups of Am Fah as well as a statue of Balthazar (2) that you can kneel in front of to give your team a boost. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter a group of Am Fah guarding the Storage Chest (3). As soon as you attack the Am Fah more enemies will fall from the ceiling, so be ready for a fight.

quests/quest:gww:9630/sections/notes-1/b.text: You do not need to kill the Am Fah that are guarding the chest, you can run to chest, pick it up and then map travel back to Kaineng Center.
You can complete this quest, Eliminate the Am Fah, and A Monstrous Revelation simultaneously.

While this quest is to retrieve a specific item, the "result" isn't like any other, in that the item being retrieved doesn't actually appear in your inventory, and it isn't an item that needs to be carried to a certain person or place.
The quest dialogue states that you are to return with a Storage Vault but the item that you obtain is called a Storage Chest.

quests/quest:gww:20861/sections/objectiv.text: Help Hogun save his fiancee from corsair rivals.
Kill Hogun and his band of corsairs.
Speak with Ailonseh Dejarin and see if she is hurt.
Escort Ailonseh Dejarin to Camp Hojanu.
See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:20861/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest from Hogun (who is standing outside Pogahn Passage), escort him to where Ailonseh is being held. After some dialogue, the corsairs will turn hostile, so kill them. It's best that, before escorting Alionseh to Camp Hojanu, your party would kill all the monsters along the path to avoid her dying because she is only a level 10 monk. Be wary not to let her lag too far behind, as she has no regard for the aggro range of monsters, leading to her quick demise.

quests/quest:gww:10099/sections/objectiv.text: Talk to Zenos and join his crew.
Obtain funding. Convince Po Fang in Kaineng Center to fund the expedition.
Make living history. Convince Jin Siyan with the Ministry of Earth to chronicle the expedition.
Hire a tracker. Convince Nendros to join the expedition.
Bring firepower. Convince Zenos' estranged wife Enelora to join the expedition.

quests/quest:gww:10099/sections/walkthro.text: Before you can embark on the monster hunting expedition, you'll need to rally some assistance and support from Zenos' crew in various locations around the Jade Sea and Kaineng, requiring some map travel.

Zenos himself can be found on the island in the middle of Silent Surf, and heading in from Seafarer's Rest provides the shortest and simplest route. Take a quick turn north when outside Seafarer's Rest, then cross over the bridge to the central island.
Po Fang and Jin Siyan can both be found in Kaineng Center.
Nendros is standing by the resurrection shrine in Silent Surf, just outside Seafarer's Rest.
Enelora is waiting in Silent Surf, just outside the Leviathan Pits.
After speaking to all the crew members, return to Zenos on the island and tell him about your progress. After that, go to the Leviathan Pits to collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10099/sections/notes-1/.text: When you receive this quest's reward, the followup quest is automatically added to your quest log.

quests/quest:gww:295337/sections/shared-.text: Getting closer than two aggro bubbles to the hostile foes and allies will cause them to engage in combat, this allows you to recharge your skills and energy before charging towards the next group of allies. Use skills such as "Fall Back!" to close the distance quickly to rescue the canthan peasants. Only one peasant needs to survive from each group to count as "saving" the group for the purposes of the quest. Consider microing heroes or telling human healers to heal peasants under fire. Should you let Eri escape, she will become an ally in the quest The Final Confrontation.

quests/quest:gww:199594/sections/notes-1.text: This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.

quests/quest:gww:204891/sections/objecti.text: Talk to the three Vabbi Princes about joining your cause.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:204891/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:204891/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Tihark Orchard mission. This is a solo mission and you must be the only person in your party.

quests/quest:gww:25493/sections/objectiv.text: Head due north from Ashford until you find the road to Green Hills County. Go to Green Hills County and talk to Grazden the Protector.

quests/quest:gww:25493/sections/walkthro.text: After talking to Devona, you can go straight to the north eastern limit of the map where the portal to Green Hills County is located. Map traveling to Ashford Abbey and starting from the entrance of the outpost can spare you a bit of time instead of starting from Devona's location.

Right after the portal there is a statue of Balthazar. Behind it, you will spot a Resurrection Shrine where Grazden the Protector can be found. Map travel to Ashford Abbey and return to Devona to deliver the tithe and claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25493/sections/notes-1/.text: While the initial, intermediate, and reward dialogue all allude to an encounter with bandits, no bandits are encountered as part of this quest.

quests/quest:gww:25679/sections/objectiv.text: Meet Nobleman Emrah and his fellow Vabbians in Lahtenda Bog.
Escort the Vabbians on their hike to the Sunspear Crypt in Lahtenda Bog.
See Nobleman Emrah for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25679/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the map to the quest marker, killing any foes you encounter. Watch out for popup Mandragors and roving Insects.

quests/quest:gww:25679/sections/notes-1/.text: This quest can be combined with the quest Crypt-ology as both lead to the same spot in Lahtenda bog.
You can also do the quests Down on the Bayou and Wandered Off Again while working on this quest.

quests/quest:gww:18034/sections/objectiv.text: Gather petals from a swamp flower plant.
See Barlom Dye Trader for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:18034/sections/instruct.text: "Oh dear! I'm almost out of swamp flower petals, but I can't stop stirring to find more or this dye I'm working on will be ruined! If you have time, I'd be willing to give you a fresh vial of dye from my most recent batch if you bring me some petals from the swamp flowers growing in the Zehlon Reach. Think you have some time for that?"

quests/quest:gww:25678/sections/objectiv.text: Meet the Vabbian nobles in Zehlon Reach.
Escort the Vabbian nobles on their tour of the Zehlon Reach.
See Clerk Arlon for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25678/sections/instruct.text: "Now that I know I can trust you to handle a task, I have a job to offer you. It's cushy and pays well. I can see you are interested. All you need to do is escort a small group of Vabbian noblemen on a hike through Zehlon Reach. They absolutely insist on taking a closer look at the "real Istani countryside" no matter how dangerous I tell them the area can be. Accompany them on their little expedition and I'll reward you handsomely."

quests/quest:gww:25357/sections/objectiv.text: Help Galen Trask complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
Help Kilroy Stonekin complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
Help High Priest Alkar complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
Help Orozar Highstone complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
Find Galen Trask somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
Lead Galen Trask into Sorrow's Furnace.
Find Kilroy Stonekin somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
Lead Kilroy Stonekin into Sorrow's Furnace.
Find High Priest Alkar somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
Lead High Priest Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace.
Find Orozar Highstone somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
Lead Orozar Highstone into Sorrow's Furnace.

quests/quest:gww:25357/sections/walkthro.text: This quest actually involves four subquests. There is no particular order in which these subquests must be completed; however, all the subquests cannot be acquired at the same time.
Starting from the Deldrimor War Camp, for each of the four parts of the main "container" quest you'll have to:

Find a dwarf in Grenth's Footprint (and probably kill a couple of Stone Summit bosses along the way; this is not difficult, but when fighting the mobs here, take out the Stone Summit Gnashers as a priority, before they overwhelm the party with animated Bone Fiends);
Lead the dwarf to Sorrow's Furnace (and you can only lead one at a time);
Speak to the dwarf within the door of Sorrow's Furnace;
Complete the subquest that they in turn give you.
Each of these subquests must be completed before exiting Sorrow's Furnace, or you will be required to locate the relevant NPC in Grenth's Footprint again.
Each of the subquests is a repeatable quest, and a good source of experience points.
For more information, see the individual entries:
Summit Slaves (given by Galen Trask, and this one involves sub-subquests)
Unspeakable, Unknowable (given by High Priest Alkar)
Noble Intentions and Noble Intentions Plan B (given by Orozar Highstone)

quests/quest:gww:25357/sections/notes-1/.text: If you speak to any of the NPCs after completing their subquest, your quest log will update as if you need to complete the same subquest again. However, you can skip it and focus on the subquests that remain or proceed with The Final Assault, if you have completed each of the four tasks.

quests/quest:gww:14628/sections/objectiv.text: Search the mines for Belgun's assistants.
Defeat the Kournan and Margonite guards and free Assistant Lenahn.
Survive the onslaught of Kournan and Margonite troops.
See Belgun the Quarry Master for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14628/sections/walkthro.text: After receiving the quest from Belgun, head north-west to find Lenahn, who is being held captive by Kournans and a Margonite. After defeating the first Kournan group, further groups of Margonite reinforcements will approach the party from either side: 2 from the east, and 3 from the west (including the final boss group). After defeating all the groups, speak to Belgun for your reward and the followup quest.

quests/quest:gww:14628/sections/notes-1/.text: Nehpek the Remorseless does not spawn if this quest is active.

The foes' pincer movement can be avoided by retreating back along your arrival path as soon as the group at the quest marker has been eliminated, and fighting the spawns at that end alone. Once no more foes appear, head back to the marker to fight foes arriving from the other side.

The foes at the eastern end sometimes get stuck indefinitely on a Vabbi Chest which spawns in that narrow passage, so waiting at the quest marker can be fruitless. Simply travel out and tackle them at their sticking point.

quests/quest:gww:25719/sections/objectiv.text: Rescue the Order of Whispers company trapped behind enemy lines.
See Warden of Whispers for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25719/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, pick up the Shard of Brilliance if you want, it will give a little light, although it's not essential. As you leave the short passageway, notice a group of Order of Whispers standing out front. As you approach, four groups of three Torment creatures each will charge that position. Defend yourselves.

Follow the quest marker to the west, pulling and taking out patrols as necessary. There are groups of Order of Whispers and Torment creatures at several locations. At each one, they will begin fighting as you approach. Helping them is optional, since the survivors won't follow you anyway.

Once you reach the quest marker where the Warden of Whispers and four Order of Whispers are, the waves will start coming. Each wave consists of 3 Torment creatures of the same profession. The waves come fast, and gets even faster towards the end. Your party must be able to dispatch each wave as quickly as possible before the numbers become overwhelming. The NPCs are of little help except as corpses, but take note that the Warden of Whispers inside the cave must survive.

Depending on your style, it is also possible to intercept the Torment creatures outside the cave, in order to have a wider battlefield. This is quite risky as the NPCs inside that cave cannot survive even one group.

quests/quest:gww:25719/sections/notes-1/.text: If you enter the cave where the Warden of Whispers is prior to starting the quest, the waves of torment creatures will attack before you can reach the Warden, making it next to impossible to succeed.

quests/quest:gww:25449/sections/objectiv.text: Deliver Master Togo's ultimatum to Captain Quimang.
See The Emperor's Blade for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25449/sections/walkthro.text: This quest is relatively easy to complete. Basically, you have to walk to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang and his group are hanging out. Upon leaving Tsumei Village, Port Kaimu is to the Southwest (as the crow flies). You can follow the Southwest path, or go across Qi Falls near Ang the Ephemeral, and then turn South.

You will probably encounter various groups of Kappa and the occasional hostile group of Crimson Skull along your travel. Once you get closer to the Port, the Crimson Skull pirates present will not be hostile, and will let you deliver the message and leave in peace.

quests/quest:gww:25449/sections/notes-1/.text: Captain Quimang and his men do not become hostile when given the ultimatum. If you can get to him, this quest is Survivor-safe. The only potential problem is the groups of Crimson Skull you encounter before getting to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang is.

quests/quest:gww:25476/sections/requirem.text: Wait until the end of the dialog between Sunzu and Nakai.

quests/quest:gww:25476/sections/objectiv.text: Speak to Nakai about the loan.
Speak to Sunzu about the loan.
Speak to Mitah about the loan.
Return to Sunzu and discuss the loan.

quests/quest:gww:25476/sections/walkthro.text: Nakai and Sunzu can initially be found in Bukdek Byway, east of The Marketplace: you will need to head east from the Marketplace over the bridge where the merchants and peasants are located, then double back over a shorter bridge south of this one.

When your party approaches them, Nakai and Sunzu will have an argument about the debt Mitah owes, then Sunzu will run off back over the bridge towards Mitah. When Sunzu has gone far enough, Nakai will offer this quest.

Head back to Mitah and Sunzu and speak to them in turn, and decide which of Sunzu's choices for the debt fix you prefer, either pay up 250 gold to help out Mitah, or refuse and kill Sunzu. If you refuse, and choose to kill Sunzu, a group of Jade Brotherhood members will appear (3 Mages and 1 Mesmer) and Sunzu himself will turn hostile and attack.
Finally, head back across the bridge to collect your reward from Nakai.

quests/quest:gww:25476/sections/notes-1/.text: Sometimes Nakai won't offer the quest after Sunzu has run far enough to normally trigger the offer. Running back to Mitah, then back to Nakai can correct this. Sometimes Sunzu's helpers only spawn when you run through that area at a later time, even if you handed in the quest in the meanwhile.

quests/quest:gww:25626/sections/objectiv.text: Defeat 5...0 more ancestral sprouts to cleanse the Ancestor Tree.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25626/sections/walkthro.text: Defeat the 5 ancestral sprouts near the Ancestor Tree. They spawn one at a time and once a group is defeated, the next will appear.

quests/quest:gww:25347/sections/objectiv.text: Destroy the Shadow Army forces surrounding the Tower of Courage. You have 5...0 groups left.
Destroy the Shadow Lord within the Tower of Courage.
Return to Rastigan the Eternal for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25347/sections/walkthro.text: The events of this quest will play out whether the quest is taken or not. You must be prepared for this if your party approaches the Tower of Courage because you will be thrown out of the Fissure of Woe if Rastigan the Eternal perishes. Each group of Shadow Army you need to kill for this quest consists of an Abyssal and two Shadow Rangers. Aggroing these groups will cause Rastigan to run forward, and he will certainly die if you haven't taken care of things.

First, clear out the area between you and the Tower without aggroing the Abyssal/Ranger groups. Most groups start with the left side first, and then the right. Be mindful of patrols and Shadow Beast popups. When the area is clear, take out the first group at the southwest of the Tower. Rastigan will run forward and stand where this group was. Take out the rest of the groups around the Tower. When they're dead, Rastigan will come up and open the tower gate. Shadow Lord Vogris will spawn inside with 2 Abyssals. One possible tactic to defeat this last group is to have one or more players body block them at the gate entrance. This will help focus their damage on fewer party members and bunch them up for AoE damage.

It is possible to prevent Rastigan from running forward after aggroing one of the Shadow Army groups if your party is well out of his range. The groups can then be defeated at your own pace. When you are ready for him to run forward, move within his range.

quests/quest:gww:25347/sections/notes-1/.text: An unlocked Chest spawns inside the tower when this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:25346/sections/objectiv.text: Clear the path to the Tower of Strength. You have 5...0 Shadow Patrols left.
Enter the Tower of Strength and destroy the Shadow Lord.
Return to Eternal Lord Taeres for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25346/sections/walkthro.text: Exit the forge to the south and keep to the left. You will find several strong patrols of Shadow Army creatures and a lot of hidden Shadow Beasts on your way, so advance carefully. The Shadow Patrols that have to be killed are five single beasts similar to Abyssals, however, they are accompanied by large numbers of other nightmares and some Infernal Wurms.

When the Tower of Strength comes into sight, keep close to the right wall and always fight only one group at a time. With careful luring you can use the geography of this place to your advantage: There is a path leading down towards the tower with a ridge at its side. Spellcasters and Rangers should stay on that ridge and Warriors should lure the opponents to the place directly below the ridge. If done right this will keep the fragile party members out of harm's reach (at least from the powerful melee attacks of the Abyssals) but still enable them to participate in the fight.

After the way to the tower is cleared you will have to send one of your party members back to the forge to fetch the Tower Mage, he will not start moving until a player comes within radar range of him.
When coming close to the gate, he will open it. The Shadow Lord will then spawn all alone inside the tower and shouldn't pose any threat whatsoever.

quests/quest:gww:25346/sections/notes-1/.text: Unlike other essential quest NPCs, the tower mage will not be attacked and thus does not need to be defended.

quests/quest:gww:203201/sections/objecti.text: Kill the TPS Regulator Golem in Oola's Lab.
*BONUS* Kill the TPS Regulator Golem in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:203201/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:203201/sections/walkthr.text: Quest involved: Little Workshop of Horrors.

quests/quest:gww:283856/sections/objecti.text: Find information regarding the chalice. Good responses: [0...3] of 3.
Find information regarding the chalice. Bad responses: [0...3] of 3
See Xan Hei for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283856/sections/shared-.text: Start from Senji's Corner and exit to Xaquang Skyway to talk to Xan Hei who is a few steps from the town. He will transport you to a small area in The Marketplace where you must talk to the people in order to further the quest.

There are two parts to the quest. The first requires that you obtain intel about the Chalice by questioning the locals; you succeed by getting three good or three bad responses. Fortunately, there are five NPCs, so you will inevitably get three responses of the same type no matter how they respond.

Unfortunately, as soon as you accomplish this task, Fah Yu the Shadow's Eye and a couple of Am Fah mobs spawn and rush toward the center of The Marketplace area (the red platform in the middle). Initially there are two mobs from each direction, then after they are dead there is another group from each side. As long as you are spread out when this happens, you should not expect too much trouble, since these foes are not any tougher than the ones you have seen so far. After killing Fah Yu and company, listen to the brief dialogue, then return to Xan Hei to claim your reward.

Since the area is small, certain skills are especially effective: those with AoE damage or protection, Shouts, Wards, and Wells. To prevent getting wiped by the Am Fah's Chaos Storms, replace any wands or staves with martial weapons (preferably spears for heroes, so that they do not follow foes into melee range).
Hard Mode

In hard mode, the typical strategy is to park the party in the northwest corner, near Kaineng Docks exit, where enemies are least likely to go towards. Having a bonder hero eases the difficulty in this quest. Am Fah that spawn out of the Bukdek Byway exit will head west along the north side, and are easy to aggro from the Kaineng Docks exit; meanwhile the enemies from Wajjun Bazaar exit will head east to the spawn point and can be pulled later by players at their leisure. It is best to leave Kun Yao last to talk to be in position without aggroing a Wajjun group.
Good and bad responses
To get the desired response, choose the listed dialogue as it becomes available during your conversations:
Speaking with Ja Wen, Vai Di, Jeiff, or Sho Ri will not advance the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25684/sections/objectiv.text: Gather 20 shells on the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You have gathered [0...20] of 20.
Give the shells to Elder Olunideh and collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25684/sections/notes-1/.text: There are approximately 78 shells in Mehtani Keys during this quest.
Because you can collect the same shell more than once, you can repeatedly enter and exit Kodlonu Hamlet collecting the shells that are nearby, rather than running around the whole area.
This quest can be completed at the same time as Isle of the Dead, by collecting the shells while killing the Ancient Undead in Mehtani Keys.
The chat window doesn't display Elder Olunideh taking the shells.

quests/quest:gww:25684/sections/instruct.text: "Those Vabbian merchants are a strange sort. They come here with big talk of trade between our people, but are they interested in our crops? No. Instead, they ask about shells. Shells! They're all over the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You just walk the dunes and look down. We never collect them; they're just shells. But that's what the Vabbians want. I need a "starter shipment" of 20 shells. If you gather them for me, I'll give you a share of the profits."

quests/quest:gww:289563/sections/objecti.text: Search for signs of suspicious activity.

quests/quest:gww:289563/sections/notes-1.text: The Quest Log doesn't display the gold or experience rewards for this quest, though gold and experience are given when the quest is turned in, and are displayed in the initial quest dialogue.

quests/quest:gww:289563/sections/shared-.text: Start from Amatz Basin, follow the quest markers through Mourning Veil Falls, and protect the Kurzick Diplomats. They are high level healers, but you will get attacked by enemies that spawn from three different directions, be sure not to leave them unprotected against attacks from behind.

Alternatively you can fight at the slope directly across from where the diplomats were standing. The diplomats should be able to keep themselves alive as long as you distract the incoming enemies enough. Keep your healers just in range so that they can still heal the diplomats. This will allow your party to avoid most of the area of effect (AoE) damage, making the fight much easier.

If having difficulty with the waves of foes, use a minion master hero and flag it into the shallow stream to the south of the Diplomats (and slightly east) - they will follow the minions to heal and be out of range of the majority of spawns.
Note that the Jade Brotherhood and Ministry of Purity are hostile towards each other; if you can get the Kurzicks out of the way, the enemies will thin themselves.
Blood is Power and/or minions for exploiting the Kurzick Diplomats' AI.
AoE damage and control skills, especially Pain of Disenchantment, Ineptitude and/or Panic.
AoE support skills (so that your allies benefit), especially Recuperation, Shelter and/or Union.

quests/quest:gww:280493/sections/objecti.text: Clear Traveler's Vale in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:280493/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:280493/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Traveler's Vale in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:280493/sections/target-.text: You can access the area via
Yak's Bend, where you're teleported upon completion of the Nolani Academy mission
Ascalon Foothills if running from Ascalon
Iron Horse Mine if running from Kryta
The Way is Blocked is the primary quest that takes the player through this area.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 163–191 foes. There are hidden Juniper Barks throughout the area.
Enchantment based builds are vulnerable to stripping from the large number of Stone Summit in the area.
There are several walking groups of 2 Stone Summit each at the eastern part of the map below Yak's Bend which can be overlooked easily because they have a larger patrol circle/area.
This is said to be where Nicholas found Professor Yakkington as a calf, before the Searing.
The Centaurs and Dwarves are hostile to each other.

quests/quest:gww:25511/sections/objectiv.text: Go to Lakeside County and follow the road to Ashford. Talk to Devona about the Grawl threat.
Go with Devona and destroy the Grawl threatening Ashford.

quests/quest:gww:25511/sections/walkthro.text: From Ascalon City, follow the southwest road to Ashford. Talk to Devona, then follow her across the bridge to trigger the Grawl ambush. Watch out for Grawl Shamans who use Infuse Health and Heal Area; it may be worthwile to focus on them first. Since there are quite a few Grawl here, consider taking a healing spell to heal yourself and Devona if needed.
Keep your distance and let the Grawl waves come to you. Devona will often pull aggro from nearby skale, so a cautious approach prevents you from being overwhelmed.

During the ambush, the Charr ranger Vatlaaw Doomtooth will spawn, cast Favorable Winds, and immediately flee through the portal to Regent Valley. Usually, he will escape before you can reach him. Once the Grawl are defeated, speak to Devona to claim your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25511/sections/notes-1/.text: With some preparation it is actually possible kill Vatlaaw. To do so you will usually want high firepower, Imagined Burden to slow him down, and/or the use of minions or gwen to bodyblock him. When blocked, he will not fight back and can be easily killed. You will have to follow a method to stand in his path before he spawns:
Sneak around the devourer cave (after talking to Devona) to the east. This way, he will be forced to run into you while trying to flee into Regent Valley.
Bring another player of significant level that will be waiting at Vatlaaw's spawn point up the road from Ashford.
Using a cupcake may also work.

Vatlaaw will occasionally become blocked or stuck, and not make his escape. Vatlaaw automatically casts Favorable Winds on spawn, however does two knockdown animations during the cast even though he is not being knocked down.

quests/quest:gww:25624/sections/objectiv.text: Seek the source of the corruption by defeating and purifying the tormented lands. You have [10...0] more tormented lands to defeat.
Defeat and purify the Earthen Abomination.
See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25624/sections/environm.text: Earthen Abomination and Tormented Lands will no longer spawn in Turai's Procession after this quest is completed.

quests/quest:gww:25624/sections/walkthro.text: After accepting the quest, Mirza will drop a Sacred Seed for a party member to carry.

Take the seed and follow the quest pointer into the central area of Turai's Procession where you will see a Tormented Land, defeat the creature and drop the seed on its corpse. You will see a shimmering effect on the ground, and the creature's corpse will disappear as the corruption in it is purified. This process must be performed 10 times in total, once for each Tormented Land that appears.
After defeating 10 Tormented Lands, the final corrupted creature, the Earthen Abomination will appear, as above, slay this creature and drop the seed on its corpse to complete the purifying process.
Finally, return to Mirza and collect your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25624/sections/notes-1/.text: You can drop the seeds on the bodies in any order, including the boss.
Completion of this quest increases the number of foes required to Vanquish the area.
Tormented Lands will appear near the central area until the quest is completed. To complete the vanquish, each spawn only needs to be killed once.
After the quest is completed, the quest-related foes will be replaced by groups totaling more than 11 foes (including Heket, Stone Shard Crag/Cracked Mesa, and Tusked Hunter/Tusked Howler).

quests/quest:gww:63412/sections/objectiv.text: Find the home of Hogni Truthseeker in Drakkar Lake.

quests/quest:gww:63412/sections/rewards-.text: Note: The quest will only be available after completing "Tracking the Nornbear" quest.

quests/quest:gww:63412/sections/walkthro.text: Start from either Olafstead or Sifhalla to get to Hogni Truthseeker. The route from Olafstead is shorter. It is entirely possible to run, as this quest requires no fighting.

quests/quest:gww:63412/sections/notes-1/.text: Hogni Truthseeker gives you three quests (A Hunter's Pride, Leader of the Pack and Shadows in the Night) to gain the elite form skills Ursan, Volfen and Raven blessings as well as Norn reputation points.

The quests for each skill only become available after completing the primary quest in which you receive the corresponding temporary blessing: Blood Washes Blood (Ursan), Curse of the Nornbear (Volfen) and A Gate Too Far (Raven).

quests/quest:gww:25525/sections/objectiv.text: Find and retrieve a mossy rock from the cave near the ruins of Ashford.
Return to Vassar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25525/sections/walkthro.text: The cave is to the southeast of the Sanitarium. Follow the quest marker. There will be one or two Grawl boss groups in front of the cave entrance, as well as the elemental Grit Slingstone inside the cave; you do not have to kill any of them to complete the quest. Click on the mossy rock on the ground and you will obtain a Mossy Rock quest item. Take this back to Vassar.

quests/quest:gww:25525/sections/notes-1/.text: Combines well with Mesmerizing the Enemy as the target boss will be along the way.

quests/quest:gww:320333/sections/notes-1.text: The portal on the first level claims it leads to the third level of Forsaken Tunnels. Multiple groups of singed oaks fail to fight back.
The dungeon can be entered with a party of 6 when starting from Yak's Bend or even 8 when starting from Temple of the Ages (very far away).
If any party members have Elegy for Those Left Behind, the bandits that drop the Elemental Keystone don't spawn, so the party cannot advance to the second level.
If no party members have The Dreamer and the Zealot active, the gate to the third level remains closed and none of the bosses on the third level spawn.
First and second floor re-uses the second and third floor of Forsaken Tunnels with slight environmental differences.
Because this area is mechanically part of the Depths of Tyria, the Reforged Mode effect is not applied.

quests/quest:gww:320333/sections/shared-.text: Note: Ghost of Althea will not accompany your group until you enter the second level.
Collect the Elemental Keystone bundle item from the bandits toward the north west.
Carry it back to the Crystal Gate to open it and proceed to the second level.
Continue through this level until you get to a closed rock doorway that the Ghost of Althea will open.
Push on and kill the Enraged Phantom boss that drops the Boss Key before proceeding to the end door with the Boss Lock.
Varny will summon a first wave of manipulated Grawl, then a second one among including the God-touched Grawl. That boss will turn friendly and help you once it reaches around 10-20% health.
Varny will then personally confront you with a last wave of Grawl.
This quest is actually coded as two quests, one for the first time and one for repeated runs.
Doing this quest in hard mode can yield two maximum requirement gold weapon drops with inscription slots from the end chest, but the quest rewards are still the same as normal mode.

Remember to cover your important enchantment spells. The foes here can easily strip them. Cast enchantments of lower importance on top of them, and monitor them closely. It will give you precious time to recast when the foes strip them.

When repeating the quest, it is possible to pull the various Manipulated Grawls in the boss room into a fight with the Echos and Horsemen. It can thin their numbers significantly when finally facing the boss Varny, which is especially helpful in hard mode. This is not possible during a first run of the quest, because Echos and Horsemen will not spawn yet.
You can trigger Varny's initial dialogue and the spawning of the manipulated grawl from the ledge above, near the 2nd resurrection shrine:

quests/quest:gww:278507/sections/objecti.text: Clear Turai's Procession in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:278507/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:278507/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Turai's Procession in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:278507/sections/target-.text: Turai's Procession is the north exit in Command Post.

This area is named after Turai Ossa, but the "Procession" might refer to the march of his army towards the Battle of Jahai or him leading settlers to the Crystal Desert. Geographically, the latter is more likely.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title, the largest in Kourna.
This zone has a small section (on the eastern edge) with a permanent fog: it will remain covered even after your character explores it.
If triggered, Mirza's Last Stand greatly increases the number of foes in this area.

Until the quest Troubled Lands is completed, vanquishing requires killing the Tormented Lands. They spawn in a fixed order and might make vanquishing confusing - refer to the map in on the quest page if you're having difficulty finding the last few mobs.

Kill each Tormented Land once - another will spawn nearby until the original ten are killed, at which point an Earthen Abomination spawns. Kill the Abomination and from this point on you can ignore these creatures. Two minutes later, the spawning process will begin again. The first 11 unique kills contribute to experience, leave drops, and count towards vanquishing; killing the re-spawned ones does not; the Earthen Abomination boss gives the morale boost only after first kill.

Completing Troubled Lands raises the kill count, as it replaces the Tormented Lands (10) and Earthen Abomination (1) with groups totaling more than the aforementioned 11 elementals required to complete the quest.

quests/quest:gww:68718/sections/objectiv.text: Defeat the White Mantle who have taken the Grimoire Arcanum.
Return the Grimoire Arcanum to Justiciar Naveed.

quests/quest:gww:68718/sections/walkthro.text: Find Justiciar Naveed outside of Tarnished Haven. Travel to the west side of Alcazia Tangle near the exit to Magus Stones and defeat the group of White Mantle there. Pick up the Grimoire Arcanum and return it to Justiciar Naveed. To save time, once you have acquired the Grimoire Arcanum you can map back to Tarnished Haven and go to Justiciar Naveed from there.

quests/quest:gww:68718/sections/notes-1/.text: A far easier route, than fighting through Alcazia Tangle to reach the West side, would be to travel South from Rata Sum through Magus Stones and then head through the portal into Alcazia Tangle. The White Mantle are just South of the portal.
Using the Chest (under the quest marker) after killing the White Mantle will acquire the Grimoire Arcanum.

Justiciar Naveed will not accept the Grimoire Arcanum if you get it on one character and try to turn it in on another character, who has not completed the first objective (which is similar to Temple of the Damned and its quest item).
The assassin boss Pywatt the Swift is nearby.

quests/quest:gww:279738/sections/objecti.text: Clear Twin Serpent Lakes in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279738/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279738/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Twin Serpent Lakes in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279738/sections/target-.text: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Vanquishing: 171–194 foes. A Spined Aloe is often hidden between Ancient Oakhearts.
With War in Kryta active (during a Bounty), the foe count is approximately 137.
The Drakes, Gargoyles, and Skale often roam together. Use terrain features, such as walls, to obstruct their line of sight, and pull groups apart to avoid engaging multiple species at once.
The Caromi Tengu groups have long patrol routes and move quickly.

quests/quest:gww:23901/sections/objectiv.text: Rout the remaining Kournan forces. You have 0..3 groups to rout.
See Elder Jonah for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23901/sections/walkthro.text: Kournan soldiers will gather at the three entrances to the village. After some dialogue, the center group will attack, followed by the two outside groups. With the exception of the Kournan Commander, all the troops are level 16 and killing them should not be a problem for a full group.
If you kill the center group before they enter the village gates, the other two groups will not become hostile. Thus, the quest cannot be completed.

quests/quest:gww:23901/sections/notes-1/.text: There is a resurrection shrine near to the village, with a hunt blessing, so this quest can be used to farm Sunspear points.

quests/quest:gww:23318/sections/objectiv.text: Convince Kareh Ossa's commanders to align with Joko by defeating them in combat. You have defeated [0...4] of 4 commanders.
See Palawa Joko for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:23318/sections/walkthro.text: Follow the quest pointer to each of the commanders in turn and defeat them and their guards. Be careful, since the normal area spawns will also be present making for large mixed groups of enemies. Two commanders can be reached using Junundu, making them easy to defeat.
On the map: W is Wurm Spoor locations. The numbers are the four commanders.

quests/quest:gww:23318/sections/notes-1/.text: The four commanders are: Commander Mosek, Commander Yamji, Commander Lohgor and Commander Giturh. Note that while some of them have elite skills, they cannot be captured due to the fact that they automatically turn non-hostile if defeated (less than 20% health), preventing their deaths. Also since they do not, technically, die - you do not receive any morale boosts.
Should you map back to town to remove any death penalty, you will restart the quest.
The mob linked with each commander will become friendly when the commander is defeated, so if you want a fast run, target and take down each commander first.
The boss group of Churkeh the Defiant might not spawn if this quest is active when entering the area.

quests/quest:gww:25216/sections/objectiv.text: Return to Erudine for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25216/sections/walkthro.text: Exit Serenity Temple and follow the quest marker to reach the giant crystal. The boss will spawn in the general area. Once you kill the boss, pick up the Storm Rider Tissue Sample and bring it back to Erudine for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25216/sections/notes-1/.text: The quest will not be marked as completed after obtaining the Storm Rider Tissue Sample.

quests/quest:gww:25508/sections/objectiv.text: Go to the falls to the west. Destroy the aloe husks until you find an aloe root.
Take the aloe root back to Aidan.
Aidan will give you the following skills when accepting this quest:

quests/quest:gww:25508/sections/walkthro.text: You can find Aidan south-east next to a small fishing village in the Wizard's Folly.

If you draw a line straight south from Ashford Abbey to the bottom of the map, the bottom of the line would cross the small fishing village. By foot that means go east from Foible's Fair until you come to the river. Then try to go south and you'll find the village. The village is in an area of the river shaped like a large "Y".

When you're at the village, go south. You'll encounter some spiders. When you can't go south anymore, go east; you'll see a small house at a mountain. You can find Aidan at the foot of the hill, next to a part of the river which flows north to south.

Equipping the two skills Aidan gives you will be a big help, as the Large Aloe Seeds you will encounter are susceptible to fire damage and come in clusters of three. This quest serves as an introduction to the concept of skill chaining, using skills in combination for greater effect. Using Dual Shot doubles the effect of Ignite Arrows.

Follow the quest marker west until you encounter the river. Several Large Aloe Seeds will be hanging out here. Kill them, using your new skills if you wish. They will drop Aloe Roots when they die. Pick one up and take it back to Aidan.

quests/quest:gww:25508/sections/notes-1/.text: The Hunter's Horn quest leads to Aidan, who can be hard to find for new players.
The Large Aloe Seeds spawn even without the quest active in the log, but they cease to spawn after completion of the quest.

quests/quest:gww:25364/sections/requirem.text: Summit Slaves active in quest log.

quests/quest:gww:25364/sections/objectiv.text: See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25364/sections/notes-1/.text: The Stone Basilica can be scouted for Summit Slaves on the way to Molachev.
Darkhaven can be scouted for Summit Slaves while fighting Molachev.
The ally and enemy Dredge in Darkhaven are hostile to each other.

quests/quest:gww:25356/sections/objectiv.text: Return to the ancient ruins of the Great Destroyer.
Destroy the Hierophant Morlog before he learns the true name of the Great Destroyer.
Return the Tome of the Rubicon to the ancient ruins. Drop it where High Priest Alkar awaits.
Collect 4 shards of Balthazate crystal and place them near High Priest Alkar. You have [4..0] shards remaining. Be sure to protect the High Priest from enemy patrols.
See High Priest Alkar for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25356/sections/rewards-.text: 8,000 Experience (You must collect the reward before leaving Sorrow's Furnace.)

quests/quest:gww:25356/sections/walkthro.text: To acquire this quest, you will first need to locate High Priest Alkar in Grenth's Footprint. You'll find him towards the northeast. You will then have to lead Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace, taking down several groups of Stone Summit along the way. Simply head towards the quest marker and enter Sorrow's Furnace, regardless of whether Alkar managed to keep up with your party.
Getting the Tome of the Rubicon

Once inside, talk to Alkar again to accept this quest. Head past the large doors and down to engage the first enemy group. After taking down this group, Alkar will start moving on his own towards the Stone Basilica (taking a right at the first junction). It is important that the party keep an eye on Alkar, since his death will return the party to an outpost. Try to gather drops during a fight rather than after, since Alkar will immediately set off towards the quest marker the moment the last enemy falls.

Eventually, you'll see Hierophant Morlog, who is surrounded by many Summit Taskmasters. Pull the surrounding enemies to thin them before engaging the Hierophant, who will drop the Tome of the Rubicon upon defeat. Alkar will head back towards the stairs. Bring the Tome to him and drop it near him. Do not delay bringing the tome to Alkar because he will be attacked when he reaches the platform. You must return to defend him. The next (more difficult) part of the quest will start.
Gathering four Balthazate Crystals

The second part of the quest will require you to retrieve four Balthazate Crystals to help power Alkar's ritual to bury the Tome of the Rubicon. The Balthazate Crystals will drop from the four newly-spawned Dredge Blastrocks. Each of the Dredge Blastrocks spawn amongst a group of Dredge, but are not part of the group. As such, depending on your luck, it may be possible to pull the Dredge Blastrock away from the Dredge group.

Alkar will remain on the platform. The party must split up at this point - a smaller group to protect Alkar (he will get attacked), and a larger group to retrieve the Balthazate Crystals. The group protecting Alkar should consist of at least a tank and a healer, but no more than three, or there may not be enough firepower to take down the Dredge Blastrocks.

The quest marker will indicate the location of the next Dredge Blastrock, so use it to find them. Keep in mind that engaging and killing Dredge Blastrocks will trigger enemy spawns to charge down the stairs towards Alkar's position, so be ready to run back to help defend Alkar. Left alone, Alkar will fall very quickly.

The first Dredge Blastrock is a short distance to the southeast. The third and fourth are further beyond, to the southeast and southwest respectively (watch out for overlapping patrols). The second Dredge Blastrock actually requires that you backtrack up the stairs. The tricky thing about taking down the Dredge Blastrock is that enemies will spawn and charge towards Alkar's position the first time a Dredge Blastrock is attacked and when a Dredge Blastrock is killed.

In other words, when a Dredge Blastrock is attacked for the first time, a small group of usually three Stone Summit will attack Alkar's position. Upon killing a Dredge Blastrock, a larger group of about 5 or 6 Stone Summit and spawn and charge Alkar's position.
There are two things to keep in mind:
Kill all nearby Dredge before engaging a Dredge Blastrock and do not kill a Dredge Blastrock too quickly after engaging it (to avoid quickly overwhelming the defending group).

When a Dredge Blastrock is almost dead, if the party has multiple players, have some of them start running back. If using henchmen, run back to Alkar immediately after killing a Dredge Blastrock. Consider ignoring the Balthazate Crystal first and come back for it later, after defending Alkar from the assault. Running back only after Alkar starts taking damage usually means it will be too late.
For each Balthazate Crystal retrieved, just drop them near Alkar. Once you have successfully recovered four of them, a cutscene will trigger and the quest will be completed.
Walkthrough variations

It may be possible to leave Alkar going one-on-one with Hierophant Morlog, possibly supported by just one healer. If they manage to fight to a standstill, it makes the second part of this quest much easier, since you don't have to worry about Alkar dying. You just need to know where the Dredge Blastrock will spawn (since they have not spawned yet), and also to keep your heroes, henchmen, or minions from killing the Hierophant.

If only using henchmen, completing this quest will be tricky. The key would be in knowing how to trigger the enemy spawn that attacks Alkar. The idea is that you trigger a spawn, then immediately run back to defend Alkar. Having party-wide speed boost skills will be helpful (e.g. "Charge!").

Leaving a single warrior with defensive stances and powerful AoE damage to defend Alkar is also possible, because Alkar is a powerful healer. A single trapping ranger would be even better. Covering the stairs in traps will decimate the enemies charging down it, or at least weaken them enough for the rest of the party to come back and help.
Additional tips
The key to taking down Stone Summit groups is to take down any Priests of Sorrows first. The Summit Dark Binders will exploit corpses, so it may be useful to take them down early as well.
Similarly, for Dredge groups, take down the Dredge Spirit Keepers first, as they have Resurrect. Also, the Dredge Spirit Guards possess a Resurrection Signet.
There is a resurrection shrine close to Alkar's position. As long as Alkar is not dead, the quest is not yet lost.
Leave a minion master with Alkar to take advantage of the corpses and to have minions providing additional firepower and targets for the Stone Summit.
If using a minion master, Alkar will follow you in an attempt to heal the minions for all but the second Balthazate crystal.
Ward Against Melee may be a good skill to have when defending Alkar, since most of the attacking spawns will consist of Summit Deep Knights and Enslaved Ettins.

Alkar may start to follow your minion master and heal his minions. You can lure him away from Stone Basilica this way. He also may get stuck on the wall and stop moving till your minion master comes back.

quests/quest:gww:206186/sections/objecti.text: Defeat Kuunavang in the Unwaking Waters.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in under 15 minutes.
*BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:206186/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:206186/sections/walkthr.text: As per the Unwaking Waters mission.

quests/quest:gww:279380/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Unwaking Waters in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279380/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279380/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Unwaking Waters in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279380/sections/target-.text: Can only be entered from Harvest Temple.

If every character in the party has completed Befriending the Luxons, Hylas will grant the group access to the Unwaking Waters (Luxon) mission outpost, and you will be able to explore the Luxon side without finishing the Gyala Hatchery mission.

Similarly, if all characters in the party have completed Befriending the Kurzicks, talking to Gatekeeper Dedrick will give you similar access to the Unwaking Waters (Kurzick) mission outpost, and you can explore the Kurzick side without finishing the Eternal Grove mission.

You can gate glitch both of these gates. Although this does take you to the Unwaking Waters (Kurzick) or Unwaking Waters (Luxon) outpost, your spawn location in both outposts after using the glitch is inside the Harvest Temple. This can be resolved by changing district or using map travel twice.
