quests/quest:gww:283859/sections/objecti.text: Locate and defeat Reisen the Phoenix.
See Xan Hei for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283859/sections/shared-.text: Speak to Xan Hei again, who will transport your party to an altered Dragon's Throat.

There is only one route to Reisen the Phoenix, requiring you to fight through group after group of Jade Brotherhood. If you deviate from it, you will have to fight additional foes, including additional bosses. Each time you kill one of these bosses, additional foes will spawn with Reisen and along the path itself. Stick to the path, if you want things to be as easy as possible.

As with most of Winds of Change, groups here spawn close to one another and have overlapping patrol routes. Sometimes, a healer from one group will separate to heal one of their allies in another, so it can be hard to avoid over-aggroing. Do your best to pull groups apart and be ready to retreat before you get overwhelmed.

The layout of Dragon's Throat lends itself well to balling up, both for you and for the enemies; there are plenty of choke points (e.g. corners, narrow hallways, or stairways). Take advantage of this by positioning the party before the choke point, pulling groups towards you, forcing them to clump; then use AoE skills and effects to wipe out entire mobs at a time. Avoid letting this happen to the party, since your foes can return the favor (particularly their Splinter Weapon-wielding Warriors).

Bring skills that can take advantage of the choke-point tactics: Wards, AoE damage/effects (especially damage over time), defensive spirits (since they can be setup safely behind your group), and multiple-foe interrupts. Melee characters should consider bringing Asuran Scan due to the enemies' propensity to use blocking and blind-inflicting skills.
After defeating Reisen the Phoenix, be sure to wait for the conversation between you and Xan Hei to end before leaving the map.
Although there is no visible Resurrection Shrine on the Mission Map, you will respawn at the beginning of the quest if you die.
Each member of Reisen's group, including Reisen himself, can be pulled separately from other members of the group.
The Jade Brotherhood Warriors that accompany Lai, Graceful Blade as well as Sheng Pai will not always say their line of dialogue.

quests/quest:gww:283684/sections/objecti.text: Meet Ministry Agent Oroku in the Undercity.
Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
Find the source of the corruption.
Defeat Kai Shi Jo and his corrupted kappa.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:283684/sections/environ.text: Baubao Wavewrath does not spawn in the Undercity during this quest.

quests/quest:gww:283684/sections/walkthr.text: Enter the Undercity from the Wajjun Bazaar, via the Nahpui Quarter outpost. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the Kappa come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of spellcasters, area of effect skills and caster shutdown will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the Am Fah. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)
Once you have cleansed all 3 areas of corruption, Oroku will revive after dying from that point on.

If you have Cleansing the Undercity active, you can bring along Initiate Zei Ri as an extra ally to help make this quest easier. Just make sure to complete Oroku's quest first before killing the Afflicted mobs.

quests/quest:gww:284032/sections/objecti.text: Meet Ministry Agent Oroku in the Undercity.
Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
Find the source of the corruption.
Defeat Kai Shi Jo and his corrupted kappa.
See Lei Jeng for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:284032/sections/walkthr.text: In Hard Mode at site 2, a good strategy is to: clear the site's 2 area from mobs. Then flag all Heroes upstairs on the left side (as looking from the site 2 into the corridor). Next, run with Oroku to start the waves and as soon as Kappas appear, run upstairs to your Heroes. Or stay down as melee support. Keep an eye on Heroes' health and move them as needed, good idea is to place two Heroes near the edge to keep Kappas' aggro and the rest as support which you move forward and backward when health drops. Give them Flesh of My Flesh for fast Resurrection.

The waves are triggered by killing specified Kappas, probably Violent Kappa or Maddened Kappa. You should try to kill those specified Kappas last, but there are few Kappas of those types in a wave, so you can't be sure which one of them triggers a next wave.
As Kappas can be a little disoriented by the long way around to get upstairs, they can sometimes move back etc., so this strategy makes the site 2 doable without Consumables and with Heroes.
Before entering the site's 3 area - use Consumables to recover if you have any Death Penalty (specifically on the Heroes who kept aggro) and for safety add some party-wide boost.
Again, aim for Violent Kappa first.

quests/quest:gww:15533/sections/objectiv.text: Find Gardener Tidak and tell that lazy bum to get back to work!
Kill the advancing beasts threatening Gardener Tidak.
See Horticulturist Hinon for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:15533/sections/walkthro.text: After receiving the quest, the party will need to make their way back into the outer garden area, towards a point slighty north-east of the garden entry portal, where they will find Tidak. As you approach, a group of 4 Roaring Ethers spawn and run towards him.
Although the objective mentions beasts threatening Tidak, none of the Ethers appear to attack him, they simply cluster in his general area waiting for the party to approach and fight them.

quests/quest:gww:15533/sections/notes-1/.text: Although the threatening beasts of the quest are a group of Roaring Ethers, it's very likely that some Rain Beetles and Rock Beetles will pop up as well, when you approach Tidak.
Combines well with Botanical Research and Plague of Frogs.

quests/quest:gww:10993/sections/objectiv.text: Travel throughout Echovald Forest and slay 40 wardens. You have killed [0...40] of 40 wardens.
See Dunmel Gorhopf for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:10993/sections/walkthro.text: Find and kill 40 wardens, then return to Dunmel for your reward. Wardens can be found in any area of Echovald Forest, although Arborstone and Morostav Trail seem to have high concentrations of them.

quests/quest:gww:10993/sections/notes-1/.text: Can be combined with Vanquisher title since this will require you to kill the wardens.
This quest is very similar to Forgotten Retribution in the Nightfall campaign.

quests/quest:gww:281100/sections/target-.text: This optional area can be easily reached by heading out the eastern exit of the Dzagonur Bastion mission outpost.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.95% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
Spawns in this area permanently change after certain quests are completed.

Completion of all the local quests will reduce the foe count by dozens of Harpies and Hekets. However, completing Destroy the Harpies causes Korrub, Flame of Dreams to spawn, who is considered to be one of the more difficult foes to defeat.
There are a few hidden beetle groups in the southeast, some of which overlap patrol paths of other beetle groups and behemoth groups.

After Scratcher or Screecher die, several harpy groups spawn and run towards the Resplendent Makuun exit. These new foes will not attack the party and they do not need to be killed to vanquish the area, unless they get stuck.
The Minotaur Hunt bounty will be offered even though there are no minotaurs in the area until after completing Extinction.

quests/quest:gww:25348/sections/objectiv.text: Travel through the Sage Lands and await the druids at the base of the waterfall.

quests/quest:gww:25348/sections/walkthro.text: Kneel at the Statue of Dwayna in Druid's Overlook. She will appear and you can take the quest.

It's preferable to start out from The Wilds. The path is shorter and pretty much straight. From Druid's Overlook you will have to take a significant detour to the west when your path to the north is blocked; a detour that will practically take you to The Wilds doorstep.

Once at the spot where the quest marker leads you, you will be attacked by successive groups of Maguuma Spiders (x2, x2, x3, then x3). The Druids will then appear after the spiders are defeated. Watch their ritual and talk to the Ancient Druid Spirit when they are finished.

quests/quest:gww:25348/sections/notes-1/.text: Be wary of going up the small hill to where the Maguuma Spider waves spawn, because there are several more spider spawns hiding in the trees, and Moss Scarabs hidden in the ground.
The Rider boss you need to kill for Eye For Profit is in the same spot, and can be killed at the same time regardless of whether you have spoken to Grahm.

quests/quest:gww:281664/sections/objecti.text: Clear Witman's Folly in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:281664/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:281664/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Witman's Folly in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:281664/sections/target-.text: Witman's Folly lies southeast of Droknar's Forge and is usually traversed on the way to Port Sledge in the southwestern corner of this area.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
Be careful with approaching the Grawl groups as they patrol close to each other.
Consider clearing the western half first (the Grawl). The only visible groups in the eastern half are the two boss groups. Be careful of hidden Nightmare popups when approaching the two boss groups.
There is a pair of Grawl that can easily be missed as they may travel the length of the path that connects to Droknar's Forge.
Skills can be captured faster by repeatedly entering from Port Sledge until the Grawl boss with the desired elite spawns near the portal.
The Grawl here have very few skills and even on hard mode they are easy to interrupt. This combined with their clustered nature makes the Wastrel skills extremely potent here.
Three Shiverpeak Chests (Locked Chests in Hard mode) will always spawn in this area, occasionally one of the chests spawns directly outside of Droknar's Forge.

quests/quest:gww:14224/sections/objectiv.text: Speak with Theatre Manager Daudi and find out how the Kournans were able to infiltrate the acting company.
Return to Prince Bokka the Magnificent and relate what you have learned.
See Prince Bokka the Magnificent for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:14224/sections/notes-1/.text: Although Theatre Manager Daudi does not spawn during some quests, such as Til Death Do Us Part..., Norgu will speak his part of the dialogue upon approaching Daudi's normal location, allowing the quest to progress to the next objective.

quests/quest:gww:14224/sections/instruct.text: "Oh, , I never got a chance to thank you for saving me. As for you, Norgu, stay away from my buffet!"

"I must admit, I am still rather shaken from the attempt on my life. I never thought that I could be a target in my own home...how could this have happened? I want to know, I want to know, and I want to know what you know, as soon as you know it! Norgu, you've dealt with that spineless Theatre Manager Daudi before. Go with and find out how he could let this happen! I am tempted to call my executioner again, I tell you, but I just got this new manager broken in. I go through them so quickly..."
Theatre Manager Daudi: "Norgu! Oh, thanks the gods, I thought for sure you were the headsman."
Norgu "Well, if you don't tell us how you let all those Kournans get to the prince, you'll be seeing him soon enough."

Theatre Manager Daudi: "But I didn't know they were Kournans! I had to hire more actors. My regulars quit! Bokka only pays them in bread. And these new actors applied! They agreed to work cheap, so I overlooked their lack of proper references...."
Norgu "Maybe you're right. I guess we'll have to let the prince decide what to do from here."
Theatre Manager Daudi: "You know I'd never do anything to hurt the prince. Please, you have to tell him it wasn't my fault...I have kids! Oh, it's no use. There's no way out...."
Norgu "Calm down...I'll do what I can. Just stop shaking. You're going to end up shaking this whole palace apart!"

"What? The real actors all decided to go overseas and work for someone else who lets them keep their profits AND gives them sprawling buffets every night? How dare they! It's all THEIR fault this happened! My bread is just as good as any lousy buffet could ever be."

quests/quest:gww:63382/sections/objectiv.text: Prove your valor to Sif. Vanquish Koren Wildrunner in Drakkar Lake.
Continue proving your worth. Defeat Myish, Lady Of The Lake in Drakkar Lake.
Flex your valor muscle. Stomp Nulfastu, Earthbound in Drakkar Lake.
See Sif Shadowhunter for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:63382/sections/walkthro.text: You can kill the bosses in any order and at any time. See the articles for each boss for specific combat tips. In brief, they are:
At the center of Drakkar Lake (northern green star).
She is easy to kill if you first take out the Chilling Wisps and Elementals that patrol the lake.
Patrols either clockwise or counterclockwise on the shore around the lake (possible initial positions marked in blue).
Be careful of overlapping patrols when you confront Koren Wildrunner.
An easy way to find him, is to follow his trail of Spirits of Symbiosis.
In the southeast corner of the map (southern green star).
Follow a white rabbit down into a small glade.
Watch out for numerous popups at the top and then again at the bottom. It helps to move slowly, pulling foes to you.

quests/quest:gww:63382/sections/notes-1/.text: You can combine this quest with the Zaishen bounty quests for Myish and Nulfastu.

quests/quest:gww:25521/sections/requirem.text: Free the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale by killing the Terrorweb Dryders around Grenth's statue in the Forgotten Vale after accepting the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments.

quests/quest:gww:25521/sections/objectiv.text: Eliminate the Wrathful Spirits before they destroy all the villagers.
Return to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:25521/sections/walkthro.text: You should clear the closest patrolling groups of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights before taking the quest. When you take the quest, five groups of three hostile Tortured Spirits spawn nearby. Four of the groups spawn in the village in the midst of the allied Tortured Spirits and start attacking them. The last group will spawn on the nearby hill and can be ignored until the other groups have been handled.

Killing the hostile Tortured Spirits isn't as simple as killing a regular level 15 enemy. They use Illusionary Weaponry with a high level of Illusion Magic, inflicting 40 points of armor ignoring damage per hit. A full group of three spirits will therefore cause a very high amount of damage if they gang up on a single target.

In addition to having to cope with the enemy, you need to protect the allied spirits. If all of them die your quest will fail. In addition, the hostile spirits will attack Mayor Alegheri and the Reaper after killing all other spirits. If the mayor or reaper die your party will be returned to the outpost from which you left to the Underworld. The allied spirits far away will most likely die before you can reach them, so make sure to protect atleast one of the nearest allied spirits. Even one survivor is enough. If possible a monk should concentrate on healing one of the spirits, but you can also use traps, AoE and interruption.
After defeating the hostile spirits in the village you can take out the last group on the hill. Then talk to the Reaper to receive your reward.

Completing the quest will spawn an unlocked chest and a Black Widow next to the monument of Grenth, allowing a party member to charm it. If charming the pet, remember to ask the others not to attack it when it turns hostile. The chest will drop a random purple or gold item to one random member of the party.

Tip: There is a trick to avoid the possibility of failing the quest. The friendly spirits you need to protect will spawn to the area after you kill the Grasping Darknesses near Mayor Alegheri. If you leave the first Darkness group alive, some of the spirits will not spawn making it so you cannot fail the quest. Just remember to avoid aggroing the darknesses when fighting the Wrathful Spirits. After you have cleared the area of most of the Wrathful Spirits you can kill the Grasping Darknesses.

quests/quest:gww:40716/sections/requirem.text: Summit Slaves active in quest log.

quests/quest:gww:40716/sections/objectiv.text: Place the toothed cog in The Cruncher's cog mouth. It is the only place a master gear won't fit.
Eliminate the [5...0] remaining rebel spirit keepers.
See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:40716/sections/walkthro.text: Take a Master Gear from a nearby working Gearbox, and use it on the gearbox by the gate south-east of Krak Flamewhip to open it. Follow the quest marker into the cavern beyond.

Kill the Rebel Spirit Keepers until one drops the Toothed Cog and activate the proper gearbox indicated by the quest marker (the only one with square looking gears). Although the Rebel Spirit Keepers are not linked to any of the nearby Dredge groups, aggroing the patrolling additional Dredge is very likely.
Return to Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

Rebel Spirit Keepers use Resurrect (monster skill) (8 second cast time, no recharge). Disabling this skill, either via Frozen Soil or interrupts (preferably using interrupts which also disable the skill, such as Distracting Shot) will make the Dredge groups easier to handle.

quests/quest:gww:40716/sections/notes-1/.text: Sorrow's Belly can be scouted for Summit Slaves while fighting the Dredge.

quests/quest:gww:279824/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Xaquang Skyway in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279824/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279824/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Xaquang Skyway in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279824/sections/target-.text: The portals from Bukdek Byway and Wajjun Bazaar are blocked until Nahpui Quarter is completed.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Canthan Cartographer title.

If you have started Winds of Change, consider vanquishing this area with Light My Fire or its hard mode version active: the foes will be the tougher Winds of Change version, but you will have powerful allies to compensate. Further, to complete either quest, you would need to kill most of the foes in the area.

Pay attention to Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte. He will start running towards the entry of Senji's Corner once you reach his bridge, whether you approach him from the northern or the southern side. If you don't defeat him he will stay at Senji's Corner, which can be frustrating while vanquishing this area since it's not an obvious place for enemies to be.

As with any bridges, NPC models in the area may not render when they are on the opposite side from the player: the bodies disappear, although the names can still be seen and they can still be targeted.

quests/quest:gww:279687/sections/objecti.text: Clear the Yatendi Canyons in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

quests/quest:gww:279687/sections/rewards.text: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.

quests/quest:gww:279687/sections/instruc.text: "Clear the Yatendi Canyons in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279687/sections/target-.text: Characters will pass through here out of Wehhan Terraces as part of the primary quest Rally The Princes.
These quests affect the spawns in this area:
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
Be wary of the southwestern area before the Fortress of Jahai. Several boss groups are placed quite near each other.

If the quest "Between a Rock..." is active, after killing the first group within the Fortress of Jahai, several groups of margonites will spawn and head to your location. Make sure you kill all of them before engaging the groups inside.

Kneeling at the statue of Balthazar resurrection shrine at the exit into Chantry of Secrets does not cause the Champion of Balthazar to appear. Also, while the world has Favor of the Gods, this statue of Balthazar is not animated.

quests/quest:gww:25616/sections/objectiv.text: Jerob No-Spine has betrayed you. Help Margrid find him and mete out corsair justice.
Seek Ruthless Sevad on the Barbarous Shore.
Find Herbalist Makala in Yohlon Haven.
Meet with Herdsman Mehnosi in the Marga Coast.
Seek out Jerob No-Spine along the southern Marga Coast.

quests/quest:gww:25616/sections/walkthro.text: Start out from Camp Hojanu and go speak to Ruthless Sevad in the middle of the Barbarous Shore to see what he can tell you about Jerob No-Spine. After talking to Ruthless Sevad, it's quickest to map straight to Yohlon Haven and see Makala. From there, map to Nundu Bay and head out to the Marga Coast to meet with Mehnosi. His location depends on whether you have done a quest Herds to the Slaughter before. If yes, he is standing on the western side of the zone near the sea; otherwise he is near the small swamp southeast of the Kournan garrison. After speaking to Mehnosi, follow the quest pointer to find Jerob in the Marga Coast area.
Although friendly at first, Jerob will turn hostile and attack the party, but will soon return to his spineless ways and beg for mercy rather than die.

quests/quest:gww:25616/sections/notes-1/.text: If you have Toma with you, it is possible for him to kill Jerob with Feeding Frenzy. If this happens, Jerob will not respawn even if you rezone. You must abandon the quest and restart it from the beginning.
If you rezone after completing the quest but before accepting the reward, Jerob will not spawn. You must abandon the quest and restart it from the beginning.
Even if you have the quest A Fool's Luck (in which you meet Jerob No-Spine in Barbarous Shore) you can't talk to him about the You Can Run... quest.

quests/quest:gww:279863/sections/instruc.text: "Clear Zehlon Reach in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."

quests/quest:gww:279863/sections/target-.text: Zehlon Reach is situated to the northeast of Jokanur Diggings. The primary quest that will first bring a character here is the Honorable General.
Many other secondary quests will lead to and take place here, such as Student Jin and Student Sousuke, To Dye For, and the Cult of the Stone Face.
The Ridgeback Skales, Stormseed Jacarandas and Skale Blighters all have different levels. Watch their levels before attacking if your party is still at a low level.
The eastern half of the area has many Skale Blighters capable of spreading Disease. Consider Condition removal or Health Regeneration skills.
Approaching the small island with corpses (to the east of the village) will spawn 4 Corsairs.
There are hidden Mandragors in several locations: northwest of Jokanur Diggings (outpost), north of Cliffs of Dohjok exit, and the central Plant-infested area.
Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.1% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
If approached, Suspicious Hermit turns hostile once his dialogue runs out. It is easy to leave the area before he becomes fully hostile and not notice. He is in the NE most tip of the map.
Starting from Blacktide Den or Beknur Harbor and arriving here via Cliffs of Dohjok will enable a party of 8 instead of 4.
For non-Nightfall characters (only), there are several quest-related spawns or triggers that are incorrect. These quests cannot be done by non-Nightfall characters yet they affect the instance.
Kohanu and Shaudok will always initiate their conversation for A Loose Cannon and A Peaceful Solution.
Hatuk will always initiate his dialogue for Secret Passage.
Several hostile Hungry Skale of the quest Skale and Magic Compass will always spawn.
Trapped Voices for the quest Voices in the Night can always be seen.

Zunraa can be summoned by using a Shrine of Zunraa and will follow your party as an ally.
There is a Komainu guarding the passage towards Kahnju Overlook.
Most of the afflicted groups contain an Afflicted Ritualist; prevention of their Spirit Transfer and Recuperation is recommended.
Afflicted Rangers, Monks, Mesmers and Elementalists are only found in two or three groups.

Factions characters can vanquish this area by killing or charming a single animal. This trick requires that all characters have completed An Unwelcome Guest and that Winds of Change is not active (either because the character has not started it or because Memories of Purity is active). It will not work if the party includes any Prophecies or Nightfall characters. This is an intended feature, rewarding Canthan natives for their role in clearing evil from the area. (Source: Gaile Gray at Inc Gamers, in 2008 (Broken link))

quests/quest:gww:9855/sections/objective.text: Keep Battle Priest Calibos alive for as long as possible.
Destroy Luxon Adepts to receive a morale boost and score bonus.

quests/quest:gww:9855/sections/rewards-1.text: Scoring in this mission rewards Luxon faction, experience, and gold based on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.

quests/quest:gww:9855/sections/walkthrou.text: There is no time limit during this mission, however, if Battle Priest Calibos dies, the mission ends.
Points can be obtained in three ways:
Completely defeating a wave of monsters. (Each wave is outlined in the table below.)
A 2 point hold-out bonus is awarded every minute.

Killing the 6 Luxon Adepts scattered across the map. They're 3 points each and every 3 minutes their point value increases by 3. You can view their current point value in the quest log. Defeating one will give your team a morale boost and the effect Rage of the Sea.

At the start of the mission, Battle Priest Calibos will greet the party and run to the top of the island. He will remain there to assist with healing and smiting spells, but cannot keep himself alive if left completely alone. Each wave is made up of several separate groups that immediately head toward the island once summoned.

It is a good idea to flag any Heroes and Henchmen in your party near Battle Priest Calibos at the start of the mission; this will ensure that they cover both sides equally and do not allow enemies to slip in on an unprotected side. You will not be moving from this spot until much later, if at all, so it is very advisable to bring skills which take advantage of this. Wells and wards in particular can be very advantageous here, because they will nearly always affect a large number of allies or enemies. It is also almost essential to have a minion master, or even better a minion bomber type character in your party, because this will provide a valuable meat shield which enemies will target preferentially over your party or Battle Priest Calibos.

Due to the massive number of enemies it is also advisable that you bring plenty of area of effect damage. Skills such as Splinter Weapon really shine here, so you might consider bringing multiple copies.

If you start to have difficulty with the Naga you may have to start focusing damage on single targets. Naga Archers in particular have block stances, and a self heal. If trying to bring down more than one at once your damage may become spread too thin, and you will have more difficulty killing them. From wave four you will start to see Oni and Saltspray Dragons. These have the potential to inflict a large amount of damage on your party, so it is wise to focus damage on these to bring them down quickly.

The reward for killing the 6 Luxon Adepts gradually increases, but they do not respawn, so it is advisable to wait as long as possible before defeating them. Rangers, ritualist spirits, or any character with ranged attacks can kill them while the rest of the party defends the priest. The location of each Adept is marked on the map above.
Spawns per wave

After you reach wave eight, each wave will afterwards consist of six Siege Turtles scattered across the map in pairs. Defeating all six in the time allotted for that wave will grant you a 50 point bonus, plus 5 points for each wave of turtles you have successfully destroyed previously. The turtles will attack from a large range, but then will be vulnerable while their attack is recharging.
When the turtles start spawning, they will stop attacking and just walk back and forth near their spawn point, allowing for infinite points and faction without any risk or effort
Skill Recommendations

Skills like Protective Spirit will be extremely useful in surviving the initial cannon blasts, which each do up to about 300 points of damage to their main target, and slightly less to foes in their AoE. Turtles will also try to flee during the times when their attack skill is recharging, making snares somewhat useful. Running skills can also help greatly with this stage, although it may not be possible to bring them if you have trouble holding out beyond the initial seven waves.

quests/quest:gww:9855/sections/notes-1/b.text: Like most challenge missions, the foes in this mission do not drop items when killed.
Your faction cap will increase by 1,000 Luxon faction the first time you finish this mission with 100 points or more.
If Luxon faction is maxed the first time you get over 100, you do not receive the extra end mission faction even when the limit is raised.

This challenge mission can be AFK farmed for Luxon faction points. As noted above, after wave 7 the mission bugs out, and never sends wave 8 and later waves to the island where Battle Priest Calibos stands. This allows players to gain 50 faction / minute indefinitely without any risk or effort. Certain hero team comps can successfully complete the first 7 waves without any player input.

quests/quest:gww:68265/sections/walkthro.text: The Great Destroyer skills
Description
Call of Destruction
Summons a group of Destroyers.
Enraged Blast
When interrupted, emits a blast of Energy that knocks down all foes within earshot and deals 115 damage.
Flame Jet (Hard mode only)
A jet of lava shoots out to target foe dealing 600 damage. If that foe is under the effects of an enchantment, the damage is halved.
Lava Blast
Lava surges upward, knocking down all foes standing in lava and dealing 75 damage.
Lava Ground
Creates a giant blast that melts earth into lava.
Lava Wave

Sends out a wave of lava that deals 100 fire damage to all Burning foes. While submerged in lava, the Great Destroyer gains 10 Health regeneration and is immune to all damage. Lava Wave ends after 12 seconds or if all other Destroyers are destroyed.
Searing Breath
Breathes a cone of fire that hits foes for 80 fire damage and 40 more fire damage for each enchantment on them. All Destroyers in the affected area are healed for 80 Health.

quests/quest:gww:11060/requirement/quest.text:
To get to the Fissure of Woe, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). Players must then either use a Passage Scroll to the Fissure of Woe (in Embark Beach or any of the following locations below), or pay 1000 gold to the Champion of Balthazar at a Statue of Balthazar in any of the following locations:
Chantry of Secrets
Temple of the Ages
Zin Ku Corridor

references.title: Guide to The Fissure of Woe

quests/quest:gww:2742/requirement/quest:.text:
To get to the Underworld, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). The party must be in one of the locations below and have a player either use a Passage Scroll to the Underworld or pay 1000 gold to the Voice of Grenth at a Statue of Grenth.
Embark Beach (No statue, scroll only)
Chantry of Secrets
Temple of the Ages
Zin Ku Corridor
Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)

Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed A Formal Introduction (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Sunqua Vale will be closed.
A Formal Introduction grants access, but any Factions characters without a secondary profession will be left behind in Sunqua Vale.
Access through Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area) is unavailable because the gate from Kinya Province to Ran Musu Gardens is closed if the party contains any characters that have not completed Minister Cho's Estate.

quests/quest:gww:6576/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed To Zen Daijun (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Haiju Lagoon will be closed.
To Zen Daijun grants access.
Access through Zen Daijun (explorable area) is unavailable because Guard Lae Fao will not grant access if the party contains any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun.

quests/quest:gww:10990/requirement/quest.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.

quests/quest:gww:6580/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Closer to the Stars (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Wajjun Bazaar will be closed.
Closer to the Stars grants access, but any characters that have not completed Vizunah Square will be left behind in Wajjun Bazaar.

quests/quest:gww:6582/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed To Tahnnakai Temple (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
To Tahnnakai Temple grants access, but any characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.

quests/quest:gww:6877/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but the gate from Arborstone (explorable area) is inaccessible from the north side of the area. However, there is a glitch that allows access to the southern side, from which you can simply walk into the mission outpost.
The Count's Daughter grants access, but any characters that have not completed Tahnnakai Temple will be left behind in Arborstone (explorable area).

quests/quest:gww:6886/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed The Convocation (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Pongmei Valley will be closed.
The Convocation grants access, but any characters that have not completed Arborstone will be left behind in Pongmei Valley.
Access through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Boreas Seabed.

quests/quest:gww:380/requirement/quest:g.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Battle in the Sewers (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
Battle in the Sewers grants access, but any characters that have not completed Boreas Seabed will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.

quests/quest:gww:8485/requirement/quest:.text:
Your party will not be able to enter this mission unless it has eight members.
If the party contains any characters that have not completed Into the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Morostav Trail will be closed, and if the party contains any characters that have not completed Journey to the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Silent Surf will be closed.
Into the Whirlpool and Journey to the Whirlpool grant access, but any characters that have not completed The Eternal Grove will be left behind in Morostav Trail.

quests/quest:gww:8469/requirement/quest:.text:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed The Defenders of the Forest (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Drazach Thicket will be closed.
The Defenders of the Forest grants access, but any characters that have not completed Befriending the Kurzicks will be left behind in Drazach Thicket.
Alternatively, it is possible for any character to walk into the outpost from The Eternal Grove (explorable area), but this first requires you to complete Unwaking Waters from the Luxon side and glitch through the gate from Unwaking Waters (explorable area) to Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).

quests/quest:gww:17278/requirement/quest.text:

Access through Gyala Hatchery (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Befriending the Luxons.
